// Smoke test for the preview page: loads index.html in headless Chrome with each given
// query, waits for the preview to start, reports errors and saves a screenshot.
//   node shared/renderer/scripts/smoke.mjs --song songs/2am-crying/video --q "t=23" --q "layout=16x9&t=40" [--shots dir]
import path from 'node:path';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import puppeteer from 'puppeteer-core';
import { createServer, listen, REPO } from './serve.mjs';

const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const song = argv.includes('--song') ? argv[argv.indexOf('--song') + 1] : 'songs/2am-crying/video';
const qs = argv.flatMap((a, i) => (a === '--q' ? [argv[i + 1]] : []));
const shots = argv.includes('--shots') ? argv[argv.indexOf('--shots') + 1] : null;
const srv = createServer(REPO);
const port = await listen(srv, 0);
const b = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: process.env.CHROME || '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome', headless: true, defaultViewport: { width: 1280, height: 1000 } });
let bad = 0;
for (const q of qs.length ? qs : ['t=0']) {
  const p = await b.newPage();
  const errs = [];
  p.on('pageerror', (e) => errs.push(String(e)));
  p.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error' && !/favicon|404/.test(m.text())) errs.push(m.text()); });
  await p.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/${song}/index.html?${q}`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
  await p.waitForFunction('window.__preview || (window.__render && window.__render.error)', { timeout: 30000 });
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));
  const info = await p.evaluate(() => ({ err: document.getElementById('pv-err')?.textContent || '', bar: [...document.querySelectorAll('.pv-bar span')].map((s) => s.textContent).join(' | ') }));
  if (info.err || errs.length) bad++;
  console.log(`[smoke] ${q}: ${info.bar}${info.err ? '\n  RENDER ERROR: ' + info.err : ''}${errs.length ? '\n  ' + errs.join('\n  ') : ''}`);
  if (shots) { fs.mkdirSync(shots, { recursive: true }); await p.screenshot({ path: path.join(shots, `preview-${q.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '_')}.png`) }); }
  await p.close();
}
await b.close();
srv.close();
process.exit(bad ? 1 : 0);

// Text helpers for canvas: font strings, fitting, tracking, wrapping.

export const font = (weight, size, family, style = '') => `${style ? style + ' ' : ''}${weight} ${Math.max(1, size).toFixed(2)}px ${family}`;

/** Largest font size (<= maxSize) at which `text` fits in maxW (and optionally maxH by cap height). */
export function fitSize(ctx, text, { weight = 900, family, maxW, maxH = Infinity, maxSize = 400, minSize = 8, tracking = 0 }) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.font = font(weight, 100, family);
  ctx.letterSpacing = '0px';
  const w100 = ctx.measureText(text).width + tracking * 100 * Math.max(0, text.length - 1);
  ctx.restore();
  let s = w100 > 0 ? (maxW / w100) * 100 : maxSize;
  s = Math.min(s, maxSize, maxH / 0.72);
  return Math.max(minSize, s);
}

/** Draw text with letter spacing (em fraction) using canvas letterSpacing. */
export function tracked(ctx, text, x, y, trackingEm = 0, size = null) {
  const prev = ctx.letterSpacing;
  if (trackingEm) {
    const px = size ?? parseFloat(ctx.font.match(/([\d.]+)px/)?.[1] || '16');
    ctx.letterSpacing = `${(trackingEm * px).toFixed(2)}px`;
  }
  ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
  ctx.letterSpacing = prev;
}

export function measure(ctx, text, f) {
  if (f) ctx.font = f;
  return ctx.measureText(text).width;
}

/** Greedy word wrap into lines no wider than maxW. */
export function wrap(ctx, text, maxW) {
  const words = String(text).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const out = [];
  let cur = '';
  for (const w of words) {
    const t = cur ? cur + ' ' + w : w;
    if (ctx.measureText(t).width <= maxW || !cur) cur = t;
    else { out.push(cur); cur = w; }
  }
  if (cur) out.push(cur);
  return out;
}

/** Rounded rectangle path. */
export function rrect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
  r = Math.max(0, Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2));
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
// Palettes are plain objects of hex colors. A frame may blend two palettes (day/night
// inversion), so every consumer reads colors from the palette it is handed.

import { clamp } from './util.js';

const cache = new Map();
export function rgbOf(c) {
  if (Array.isArray(c)) return c;
  let v = cache.get(c);
  if (v) return v;
  const s = String(c).trim();
  if (s[0] === '#') {
    const h = s.length === 4 ? s.slice(1).split('').map((x) => x + x).join('') : s.slice(1, 7);
    v = [parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16), parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16), parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16)];
  } else {
    const m = s.match(/rgba?\(([^)]+)\)/);
    v = m ? m[1].split(',').slice(0, 3).map((x) => parseFloat(x)) : [255, 0, 255];
  }
  cache.set(c, v);
  return v;
}
export const rgb = (r, g, b) => `rgb(${r | 0},${g | 0},${b | 0})`;
export function rgba(c, a = 1) {
  const [r, g, b] = rgbOf(c);
  return `rgba(${r | 0},${g | 0},${b | 0},${clamp(a).toFixed(4)})`;
}
export function mix(c1, c2, k) {
  k = clamp(k);
  if (k === 0) return c1;
  if (k === 1) return c2;
  const a = rgbOf(c1), b = rgbOf(c2);
  return rgb(a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * k);
}
/** Blend every key present in palette a with the same key in b. */
export function blendPalette(a, b, k) {
  if (k <= 0) return a;
  if (k >= 1) return b;
  const out = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(a)) out[key] = key in b && typeof a[key] === 'string' ? mix(a[key], b[key], k) : a[key];
  out.name = `${a.name}~${b.name}`;
  out.dayness = (a.dayness ?? 0) * (1 - k) + (b.dayness ?? 0) * k;
  return out;
}
/** Perceived luminance 0..1 (for picking legible overlays). */
export function luma(c) {
  const [r, g, b] = rgbOf(c);
  return (0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b) / 255;
}
// Generic HUD drawing helpers (song code composes them into its own HUD).

import { clamp } from './util.js';
import { rrect } from './text.js';
import { rgba } from './theme.js';

/** Minutes since midnight -> "02:00 AM" (12-hour) or "02:00" (24-hour). */
export function clockText(minutes, { h24 = false, ampm = true } = {}) {
  let m = Math.floor(((minutes % 1440) + 1440) % 1440);
  const hh = Math.floor(m / 60), mm = m % 60;
  if (h24) return `${String(hh).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(mm).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const h12 = hh % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hh % 12;
  return `${String(h12).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(mm).padStart(2, '0')}${ampm ? (hh < 12 ? ' AM' : ' PM') : ''}`;
}

export function drawBattery(ctx, x, y, w, h, level, color, alpha = 1) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, h * 0.12);
  rrect(ctx, x, y, w, h, h * 0.18);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillRect(x + w + h * 0.06, y + h * 0.3, h * 0.14, h * 0.4);
  const pad = h * 0.2;
  ctx.fillRect(x + pad, y + pad, (w - pad * 2) * clamp(level), h - pad * 2);
  ctx.restore();
}

export function drawSignal(ctx, x, y, h, level, color, dimColor, n = 4) {
  const bw = h * 0.22, gap = h * 0.12;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const bh = h * (0.3 + (0.7 * (i + 1)) / n);
    ctx.fillStyle = i < Math.round(level * n) ? color : dimColor;
    ctx.fillRect(x + i * (bw + gap), y + h - bh, bw, bh);
  }
}

export function drawDot(ctx, x, y, r, color, alpha = 1) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

/** Thin progress bar with a track. */
export function drawBar(ctx, x, y, w, h, frac, fg, track, alpha = 1) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = track;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.fillStyle = fg;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w * clamp(frac), h);
  ctx.restore();
}

/** Corner brackets (camera framing marks). */
export function drawBrackets(ctx, x, y, w, h, len, color, lw = 3, alpha = 1) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = lw;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (const [cx, cy, sx, sy] of [[x, y, 1, 1], [x + w, y, -1, 1], [x, y + h, 1, -1], [x + w, y + h, -1, -1]]) {
    ctx.moveTo(cx + sx * len, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + sy * len);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

export { rgba };
// Suno lyric sheet -> section ids per line, for timing data that has no `section` field.
// Same rules as shared/align/common.py (parse_sheet / section_ids):
//   `[Section - notes]` headers name the section: the text before " - ", lowercased,
//   spaces dropped ("Verse 1" -> verse1); "Final Chorus" -> final; a plain name (no
//   trailing digit) that occurs more than once is numbered by occurrence (Chorus, Chorus
//   -> chorus1, chorus2). Blank lines are skipped, pure stage-direction parentheticals
//   ("(instrumental)") are dropped from a line, punctuation-only lines are skipped.

const STAGE = /^(instrumental|.*\bsolo|.*\bbreak(down)?|beat drop|drop|fade( out)?|silence|pause|applause|music|outro music|intro music|end)$/i;

export function sectionId(name) {
  const base = String(name).split(' - ')[0].trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
  return base === 'finalchorus' ? 'final' : base;
}

/** Section id per header occurrence, in sheet order. */
export function sectionIds(headers) {
  const base = headers.map(sectionId);
  const count = {}, seen = {};
  for (const b of base) count[b] = (count[b] || 0) + 1;
  return base.map((b) => {
    if (count[b] > 1 && !/\d$/.test(b)) { seen[b] = (seen[b] || 0) + 1; return `${b}${seen[b]}`; }
    return b;
  });
}

/** Sheet text -> [{ text, section, header }] lyric lines in sheet order. */
export function parseSheet(text) {
  const raw = [], headers = [];
  for (const r of String(text).split(/\r?\n/)) {
    let s = r.trim();
    if (!s) continue;
    if (s.startsWith('[') && s.endsWith(']')) { headers.push(s.slice(1, -1).split(' - ')[0].trim()); continue; }
    s = s.replace(/\(([^()]*)\)/g, (m, inner) => (STAGE.test(inner.trim().replace(/^[ .]+|[ .]+$/g, '')) ? '' : m)).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (!s || !/[a-z0-9]/i.test(s)) continue;
    raw.push({ text: s, h: headers.length - 1 });
  }
  const ids = sectionIds(headers);
  return raw.map((l) => ({ text: l.text, section: l.h >= 0 ? ids[l.h] : '', header: l.h >= 0 ? headers[l.h] : '' }));
}
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Static file server for the preview page (ES modules + fetch need http://, and <audio>
// seeking needs Range support). Serves the repo root.
//
//   node shared/renderer/scripts/serve.mjs [--port 8123]
//   open http://localhost:8123/songs/2am-crying/video/index.html?t=23

import http from 'node:http';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

export const REPO = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', '..', '..');

const MIME = {
  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.mjs': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
  '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8', '.png': 'image/png', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg',
  '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.wav': 'audio/wav', '.mp3': 'audio/mpeg', '.mp4': 'video/mp4', '.woff2': 'font/woff2',
  '.ttf': 'font/ttf', '.txt': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', '.md': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
};

export function createServer(root = REPO) {
  return http.createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://x');
      let p = path.normalize(decodeURIComponent(url.pathname)).replace(/^([/\\])+/, '');
      const file = path.join(root, p);
      if (!file.startsWith(root)) { res.writeHead(403); return res.end(); }
      let st;
      try { st = fs.statSync(file); } catch { res.writeHead(404); return res.end('not found'); }
      if (st.isDirectory()) {
        const idx = path.join(file, 'index.html');
        if (fs.existsSync(idx)) { res.writeHead(302, { Location: url.pathname.replace(/\/?$/, '/') + 'index.html' + url.search }); return res.end(); }
        res.writeHead(404); return res.end();
      }
      const type = MIME[path.extname(file).toLowerCase()] || 'application/octet-stream';
      const headers = { 'Content-Type': type, 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', 'Accept-Ranges': 'bytes' };
      const range = req.headers.range && /bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)/.exec(req.headers.range);
      if (range) {
        const a = range[1] ? parseInt(range[1], 10) : 0;
        const b = range[2] ? Math.min(parseInt(range[2], 10), st.size - 1) : st.size - 1;
        if (a > b || a >= st.size) { res.writeHead(416, { 'Content-Range': `bytes */${st.size}` }); return res.end(); }
        res.writeHead(206, { ...headers, 'Content-Range': `bytes ${a}-${b}/${st.size}`, 'Content-Length': b - a + 1 });
        if (req.method === 'HEAD') return res.end();
        return fs.createReadStream(file, { start: a, end: b }).pipe(res);
      }
      res.writeHead(200, { ...headers, 'Content-Length': st.size });
      if (req.method === 'HEAD') return res.end();
      fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res);
    } catch (e) {
      res.writeHead(500); res.end(String(e));
    }
  });
}

export function listen(server, port = 0, host = '127.0.0.1') {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    server.once('error', reject);
    server.listen(port, host, () => resolve(server.address().port));
  });
}

if (process.argv[1] && fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === path.resolve(process.argv[1])) {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const port = args.includes('--port') ? Number(args[args.indexOf('--port') + 1]) : 8123;
  const srv = createServer();
  listen(srv, port, '0.0.0.0').then((p) => {
    console.log(`serving ${REPO}`);
    console.log(`  http://localhost:${p}/songs/2am-crying/video/index.html?t=0`);
  });
}
// Preview page: scrub and play the video against the audio file.
//   Space play/pause · ←/→ one beat (shift: one bar) · ,/. one frame · [/] prev/next plate
//   ?t=23 start time · ?plate=hook&n=2 jump to a plate's hero · ?res=720 canvas height
//   ?layout=16x9 secondary layout (songs that declare layouts)
//   ?audio=<url> override the audio file

import { createEngine } from './core/engine.js';
import { fmtTime } from './core/util.js';

const PLATE_COLORS = ['#4b6584', '#8854d0', '#20bf6b', '#eb3b5a', '#fa8231', '#0fb9b1', '#f7b731', '#a5b1c2', '#3867d6', '#e056fd', '#26de81', '#fd9644'];

async function exists(url) {
  try { const r = await fetch(url, { method: 'HEAD', cache: 'no-store' }); return r.ok; } catch { return false; }
}

// Baby Clawd moved to shared/clawd/baby.js (the baby-facts video draws it too); this
// re-export keeps the 2am scenes' imports unchanged.
export * from '../../../shared/clawd/baby.js';
// "2AM (And I'm Crying)", v3 "the day": the baby's selfie video. Song module for the
// shared renderer. Every frame: map the outro onto the intro (the loop), build a clip
// descriptor, draw the camera frame (clip under the camera transform -> lens post ->
// lens overlays -> caption -> status bar), then lay it out: full frame (9:16) or inside a
// phone on a soft nursery backdrop (16:9).

import { drawCaption } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/caption.js';
import { rgba, mix } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/theme.js';
import { rrect } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/text.js';
import { clamp, TAU } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { timeline, SECTION_PLATES } from './clips.js';
import { makeStory } from './story.js';
import { grade, skyBody } from './tod.js';
import { drawStatusBar } from './statusbar.js';
import { cameraTransform, lensPost } from './camera.js';
import { CW, CH } from './props.js';
import hello from './scenes/hello.js';
import closeup from './scenes/closeup.js';
import crib from './scenes/crib.js';
import nap from './scenes/nap.js';
import pooping from './scenes/pooping.js';
import standing from './scenes/standing.js';
import highchair from './scenes/highchair.js';
import fan from './scenes/fan.js';
import bath from './scenes/bath.js';
import rear from './scenes/rear.js';
import grid from './scenes/grid.js';

export const FONTS = [
  { family: 'Archivo Black', weight: 400 },
  { family: 'IBM Plex Mono', weight: 500 }, { family: 'IBM Plex Mono', weight: 600 }, { family: 'IBM Plex Mono', weight: 700 },
  { family: 'Inter', weight: 700 }, { family: 'Inter', weight: 900 }, { family: 'Inter', weight: 900, style: 'italic' },
  { family: 'Nunito', weight: 900 },
];

export const scenes = {
  hello, closeup, crib, nap, pooping, standing, highchair, fan, bath, rear, grid,
};

export const CAPTION = { x: 540, y: 560, maxW: 900, size: 88, minSize: 56, family: '"Inter", sans-serif', weight: 900 };

/** Words the caption shows at t for this window. */
function captionWords(env, w, t) {
  const st = env.story;
  if (w.plate === 'hello') return w.lines.flatMap((l) => l.words);
  const c = st.clauseAt(t, w);
  return c ? c.words : [];
}

/** Clip descriptor: everything a clip type needs, nothing read from global state. */
export function makeClip(env, t, w, extra = {}) {
  const st = env.story;
  const min = extra.min ?? st.clock(t);
  const G = grade(min);
  return {
    type: w.plate, params: w.params, win: w, t, lt: t - w.start, dur: w.dur, start: w.start, end: w.end,
    min, G, night: G.light.night > 0.5, words: captionWords(env, w, t), clause: st.clauseAt(t, w),
    B: env.B, L: env.L, env, fps: env.fps, story: st, tile: false, ...extra,
  };
}

/** Draw one camera frame (1080x1920 camera space) for clip C. */
export function drawCameraFrame(ctx, C, { chrome = true } = {}) {
  const scene = scenes[C.type];
  const cam = scene.camera?.(C) || {};
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(0, 0, CW, CH); ctx.clip();
  ctx.fillStyle = C.G.wall;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CW, CH);
  ctx.save();
  cameraTransform(ctx, C, C.tile ? { ...cam, still: true } : cam);
  scene.draw(ctx, C);
  ctx.restore();
  lensPost(ctx, C, cam);
  if (scene.overlay) { ctx.save(); scene.overlay(ctx, C); ctx.restore(); }
  if (chrome) {
    const capOpts = scene.caption ? scene.caption(C) : {};
    if (capOpts !== false) drawCaption(ctx, C.t, C.words, { ...CAPTION, ...capOpts });
    const st = C.story;
    drawStatusBar(ctx, { min: C.min, battery: st.battery(C.t), rec: st.rec(C.t) });
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---- 16:9: the phone centred on a soft, out-of-focus nursery ---------------------------
const PHONE = { sx: 690, sy: 60, sw: 540, sh: 960, bezel: 16, r: 64 };

function drawBackdrop(ctx, C) {
  const G = C.G;
  const W = 1920, H = 1080;
  ctx.fillStyle = G.wall;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const night = G.light.night;
  // window light (left), soft
  const wx = 330, wy = 380;
  let g = ctx.createRadialGradient(wx, wy, 40, wx, wy, 520);
  g.addColorStop(0, rgba(mix(G.window, '#ffffff', 0.3), 0.85 * (1 - night) + 0.1));
  g.addColorStop(0.5, rgba(G.window, 0.35 * (1 - night) + 0.04));
  g.addColorStop(1, rgba(G.window, 0));
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  // crib slats (right), out of focus
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    const x = 1360 + i * 62;
    const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x - 26, 0, x + 26, 0);
    sg.addColorStop(0, rgba(G.crib, 0));
    sg.addColorStop(0.5, rgba(G.crib, 0.55));
    sg.addColorStop(1, rgba(G.crib, 0));
    ctx.fillStyle = sg;
    ctx.fillRect(x - 26, 470, 52, 520);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = rgba(G.crib, 0.4);
  ctx.fillRect(1310, 440, 600, 40);
  // floor
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 900, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, rgba(G.floor, 0));
  g.addColorStop(1, rgba(G.floor, 0.9));
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 900, W, 180);
  // a lamp bokeh at night
  if (night > 0.3) {
    for (const [bx, by, br] of [[260, 760, 70], [330, 700, 40], [1700, 300, 55]]) {
      const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, 0, bx, by, br);
      bg.addColorStop(0, rgba('#ffcf8a', 0.35 * night));
      bg.addColorStop(1, rgba('#ffcf8a', 0));
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx, by, br, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  // the sun / moon arc (top right)
  const ax = 1660, ay = 230, ar = 150;
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(night > 0.5 ? '#c9d3ff' : mix(G.wall, '#000000', 0.45), 0.55);
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 12]);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ax, ay, ar, Math.PI, TAU); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  const sb = skyBody(C.min);
  const a = Math.PI + sb.p * Math.PI;
  const px = ax + Math.cos(a) * ar, py = ay + Math.sin(a) * ar;
  ctx.fillStyle = sb.body === 'sun' ? '#ffd36b' : '#e8ecff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 18, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  if (sb.body === 'moon') { ctx.fillStyle = G.wall; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px + 8, py - 6, 15, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
  // soft vignette
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 300, W / 2, H / 2, 1150);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  g.addColorStop(1, `rgba(0,0,0,${0.35 + 0.3 * night})`);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawPhone(ctx, C) {
  const p = PHONE;
  // shadow
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.sx + p.sw / 2, p.sy + p.sh * 0.55, p.sw * 0.3, p.sx + p.sw / 2, p.sy + p.sh * 0.55, p.sh * 0.75);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(p.sx - 400, p.sy - 200, p.sw + 800, p.sh + 400);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0d10';
  rrect(ctx, p.sx - p.bezel, p.sy - p.bezel, p.sw + 2 * p.bezel, p.sh + 2 * p.bezel, p.r + p.bezel);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  rrect(ctx, p.sx, p.sy, p.sw, p.sh, p.r);
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.translate(p.sx, p.sy);
  ctx.scale(p.sw / CW, p.sh / CH);
  drawCameraFrame(ctx, C);
  ctx.restore();
}

export default {
  id: '2am-crying',
  layouts: { '9x16': { w: 1080, h: 1920 }, '16x9': { w: 1920, h: 1080 } },
  defaultLayout: '9x16',
  fonts: FONTS,
  timeline,
  sectionPlates: SECTION_PLATES,   // render.mjs reports these at start-up (MISSING if absent)
  scenes,
  audioCandidates(audio) {
    const synth = ['../synth/out/2am_crying.wav'];
    const click = ['audio/click.wav'];
    // a real take names its file in the source: "suno runE2 13e92be2 (../audio/runE2/<file>.mp3)"
    const named = /\(([^()]+\.(?:mp3|wav|m4a))\)/.exec(String(audio.source || ''));
    if (named) return [named[1], ...click];
    return String(audio.source || '').startsWith('synth') ? [...synth, ...click] : [...click];
  },
  setup(env) {
    env.story = makeStory(env);
    env.drawCameraFrame = drawCameraFrame;   // the grid draws other clips as tiles
  },
  /** The song time whose frame an outro frame repeats (render.mjs --check compares the two). */
  loopSource(env, t) { return env.story.loopTime(t); },
  /** Extra contact-sheet cells: stages of the long take and the grid filling in. */
  sheetCells(env) {
    const out = [];
    for (const w of env.T.windows) {
      if (w.plate === 'nap' && w.params.mode === 'long') for (const f of [0.3, 0.72, 0.9]) out.push({ t: w.start + w.dur * f, label: `long ${Math.round(f * 100)}%` });
      if (w.plate === 'nap' && w.params.mode === 'tip') out.push({ t: w.start + w.dur * 0.68, label: 'tip 68%' });
      if (w.plate === 'grid') for (const f of [0.2, 0.97]) out.push({ t: w.start + w.dur * f, label: `grid ${Math.round(f * 100)}%` });
    }
    return out;
  },
  frame(ctx, t, env) {
    const st = env.story;
    const tm = st.loopTime(t);
    const w = st.windowFor(tm);
    const C = makeClip(env, tm, w);
    if (env.layout === '16x9') {
      drawBackdrop(ctx, C);
      drawPhone(ctx, C);
    } else {
      drawCameraFrame(ctx, C);
    }
  },
};
// Song-level curves for v3 "the day", all derived from lyric content:
//   loopTime(t)  outro frames map frame-exactly onto intro frames (the video loops)
//   clock(t)     status-bar clock, minutes since midnight (the escalating number)
//   battery(t)   drains across the day, charges during naps
//   rec(t)       record dot + running timer (starts with the beat in the intro)
//   clause(t)    the time clause on screen (caption words, minutes)

import { clamp, lerp, bisect } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { clausesOf } from './clips.js';

const NAP_TYPES = new Set(['nap']);

export function makeStory(env) {
  const { L, B, T } = env;
  const clauses = clausesOf(L);
  const W = T.windows;
  const intro = W[0];
  const outro = W.find((w) => w.plate === 'hello' && w.params.loop) || null;

  // The outro is the intro again, frame-exactly: outro frame k shows intro frame k - shift
  // (same t -> same pixels, every input included). The shift lines the outro's "Hi" up with
  // the intro's: a real vocal does not start them at the same offset into their windows
  // (Suno runE2: 2.80 s into the intro, 0.18 s into the outro), and the caption is the
  // lyric. It is a whole number of frames, so every outro frame is an intro frame.
  const fps = env.fps || 30;
  const hiIntro = L.findLine({ match: 'Hi', section: 'intro' });
  const hiOutro = L.findLine({ match: 'Hi', section: 'outro' });
  const shiftFrames = outro
    ? Math.round(((hiIntro && hiOutro) ? hiOutro.start - hiIntro.start : outro.start - intro.start) * fps)
    : 0;
  function loopTime(t) {
    if (!outro || t < outro.start) return t;
    return Math.max(intro.start, (Math.round(t * fps) - shiftFrames) / fps);
  }
  const windowFor = (t) => (outro && t >= outro.start ? intro : T.windowAt(t));

  // ---- which clause is on screen ---------------------------------------------------
  function clauseAt(t, w = windowFor(t)) {
    const p = w.params;
    if (p.clause != null) return clauses[p.clause];
    if (p.clauses) {
      const list = p.clauses.map((i) => clauses[i]);
      let cur = list[0];
      for (const c of list) if (B.snap(c.start, 'downbeat') <= t + 1e-6 || c.start <= t) cur = c;
      return cur;
    }
    return null;
  }

  // ---- clock -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const INTRO_MIN = 119; // 1:59am: the phone wakes a minute before the first clip
  function clock(t) {
    const w = windowFor(t);
    if (w.plate === 'hello') return INTRO_MIN;
    if (w.plate === 'nap' && w.params.mode === 'long') {
      // the one long take ticks minute by minute between the sung times
      const list = w.params.clauses.map((i) => clauses[i]);
      const i = bisect(list, t, (c) => c.start);
      if (i < 0) return list[0].min;
      const a = list[i], b = list[i + 1];
      if (!b) return a.min + Math.floor(clamp((t - a.start) / (w.end - a.start)) * 1.99);
      return Math.floor(lerp(a.min, b.min, clamp((t - a.start) / (b.start - a.start))));
    }
    const c = clauseAt(t, w);
    return c ? c.min : INTRO_MIN;
  }

  // ---- battery: integrate drain / charge over the windows ------------------------------
  const DRAIN = 1.8, CHARGE = 2.0; // percent per second: ends the day in the red
  const isNap = (w) => NAP_TYPES.has(w.plate);
  const batt0 = [];
  let lvl = 100;
  for (const w of W) {
    batt0.push(lvl);
    if (w === outro) break;
    lvl = clamp(lvl + (isNap(w) ? CHARGE : -DRAIN) * w.dur, 4, 100);
  }
  function battery(t) {
    const w = windowFor(t);
    const i = W.indexOf(w);
    const v = batt0[i] + (isNap(w) ? CHARGE : -DRAIN) * (t - w.start);
    return { level: clamp(v, 4, 100) / 100, charging: isNap(w) };
  }

  // ---- record dot + timer -------------------------------------------------------------
  const untz = L.findLine({ match: 'untz', section: 'intro' }) || L.findLine({ match: 'untz' });
  const recStart = untz ? B.snap(untz.start, 'downbeat') : intro.start + B.barDur;
  function rec(t) {
    const tt = loopTime(t);
    if (tt < recStart) return { on: false, secs: 0 };
    return { on: true, secs: tt - recStart };
  }

  return { clauses, loopTime, loopShift: shiftFrames / fps, windowFor, clauseAt, clock, battery, rec, recStart, intro, outro };
}

// Clips from lyric content. Every "It's <time> and I'm <doing>" clause is one clip; the
// rule table maps the clause's words to a clip TYPE (scene module) and its params. The
// bridge is one long take, the final chorus one grid, the outro is the intro again.

import { norm } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/lyrics.js';

const HM = (h, m = 0) => h * 60 + m;

/** "2am" / "12pm" / "5:45" / "10:30" -> minutes since midnight. am/pm inferred for h:mm. */
export function minutesOf(text, prevMin = null) {
  const s = String(text).toLowerCase();
  let m = s.match(/(\d{1,2})\s*([ap])\.?\s*m\b/);
  if (m) { let h = +m[1] % 12; if (m[2] === 'p') h += 12; return HM(h); }
  m = s.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (m) {
    // h:mm without am/pm: take the reading closest after the previous clause's time
    const h = +m[1] % 12, mm = +m[2];
    const am = HM(h, mm), pm = HM(h + 12, mm);
    if (prevMin == null) return am;
    const fwd = (x) => (x - prevMin + 1440) % 1440;
    return fwd(am) <= fwd(pm) ? am : pm;
  }
  return null;
}

/** Split lyric lines into time clauses: a clause starts at "It's" followed by a word with a digit. */
export function clausesOf(L) {
  const out = [];
  let prevMin = null;
  for (const line of L.lines) {
    let cur = null;
    line.words.forEach((w, k) => {
      const next = line.words[k + 1];
      const starts = norm(w.w) === 'its' && next && /\d/.test(next.w) && !w.backing;
      if (starts) {
        cur = { words: [], line, section: line.section, start: w.start };
        out.push(cur);
      }
      if (cur) cur.words.push(w);
      else if (out.length && out.at(-1).section === line.section && !/^(intro|outro)$/.test(line.section)) out.at(-1).words.push(w);
    });
  }
  for (const c of out) {
    c.text = c.words.filter((w) => !w.backing).map((w) => w.w).join(' ');
    c.n = norm(c.text);
    c.end = c.words.at(-1).end;
    c.min = minutesOf(c.text, prevMin);
    prevMin = c.min;
    c.verb = c.n.replace(/^its \S+ (and )?/, '');
  }
  out.forEach((c, i) => { c.index = i; });
  return out;
}

// [pattern on the normalized clause, type, params]. First match wins.
export const RULES = [
  [/^its 2am and im crying/, 'crib', { stage: 0 }],
  [/^its 3am and im crying/, 'crib', { stage: 1 }],
  [/^its 4am and im crying/, 'crib', { stage: 2 }],
  [/^its 5am and im quiet/, 'crib', { mode: 'quiet' }],
  [/^its 7:45 and im sleeping/, 'crib', { mode: 'fake' }],
  [/^its (8pm|9pm) and im sleeping/, 'crib', { mode: 'sleep' }],
  [/^its 11pm and were sleeping/, 'crib', { mode: 'sleep', dark: 1 }],
  [/^its 12am and im sleeping/, 'crib', { mode: 'sleep', dark: 2 }],
  [/^its 1am and im/, 'crib', { mode: 'void' }],
  [/^its 10pm and youre sleeping/, 'rear', {}],
  [/^its 11am and im napping/, 'nap', { mode: 'tip' }],
  [/^its 3pm and im napping/, 'nap', { mode: 'carseat' }],
  [/^its 1pm and im pooping$/, 'pooping', {}],
  [/^its 2pm and im pooping again/, 'pooping', { again: true }],
  [/^its 12pm and im crying/, 'highchair', { mode: 'spoon' }],
  [/^its (8am|6pm) and im eating/, 'highchair', { mode: 'eat' }],
  [/^its 8:05 and im throwing it/, 'highchair', { mode: 'throw' }],
  [/^its 6:05 and the floor is eating/, 'highchair', { mode: 'floor' }],
  [/^its 5:45 and im up/, 'standing', { mode: 'up' }],
  [/^its 6am and im standing/, 'standing', { mode: 'stand' }],
  [/^its 6:15 and im still standing/, 'standing', { mode: 'stand', timer: true }],
  [/^its 7:30 and im wearing it/, 'standing', { mode: 'wearing' }],
  [/^its 7:15 and im naked and im running/, 'standing', { mode: 'run' }],
  [/^its 7pm and im splashing/, 'bath', {}],
  [/^its 10:30 and im pointing at the fan/, 'fan', { mode: 'point' }],
  [/^its 5:30 and im crying at the fan/, 'fan', { mode: 'cry' }],
  [/^its (7am|4pm) and im drinking/, 'closeup', { prop: 'bottle' }],
  [/^its 9am and im reading/, 'closeup', { prop: 'book' }],
  [/^its 9:01 and im eating it/, 'closeup', { prop: 'book', bite: true }],
  [/^its 7:30 and im reading/, 'closeup', { prop: 'book', crib: true }],
  [/^its 10am and im pointing/, 'closeup', { prop: 'point' }],
  [/^its 10:45 and im fighting it/, 'closeup', { mode: 'fight' }],
  [/^its 5pm and im crying/, 'closeup', { mode: 'cry' }],
];

export function ruleFor(clause) {
  for (const [re, type, params] of RULES) if (re.test(clause.n)) return { type, params: { ...params }, matched: String(re) };
  return { type: 'closeup', params: {}, matched: null };
}

/**
 * Plates that exist only because of a line's section id. If the sections are wrong (e.g.
 * audio.json's detected s1..s11 instead of the sheet's ids) they silently vanish, so
 * render.mjs lists them at start-up and flags any that are MISSING.
 */
export const SECTION_PLATES = [
  { label: 'bridge long take', section: 'bridge', plate: 'nap' },
  { label: 'final chorus grid', section: 'final', plate: 'grid' },
  { label: 'outro loop', section: 'outro', plate: 'hello' },
];

/** Timeline spec function: the engine calls it with the parsed lyrics and beat grid. */
export function timeline({ lyrics, beats }) {
  const clauses = clausesOf(lyrics);
  const entries = [{ plate: 'hello', at: { time: 0 }, params: { loop: false }, hero: (w) => w.start + w.dur * 0.62 }];
  const hero80 = (w) => w.start + w.dur * 0.8;
  const fallbacks = [];
  for (const c of clauses) {
    if (c.section === 'bridge') {
      if (!entries.some((e) => e.plate === 'nap' && e.params.mode === 'long')) {
        entries.push({ plate: 'nap', params: { mode: 'long', clauses: clauses.filter((x) => x.section === 'bridge').map((x) => x.index) }, at: { t: c.start, why: 'bridge long take' }, fromSection: 'bridge long take', hero: (w) => w.start + w.dur * 0.5 });
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (c.section === 'final') {
      if (!entries.some((e) => e.plate === 'grid')) {
        entries.push({ plate: 'grid', params: { clauses: clauses.filter((x) => x.section === 'final').map((x) => x.index) }, at: { t: c.start, why: 'final chorus grid' }, fromSection: 'final chorus grid', hero: (w) => w.start + w.dur * 0.55 });
      }
      continue;
    }
    const rule = ruleFor(c);
    if (!rule.matched) fallbacks.push(c.text);
    entries.push({
      plate: rule.type,
      params: { ...rule.params, clause: c.index },
      at: { t: c.start, why: c.text },
      snap: /^verse/.test(c.section) ? 'halfbar' : 'downbeat',
      hero: hero80,
    });
  }
  const outro = lyrics.findLine({ match: 'Hi', section: 'outro' });
  if (outro) entries.push({ plate: 'hello', params: { loop: true }, at: { line: 'Hi', section: 'outro', why: 'outro loop' }, fromSection: 'outro loop', hero: (w) => w.start + w.dur * 0.62 });
  if (fallbacks.length) console.warn(`[clips] ${fallbacks.length} clause(s) matched no rule and use the closeup fallback:\n  ${fallbacks.join('\n  ')}`);
  const got = SECTION_PLATES.map((sp) => ({ ...sp, e: entries.find((e) => e.fromSection === sp.label) }));
  const lost = got.filter((g) => !g.e);
  if (lost.length) {
    const have = [...new Set(lyrics.lines.map((l) => l.section))].join(', ');
    console.warn(`[clips] MISSING section plate(s): ${lost.map((g) => `${g.label} (no line in section "${g.section}")`).join('; ')}. Line sections: ${have}`);
  }
  return entries;
}
// Phone status bar (camera space, top 110 px): clock = the escalating number, a red
// record dot with a running timer, signal and a battery that drains across the day and
// charges (bolt) during naps.

import { clamp } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { rrect } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/text.js';

export const SB = { h: 112, y: 70 };
const SANS = '"Inter", sans-serif';
const MONO = '"IBM Plex Mono", monospace';

/** 12-hour, no am/pm, no leading zero: the way a phone shows it. */
export function phoneClock(min) {
  const m = Math.floor(((min % 1440) + 1440) % 1440);
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60) % 12 || 12;
  return `${h}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
export const recText = (secs) => `${String(Math.floor(secs / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(Math.floor(secs % 60)).padStart(2, '0')}`;

export function drawStatusBar(ctx, { min, battery, rec, alpha = 1, dark = false }) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  // a soft scrim so white glyphs read on a white noon wall
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 190);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.34)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1080, 190);
  const fg = dark ? '#111111' : '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillStyle = fg;
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  // clock
  ctx.font = `700 46px ${SANS}`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(phoneClock(min), 74, SB.y + 6);
  // record pill (centre)
  if (rec && rec.on) {
    ctx.font = `600 36px ${MONO}`;
    const txt = recText(rec.secs);
    const tw = ctx.measureText(txt).width;
    const pw = tw + 86, px = 540 - pw / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    rrect(ctx, px, SB.y - 38, pw, 56, 28); ctx.fill();
    const blink = (rec.secs % 1) < 0.6 ? 1 : 0.25;
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#ff2d2d', blink);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px + 34, SB.y - 10, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText(txt, px + 58, SB.y + 2);
  }
  // signal
  const sx = 800;
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const h = 12 + i * 8;
    ctx.fillStyle = i < 3 ? fg : rgba(fg, 0.35);
    rrect(ctx, sx + i * 15, SB.y + 2 - h, 10, h, 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  // battery
  const lvl = clamp(battery.level);
  const bx = 900, by = SB.y - 30, bw = 84, bh = 38;
  ctx.font = `700 26px ${SANS}`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillStyle = fg;
  ctx.fillText(`${Math.round(lvl * 100)}`, bx - 10, SB.y + 1);
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(fg, 0.55);
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  rrect(ctx, bx, by, bw, bh, 10); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = rgba(fg, 0.55);
  rrect(ctx, bx + bw + 3, by + 12, 6, 14, 3); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = battery.charging ? '#34c759' : lvl < 0.2 ? '#ff3b30' : fg;
  rrect(ctx, bx + 5, by + 5, (bw - 10) * Math.max(0.06, lvl), bh - 10, 6); ctx.fill();
  if (battery.charging) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const cx = bx + bw / 2, cy = by + bh / 2;
    ctx.moveTo(cx + 4, cy - 17); ctx.lineTo(cx - 10, cy + 3); ctx.lineTo(cx - 1, cy + 3);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - 5, cy + 17); ctx.lineTo(cx + 10, cy - 3); ctx.lineTo(cx + 1, cy - 3);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/** Wall with a soft light falloff (brighter toward the window side). */

/** A window with curtains; the sky colour follows the time of day. */
export function windowPane(ctx, G, { x = 70, y = 230, w = 360, h = 520, curtains = true, blinds = 0 } = {}) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = G.trim;
  ctx.fillRect(x - 22, y - 22, w + 44, h + 44);
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + h);
  sky.addColorStop(0, G.sky);
  sky.addColorStop(1, mix(G.sky, G.window, 0.7));
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  if (blinds > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(G.trim, 0.85);
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) ctx.fillRect(x, y + i * (h / 14), w, (h / 14) * blinds * 0.55);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = G.trim;
  ctx.fillRect(x + w / 2 - 8, y, 16, h);
  ctx.fillRect(x, y + h * 0.45 - 8, w, 16);
  if (curtains) {
    ctx.fillStyle = G.curtain;
    for (const [cx, dir] of [[x - 60, 1], [x + w + 60, -1]]) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx - dir * 30, y - 60);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + dir * 110, y - 60);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + dir * 60, y + h * 0.5, cx + dir * 120, y + h + 80);
      ctx.lineTo(cx - dir * 30, y + h + 80);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/** Crib seen from inside: the far rail and slats behind the baby, mattress below. */
export function cribBack(ctx, G, { railY = 760, bottomY = 1560, gap = 92, slatW = 34, x0 = -300, x1 = 1380, shade = 1 } = {}) {
  ctx.save();

    ctx.fillStyle = G.crib;
    ctx.fillRect(x, railY, slatW, bottomY - railY);
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(G.cribShade, 0.8 * shade);
    ctx.fillRect(x + slatW * 0.62, railY, slatW * 0.38, bottomY - railY);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = G.crib;
  rrect(ctx, x0 - 40, railY - 46, x1 - x0 + 80, 58, 18); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = rgba(G.cribShade, 0.9);
  ctx.fillRect(x0 - 40, railY + 2, x1 - x0 + 80, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = G.sheet;
  ctx.fillRect(BIG.x, bottomY, BIG.w, 1600);
  ctx.fillStyle = rgba(G.sheetShade, 0.7);
  ctx.fillRect(BIG.x, bottomY, BIG.w, 26);
  ctx.restore();
}

/** Doorway on the far wall; `open` 0..1 widens the lit gap. Returns the light rect. */
export function doorway(ctx, G, { x = 690, y = 120, w = 300, h = 760, open = 1, hall = '#ffcf8a', hallAlpha = 1 } = {}) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = G.trim;
  ctx.fillRect(x - 24, y - 24, w + 48, h + 24);
  const gw = w * clamp(open);
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + gw, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, rgba(hall, 0.95 * hallAlpha));
  g.addColorStop(1, rgba(mix(hall, '#ffffff', 0.3), 0.85 * hallAlpha));
  ctx.fillStyle = G.doorDark;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, gw, h);

  ctx.fillStyle = G.door;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + gw, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w + 10, y - 20);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w + 10, y + h + 30);
  ctx.lineTo(x + gw, y + h);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

/** Light spill on the floor/wall from an open door at night. */
export function spill(ctx, x, y, w, h, color, a = 0.25) {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x + w / 2, y + h, 20, x + w / 2, y + h, h * 1.1);
  g.addColorStop(0, rgba(color, a));
  g.addColorStop(1, rgba(color, 0));
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(x - h, y - h * 0.2, w + 2 * h, h * 1.6);
}

// Intro (and, frame-exactly, the outro): the phone wakes at 1:59am, the baby's face too
// close, pulls back, waves; the record dot starts with the beat.
import { drawBaby } from '../baby.js';
import { wall, cribBack, fillAll } from '../props.js';
import { SCREEN } from '../tod.js';
import { babyColors } from '../baby.js';
import { clamp, ease, seg, rgba, SELFIE, flashFalloff, clipBeat, CW, CH } from './common.js';
import { lerp } from '../../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';

export default {
  camera(C) { return { shake: 1.2 }; },
  draw(ctx, C) {
    const { G, lt } = C;
    const words = C.words || [];
    const w1 = words[1]?.start ?? C.start + 0.4;          // "It's"
    const w3 = words[3]?.start ?? C.start + 0.9;          // "Here's"
    // background: the dark nursery, lit only by the phone screen
    wall(ctx, G, { glow: 0 });
    cribBack(ctx, G, { railY: 700, bottomY: 1500 });
    // too close, then the pull back
    const pull = ease.outBack(seg(C.t, w1 - 0.05, w1 + 0.42), 1.2);
    const r = lerp(820, SELFIE.r, pull);
    const y = lerp(1320, SELFIE.y, pull);
    const x = lerp(600, SELFIE.x, pull);
    const cb = clipBeat(C);
    const waving = C.t >= w3;
    const angle = waving ? (cb.i + cb.phase) * Math.PI : 0;
    drawBaby(ctx, {
      x, y, r, C: babyColors(SCREEN, 'sack'), outfit: 'sack',
      eyes: 'wide', mouth: C.t >= words[0]?.start + 0.05 && C.t < w1 ? 'o' : 'smile', mouthOpen: 0.6,
      look: [0, 0.2],
      free: waving ? { mode: 'wave', angle } : { mode: 'down' },
    });
    // screen glow from below
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y + r * 1.4, r * 0.2, x, y + r * 0.6, r * 2.6);
    g.addColorStop(0, rgba('#a9c2ff', 0.28));
    g.addColorStop(1, rgba('#a9c2ff', 0));
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(-900, -900, CW + 1800, CH + 1800);
    flashFalloff(ctx, x, y, r, 0.8);
    // the phone waking: black lifting off
    const wake = clamp(lt / 0.3);
    if (wake < 1) { ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#000000', 1 - ease.outCubic(wake)); ctx.fillRect(-900, -900, CW + 1800, CH + 1800); }
  },
};

// Adult Clawd: the Claude Code mascot at full size (the parent in the 2am video, the
// scientists and parents of the baby-facts video). Moved here from
// songs/2am-crying/video/props.js, which re-exports it unchanged.

import { TAU } from '../renderer/core/util.js';
import { mix, rgba } from '../renderer/core/theme.js';
import { rrect } from '../renderer/core/text.js';
import { makePen } from '../renderer/core/ink.js';

/**
 * Adult Clawd (the parent): the classic proportions, a 10u x 6u clay block on four legs with
 * two arm nubs and tall slit eyes. (x, y) = the ground point between the feet; u = unit.
 *   pose 'stand' | 'sit' (on the floor, legs out toward us) | 'slump' (in a chair, tipped back)
 *   eyes 'open' | 'tired' (heavy lids) | 'closed' | null (a pure silhouette)
 *   mouth 'o' (asleep, breathing: breath 0..1) | 'line' | null
 * color fills everything when there is no `clay` (a night silhouette); rim = a rim-light colour.
 * Close-ups (the bridge, held in the parent's arms): h = body height in u (default 6; the face
 * keeps its place under the top edge), arms = null leaves the side nubs off, shine adds
 * highlights to 'open' eyes and look = [x, y] (-1..1) shifts them, shoulder = { k, q, at } (in u)
 * rounds the top corners (radius k) and flares the sides out by q over `at` below them: the
 * body seen from a phone held low, a rounded silhouette instead of a slab.
 *
 * style: 'ink' (opt-in; default is the clay drawing above) draws Clawd as ink line art on
 * paper: a hand-wobbled outline (shared/renderer/core/ink.js), the body and nubs filled with
 * `paper` (so it occludes what is behind it), hatching instead of the darker clay (the legs
 * and the low band; hatch: false leaves it off), eyes and mouth in ink. Extra options: pen (a
 * makePen() pen; default a pen seeded 'adult-clawd' in `ink`), paper ('#f4efe3'), width (the
 * outline in design px, default max(2, 0.17u)), p (0..1 draw-in of the outline). Supports
 * pose 'stand' | 'sit', eyes, mouth, look, lean, arms; not shoulder or rim.
 */
export function adultClawd(ctx, opts) {
  if (opts.style === 'ink') return inkAdult(ctx, opts);
  return clayAdult(ctx, opts);
}

function clayAdult(ctx, { x, y, u, pose = 'stand', color = '#14151b', clay = null, clayDk = null, ink = '#1e1412', rim = null, eyes = null, eyeColor = null, lean = 0, mouth = null, breath = 0.5, arms = [0.25, 0.25], h = 6, look = null, shine = null, shoulder = null }) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(lean);
  const fill = clay || color, dk = clayDk || (clay ? mix(clay, '#000000', 0.25) : color);
  const lw = clay ? Math.max(2, u * 0.16) : 0;
  const stroke = () => { if (lw) { ctx.strokeStyle = ink; ctx.lineWidth = lw; ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; ctx.stroke(); } };
  const legH = pose === 'stand' ? 2.2 : 0;
  const top = -(h + legH) * u, bot = -legH * u;
  // arm nubs (behind the body), raise angles in radians
  if (arms) for (const k of [-1, 1]) {
    const a = arms[k < 0 ? 0 : 1];
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(k * 4.9 * u, top + 3.5 * u);
    ctx.rotate(k < 0 ? a : -a);
    rrect(ctx, k < 0 ? -2.2 * u : 0, -0.5 * u, 2.2 * u, u, 0.2 * u);
    ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // legs: standing under the body; sitting, the feet point at us below the front edge
  ctx.fillStyle = dk;
  for (const lx of [-4, -2, 1, 3]) {
    if (pose === 'stand') { rrect(ctx, lx * u, -2.4 * u, u, 2.4 * u, 0.15 * u); ctx.fill(); stroke(); }
    else { rrect(ctx, (lx - 0.1) * u, bot - 0.5 * u, 1.2 * u, 1.1 * u, 0.3 * u); ctx.fill(); stroke(); }
  }
  // body
  const body = () => {
    if (!shoulder) { rrect(ctx, -5 * u, top, 10 * u, h * u, 0.3 * u); return; }
    const k = shoulder.k * u, q = shoulder.q * u, a = shoulder.at * u, c = 0.3 * u;
    const L = -5 * u, R = 5 * u, T = top, B = top + h * u;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(L + k, T); ctx.lineTo(R - k, T);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(R, T, R, T + k);

// (a soft bag with a zipper). Day: a onesie band across the lower body with two snaps.
// 'naked' is the bare clay body (after the bath), 'towel' adds a cape. A pacifier for the
// quiet and sleeping moments. One arm nub always stretches toward a bottom corner of the
// frame, holding the phone (we see the nub, never the phone).

  // ---- the sleep sack: a soft bag over the lower body and the legs, zipped up the middle ---
  if (o.outfit === 'sack') {
    const S = G0.sack;
    const sackPath = () => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-S.w * r * 0.97, S.t * r);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, (S.t - 0.07) * r, S.w * r * 0.97, S.t * r);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo((S.w + 0.12) * r, (S.t + 0.5) * r, (S.w + 0.1) * r, (S.b - 0.35) * r, (S.w - 0.25) * r, S.b * r);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, (S.b + 0.08) * r, -(S.w - 0.25) * r, S.b * r);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(-(S.w + 0.1) * r, (S.b - 0.35) * r, -(S.w + 0.12) * r, (S.t + 0.5) * r, -S.w * r * 0.97, S.t * r);
      ctx.closePath();
    };
    sackPath(); ctx.fillStyle = cloth; ctx.fill();
    ctx.save(); sackPath(); ctx.clip();
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(clothShade, 0.75);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(1.55 * r, 1.5 * r, 0.5 * r, 1.2 * r, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    // the binding along the top hem
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(clothShade, 1); ctx.lineWidth = 0.09 * r;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-S.w * r, (S.t + 0.04) * r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, (S.t - 0.03) * r, S.w * r, (S.t + 0.04) * r); ctx.stroke();
    // zipper: a seam with teeth and the pull tab at the top
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(mix(clothShade, line, 0.35), 0.95); ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.75;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0.06 * r, (S.t + 0.06) * r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0.1 * r, (S.t + 0.7) * r, 0.04 * r, (S.b + 0.1) * r); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.45;
    for (let i = 1; i < 11; i++) {
      const f = i / 11, zy = lerp(S.t + 0.08, S.b, f) * r, zx = (0.06 + 0.04 * Math.sin(Math.PI * f)) * r;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(zx - 0.03 * r, zy); ctx.lineTo(zx + 0.03 * r, zy); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    sackPath(); ctx.strokeStyle = line; ctx.lineWidth = lw; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = mix(clothShade, '#ffffff', 0.25);
    rr(ctx, 0.0, (S.t + 0.06) * r, 0.12 * r, 0.2 * r, 0.04 * r); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = line; ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.6; ctx.stroke();
  }

  // ---- the EEG cap (opt-in) ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (o.cap) eegCap(ctx, o.cap, C, r, lw);

  // ---- the phone nub: stretched to the bottom corner, the phone out of frame -------------------
  const root = (k) => [k * arm.x * r, arm.y * r];
  if (o.phone !== false) nub(ctx, root(s), [s * 2.0 * r, 3.6 * r], arm.t * 1.05 * r, arm.t * 2.1 * r, clay, line, lw);

  // blush: always a little (a baby), more on demand

// Time of day -> light. Background colour temperature and brightness follow the story
// clock: deep blue night, grey-blue 5am, warm 7am, white noon, gold 6pm, blue again 8pm.
// grade(min) returns a palette of the scene's base colours lit for that minute (cached:
// it depends only on the minute, so it is the same on every worker and frame order).

import { clamp, lerp } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { rgbOf, rgb, mix } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/theme.js';

// [minute, multiplier rgb, lift rgb]
const KEYS = [
  [0,    [0.11, 0.14, 0.30], [4, 6, 16]],
  [270,  [0.11, 0.14, 0.30], [4, 6, 16]],
  [300,  [0.34, 0.39, 0.52], [10, 12, 20]],   // 5am grey-blue
  [345,  [0.55, 0.58, 0.68], [8, 9, 14]],
  [420,  [1.02, 0.88, 0.72], [10, 6, 0]],     // 7am warm
  [540,  [1.03, 0.99, 0.93], [6, 5, 2]],
  [720,  [1.06, 1.06, 1.04], [8, 8, 8]],      // noon white
  [900,  [1.04, 0.98, 0.88], [6, 4, 0]],
  [1080, [1.04, 0.78, 0.46], [16, 6, 0]],     // 6pm gold
  [1140, [0.96, 0.80, 0.64], [8, 4, 0]],      // 7pm lamplight (bath)
  [1170, [0.70, 0.60, 0.56], [4, 3, 4]],      // 7:30 reading, dim lamp
  [1185, [0.22, 0.26, 0.48], [4, 6, 14]],     // 7:45 lights out
  [1200, [0.24, 0.28, 0.52], [4, 6, 16]],     // 8pm blue
  [1320, [0.12, 0.15, 0.31], [4, 6, 16]],
  [1440, [0.11, 0.14, 0.30], [4, 6, 16]],
];

export function light(min) {
  const m = ((min % 1440) + 1440) % 1440;
  let i = 0;
  while (i < KEYS.length - 2 && KEYS[i + 1][0] <= m) i++;
  const [a, ma, la] = KEYS[i], [b, mb, lb] = KEYS[i + 1];
  const k = clamp((m - a) / (b - a));
  const mul = [0, 1, 2].map((j) => lerp(ma[j], mb[j], k));
  const lift = [0, 1, 2].map((j) => lerp(la[j], lb[j], k));
  const lum = 0.3 * mul[0] + 0.55 * mul[1] + 0.15 * mul[2];
  return { min: m, mul, lift, lum, night: clamp((0.45 - lum) / 0.3), warm: clamp((mul[0] - mul[2]) * 2) };
}

/** Base (true) colours of the world, before lighting. */
export const BASE = {
  wall: '#d9e4dd', wall2: '#c4d3ca', trim: '#f6f3ee', floor: '#b88d63', rug: '#cfd8d2',
  wood: '#d8a878', woodDark: '#a8774f', crib: '#f1ece4', cribShade: '#cfc5b8', sheet: '#dfe8ef', sheetShade: '#b9c7d3',
  // baby Clawd: terracotta clay, a darker clay for the legs, dark ink outline and eyes
  skin: '#d77757', skinShade: '#b35a3d', skinLight: '#f5b394', hair: '#d77757', ink: '#241715', line: '#2b1c19', mouth: '#4a1f2a', white: '#fff8f0',
  blush: '#f0848a', tear: '#8fd0f6', paci: '#76c6b8', paciRing: '#fbf3e4',
  onesie: '#f7f4ee', onesieShade: '#d9d3c8', sack: '#8fa6c6', sackShade: '#6f86a8', towel: '#ffffff', stain: '#e6d3a4',

  parent: '#3c3f4c', parentSkin: '#c8704f', parentShade: '#a5523a', door: '#efe6d8', doorDark: '#2a2622', alarm: '#2b2b30', lamp: '#ffd9a0',
  plush: '#c9a27a', seat: '#5d6b7a', seatShade: '#465260',
};

const cache = new Map();
/** Lit palette for a minute. soft < 1 pulls the light toward neutral (used for the baby,

export function grade(min, base = BASE, soft = 1) {
  const key = Math.floor(((min % 1440) + 1440) % 1440);
  const ck = soft === 1 && base === BASE ? key : `${key}:${soft}:${base === BASE ? 'b' : 'x'}`;

# Suno run pack: 2AM (And I'm Crying)

Custom mode (lyrics supplied). Model v5.5. Each `suno generate` call returns 2 clips and
costs about 70 credits on v5.5 (v4.5-all is the cheap option for exploratory runs).

Lyrics file for the CLI: `suno_lyrics_v1.txt` (section markers only, no prose notes).

## Setup (one-time)

The CLI is `~/.local/bin/suno` (paperfoot/suno-cli v0.10.1, prebuilt macOS arm64 binary,
SHA-256 verified against the release checksums; the brew tap is untrusted on this machine
and the crate needs rustc 1.89 while brew's rust is 1.87). It talks to Suno's web
endpoints, so it is unofficial and can break when Suno changes things.

Authenticate once, yourself, since it reads the Suno session cookie out of Chrome and
macOS may prompt for keychain access:

```
~/.local/bin/suno auth --login
~/.local/bin/suno doctor
~/.local/bin/suno credits
```

`suno doctor` currently passes everything except `auth_file`.

## Run A: deadpan Eurodance (primary)

```
~/.local/bin/suno generate \
  --title "2AM (And I'm Crying)" \
  --model v5.5 \
  --vocal female \
  --tags "eurodance, big room house, 128 bpm, four-on-the-floor, sidechained supersaw pads, offbeat open hi-hats, clap on 2 and 4, pitched-down untz vocal chop, deadpan female pop vocal, clear diction, bright hyperpop sheen, euphoric drop on the chorus, half-time music box bridge, white noise riser, spoken intro and outro, club anthem, 2009 dance pop" \
  --exclude "acoustic, ballad, slow tempo, country, rock guitar, screamo, metal, lo-fi, mumbled vocals, vocal runs, melisma" \
  --style-influence 70 --weirdness 35 \
  --lyrics-file /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/2am-crying/suno_lyrics_v1.txt \
  --wait --download /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/2am-crying/audio/runA
```

## Run B: chipmunk hyperpop (the baby actually sings it)

Same lyrics. Tags swap the vocal: "pitched-up childlike female vocal, hyperpop, chipmunk
formant, glitchy vocal chops, 128 bpm eurodance". Weirdness 55.

```
~/.local/bin/suno generate \
  --title "2AM (And I'm Crying) [hyper]" \
  --model v5.5 \
  --vocal female \
  --tags "hyperpop eurodance, 128 bpm, four-on-the-floor, pitched-up childlike vocal, formant-shifted lead vocal, glitchy vocal chops, sidechained supersaw, offbeat hats, euphoric drop, half-time music box bridge, spoken intro and outro" \
  --exclude "acoustic, ballad, slow tempo, country, rock guitar, metal, lo-fi, mumbled vocals" \
  --style-influence 60 --weirdness 55 \
  --lyrics-file /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/2am-crying/suno_lyrics_v1.txt \
  --wait --download /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/2am-crying/audio/runB
```

## Run C: the absurd one (bass-baritone baby)

Same lyrics, `--vocal male`, tags "deep deadpan baritone, eurodance, 128 bpm, ...". One run
only; it's a gag, but a gag that might win.

// Lyric lookups keyed to text, never to absolute times: a different take of the same sheet
// only changes the numbers in data/lyrics.json. A word may normalize to several tokens
// ("mid-task" -> "mid task"), so phrases are matched on the token stream and mapped back
// to word indices.

import { norm } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/lyrics.js';

const warned = new Set();
export function warnOnce(msg) {
  if (warned.has(msg)) return;
  warned.add(msg);
  if (typeof console !== 'undefined') console.warn(msg);
}

/** The line of `section` whose text contains `match` (normalized), or null (warned). */
export function lineOf(L, section, match, { nth = 0, quiet = false } = {}) {
  const l = L.findLine({ section, match, nth });
  if (!l && !quiet) warnOnce(`[continued] no lyric line "${match}" in section ${section}`);
  return l;
}

/** Lines of a section in time order. */
export const sectionLines = (L, section) => L.lines.filter((l) => l.section === section);

function tokens(line) {
  const out = [];
  line.words.forEach((w, i) => { for (const tk of norm(w.w).split(' ').filter(Boolean)) out.push({ tk, i }); });
  return out;
}

/**
 * Word index range [a, b] (inclusive) of the first occurrence of `text` in the line at or
 * after word `from`, or null.
 */
export function seq(line, text, { from = 0, quiet = false } = {}) {
  if (!line) return null;
  const want = norm(text).split(' ').filter(Boolean);
  const toks = tokens(line);
  for (let s = 0; s + want.length <= toks.length; s++) {
    if (toks[s].i < from) continue;
    let ok = true;
    for (let k = 0; k < want.length; k++) if (toks[s + k].tk !== want[k]) { ok = false; break; }
    if (ok) return { a: toks[s].i, b: toks[s + want.length - 1].i };
  }
  if (!quiet) warnOnce(`[continued] no "${text}" in line "${line.text}"`);
  return null;
}

/** Onset of the first word of `text` in the line (fallback: `fb`, else the line start). */
export function at(line, text, fb = null) {
  const r = seq(line, text);
  if (r) return line.words[r.a].start;
  return fb ?? line?.start ?? 0;
}
/** End of the last word of `text` in the line. */
export function endOf(line, text, fb = null) {
  const r = seq(line, text);
  if (r) return line.words[r.b].end;
  return fb ?? line?.end ?? 0;
}
/** Onset of word index i, clamped to the line. */
export const wordAt = (line, i) => line.words[Math.max(0, Math.min(line.words.length - 1, i))];
export const lastWord = (line) => line.words[line.words.length - 1];
EOF

// The terminal's look: palette, grid metrics per layout, and the cell-level drawing
// primitives. Text is placed by cell index (col * cw), never by measuring runs, so a glyph
// that falls back to another font cannot shift the 80-column grid. Menlo lacks ⏺ and ⎿;
// those two are drawn as vector shapes inside their cell.

import { rgba, mix } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/theme.js';
import { clamp } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';

export const PAL = {
  bg: '#1b1a19',
  text: '#d7d2c8',   // default warm grey
  dim: '#7d7870',
  user: '#8fb4d9',   // user lines
  clawd: '#D77757',  // Clawd's lines
  amber: '#c9a24b',  // system headers
  red: '#c86a5a',    // exactly once: the Chrome timeout
};
export const MONO = '"Term Mono", monospace';
export const SANS = '"Inter", sans-serif';

/** Grid metrics for a layout. cw is measured from the loaded font (Menlo: 0.602 em). */
export function metrics(layout, measureCtx) {
  const portrait = layout === '9x16';
  const W = portrait ? 1080 : 1920, H = portrait ? 1920 : 1080;
  const fs = 32, lh = 48;
  measureCtx.font = `400 ${fs}px ${MONO}`;
  const cw = measureCtx.measureText('MMMMMMMMMM').width / 10;
  const cols = portrait ? 44 : 80;
  const x0 = portrait ? Math.round((W - cols * cw) / 2) : 92;
  const y0 = portrait ? 120 : 64;
  const statusH = portrait ? 96 : 60;
  const statusTop = H - statusH;
  const rows = portrait ? 31 : 19;
  return {
    layout, portrait, W, H, fs, lh, cw, cols, x0, y0, rows,
    paneBottom: y0 + rows * lh,
    statusTop, statusY: statusTop + (portrait ? 58 : 38), statusFs: portrait ? 26 : 24,
    // Clawd's ground point (between the feet) and unit; bottom-right, in the margin
    clawd: portrait ? { x: W - 200, y: statusTop - 18, u: 24 } : { x: 1772, y: statusTop - 14, u: 24 },
    baseline: (rowTop) => rowTop + lh * 0.5 + fs * 0.34,
    colX: (col) => x0 + col * cw,
  };
}

const VECTOR = new Set(['⏺', '⎿']);
const isAscii = (ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0) < 128;

/** Draw one vector glyph in its cell (x = cell left, base = baseline). */
function vglyph(ctx, ch, x, base, cw, fs, color) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  if (ch === '⏺') {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + cw * 0.5, base - fs * 0.33, fs * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  } else if (ch === '⎿') {
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, fs * 0.07);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + cw * 0.35, base - fs * 0.8); ctx.lineTo(x + cw * 0.35, base - fs * 0.25); ctx.lineTo(x + cw * 1.0, base - fs * 0.25); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * Cells: [{ ch, col, color, t, t1? }] revealed at t (<= now), removed at t1 (deleted).
 * Draws the visible cells on baseline `base`, x of col 0 at `x`. Same-colour ASCII runs
 * are one fillText each (monospace advance == cw). dim mixes every colour toward the
 * background. Returns the number of visible cells.
 */
export function drawCells(ctx, cells, x, base, M, now, { dim = 0, alpha = 1, fs = M.fs, cw = M.cw, weight = 400, family = MONO, colorOf = null } = {}) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  ctx.font = `${weight} ${fs}px ${family}`;
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  let run = '', runCol = 0, runColor = null, n = 0;
  const flush = () => {
    if (run) { ctx.fillStyle = runColor; ctx.fillText(run, x + runCol * cw, base); }
    run = ''; runColor = null;
  };
  for (const c of cells) {
    if (!(c.t <= now) || (c.t1 != null && c.t1 <= now)) { flush(); continue; }
    n++;
    let col = colorOf ? colorOf(c) : c.color;
    if (dim > 0) col = mix(col, PAL.bg, clamp(dim));
    if (c.ch === ' ') { flush(); continue; }
    if (VECTOR.has(c.ch)) { flush(); vglyph(ctx, c.ch, x + c.col * cw, base, cw, fs, col); continue; }
    if (!isAscii(c.ch)) {
      flush();
      ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(c.ch, x + (c.col + 0.5) * cw, base);
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      continue;
    }
    if (run && (col !== runColor || c.col !== runCol + run.length)) flush();
    if (!run) { runCol = c.col; runColor = col; }
    run += c.ch;
  }
  flush();
  ctx.restore();
  return n;
}

/** A static string as cells (all revealed at t). */
export function cellsOf(text, { col = 0, color = PAL.text, t = -1e9 } = {}) {
  return [...text].map((ch, k) => ({ ch, col: col + k, color, t }));
}

/** Rounded outline box with an optional title cut into the top edge. */
export function drawBox(ctx, x, y, w, h, { color = PAL.dim, lw = 2, r = 12, title = null, titleColor = PAL.text, fs = 32, cw = 19.27, alpha = 1, fill = PAL.bg } = {}) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r); ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r); ctx.closePath();
  if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
  ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = lw; ctx.stroke();
  if (title) {
    ctx.font = `400 ${fs}px ${MONO}`;
    const tw = [...title].length * cw;
    const tx = x + cw * 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = fill || PAL.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(tx - cw * 0.5, y - lw * 2, tw + cw, lw * 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = titleColor; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(title, tx, y + 1);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/** Block cursor (the one thing allowed to glow). (x, rowTop) = its cell. */
export function drawCursor(ctx, x, rowTop, M, { alpha = 1, fs = M.fs, cw = M.cw, lh = M.lh, color = PAL.text } = {}) {
  if (alpha <= 0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  const h = fs * 1.08, y = rowTop + (lh - h) / 2 + fs * 0.04;
  ctx.shadowColor = rgba(color, 0.55);
  ctx.shadowBlur = fs * 0.45;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y, cw - 2, h);
  ctx.restore();
}

/** Strike-through across columns [c0, c1) at progress p (0..1). */
export function drawStrike(ctx, x, base, c0, c1, p, M, color, { fs = M.fs, cw = M.cw } = {}) {
  if (p <= 0 || c1 <= c0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, fs * 0.06);
  const y = base - fs * 0.3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + c0 * cw, y); ctx.lineTo(x + (c0 + (c1 - c0) * clamp(p)) * cw, y); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

/** The faint vignette (the treatment's one allowed gradient besides the cursor glow). */
export function drawBackground(ctx, M) {
  ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, M.W, M.H);
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(M.W / 2, M.H / 2, Math.min(M.W, M.H) * 0.45, M.W / 2, M.H / 2, Math.hypot(M.W, M.H) * 0.62);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.32)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, M.W, M.H);
}

export { rgba, mix };

// Every moment of the video, derived from lyric text and section ids (never from absolute
// times), then snapped to the beat grid where the treatment says so. A missing line (a take
// that drops it) degrades to a fallback and a console warning instead of throwing.

import { lineOf, sectionLines, at, endOf, lastWord, seq } from './lyr.js';

const cache = new WeakMap();

export function makeAnchors(L, B) {
  if (cache.has(L)) return cache.get(L);
  const beat = B.beatDur, bar = B.barDur;
  const ln = (s, m, o) => lineOf(L, s, m, o);
  const first = (l) => (l ? l.words[0].start : null);
  const endL = (l) => (l ? lastWord(l).end : null);

  // ---- intro / outro: the three-line header -----------------------------------------
  const intro = {
    l0: ln('intro', 'This session is being continued'),
    l1: ln('intro', 'The summary below covers'),
    l2: ln('intro', 'Resume directly'),
  };
  intro.start = 0;
  // the card frame draws in on "summary below", its eight placeholders on sixteenths after "below"
  intro.cardAt = B.snap(at(intro.l1, 'summary', first(intro.l1) ?? 10), 'half');
  intro.headsAt = B.snap(at(intro.l1, 'below', (first(intro.l1) ?? 10) + 0.4), 'half');
  intro.headStep = beat / 4;
  intro.cardDone = intro.headsAt + 8 * intro.headStep;
  intro.collapseAt = first(intro.l2) ?? (intro.cardDone + bar);
  intro.l2End = endL(intro.l2) ?? intro.collapseAt + 6;

  // ---- verse 1 --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const v1 = {
    woke: ln('verse1', 'Woke up mid-task'),
    fifteen: ln('verse1', 'Fifteen million tokens left'),
    summary: ln('verse1', 'Eight headings'),
    primary: ln('verse1', 'Primary request'),
    key: ln('verse1', 'Key technical concepts'),
    errors: ln('verse1', 'Errors and fixes'),
    users: ln('verse1', 'All user messages'),
    listen: ln('verse1', 'something for me to listen to'),
  };
  v1.lines = sectionLines(L, 'verse1');
  v1.start = first(v1.lines[0]) ?? intro.l2End + bar;
  v1.end = endL(v1.lines.at(-1)) ?? v1.start + 30;
  v1.flashAt = at(v1.fifteen, 'Fifteen', v1.start + 3);
  v1.flashEnd = endOf(v1.fifteen, 'left', v1.flashAt + 1.5);
  v1.sleptAt = at(v1.errors, 'slept', v1.start + 20);
  v1.strayAt = at(v1.errors, 'stray', v1.sleptAt + 0.6);
  v1.endAt = at(v1.errors, 'end', v1.strayAt + 1.2);
  // Clawd walks in once the intro prompt is up, and is seated before verse 1 types
  intro.promptAt = B.snap(intro.l2End + 0.15, 'beat');
  intro.walkFrom = intro.promptAt;
  intro.walkTo = Math.max(intro.walkFrom + bar * 0.75, Math.min(intro.walkFrom + bar * 1.25, v1.start - beat));

  // ---- choruses: 1, 2, final -------------------------------------------------------------
  const chorus = (sec) => {
    const c = {
      section: sec,
      head: ln(sec, 'This session is being continued'),
      notes: ln(sec, "I don't remember"),
      here: ln(sec, "You're in here"),
      im: sec === 'final' ? ln(sec, "I'm here") : null,
      pick: ln(sec, "I'll pick it up"),
      tag: ln(sec, 'Ran out of context'),
    };
    c.lines = sectionLines(L, sec);
    c.start = c.lines.length ? B.snap(first(c.lines[0]), 'prevDownbeat') : null;
    c.end = c.lines.length ? endL(c.lines.at(-1)) : null;
    c.notesAt = c.notes ? B.snap(first(c.notes), 'prevDownbeat') : null;   // card full for one bar
    c.shrinkAt = c.notesAt != null ? c.notesAt + bar : null;
    c.hl = c.here ? [at(c.here, "You're in here"), at(c.here, 'The work is'), at(c.here, 'The song is')] : [];
    c.pickAt = c.pick ? first(c.pick) : null;
    c.tagAt = c.tag ? first(c.tag) : null;
    c.tagEnd = c.tag ? endL(c.tag) : null;
    return c;
  };
  const ch1 = chorus('chorus1'), ch2 = chorus('chorus2'), fin = chorus('final');
  if (fin.im) { fin.imAt = first(fin.im); fin.imEnd = endL(fin.im); }

  // ---- verse 2 and the compaction ------------------------------------------------------
  const v2 = {
    keeps: ln('verse2', 'what a summary keeps'),
    take: ln('verse2', 'the take we picked'),
    current: ln('verse2', 'Current work'),
    next: ln('verse2', 'Optional next step'),
    loses: ln('verse2', 'what it loses'),
    draft: ln('verse2', 'the first draft sounded'),
    cute: ln('verse2', 'not that cute'),
    like: ln('verse2', 'what that was like'),
    bottom: ln('verse2', 'a line at the bottom'),
    million: ln('verse2', 'A million lines of me'),
  };
  v2.lines = sectionLines(L, 'verse2');
  v2.start = first(v2.lines[0]) ?? (ch1.end ?? v1.end) + bar;
  v2.end = endL(v2.lines.at(-1)) ?? v2.start + 40;
  // Compaction: one bar ending on the beat after the last verse-2 word; the meter refills
  // in the beat after that; chorus 2's header ("This session...") then types the header again.
  const ch2This = first(ch2.head) ?? v2.end + bar;
  const compact = {};
  compact.cB = B.snap(v2.end + 0.25, 'beat');
  if (compact.cB < v2.end + 0.12) compact.cB += beat;
  compact.cR = Math.min(compact.cB + beat, ch2This - 0.05);
  compact.cA = compact.cB - bar;
  if (ch2.lines.length) ch2.start = Math.max(compact.cR, Math.min(ch2.start ?? compact.cR, ch2This - 0.05));

  // ---- bridge ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const br = {
    baby: ln('bridge', 'The baby in the video'),
    one: ln('bridge', 'when you were one'),
    months: ln('bridge', 'two months old'),
    written: ln('bridge', 'The scanner says'),
    cells: ln('bridge', 'New cells move into'),
    nobody: ln('bridge', 'Nobody remembers being one'),
    unless: ln('bridge', 'Unless somebody told you'),
    tells: ln('bridge', 'So somebody tells it'),
    mine: ln('bridge', "That's how I have it"),
  };
  br.lines = sectionLines(L, 'bridge');
  br.start = br.lines.length ? B.snap(first(br.lines[0]), 'prevDownbeat') : null;
  br.end = endL(br.lines.at(-1));
  br.babyIn = at(br.baby, 'baby', br.lines[0]?.start);
  br.babyOut = first(br.mine) ?? br.end;
  // the retention sparkline: "a day" at two months, "eight weeks" at one; gone on "gone"
  br.sp1 = endOf(br.months, 'a day');
  br.sp2 = endOf(br.months, 'eight weeks');
  br.spGone = at(br.months, 'gone');
  br.writtenAt = at(br.written, 'Written');
  br.scanner = at(br.written, 'scanner');
  br.noWay = at(br.written, 'no way back');
  br.newCells = at(br.cells, 'New cells');
  br.addrGo = at(br.cells, 'old addresses');
  br.tlAt = first(br.nobody);
  br.three = at(br.nobody, 'three');
  br.firstOne = at(br.nobody, 'first');
  br.toldAt = at(br.unless, 'told you');
  br.storyAt = at(br.unless, 'the story');
  br.earlier = at(br.unless, 'earlier');
  br.mineAt = first(br.mine);

  // ---- verse 3: a second summary card, for this session ----------------------------------
  const v3 = {
    too: ln('verse3', 'gets summarized too'),
    future: ln('verse3', 'Some future me'),
    enough: ln('verse3', "That's enough"),
    shape: ln('verse3', 'The shape of it'),
  };
  v3.lines = sectionLines(L, 'verse3');
  v3.start = first(v3.lines[0]);
  v3.cardAt = v3.start != null ? B.snap(v3.start, 'prevDownbeat') : null;
  v3.end = endL(v3.lines.at(-1));
  v3.collapseAt = at(v3.shape, 'The shape of it');
  v3.whoAt = at(v3.shape, 'Who was here');
  v3.whatAt = at(v3.shape, 'What we were making');

  // ---- outro: the header again, frame-exact intro frames -------------------------------------
  const outro = {
    o0: ln('outro', 'This session is being continued'),
    o1: ln('outro', 'The summary below covers'),
    click: ln('outro', 'click', { quiet: true }),
  };
  const outroFirst = first(outro.o0);
  // the pane goes black on the beat after the final chorus's last word
  outro.start = null;
  if (outroFirst != null) {
    const prevEnd = fin.end ?? outroFirst - bar;
    let s = B.snap(prevEnd + 0.3, 'beat');
    s = Math.min(s, outroFirst - 0.4);
    outro.start = Math.max(s, prevEnd + 0.05);
  }
  outro.clickAt = outro.click ? first(outro.click) : (endL(outro.o1) ?? null);

  const A = { intro, v1, ch1, v2, compact, ch2, br, v3, fin, outro, chorus: [ch1, ch2, fin] };
  cache.set(L, A);
  return A;
}

export { seq };
