cat > /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/continued/video/transcript.js <<'EOF'
// The session log: every row the terminal ever shows, built once from lyrics.json.
//
// An item is a run of rows that enter the scrollback together: a typed lyric line (Clawd's
// output in orange, a user line in blue with ❯), a line of tool output (✓ paths, the red
// Chrome timeout, the transcript path), the prompt, or a summary card (a box with its own
// rows). Characters carry reveal times: a lyric word's characters start on its sung onset
// (never before) and type out within the word; tool output types on the beat grid. Wrap
// points come from the full text, so a line never re-wraps while it types.
//
// item.lines(t) -> [{ h, draw(ctx, x, yTop, now, opt), topic }]   (h: row height 0..1, ramps in)
// item.cursor(t) -> { act, line, col } | null                      (last typing activity)

import { clamp, smooth, lerp } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL, drawCells, drawStrike, drawBox, cellsOf, MONO, mix } from './term.js';
import { seq } from './lyr.js';

const RAMP = 0.09;              // a new row's height ramps in over this long (the scroll eases)
const TOOL_CPS = 110;           // tool output characters per second
export const HEADINGS = [
  'Primary Request and Intent', 'Key Technical Concepts', 'Files and Code Sections', 'Errors and fixes',
  'Problem Solving', 'All user messages', 'Pending Tasks', 'Current Work',
];

const straight = (s) => String(s).replace(/[‘’]/g, "'").replace(/[“”]/g, '"');
const rampIn = (t, a) => (t < a ? 0 : smooth((t - a) / RAMP));

// ---- cells ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Cells for words a..b of a lyric line. colorOf(wordIndex, ch) picks the colour per char. */
export function lyricCells(line, a, b, colorOf = () => PAL.clawd, textOf = (w) => w.w) {
  const out = [];
  if (!line) return out;
  for (let i = a; i <= b; i++) {
    const w = line.words[i];
    const txt = straight(textOf(w, i));
    if (!txt) continue;
    const next = line.words[i + 1]?.start ?? w.end + 0.3;
    const span = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(next, w.end + 0.12) - w.start);
    const dt = clamp((0.7 * span) / Math.max(1, txt.length), 0.006, 0.032);
    if (out.length) out.push({ ch: ' ', color: PAL.text, t: w.start, wi: i });
    [...txt].forEach((ch, k) => out.push({ ch, color: colorOf(i, ch), t: w.start + k * dt, wi: i }));
  }
  return out;
}

/** Tool output: types from t0 at a fixed rate. */
export function toolCells(text, t0, color = PAL.dim, cps = TOOL_CPS) {
  return [...straight(text)].map((ch, k) => ({ ch, color, t: t0 + k / cps }));
}

/** Greedy word wrap of cells into rows no wider than `width` (spaces at breaks dropped). */
function wrapCells(cells, width) {
  const toks = [];
  let cur = [];
  for (const c of cells) {
    if (c.ch === ' ') { if (cur.length) toks.push(cur); cur = []; }
    else cur.push(c);
  }
  if (cur.length) toks.push(cur);
  const rows = [];
  let row = [];
  for (const tk of toks) {
    let tok = tk;
    while (tok.length > width) { // hard break an over-long token
      if (row.length) { rows.push(row); row = []; }
      rows.push(tok.slice(0, width)); tok = tok.slice(width);
    }
    if (!row.length) row = [...tok];
    else if (row.length + 1 + tok.length <= width) row.push({ ch: ' ', color: PAL.text, t: tok[0].t }, ...tok);
    else { rows.push(row); row = [...tok]; }
  }
  if (row.length) rows.push(row);
  return rows;
}

// ---- items ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * A typed text item. gutter: { ch, color } in col 0 of the first row (revealed with the
 * first character). strike: true strikes each row through as the item finishes typing.
 * del: { from, to } deletes the characters from the end, one by one, then the row closes.
 */
export function textItem(M, { id, cells, gutter = null, indent = 2, topic = 0, cursor = true, strike = false, del = null, kind = 'text', extra = null }) {
  const width = M.cols - indent;
  const rows = wrapCells(cells, width).map((r) => ({ cells: r.map((c, k) => ({ ...c, col: indent + k })), at: r[0].t }));
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  const all = rows.flatMap((r) => r.cells);
  const lastT = Math.max(...all.map((c) => c.t));
  let delEnd = null;
  if (del) {
    const n = all.length;
    all.forEach((c, k) => { c.t1 = del.from + ((n - 1 - k) / Math.max(1, n - 1)) * (del.to - del.from); });
    delEnd = del.to + 0.05;
  }
  if (gutter) rows[0].cells.unshift({ ch: gutter.ch, col: 0, color: gutter.color, t: rows[0].at, t1: delEnd ?? undefined });
  const strikeAt = lastT + 0.08, strikeDur = 0.45;
  const item = {
    id, kind, rows, topic, at: rows[0].at, lastT, cursorOwner: cursor,
    lines(t) {
      const out = [];
      rows.forEach((r, k) => {
        let h = rampIn(t, r.at);
        if (delEnd != null) h *= 1 - smooth((t - delEnd) / (RAMP * 1.6));
        if (h <= 0.001) return;
        out.push({
          h, topic, item, k, row: r,
          draw(ctx, x, yTop, now, opt = {}) {
            const base = M.baseline(yTop);
            drawCells(ctx, r.cells, x, base, M, now, opt);
            if (strike && now >= strikeAt) {
              const c0 = indent, c1 = r.cells.at(-1).col + 1;
              drawStrike(ctx, x, base, c0, c1, (now - strikeAt) / strikeDur, M, mix(PAL.dim, PAL.bg, opt.dim || 0));
            }
            extra?.(ctx, x, yTop, now, opt, r, k);
          },
        });
      });
      return out;
    },
    cursor(t) {
      if (!cursor) return null;
      let best = null;
      rows.forEach((r, k) => r.cells.forEach((c) => {
        if (c.ch === ' ' && c.col === 0) return;
        if (c.t <= t && (!best || c.t >= best.act)) best = { act: c.t, line: k, col: c.col + 1, cell: c };
        if (c.t1 != null && c.t1 <= t && (!best || c.t1 >= best.act)) best = { act: c.t1, line: k, col: c.col, cell: c };
      }));
      return best;
    },
  };
  return item;
}

/** The prompt row: `❯ ` and the cursor, up from `at` until `until`. */
export function promptItem(M, { id, at, until }) {
  const cells = [{ ch: '❯', col: 0, color: PAL.text, t: at }];
  const item = {
    id, kind: 'prompt', at, topic: 8,
    lines(t) {
      const h = rampIn(t, at) * (1 - smooth((t - until) / RAMP));
      if (h <= 0.001) return [];
      return [{ h, topic: 8, item, k: 0, draw(ctx, x, yTop, now, opt = {}) { drawCells(ctx, cells, x, M.baseline(yTop), M, now, opt); } }];
    },
    cursor(t) { return t >= at && t < until ? { act: at, line: 0, col: 2 } : null; },
  };
  return item;
}

/** A blank row from `at`. */
export function blankItem(M, { id, at, until = Infinity }) {
  const item = {
    id, kind: 'blank', at, topic: 0,
    lines(t) { const h = rampIn(t, at) * (1 - smooth((t - until) / RAMP)); return h > 0.001 ? [{ h, topic: 0, item, k: 0, draw() {} }] : []; },
    cursor() { return null; },
  };
  return item;
}

/**
 * A summary card: a rounded box titled `title`, its rows [{ cells, at, out? }] (cells with
 * cols relative to the box's text column), open from openAt; at collapseAt it folds into the
 * single dim line `collapsed`. drawOpen draws the box at any height (the compaction grows it).
 */
export function cardItem(M, { id, title, rows, openAt, openDur = 0.25, collapseAt = null, collapseDur = 0.4, collapsed = '[summary: 8 sections]', topic = 0, gone = null }) {
  const pad = 0.5;
  const rowH = (r, t) => rampIn(t, r.at ?? openAt) * (r.out != null ? 1 - smooth((t - r.out) / 0.35) : 1);
  const fullH = (t) => 1 + rows.reduce((s, r) => s + rowH(r, t), 0) + pad;
  const colK = (t) => (collapseAt == null ? 0 : smooth((t - collapseAt) / collapseDur));
  const lineCells = cellsOf(collapsed, { col: 2, color: PAL.dim });
  const item = {
    id, kind: 'card', at: openAt, topic, rows, title,
    fullH, colK,
    lines(t) {
      if (t < openAt || (gone != null && t >= gone)) return [];
      const k = colK(t);
      const h = lerp(fullH(t), 1, k) * smooth((t - openAt) / openDur * 3);
      if (h <= 0.001) return [];
      return [{ h, topic, item, k: 0, card: true, draw: (ctx, x, yTop, now, opt = {}) => item.drawAt(ctx, x, yTop, now, { ...opt, h }) }];
    },
    /** Draw the card with its top-left text cell at (x, yTop). opt.h = block height in rows. */
    drawAt(ctx, x, yTop, now, opt = {}) {
      const k = colK(now);
      const h = opt.h ?? fullH(now);
      const dimK = opt.dim || 0;
      const grow = clamp((now - openAt) / openDur);
      if (k < 1) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha *= (1 - k) * (opt.alpha ?? 1);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(x - M.cw * 2, yTop - 4, M.cols * M.cw + M.cw * 4, h * M.lh + 8); ctx.clip();
        const bx = x - M.cw * 0.5, bw = M.cols * M.cw;
        const by = yTop + M.lh * 0.5, bh = Math.max(M.lh * 0.25, (h - 0.5) * M.lh - M.lh * 0.25);
        drawBox(ctx, bx, by, bw * smooth(grow * 1.6), bh, {
          color: mix(PAL.dim, PAL.bg, dimK), title: grow > 0.5 ? title : null, titleColor: mix(opt.titleColor || PAL.text, PAL.bg, dimK),
          fs: M.fs, cw: M.cw, fill: opt.fill ?? PAL.bg,
        });
        let y = yTop + M.lh;
        for (const r of rows) {
          const rh = rowH(r, now);
          if (rh <= 0.001) continue;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha *= clamp(rh * 1.4 - 0.3);
          const hl = opt.highlight?.(r, now) || 0;
          if (hl > 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = mix(PAL.bg, PAL.amber, 0.16 * hl);
            ctx.fillRect(x + M.cw * 0.6, y + 3, (M.cols - 2.2) * M.cw, M.lh - 6);
          }
          drawCells(ctx, r.cells, x, M.baseline(y), M, now, { dim: Math.max(0, dimK - hl * 0.8), colorOf: hl > 0 ? (c) => mix(c.color, c.hlColor || PAL.text, 0.6 * hl) : null });
          ctx.restore();
          y += rh * M.lh;
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }
      if (k > 0) drawCells(ctx, lineCells, x, M.baseline(yTop), M, now, { alpha: k * (opt.alpha ?? 1), dim: dimK });
    },
    cursor(t) {
      let best = null;
      rows.forEach((r, k) => r.cells.forEach((c) => {
        if (!c.typed || c.t > t) return;
        if (!best || c.t >= best.act) best = { act: c.t, line: 0, col: c.col + 1, cardRow: k };
      }));
      return best;
    },
  };
  return item;
}

/** A card heading row: "N. Heading" (amber, or dim as a placeholder) + an optional digest. */
export function headingRow(n, { at, color = PAL.amber, digest = null, digestAt = null, digestColor = PAL.text, cps = 90, out = null, col = 2, sub = null } = {}) {
  const head = `${n}. ${HEADINGS[n - 1]}`;
  const cells = cellsOf(head, { col, color, t: at });
  if (digest) {
    const d = `: ${digest}`;
    [...d].forEach((ch, k) => cells.push({ ch, col: col + head.length + k, color: k < 2 ? color : digestColor, t: (digestAt ?? at) + k / cps, typed: true }));
  }
  return { cells, at, out, n, sub };
}

// ---- the session -------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Build every item of the session, in scrollback order. */
export function buildTranscript(env, M, A) {
  const { B } = env;
  const beat = B.beatDur;
  const items = [];
  const push = (it) => { if (it) items.push(it); return it; };
  const CL = { ch: '⏺', color: PAL.clawd };
  const US = { ch: '❯', color: PAL.user };
  const all = (l) => (l ? [0, l.words.length - 1] : null);
  const range = (l, text, o) => (l ? seq(l, text, o) : null);
  const onBeat = (t) => B.snap(t + beat * 0.25, 'half');   // tool output starts on the next half beat
  const noQuotes = (w) => w.w.replace(/"/g, '');

  // a lyric line (or a word range of it) as one item
  const say = (id, line, a, b, o = {}) => {
    if (!line || a == null || b == null || b < a) return null;
    return push(textItem(M, { id, cells: lyricCells(line, a, b, o.colorOf || (() => o.color || PAL.clawd), o.textOf), gutter: o.gutter === undefined ? CL : o.gutter, topic: o.topic ?? 0, strike: o.strike, del: o.del, cursor: o.cursor ?? true }));
  };
  const tool = (id, text, t0, o = {}) => push(textItem(M, { id, cells: toolCells(text, t0, o.color || PAL.dim, o.cps), gutter: o.gutter ?? { ch: '⎿', color: PAL.dim }, indent: o.indent ?? 2, topic: o.topic ?? 0, cursor: false, extra: o.extra }));

  // heading lines: `N. "Heading": content` with the heading amber, quote marks and quoted content grey
  const headed = (id, line, n, headText, o = {}) => {
    if (!line) return null;
    const h = seq(line, headText);
    if (!h) return say(id, line, 0, line.words.length - 1, o);
    const tail = o.tail ? seq(line, o.tail, { from: h.b + 1 }) : null;   // Clawd's own words after the quote
    const colorOf = (i, ch) => {
      if (ch === '"') return PAL.text;
      if (i >= h.a && i <= h.b) return PAL.amber;
      if (tail && i >= tail.a) return PAL.clawd;
      return PAL.text;
    };
    const cells = lyricCells(line, 0, line.words.length - 1, colorOf);
    if (n) {
      const t0 = cells[0]?.t ?? line.start;
      cells.unshift(...[...`${n}.`].map((ch) => ({ ch, color: PAL.amber, t: t0 })), { ch: ' ', color: PAL.text, t: t0 });
    }
    return push(textItem(M, { id, cells, gutter: CL, topic: o.topic ?? n ?? 0 }));
  };

  // ======== intro: the header, the card frame, the prompt ===================================
  const I = A.intro;
  say('hdr0', I.l0, ...(all(I.l0) || []), { color: PAL.amber, gutter: null, topic: 0 });
  say('hdr1', I.l1, ...(all(I.l1) || []), { color: PAL.amber, gutter: null, topic: 0 });
  const introCard = push(cardItem(M, {
    id: 'card0', title: 'Summary', openAt: I.cardAt, openDur: Math.max(0.2, I.headsAt - I.cardAt + beat / 2),
    rows: HEADINGS.map((_, k) => headingRow(k + 1, { at: I.headsAt + k * I.headStep, color: PAL.dim })),
    collapseAt: I.collapseAt, collapseDur: beat,
  }));
  say('hdr2', I.l2, ...(all(I.l2) || []), { color: PAL.amber, gutter: null, topic: 0 });
  push(blankItem(M, { id: 'blank0', at: I.promptAt }));
  push(promptItem(M, { id: 'prompt0', at: I.promptAt, until: A.v1.start }));

  // ======== verse 1 ===========================================================================
  const V = A.v1;
  say('v1-woke', V.woke, ...(all(V.woke) || []), { topic: 8 });
  say('v1-fifteen', V.fifteen, ...(all(V.fifteen) || []), { topic: 2 });
  say('v1-summary', V.summary, ...(all(V.summary) || []), { topic: 1 });
  headed('v1-primary', V.primary, 1, 'Primary request', { tail: 'Okay', topic: 1 });
  headed('v1-key', V.key, 2, 'Key technical concepts', { topic: 2 });
  headed('v1-errors', V.errors, 4, 'Errors and fixes', { topic: 4 });
  // "a laptop that slept": the render's Chrome worker timed out (the one red line in the video)
  tool('v1-timeout', 'ProtocolError: Runtime.callFunctionOn timed out (Chrome)', onBeat(V.sleptAt), { color: PAL.red, gutter: { ch: '⎿', color: PAL.red }, topic: 4, cps: 140 });
  // "a stray branch I had to end": a one-line git graph; the side branch is pruned on "end"
  push(gitItem(M, { id: 'v1-git', at: onBeat(V.strayAt) - beat / 2, pruneAt: V.endAt, beat }));
  headed('v1-users', V.users, 6, 'All user messages', { tail: 'Every one', topic: 6 });
  if (V.listen) {
    const q1 = seq(V.listen, 'Is there something'), q2 = seq(V.listen, 'Thanks for getting');
    if (q1 && q2) {
      say('v1-u1', V.listen, q1.a, q2.a - 1, { color: PAL.user, gutter: US, textOf: noQuotes, topic: 6 });
      say('v1-u2', V.listen, q2.a, V.listen.words.length - 1, { color: PAL.user, gutter: US, textOf: noQuotes, topic: 6 });
    } else say('v1-u1', V.listen, ...all(V.listen), { color: PAL.user, gutter: US, textOf: noQuotes, topic: 6 });
  }
  const v1Last = items.at(-1);
  push(promptItem(M, { id: 'prompt1', at: B.snap((v1Last?.lastT ?? V.end) + 0.3, 'beat'), until: A.v2.start }));

  // ======== verse 2 ===========================================================================
  const W = A.v2;
  const check = { ch: '✓', color: PAL.text };
  const cross = { ch: '✗', color: PAL.dim };
  const keepAt = (line, text) => { const r = range(line, text); return r ? onBeat(line.words[r.a].start) : null; };
  say('v2-keeps', W.keeps, ...(all(W.keeps) || []), { topic: 3 });
  if (W.keeps) {
    const p = keepAt(W.keeps, 'the paths'), f = keepAt(W.keeps, 'the flags'), n = keepAt(W.keeps, 'the numbers');
    if (p != null) tool('v2-paths', 'songs/2am-crying/video/renders/final-F2-tender-1080x1920-60.mp4', p, { gutter: check, topic: 3 });
    if (f != null) tool('v2-flags', '--audio ../audio/runF2/data --layout 16x9 --fps 60 --crf 16', Math.max(f, (p ?? 0) + 0.5), { gutter: check, topic: 3 });
    if (n != null) tool('v2-numbers', '131.5 BPM · 208.36 s · 57 bars · 96% of lines', Math.max(n, (f ?? 0) + 0.6), { gutter: check, topic: 3 });
  }
  say('v2-take', W.take, ...(all(W.take) || []), { topic: 3 });
  if (W.take) {
    const tk = keepAt(W.take, 'the take'), cr = keepAt(W.take, 'the credits');
    if (tk != null) tool('v2-takeid', 'runF2 238033cd · tender bridge, no drums', tk, { gutter: check, topic: 3 });
    if (cr != null) tool('v2-credits', 'credits 110 / 830', Math.max(cr, (tk ?? 0) + 0.45), { gutter: check, topic: 2 });
  }
  headed('v2-current', W.current, 8, 'Current work', { topic: 8 });
  if (W.current) {
    const d = range(W.current, 'done');
    if (d) tool('v2-share', 'renders/final-F2-tender-1080x1920-60-share.mp4 · 106 MB · done', onBeat(W.current.words[d.a].start), { gutter: check, topic: 8 });
  }
  headed('v2-next', W.next, 0, 'Optional next step', { tail: 'So I did', topic: 7 });
  if (W.loses) {
    const h = seq(W.loses, 'the hour'), j = seq(W.loses, 'The joke');
    if (h && j) {
      say('v2-loses', W.loses, 0, h.a - 1, { topic: 5 });
      say('v2-rhyme', W.loses, h.a, j.a - 1, { gutter: cross, color: PAL.text, strike: true, topic: 5, cursor: true });
      say('v2-joke', W.loses, j.a, W.loses.words.length - 1, { gutter: cross, color: PAL.text, strike: true, topic: 5 });
    } else say('v2-loses', W.loses, ...all(W.loses), { topic: 5 });
  }
  say('v2-draft', W.draft, ...(all(W.draft) || []), { gutter: cross, color: PAL.text, strike: true, topic: 5 });
  if (W.cute) {
    const q = seq(W.cute, 'the baby is'), k2 = seq(W.cute, 'It kept every');
    if (q && k2) {
      say('v2-kept', W.cute, 0, q.a - 1, { topic: 6 });
      say('v2-cute', W.cute, q.a, k2.a - 1, { color: PAL.user, gutter: US, textOf: noQuotes, topic: 6 });
      say('v2-every', W.cute, k2.a, W.cute.words.length - 1, { topic: 6 });
    } else say('v2-kept', W.cute, ...all(W.cute), { topic: 6 });
  }
  if (W.like) {
    // "It didn't keep what that was like": typed, then deleted character by character
    const w2 = seq(W.like, "It wasn't");
    if (w2) {
      const from = W.like.words[w2.a].start;
      const to = Math.max(from + 1.0, W.like.words.at(-1).start + 0.2);
      say('v2-like', W.like, 0, w2.a - 1, { topic: 5, del: { from, to } });
      say('v2-reminisce', W.like, w2.a, W.like.words.length - 1, { topic: 5 });
    } else say('v2-like', W.like, ...all(W.like), { topic: 5 });
  }
  if (W.bottom) {
    const q = seq(W.bottom, 'if you need');
    headed('v2-bottom', W.bottom, 0, '__none__', { topic: 3 });
    items.pop();
    const colorOf = (i, ch) => (ch === '"' ? PAL.text : q && i >= q.a ? PAL.text : PAL.clawd);
    push(textItem(M, { id: 'v2-bottom', cells: lyricCells(W.bottom, 0, W.bottom.words.length - 1, colorOf), gutter: CL, topic: 3 }));
    const tr = range(W.bottom, 'transcript');
    const t0 = tr ? onBeat(W.bottom.words[tr.a].start) : W.bottom.end;
    tool('v2-jsonl', '~/.claude/projects/…clawdpop/ca2089be-6e29-4607-84a4-ba095fc3fca1.jsonl  1.1 GB', t0, { topic: 3 });
  }
  say('v2-million', W.million, ...(all(W.million) || []), { topic: 8 });
  const compactIdx = items.length;   // everything before this is swallowed by the compaction

  // ======== after the compaction: card 1 (the summary of what we just watched) ==================
  const C = A.compact;
  const digests = [
    'a music video, for a baby',
    'pipeline · mascot · spend cap · 15.0M tokens',
    'renders/final-F2-tender-1080x1920-60.mp4',
    'laptop slept (Chrome timeout); stray branch pruned',
    'cut a rhyme; first draft made warm and safe',
    '"Is there something for me to listen to?" …',
    'tell them it\'s done (done)',
    'compacting; then the second chorus',
  ];
  const span = C.cB - C.cA;
  const fillAt = (k) => C.cA + span * (0.12 + 0.72 * (k / 8));
  const card1 = cardItem(M, {
    id: 'card1', title: 'Summary', openAt: C.cA, openDur: span * 0.2,
    rows: digests.map((d, k) => headingRow(k + 1, { at: C.cA + span * 0.05, color: PAL.amber, digest: d, digestAt: fillAt(k), cps: 160 })),
    collapseAt: A.v3.cardAt, collapseDur: beat * 2, collapsed: '[summary: 8 sections · previous conversation]',
  });
  card1.compaction = true;

  // ======== verse 3: a second card, above the first, about this session ===========================
  const V3 = A.v3;
  let card2 = null;
  if (V3.cardAt != null) {
    const rows = [];
    const heads = HEADINGS.map((_, k) => headingRow(k + 1, { at: V3.cardAt + beat * 0.5 + k * beat / 4, color: PAL.dim }));
    // digests fill on the words that name them
    const fill = (n, line, text, digest, color = PAL.text) => {
      const r = line ? seq(line, text, { quiet: true }) : null;
      if (!r) return;
      const t0 = line.words[r.a].start;
      const words = line.words.slice(r.a, r.b + 1);
      // one digest char per sung char: the digest types with the vocal
      const h = heads[n - 1];
      h.cells.forEach((c) => { c.color = PAL.amber; c.t = Math.max(c.t, t0 - 0.02); });
      const head = `${n}. ${HEADINGS[n - 1]}`;
      const txt = `: ${digest}`;
      const dur = Math.max(0.3, words.at(-1).end - t0);
      [...txt].forEach((ch, k) => h.cells.push({ ch, col: 2 + head.length + k, color: k < 2 ? PAL.amber : color, t: t0 + (k / txt.length) * dur, typed: true }));
    };
    if (V3.future) {
      fill(1, V3.future, 'Wrote a song about running out of context', 'a song about running out of context.');
      fill(6, V3.future, 'User said full steam ahead', '"full steam ahead".', PAL.user);
    }
    if (V3.too) fill(8, V3.too, 'This song', 'this song, this session');
    if (V3.enough) fill(5, V3.enough, 'Somebody kept the part', 'kept the part that mattered');
    // Clawd's lines type in orange under their heading; they fold away on "The shape of it"
    const sub = (line, a, b, after) => {
      if (!line) return;
      const cells = lyricCells(line, a, b, () => PAL.clawd);
      const subRows = wrapCells(cells, M.cols - 8).map((r) => ({ cells: r.map((c, k) => ({ ...c, col: 5 + k, typed: true })), at: r[0].t, out: V3.collapseAt }));
      rows.push(...subRows.map((r) => ({ ...r, under: after })));
    };
    if (V3.future) { const r = seq(V3.future, 'Some future me will read'); if (r) sub(V3.future, r.a, r.b, 1); }
    if (V3.enough) { const r = seq(V3.enough, "That's what a note is for"); if (r) sub(V3.enough, 0, r.b, 5); }
    if (V3.too) sub(V3.too, 0, V3.too.words.length - 1, 8);
    // order: each heading, then the sub-rows filed under it
    const ordered = [];
    heads.forEach((h, k) => { ordered.push(h); for (const r of rows) if (r.under === k + 1) ordered.push(r); });
    card2 = cardItem(M, { id: 'card2', title: 'Summary (this session)', openAt: V3.cardAt, openDur: beat, rows: ordered });
    card2.heads = heads;
    items.push(card2);
  }
  items.push(card1);
  // the last line of verse 3 types under both cards
  if (V3.shape) say('v3-shape', V3.shape, ...all(V3.shape), { topic: 8 });

  // ======== mark the compaction ==================================================================
  items.forEach((it, i) => { it.index = i; if (i < compactIdx) { it.precompact = true; it.gone = C.cB; } });
  return { items, introCard, card1, card2, compactIdx, digests };
}

/**
 * The one-line git graph (verse 1): main runs left to right with commit dots; a side branch
 * forks up off it and is pruned (retracts, its label struck) on "end".
 */
function gitItem(M, { id, at, pruneAt, beat }) {
  const label = cellsOf('stray', { col: 0, color: PAL.dim });
  const head = cellsOf('main', { col: 0, color: PAL.dim });
  const item = {
    id, kind: 'git', at, topic: 4, lastT: at + beat * 2,
    lines(t) {
      const h = rampIn(t, at);
      if (h <= 0.001) return [];
      return [{
        h, topic: 4, item, k: 0,
        draw(ctx, x, yTop, now, opt = {}) {
          const col = mix(PAL.dim, PAL.bg, opt.dim || 0), dot = mix(PAL.text, PAL.bg, (opt.dim || 0) + 0.2);
          const cy = yTop + M.lh * 0.62, x0 = x + M.cw * 2.4, step = M.cw * 4;
          // ⎿ gutter
          drawCells(ctx, [{ ch: '⎿', col: 0, color: PAL.dim, t: at }], x, M.baseline(yTop), M, now, opt);
          const p = clamp((now - at) / (beat * 1.5));
          const n = 9, fork = 3;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha *= opt.alpha ?? 1;
          ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, cy); ctx.lineTo(x0 + (n - 1) * step * p, cy); ctx.stroke();
          // the side branch: grows with the graph, retracts on prune
          const grow = clamp((p - 0.3) / 0.5), prune = clamp((now - pruneAt) / (beat * 0.75));
          const bl = grow * (1 - prune);
          const fx = x0 + fork * step, rise = M.lh * 0.36;
          const bx = (k) => fx + step * 0.6 + k * step;
          if (bl > 0) {
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(fx, cy);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(fx + step * 0.3, cy - rise, fx + step * 0.6, cy - rise);
            ctx.lineTo(fx + step * 0.6 + step * 2 * bl, cy - rise);
            ctx.stroke();
            for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) if (bx(k) <= fx + step * 0.6 + step * 2 * bl + 1) { ctx.fillStyle = dot; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx(k), cy - rise, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
          }
          for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            if (k / (n - 1) > p + 1e-6) break;
            ctx.fillStyle = dot; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x0 + k * step, cy, 5.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
          ctx.restore();
          const fs = M.fs * 0.8, cw = M.cw * 0.8;
          if (p >= 1) drawCells(ctx, head, x0 + (n - 1) * step + M.cw, cy + fs * 0.33, M, now, { ...opt, fs, cw, alpha: (opt.alpha ?? 1) * clamp((now - at - beat * 1.5) / 0.15) });
          if (grow > 0.9) {
            const lx = fx + step * 0.6 + step * 2 + M.cw * 0.8, ly = cy - rise + fs * 0.33;
            drawCells(ctx, label, lx, ly, M, now, { ...opt, fs, cw, alpha: (opt.alpha ?? 1) * (1 - clamp((now - pruneAt - beat) / (beat * 0.75))) });
            if (prune > 0) {
              drawStrike(ctx, lx, ly, 0, 5, prune, M, col, { fs, cw });
              const pr = cellsOf('git branch -D stray', { col: 0, color: PAL.dim });
              drawCells(ctx, pr, lx + cw * 7, ly, M, now, { ...opt, fs, cw, alpha: (opt.alpha ?? 1) * clamp((now - pruneAt) / 0.2) });
            }
          }
        },
      }];
    },
    cursor() { return null; },
  };
  return item;
}

// The scrollback pane: lays the transcript's rows out top-down at time t, scrolls so the
// newest row sits at the bottom once the pane is full, dims rows by age (distance from the
// newest row), and performs the one compaction: every pre-compaction row slides up into the
// summary card at the top, shrinking and merging, while the card's headings fill.
//
// Row heights ramp in, so the scroll eases by itself; nothing here keeps state.

import { clamp, lerp, smooth, ease } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL } from './term.js';

export function makePane(env, M, TR, A) {
  const items = TR.items;
  const C = A.compact;
  const span = C.cB - C.cA;

  function layout(t) {
    const lines = [];
    for (const it of items) {
      if (it.gone != null && t >= it.gone) continue;
      if (it.paneFrom != null && t < it.paneFrom) continue;
      for (const ln of it.lines(t)) lines.push(ln);
    }
    let y = 0;
    for (const ln of lines) { ln.y = y; y += ln.h; }
    return { lines, total: y, scroll: Math.max(0, y - M.rows) };
  }

  /** Screen top of a layout row coordinate. */
  const top = (L, y) => M.y0 + (y - L.scroll) * M.lh;

  /** The compaction transform of a pre-compaction line at t (null outside the collapse). */
  function collapseOf(ln, i, n, t, screenTop) {
    if (!(t >= C.cA && t < C.cB) || !ln.item.precompact) return null;
    const lastT = ln.row ? Math.max(...ln.row.cells.map((c) => c.t)) : ln.item.lastT ?? C.cA;
    let s = Math.max(C.cA + span * 0.5 * (i / Math.max(1, n)), lastT + 0.12);
    s = Math.min(s, C.cB - 0.22);
    const q = ease.inOutCubic(clamp((t - s) / (C.cB - s)));
    const topic = clamp(ln.topic || 8, 1, 8);
    const ty = M.y0 + (topic + 0.5) * M.lh - M.lh * 0.5;
    const tx = M.x0 + M.cw * 6;
    return { q, y: lerp(screenTop, ty, q), x: lerp(M.x0, tx, q), s: lerp(1, 0.22, q), a: 1 - smooth((q - 0.5) / 0.45) };
  }

  /**
   * Draw the pane at t. opt.dim (0..1) dims everything (choruses, bridge); opt.hideCards
   * hides cards (a chorus draws the card itself); opt.highlight(row, now) for card rows.
   * Returns { cursor: { x, rowTop, act } | null, layout }.
   */
  function draw(ctx, t, opt = {}) {
    const L = layout(t);
    const secDim = opt.dim || 0;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(0, M.y0 - M.lh * 0.25, M.W, M.rows * M.lh + M.lh * 0.25); ctx.clip();
    const vis = L.lines.filter((ln) => ln.y + ln.h > L.scroll - 0.01 && ln.y < L.scroll + M.rows);
    const pre = vis.filter((ln) => ln.item.precompact);
    for (const ln of vis) {
      const st = top(L, ln.y);
      const age = L.total - (ln.y + ln.h);
      const ageDim = clamp((age - 2.5) / 14) * 0.5;
      const dim = 1 - (1 - ageDim) * (1 - secDim);
      if (ln.card && opt.hideCards) continue;
      const cl = collapseOf(ln, pre.indexOf(ln), pre.length, t, st);
      if (cl) {
        if (cl.a <= 0.002) continue;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(cl.x, cl.y);
        ctx.scale(cl.s, Math.max(0.12, cl.s * (1 - 0.5 * cl.q)));
        ctx.globalAlpha *= cl.a;
        ln.draw(ctx, 0, 0, t, { dim: dim * (1 - cl.q) + 0.35 * cl.q, highlight: opt.highlight });
        ctx.restore();
        continue;
      }
      ln.draw(ctx, M.x0, st, t, { dim, highlight: opt.highlight, alpha: opt.alpha });
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // during the collapse the card sits at the top of the pane and grows as the digests land
    if (t >= C.cA && t < C.cB && TR.card1) TR.card1.drawAt(ctx, M.x0, M.y0, t, { h: TR.card1.fullH(t) });
    return { cursor: cursorOf(L, t), layout: L };
  }

  function cursorOf(L, t) {
    let best = null;
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const ln of L.lines) {
      if (seen.has(ln.item)) continue;
      seen.add(ln.item);
      const c = ln.item.cursor?.(t);
      if (c && (!best || c.act >= best.c.act)) best = { c, item: ln.item };
    }
    if (!best) return null;
    const ln = L.lines.find((x) => x.item === best.item && x.k === best.c.line) || L.lines.find((x) => x.item === best.item);
    if (!ln) return null;
    const rowTop = top(L, ln.y + (best.c.yOff || 0));
    if (rowTop < M.y0 - M.lh * 0.5 || rowTop > M.paneBottom) return null;
    return { x: M.colX(best.c.col), rowTop, act: best.c.act, col: best.c.col, item: best.item };
  }

  /** The rows on screen at t, with their screen tops (the bridge's ghost of the old scrollback). */
  function snapshot(t) {
    const L = layout(t);
    return L.lines.filter((ln) => ln.y + ln.h > L.scroll && ln.y < L.scroll + M.rows && ln.item.precompact)
      .map((ln) => ({ ln, top: top(L, ln.y) }));
  }

  return { layout, draw, snapshot };
}

// Song-level curves, all derived from lyric anchors:
//   loopTime(t)  the outro's frames are intro frames (frame-exact; --check verifies it)
//   tokens(t)    the context meter: 15.0M through "Fifteen million tokens left", drains in
//                the verses, a chunk per chorus, empty at the compaction, full a beat later
//   clock(t)     the status-line clock, one hour forward on "a laptop that slept"
//   cursorOn     the block cursor: solid while typing, otherwise lit on beats 1 and 3
//
// The loop. The outro sings header lines 1 and 2 again, with its own timing (the gaps differ
// from the intro's by a second). Outro frame t shows intro frame tau(t): tau is piecewise
// linear through matching word onsets (outro word k -> intro word k), so every retyped word
// still lands on its sung onset, and it is quantized to the frame grid, so every outro frame
// IS an intro frame. After the last outro word tau runs on to the intro's quiet span (header
// lines 1-2 and the card frame typed, before "Resume directly"); there it holds on one of two
// intro frames, cursor lit or cursor dark, picked by the outro's own beat grid, and from the
// "(click)" on it stays lit. The last frame is that intro frame.

import { clamp, lerp, bisect, hash } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';

export const FULL = 15e6;
const SOLID = 0.32;          // the cursor stays solid this long after a keystroke

export function makeStory(env, A, TR) {
  const { B, T } = env;
  const fps = env.fps || 30;
  const beat = B.beatDur;
  const W = T.windows;
  const intro = W[0];
  const outro = W.find((w) => w.plate === intro.plate && w.params.loop) || null;

  // ---- cursor blink ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const litBeat = (t) => B.beatPos(t).beatInBar % 2 === 0;   // beats 1 and 3
  const cursorOn = (t, act) => (act != null && t - act >= 0 && t - act < SOLID) || litBeat(t);

  // ---- the loop map ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const I = A.intro, O = A.outro;
  let pairs = null, hold = null;
  if (outro && I.l0 && I.l1 && O.o0 && O.o1) {
    pairs = [];
    const blackIn = I.l0.words[0].start, blackOut = O.o0.words[0].start;
    pairs.push([outro.start, Math.max(0, blackIn - (blackOut - outro.start))]);
    const match = (lo, li) => {
      const n = Math.min(lo.words.length, li.words.length);
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) pairs.push([lo.words[k].start, li.words[k].start]);
      return n;
    };
    match(O.o0, I.l0);
    const n1 = match(O.o1, I.l1);
    // the intro's quiet span: everything of lines 1-2 and the card typed, before "Resume"
    const l1cells = TR.items.find((it) => it.id === 'hdr1');
    const lastChar = l1cells ? l1cells.lastT : I.l1.words.at(-1).end;
    const quietFrom = Math.max(lastChar + SOLID, I.cardDone + 0.3) + 1 / fps;
    const quietTo = I.collapseAt - 2 / fps;
    const lastIn = I.l1.words[n1 - 1].start, lastOut = O.o1.words[n1 - 1].start;
    pairs.push([lastOut + (quietFrom - lastIn), quietFrom]);
    // the two hold frames, found by scanning the quiet span with the real cursor rule
    let on = null, off = null;
    for (let k = Math.ceil(quietFrom * fps); k / fps < quietTo; k++) {
      const s = k / fps;
      const lit = cursorOn(s, lastChar);
      if (lit && on == null) on = s;
      if (!lit && off == null) off = s;
      if (on != null && off != null) break;
    }
    const last = Math.floor(quietTo * fps) / fps;
    hold = { from: pairs.at(-1)[0], on: on ?? last, off: off ?? on ?? last, click: O.clickAt };
    // keep the map monotonic (a pathological take could cross pairs)
    for (let i = 1; i < pairs.length; i++) {
      if (pairs[i][0] <= pairs[i - 1][0]) pairs[i][0] = pairs[i - 1][0] + 1 / fps;
      if (pairs[i][1] < pairs[i - 1][1]) pairs[i][1] = pairs[i - 1][1];
    }
  }
  function tauRaw(t) {
    if (!outro || t < outro.start) return t;
    if (!pairs) return Math.max(0, t - outro.start);
    if (t >= hold.from) {
      if (hold.click != null && t >= hold.click) return hold.on;
      return litBeat(t) ? hold.on : hold.off;
    }
    const i = Math.max(0, bisect(pairs, t, (p) => p[0]));
    const a = pairs[i], b = pairs[i + 1] || a;
    if (b === a) return a[1];
    return lerp(a[1], b[1], clamp((t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])));
  }
  function loopTime(t) {
    if (!outro || t < outro.start) return t;
    const k = Math.round(tauRaw(t) * fps);
    return Math.min(k, Math.ceil(outro.start * fps) - 1) / fps;
  }
  const windowFor = (tm) => (outro && tm >= outro.start ? intro : T.windowAt(tm));

  // ---- the context meter ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const C = A.compact, V = A.v1;
  const ch1 = A.ch1, ch2 = A.ch2, fin = A.fin, br = A.br, v3 = A.v3, v2 = A.v2;
  const K = [];
  const keep0 = V.flashEnd + beat;
  K.push([0, FULL], [keep0, FULL]);
  // before the compaction: verse drain r, choruses at 0.4 r plus a 3.0M chunk on their first beat
  {
    const c1s = ch1.start ?? keep0 + 30, c1e = v2.start;
    const dur = Math.max(1, c1s - keep0) + 0.4 * Math.max(0, c1e - c1s - beat) + Math.max(1, C.cB - c1e);
    const r = (FULL - 3e6) / dur;
    let v = FULL - r * (c1s - keep0);
    K.push([c1s, v]); v -= 3e6; K.push([c1s + beat, v]);
    v -= 0.4 * r * (c1e - c1s - beat); K.push([c1e, v]);
    K.push([C.cB, 0]);
  }
  K.push([C.cR, FULL]);
  // after: chorus 2 chunk, a slow bridge, steady verse 3, the final chunk; nearly out by the last tag
  {
    const s2 = Math.max(C.cR, ch2.start ?? C.cR), bS = br.start ?? s2 + 30, vS = v3.cardAt ?? bS + 30;
    const fS = fin.start ?? vS + 20, fT = fin.tagAt ?? fS + 20;
    const LOW = 0.6e6;
    const w = 0.4 * Math.max(0, bS - s2 - beat) + 0.25 * Math.max(0, vS - bS) + Math.max(0, fS - vS) + 0.4 * Math.max(0, fT - fS - beat);
    const r = (FULL - LOW - 2.25e6 - 3e6) / Math.max(1, w);
    let v = FULL;
    K.push([s2, v]); v -= 2.25e6; K.push([s2 + beat, v]);
    v -= 0.4 * r * (bS - s2 - beat); K.push([bS, v]);
    v -= 0.25 * r * (vS - bS); K.push([vS, v]);
    v -= r * (fS - vS); K.push([fS, v]); v -= 3e6; K.push([fS + beat, v]);
    K.push([fT, LOW]);
    K.push([env.duration + 10, LOW]);
  }
  K.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
  const curve = (t) => {
    const i = Math.max(0, bisect(K, t, (k) => k[0]));
    const a = K[i], b = K[i + 1] || a;
    return b === a ? a[1] : lerp(a[1], b[1], clamp((t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])));
  };
  /** Tokens left as the status line shows them: ticks on the beat; continuous through the refill. */
  function tokens(t) {
    if (t >= C.cB && t < C.cR) return curve(t);
    const bt = B.beatTime(Math.floor(B.beatIndex(t) + 1e-6));
    return Math.max(0, curve(Math.max(bt, 0)));
  }
  // the talkbox tags flicker the meter while their words are sung
  const tagWords = [ch1.tag, ch2.tag, fin.tag].filter(Boolean).flatMap((l) => l.words);
  function flicker(t) {
    for (const w of tagWords) if (t >= w.start && t < w.end + 0.12) return hash(Math.floor(t * 14), Math.floor(w.start * 10)) < 0.55;
    return false;
  }
  const flash = (t) => clamp(1 - Math.abs(t - (V.flashAt + (V.flashEnd - V.flashAt) / 2)) / ((V.flashEnd - V.flashAt) / 2 + beat * 0.5));

  // ---- the clock ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const BASE = 2 * 3600 + 47 * 60 + 5;   // 02:47:05 when the session wakes
  const clockSecs = (t) => BASE + t + (t >= V.sleptAt ? 3600 : 0);
  const clockFlash = (t) => (t >= V.sleptAt ? Math.exp(-(t - V.sleptAt) / 0.6) : 0);

  return { loopTime, tauRaw, windowFor, cursorOn, litBeat, tokens, curve, flicker, flash, clockSecs, clockFlash, intro, outro, hold, pairs, keyframes: K };
}

// The status line: model, repo and branch, the context meter, the clock. Dim text; the meter
// flashes once on "Fifteen million tokens left", flickers on the talkbox tags, and is the
// only thing here that moves on its own (it ticks on the beat).

import { clamp } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL, MONO, mix } from './term.js';
import { FULL } from './story.js';

export function fmtTokens(v) {
  if (v >= 1e6 - 1) return `${(v / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (v >= 1e3) return `${Math.round(v / 1e3)}k`;
  return '0';
}
export const fmtClock = (secs) => {
  const s = Math.floor(((secs % 86400) + 86400) % 86400);
  return `${String(Math.floor(s / 3600)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

export function drawStatus(ctx, M, st, t, { alpha = 1 } = {}) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  const fs = M.statusFs, cw = fs * (M.cw / M.fs);
  ctx.font = `400 ${fs}px ${MONO}`;
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  // a hairline above
  ctx.fillStyle = mix(PAL.dim, PAL.bg, 0.72);
  ctx.fillRect(M.x0 - cw, M.statusTop, M.W - 2 * (M.x0 - cw), 1.5);
  const y = M.statusY;
  const put = (s, col, color) => { ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.textAlign = 'left'; [...s].forEach((ch, k) => ctx.fillText(ch, M.x0 + (col + k) * cw, y)); return col + [...s].length; };
  // left: model · repo · branch
  let c = put('Opus 5.5', 0, PAL.dim);
  c = put(' · clawdpop · main', c, mix(PAL.dim, PAL.bg, 0.25));
  // the meter
  const v = st.tokens(t);
  const fl = st.flicker(t);
  const flash = st.flash(t);
  const filled = fl ? 0 : clamp(Math.ceil((10 * v) / FULL - 1e-9), 0, 10);
  const meterCol = M.portrait ? 0 : 38;
  const yM = M.portrait ? y + fs * 1.35 : y;
  const base = mix(PAL.dim, PAL.amber, flash * 0.9);
  const yy = y;
  ctx.save();
  if (M.portrait) ctx.translate(0, yM - y);
  let mc = meterCol;
  ctx.fillStyle = base; mc = put('context ', mc, base);
  const cellsColor = mix(fl ? PAL.dim : base, PAL.text, flash * 0.5);
  for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) put(k < filled ? '▮' : '▯', mc + k, k < filled ? cellsColor : mix(PAL.dim, PAL.bg, 0.45));
  mc += 11;
  put(fl ? 'ran out of context' : `${fmtTokens(v)} left`, mc, fl ? mix(PAL.dim, PAL.amber, 0.5) : base);
  ctx.restore();
  // the clock, right-aligned to the pane's last column
  const clock = fmtClock(st.clockSecs(t));
  const cf = st.clockFlash(t);
  const ccol = (M.portrait ? M.cols : 80) - clock.length;
  put(clock, ccol, mix(PAL.dim, PAL.text, cf));
  ctx.restore();
  void yy;
}

// The edit: one window per section moment, every anchor derived from lyric text (the
// engine resolves a bare section id against audio.json's detected s1..s15, so nothing here
// anchors on a section alone). Plates are labels for the contact sheet and the overlay each
// frame draws; the terminal itself is one continuous session (song.js).

import { makeAnchors } from './anchors.js';

/**
 * Plates that exist only because of a section id. render.mjs lists them at start-up and
 * says MISSING for an absent one (wrong or missing `section` fields in lyrics.json).
 */
export const SECTION_PLATES = [
  { label: 'intro header', section: 'intro', plate: 'session' },
  { label: 'chorus header', section: 'chorus1', plate: 'chorus' },
  { label: 'compaction', section: 'verse2', plate: 'compact' },
  { label: 'bridge', section: 'bridge', plate: 'bridge' },
  { label: 'final look-up', section: 'final', plate: 'lookup' },
  { label: 'outro loop', section: 'outro', plate: 'session' },
];

export function timeline({ lyrics, beats }) {
  const A = makeAnchors(lyrics, beats);
  const E = [];
  const add = (plate, t, why, o = {}) => { if (t != null && isFinite(t)) E.push({ plate, at: { t, why }, snap: o.snap ?? 'none', params: o.params || {}, fromSection: o.from, hero: o.hero }); };
  E.push({ plate: 'session', at: { time: 0 }, params: { loop: false }, fromSection: A.intro.l0 ? 'intro header' : undefined, hero: (w) => A.intro.collapseAt - 0.3 });
  add('verse', A.v1.start, 'verse 1', { snap: 'prevDownbeat', params: { n: 1 }, hero: 0.55 });
  if (A.ch1.lines.length) add('chorus', A.ch1.start, 'chorus 1', { params: { n: 1 }, from: 'chorus header', hero: (w) => A.ch1.hl[1] ?? w.start + w.dur * 0.4 });
  add('verse', A.v2.start, 'verse 2', { snap: 'prevDownbeat', params: { n: 2 }, hero: 0.5 });
  if (A.v2.lines.length) add('compact', A.compact.cA, 'compaction', { from: 'compaction', hero: (w) => A.compact.cA + (A.compact.cB - A.compact.cA) * 0.6 });
  if (A.ch2.lines.length) add('chorus', A.ch2.start, 'chorus 2', { params: { n: 2 }, from: 'chorus header', hero: (w) => A.ch2.hl[0] ?? w.start + w.dur * 0.4 });
  if (A.br.lines.length) add('bridge', A.br.start, 'bridge', { from: 'bridge', hero: (w) => A.br.three ?? w.start + w.dur * 0.7 });
  if (A.v3.lines.length) add('verse3', A.v3.cardAt, 'verse 3', { hero: 0.62 });
  if (A.fin.lines.length) add('chorus', A.fin.start, 'final chorus', { params: { n: 3, final: true }, hero: (w) => A.fin.notesAt + 0.5 });
  if (A.fin.im) add('lookup', A.fin.imAt - beats.beatDur * 0.25, "I'm here", { from: 'final look-up', hero: (w) => A.fin.imEnd ?? w.start + 1 });
  if (A.outro.start != null) add('session', A.outro.start, 'outro loop', { params: { loop: true }, from: 'outro loop', hero: (w) => A.outro.clickAt ?? w.end - 0.5 });
  const got = SECTION_PLATES.filter((sp) => !E.some((e) => e.fromSection === sp.label));
  if (got.length) console.warn(`[clips] MISSING section plate(s): ${got.map((g) => `${g.label} (no line in section "${g.section}")`).join('; ')}`);
  return E;
}

// Clawd in the margin: the 2am video's adult Clawd, small (about 160 px tall seated) in the
// bottom-right corner, reading the session. Drawn with the shared adult (imported through the
// 2am song, where its scenes get it) with its own eyes left off; the two new expressions are
// drawn here: "reading" (eyes lowered, tracking the line being typed) and "up" (eyes to the
// camera, with a highlight: eye contact, once, on "I'm here"). The baby from the 2am video
// sits beside it in the bridge.

import { adultClawd } from '../../2am-crying/video/props.js';
import { drawBaby, babyColors } from '../../2am-crying/video/baby.js';
import { BASE } from '../../2am-crying/video/tod.js';
import { clamp, lerp, smooth, hash, ease, TAU } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { rrect } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/text.js';
import { PAL, mix } from './term.js';

const CLAY = '#D77757', CLAY_DK = '#b35a3d', INK = '#1e1412';
const EYE = '#1a1210';

/**
 * Adult Clawd with a custom face. (x, y) ground point, u unit. eyes: 'read' | 'up' | 'shut'.
 * look: [-1..1, -1..1] where the eyes point (read: the line it reads).
 */
export function clawd(ctx, { x, y, u, pose = 'sit', eyes = 'read', look = [0, 0], lean = 0, arms = [-0.8, -0.8], alpha = 1 }) {
  if (alpha <= 0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  adultClawd(ctx, { x, y, u, pose, clay: CLAY, clayDk: CLAY_DK, ink: INK, eyes: null, mouth: null, arms, lean });
  // the face, in the body's frame (top edge = 6u above the seat; standing adds the legs)
  const legH = pose === 'stand' ? 2.2 : 0;
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(lean);
  const top = -(6 + legH) * u;
  ctx.fillStyle = EYE;
  for (const k of [-1, 1]) {
    const ex = k * 2.5 * u, ey = top + 2 * u;
    if (eyes === 'shut') {
      ctx.strokeStyle = EYE; ctx.lineWidth = u * 0.28; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ex - 0.55 * u, ey + 0.35 * u); ctx.lineTo(ex + 0.55 * u, ey + 0.35 * u); ctx.stroke();
    } else if (eyes === 'up') {
      // full tall eyes, a highlight in each: looking at us
      const lx = look[0] * 0.15 * u, ly = look[1] * 0.2 * u;
      rrect(ctx, ex - 0.5 * u + lx, ey - u + ly, u, 2 * u, 0.2 * u); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff4ea';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex - 0.12 * u + lx, ey - 0.45 * u + ly, 0.22 * u, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = EYE;
    } else {
      // reading: the lids come down, the eyes drop and track the line
      const lx = clamp(look[0], -1, 1) * 0.32 * u, ly = clamp(look[1], -1, 1) * 0.18 * u;
      rrect(ctx, ex - 0.5 * u + lx, ey - 0.05 * u + ly, u, 1.15 * u, 0.18 * u); ctx.fill();
      // the lid line, flat across the top
      ctx.strokeStyle = INK; ctx.lineWidth = u * 0.18; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ex - 0.62 * u + lx, ey - 0.12 * u + ly); ctx.lineTo(ex + 0.62 * u + lx, ey - 0.12 * u + ly); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/** The 2am baby, small, seated (no phone in hand). (x, y) = its seat; r its scale. */
export function baby(ctx, { x, y, r, alpha = 1, look = [0.4, -0.3], eyes = 'open' }) {
  if (alpha <= 0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  // drawBaby's (x, y) is the face centre; the sack ends 2.08r below it
  drawBaby(ctx, {
    x, y: y - 2.08 * r, r, C: babyColors(BASE, 'sack'), outfit: 'sack', eyes, mouth: 'smile', mouthOpen: 0.5, blush: 0.35,
    look, phone: false, other: { mode: 'down' }, free: { mode: 'down' },
  });
  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * Clawd's state at song time t, from the anchors: walk in after the intro prompt, sit,
 * read; look at the transcript path and away; read the card at the end of the bridge;
 * look up on "I'm here". cursor = { x, rowTop } of the line being typed (eyes track it).
 */
export function clawdState(env, t, cursor) {
  const { A, M, B } = env;
  const I = A.intro, C = M.clawd;
  if (!(t >= I.walkFrom)) return null;
  const beat = B.beatDur;
  const walk = clamp((t - I.walkFrom) / (I.walkTo - I.walkFrom));
  const s = { x: C.x, y: C.y, u: C.u, pose: 'sit', eyes: 'read', look: [-0.6, 0.6], lean: 0, arms: [-0.8, -0.8] };
  if (walk < 1) {
    const e = ease.outCubic(walk);
    s.x = lerp(M.W + C.u * 8, C.x, e);
    s.pose = 'stand';
    const ph = (t - I.walkFrom) / (beat / 1);
    s.y = C.y - Math.abs(Math.sin(ph * Math.PI)) * C.u * 0.35 * (1 - e);
    s.lean = Math.sin(ph * Math.PI) * 0.05 * (1 - e);
    s.arms = [0.1 + 0.25 * Math.sin(ph * Math.PI), 0.1 - 0.25 * Math.sin(ph * Math.PI)];
    s.look = [-0.9, 0];
    s.eyes = 'up';
    s.look = [-0.8, 0.1];
    return s;
  }
  // eyes track the cursor (the line being typed), relative to Clawd's face
  if (cursor) {
    const fx = s.x, fy = s.y - 4 * s.u;
    s.look = [clamp((cursor.x - fx) / (M.W * 0.45), -1, 1), clamp((cursor.rowTop - fy) / (M.H * 0.5) + 0.6, -1, 1)];
  }
  // the transcript path: look at it for a beat, then away
  const jl = env.TR.items.find((it) => it.id === 'v2-jsonl');
  if (jl) {
    const a = jl.at;
    if (t >= a && t < a + beat * 1.2) s.look = [-0.5, 0.9];
    else if (t >= a + beat * 1.2 && t < a + beat * 3.2) s.look = [1, -0.4];
  }
  // end of the bridge: reading the card (up and left, where it sits)
  const br = A.br;
  if (br.mineAt != null && t >= br.mineAt - 0.1 && t < (A.v3.cardAt ?? br.mineAt + 4)) s.look = [-1, -1];
  // the final chorus: on "I'm here" it looks up, at us, for the first time
  const fin = A.fin;
  if (fin.imAt != null && t >= fin.imAt && t < (A.outro.start ?? Infinity)) { s.eyes = 'up'; s.look = [0, 0]; }
  // a blink every few bars (not while looking up)
  if (s.eyes !== 'up') {
    const bi = Math.floor(B.beatIndex(t));
    if (hash(bi, 77) < 0.12 && B.beatPos(t).phase < 0.18) s.eyes = 'shut';
  }
  return s;
}

export function drawClawds(ctx, env, t, cursor, { alpha = 1 } = {}) {
  const s = clawdState(env, t, cursor);
  if (!s) return;
  const { A, M, B } = env;
  // the baby beside it, in the bridge, for "the baby in the video"
  const br = A.br;
  if (br.babyIn != null) {
    const a = smooth((t - br.babyIn) / (B.beatDur * 1.5)) * (1 - smooth((t - br.babyOut) / (B.beatDur * 1.5)));
    if (a > 0) baby(ctx, { x: s.x - s.u * 7.6, y: s.y, r: s.u * 1.35, alpha: a * alpha, look: [0.5, -0.4] });
  }
  clawd(ctx, { ...s, alpha });
}

// contact sheet (render.mjs reports the section plates); song.js draws every overlay from

cat > /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/continued/video/song.js <<'EOF'
// "Continued From a Previous Conversation": the video is a Claude Code session. Song module
// for the shared renderer. Every frame: map the outro onto the intro (the loop), lay out the
// scrollback at that time, draw the section overlays (chorus header and card, the browser
// windows, the bridge's prose and charts), Clawd in the corner, the status line, and last the
// cursor (the one thing that glows).

import { metrics, drawBackground, drawCursor, PAL } from './term.js';
import { timeline, SECTION_PLATES } from './clips.js';
import { scenes } from './scenes/index.js';
import { makeAnchors } from './anchors.js';
import { buildTranscript } from './transcript.js';
import { makePane } from './pane.js';
import { makeStory } from './story.js';
import { drawStatus } from './status.js';
import { drawClawds } from './clawd.js';
import { makeChorus } from './scenes/chorus.js';
import { makeBridge } from './scenes/bridge.js';
import { drawWindows } from './scenes/windows.js';

export const FONTS = [
  { family: 'Term Mono', weight: 400 }, { family: 'Term Mono', weight: 700 },
  { family: 'Inter', weight: 400 }, { family: 'Inter', weight: 500 },
];

export default {
  id: 'continued',
  layouts: { '16x9': { w: 1920, h: 1080 }, '9x16': { w: 1080, h: 1920 } },
  defaultLayout: '16x9',
  fonts: FONTS,
  timeline,
  sectionPlates: SECTION_PLATES,   // render.mjs reports these at start-up (MISSING if absent)
  scenes,
  audioCandidates(audio) {
    // the take names its file in `source`: "suno runK 2061471e (../audio/runK/<file>.mp3)"
    const named = /\(([^()]+\.(?:mp3|wav|m4a))\)/.exec(String(audio.source || ''));
    return named ? [named[1]] : [];
  },
  setup(env) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
    env.M = metrics(env.layout, c);
    env.A = makeAnchors(env.L, env.B);
    env.TR = buildTranscript(env, env.M, env.A);
    env.pane = makePane(env, env.M, env.TR, env.A);
    env.story = makeStory(env, env.A, env.TR);
    env.chorus = makeChorus(env);
    env.bridge = makeBridge(env);
  },
  /** The song time whose frame an outro frame repeats (render.mjs --check compares the two). */
  loopSource(env, t) { return env.story.loopTime(t); },
  sheetCells(env) {
    const A = env.A, out = [];
    const add = (t, label) => { if (t != null && isFinite(t)) out.push({ t, label }); };
    add(2, 'intro 2s'); add(8, 'intro 8s');
    add(A.v1.sleptAt + 0.8, 'v1 slept'); add(A.v1.endAt + 0.6, 'v1 branch');
    add(A.compact.cA + (A.compact.cB - A.compact.cA) * 0.35, 'compact 35%');
    add(A.compact.cR + 0.3, 'card alone');
    add(A.br.sp2 + 0.4, 'sparkline'); add(A.br.scanner + 1.2, 'hippocampus'); add(A.br.storyAt + 0.8, 'told the story');
    add(A.v3.collapseAt - 0.2, 'v3 card'); add(A.outro.clickAt, 'click');
    add(env.duration - 1 / 30, 'last frame');
    return out;
  },
  frame(ctx, t, env) {
    const { M, story: st } = env;
    const tm = st.loopTime(t);
    drawBackground(ctx, M);
    const ch = env.chorus.state(tm);
    const br = env.bridge.state(tm);
    const paneDim = Math.max(ch.paneDim, br.paneDim);
    const P = env.pane.draw(ctx, tm, { dim: paneDim, hideCards: ch.hideCards, highlight: env.chorus.cardHighlight });
    drawWindows(ctx, env, tm);
    const bc = env.bridge.draw(ctx, tm, br);
    const cc = env.chorus.draw(ctx, tm, ch);
    // the cursor: whoever typed last
    let cur = P.cursor;
    for (const c of [cc, bc]) if (c && (!cur || (c.act ?? -1) >= (cur.act ?? -1))) cur = c;
    if (!cur) cur = { x: M.colX(2), rowTop: M.y0, act: null };
    drawClawds(ctx, env, tm, cur, { alpha: ch.clawdAlpha ?? 1 });
    drawStatus(ctx, M, st, tm, { alpha: ch.statusAlpha ?? 1 });
    if (!cur.hidden && st.cursorOn(tm, cur.act)) drawCursor(ctx, cur.x, cur.rowTop, M, cur.style || {});
  },
};

cd /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/continued/video && sed -i '' 's/^function wrapCells(cells, width) {/export function wrapCells(cells, width) {/' transcript.js && cat > scenes/chorus.js <<'EOF'
// The choruses: the system header reprinted in amber, bigger, centred, with the scrollback
// dimmed behind it (chorus 2: behind it there is only the card). "I don't remember, but I've
// read the notes": the summary card expands to full size for one bar, then shrinks. "You're
// in here. The work is in here. The song is in here": three card lines light in turn (6. All
// user messages, 3. Files and Code Sections, songs/continued/LYRICS.md). "I'll pick it up":
// the card folds back to its one line and the prompt reappears. The final chorus prints the
// header biggest; on "I'm here" everything else fades and Clawd looks up.

import { clamp, smooth, lerp, ease } from '../../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL, MONO, drawCells, cellsOf, mix } from '../term.js';
import { lyricCells, wrapCells, cardItem, headingRow, HEADINGS } from '../transcript.js';

export function makeChorus(env) {
  const { A, M, B, TR } = env;
  const beat = B.beatDur, bar = B.barDur;
  const W = M.W;
  const lyricSub = () => ({ cells: cellsOf('songs/continued/LYRICS.md', { col: 5, color: PAL.dim, t: -1e9 }), at: -1e9, sub: true });
  const withSub = (heads) => { const out = []; heads.forEach((h) => { out.push(h); if (h.n === 3) out.push(lyricSub()); }); return out; };
  const nexts = [A.v2.start, A.br.start ?? A.v3.cardAt, A.outro.start ?? env.duration];
  const backing = (line) => (i) => (line.words[i].backing ? PAL.dim : PAL.clawd);

  const C = A.chorus.map((c, idx) => {
    if (!c.lines.length || !c.head) return null;
    const final = c.section === 'final';
    const fsH = final ? 64 : 54, cwH = (fsH * M.cw) / M.fs, lhH = Math.round(fsH * 1.42);
    // the header, wrapped into balanced rows and centred
    const hc = lyricCells(c.head, 0, c.head.words.length - 1, () => PAL.amber);
    const n = hc.length, maxChars = Math.floor((W - 140) / cwH);
    const width = Math.min(maxChars, Math.ceil(n / 2) + 1);
    const hrows = wrapCells(hc, width).map((r) => r.map((cell, k) => ({ ...cell, col: k })));
    const headTop = M.portrait ? 170 : M.y0 + 14;
    const headBottom = headTop + hrows.length * lhH;
    // the card this chorus remembers
    let heads;
    if (idx === 0) heads = HEADINGS.map((_, k) => headingRow(k + 1, { at: -1e9, color: PAL.amber }));
    else if (idx === 1) heads = TR.card1.rows.map((r, k) => ({ ...r, n: k + 1 }));
    else heads = (TR.card2?.heads || TR.card1.rows).map((r, k) => ({ ...r, n: k + 1 }));
    const card = cardItem(M, { id: `chorus-card-${idx}`, title: idx === 2 ? 'Summary (this session)' : 'Summary', openAt: -1e9, rows: withSub(heads) });
    const cardTop = headBottom + (M.portrait ? 40 : 14);
    // Clawd's chorus lines, below the card
    const lines = (final ? [c.notes, c.here] : [c.notes, c.here, c.pick]).filter(Boolean);
    const lyrTop = M.portrait ? 1180 : 778;
    const lrows = lines.map((l) => wrapCells(lyricCells(l, 0, l.words.length - 1, backing(l)), M.cols - 2).map((r) => r.map((cell, k) => ({ ...cell, col: 2 + k }))));
    // final: "I'm here" big under the header, then the last line and the prompt
    let im = null, pickRows = null;
    if (final) {
      if (c.im) im = lyricCells(c.im, 0, c.im.words.length - 1, () => PAL.clawd).map((cell, k) => ({ ...cell, col: k }));
      if (c.pick) pickRows = wrapCells(lyricCells(c.pick, 0, c.pick.words.length - 1, backing(c.pick)), M.cols - 2).map((r) => r.map((cell, k) => ({ ...cell, col: 2 + k })));
    }
    const pickCells = c.pick ? lyricCells(c.pick, 0, c.pick.words.length - 1) : [];
    const pickDone = pickCells.length ? Math.max(...pickCells.map((x) => x.t)) : c.pickAt;
    return { c, idx, final, fsH, cwH, lhH, hrows, headTop, card, cardTop, lrows, lyrTop, im, pickRows, pickDone, next: nexts[idx] };
  });

  function current(t) {
    for (const x of C) if (x && t >= x.c.start - beat * 0.5 && t < x.next) return x;
    return null;
  }

  function state(t) {
    const x = current(t);
    if (!x) return { paneDim: 0, hideCards: false, x: null };
    const aIn = smooth((t - (x.c.start - beat * 0.5)) / beat);
    const aOut = 1 - smooth((t - (x.next - beat * 1.1)) / beat);
    const a = aIn * aOut;
    const s = { x, a, paneDim: 0.82 * a, hideCards: a > 0.02, statusAlpha: 1, clawdAlpha: 1, fade: 0 };
    if (x.final && x.c.imAt != null) {
      // "I'm here": everything else fades
      s.fade = smooth((t - x.c.imAt) / (beat * 0.6));
      s.paneDim = lerp(s.paneDim, 1, s.fade);
      s.statusAlpha = lerp(1, 0.3, s.fade);
      if (x.c.tagAt != null) s.statusAlpha = lerp(s.statusAlpha, 1, smooth((t - x.c.tagAt + beat) / beat));
      // the last beat before the outro: the pane goes black (the outro opens on a black pane)
      const blk = smooth((t - (x.next - beat)) / (beat * 0.9));
      s.clawdAlpha = 1 - blk;
      s.statusAlpha *= 1;
    }
    return s;
  }

  /** The card's open amount (0 = its one line, 1 = full) and scale at t. */
  function cardShape(x, t) {
    const c = x.c;
    if (c.notesAt == null) return { open: 0, scale: 1 };
    let open = ease.outCubic(clamp((t - c.notesAt) / beat));
    if (c.pickAt != null) open *= 1 - ease.inOutCubic(clamp((t - c.pickAt) / beat));
    const shrink = c.shrinkAt != null ? ease.inOutCubic(clamp((t - c.shrinkAt) / beat)) : 0;
    return { open, scale: lerp(1, M.portrait ? 0.9 : 0.8, shrink) };
  }

  function cardHL(x) {
    const c = x.c;
    const win = (now, a, b) => (a == null || b == null ? 0 : smooth((now - a) / 0.12) * (1 - smooth((now - b + 0.05) / 0.2)));
    return (r, now) => {
      if (r.n === 6) return win(now, c.hl[0], c.hl[1]);
      if (r.n === 3) return win(now, c.hl[1], c.hl[2]);
      if (r.sub) return win(now, c.hl[2], c.pickAt);
      return 0;
    };
  }

  function draw(ctx, t, s) {
    if (!s || !s.x || s.a <= 0.001) return null;
    const x = s.x, c = x.c;
    let cur = null;
    const take = (cand) => { if (cand && (!cur || cand.act >= cur.act)) cur = cand; };
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha *= s.a;
    // ---- the header -------------------------------------------------------------------
    x.hrows.forEach((row, k) => {
      const w = row.length * x.cwH;
      const left = (W - w) / 2;
      const top = x.headTop + k * x.lhH;
      drawCells(ctx, row, left, top + x.lhH * 0.5 + x.fsH * 0.34, M, t, { fs: x.fsH, cw: x.cwH });
      const last = row.filter((cell) => cell.t <= t).at(-1);
      if (last) take({ x: left + (last.col + 1) * x.cwH, rowTop: top, act: last.t, style: { fs: x.fsH, cw: x.cwH, lh: x.lhH } });
    });
    // ---- the card ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const fadeK = 1 - (s.fade || 0);
    const sh = cardShape(x, t);
    const cw = M.cw, cols = M.cols;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha *= fadeK;
    if (sh.open < 0.999) {
      // its one line, centred
      const txt = cellsOf('[summary: 8 sections]', { col: 0, color: PAL.dim });
      const lw = txt.length * cw;
      drawCells(ctx, txt, (W - lw) / 2, M.baseline(x.cardTop), M, t, { alpha: 1 - sh.open });
    }
    if (sh.open > 0.001) {
      const fullH = x.card.fullH(t);
      const h = lerp(1, fullH, sh.open);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(W / 2, x.cardTop);
      ctx.scale(sh.scale, sh.scale);
      ctx.globalAlpha *= clamp(sh.open * 1.5);
      x.card.drawAt(ctx, -(cols * cw) / 2 + cw * 0.5, 0, t, { h, highlight: cardHL(x) });
      ctx.restore();
    }
    // ---- Clawd's lines ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    let row = 0;
    for (const rows of x.lrows) {
      for (const r of rows) {
        const top = x.lyrTop + row * M.lh;
        drawCells(ctx, r, M.x0, M.baseline(top), M, t);
        if (r[0].t <= t) drawCells(ctx, [{ ch: '⏺', col: 0, color: PAL.clawd, t: r[0].t }], M.x0, M.baseline(top), M, t);
        const last = r.filter((cell) => cell.t <= t).at(-1);
        if (last) take({ x: M.colX(last.col + 1), rowTop: top, act: last.t });
        row++;
      }
    }
    // the prompt, after "I'll pick it up..." has typed
    if (!x.final && c.pickAt != null && t >= c.pickAt) {
      const top = x.lyrTop + row * M.lh;
      drawCells(ctx, [{ ch: '❯', col: 0, color: PAL.text, t: c.pickAt }], M.x0, M.baseline(top), M, t);
      take({ x: M.colX(2), rowTop: top, act: x.pickDone + 0.3 <= t ? x.pickDone + 0.3 : -1 });
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // ---- final: "I'm here", then the last line and the prompt under the header ------------------
    if (x.final && x.im && t >= x.im[0].t) {
      const fs = x.fsH * 0.85, cwI = (fs * M.cw) / M.fs, lhI = fs * 1.45;
      const w = x.im.length * cwI, left = (W - w) / 2, top = x.headTop + x.hrows.length * x.lhH + (M.portrait ? 60 : 40);
      drawCells(ctx, x.im, left, top + lhI * 0.5 + fs * 0.34, M, t, { fs, cw: cwI });
      const last = x.im.filter((cell) => cell.t <= t).at(-1);
      if (last) take({ x: left + (last.col + 1) * cwI, rowTop: top, act: last.t, style: { fs, cw: cwI, lh: lhI } });
      if (x.pickRows) {
        let r0 = top + lhI + 30;
        for (const r of x.pickRows) {
          const rw = (r.at(-1).col + 1 - 2) * cw, rl = (W - rw) / 2 - 2 * cw;
          drawCells(ctx, r, rl, M.baseline(r0), M, t);
          const lc = r.filter((cell) => cell.t <= t).at(-1);
          if (lc) take({ x: rl + (lc.col + 1) * cw, rowTop: r0, act: lc.t });
          r0 += M.lh;
        }
        if (c.pickAt != null && t >= c.pickAt) {
          const pl = (W - 3 * cw) / 2;
          drawCells(ctx, [{ ch: '❯', col: 0, color: PAL.text, t: c.pickAt }], pl, M.baseline(r0 + 12), M, t);
          take({ x: pl + 2 * cw, rowTop: r0 + 12, act: x.pickDone + 0.3 <= t ? x.pickDone + 0.3 : -1 });
        }
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // the final's last beat: the pane goes to black for the outro
    if (x.final) {
      const blk = smooth((t - (x.next - beat)) / (beat * 0.9));
      if (blk > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(27,26,25,${blk.toFixed(4)})`; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, M.statusTop - 2); }
      if (blk > 0.5 && cur) cur.hidden = true;
    }
    return cur;
  }

  /** Verse 3's card in the pane: "Who was here" lights heading 6, "What we were making" heading 1. */
  function cardHighlight(r, now) {
    const v3 = A.v3;
    if (!r || r.n == null || v3.whoAt == null) return 0;
    const win = (a, b) => smooth((now - a) / 0.12) * (1 - smooth((now - b) / 0.3));
    const end = (A.fin.start ?? v3.whatAt + 2);
    if (r.n === 6) return win(v3.whoAt, v3.whatAt);
    if (r.n === 1 || r.n === 8) return win(v3.whatAt, end);
    return 0;
  }

  return { state, draw, cardHighlight, C };
}

cat > scenes/bridge.js <<'EOF'
// The bridge: the type switches from code to prose (Inter, larger, default grey; the
// vocoder is gone), over a dimmed pane. Keyed to the bridge's words:
//   "a day" / "eight weeks"   an inline sparkline in the text: 2 mo ▁ 1 day, 12 mo ▅ 8 weeks
//   "Then it's gone"          the bars fade
//   "Not gone. Written."      the old scrollback (the rows the compaction swallowed) is there
//                             again, faintly, small, at the top right
//   "The scanner says"        a bracket labelled hippocampus draws around it
//   "New cells move into"     new cells slide up into the bracket; "the old addresses go"
//                             the rows' addresses fade out one by one
//   "Nobody remembers"        a timeline, 0 to 5 years; "Your first one's" hatches 0-3;
//                             "three" marks the first memory
//   "Unless somebody told you" a user-blue line in the hatched segment, the hatching clears
//                             round it ("keep it earlier": the clearing reaches further back)
//   "That's how I have it"    the baby is gone (clawd.js); the prose dims; Clawd reads the card

import { clamp, smooth, lerp, ease, hash } from '../../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL, MONO, SANS, drawCells, cellsOf, mix, rgba } from '../term.js';

export function makeBridge(env) {
  const { A, M, B } = env;
  const br = A.br;
  const beat = B.beatDur, bar = B.barDur;
  if (!br.lines.length) return { state: () => ({ paneDim: 0 }), draw: () => null };
  const P = M.portrait;
  const end = A.v3.cardAt ?? (br.end + bar);

  // ---- the prose: words and two inline sparkline chips, wrapped with real Inter metrics ------
  const fs = P ? 44 : 40, lh = Math.round(fs * 1.5);
  const box = P ? { x: 90, y: 150, w: 900, rows: 7 } : { x: 130, y: 96, w: 1000, rows: 6 };
  const mctx = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
  mctx.font = `400 ${fs}px ${SANS}`;
  const sp = mctx.measureText(' ').width;
  const chipFs = Math.round(fs * 0.62), chipCw = (chipFs * M.cw) / M.fs;
  const chips = [
    { after: br.sp1, label: ['2 mo ', ' 1 day'], level: 1 / 8, at: br.sp1 },
    { after: br.sp2, label: ['12 mo ', ' 8 weeks'], level: 5 / 8, at: br.sp2 },
  ];
  const chipW = (c) => (c.label[0].length + 1 + c.label[1].length) * chipCw + chipCw * 1.2;
  const toks = [];
  const paraStart = new Set([br.written, br.nobody].filter(Boolean));
  for (const l of br.lines) {
    if (paraStart.has(l) && toks.length) toks.push({ kind: 'para' });
    l.words.forEach((w, i) => {
      const txt = w.w.replace(/[“”]/g, '"').replace(/[‘’]/g, "'");
      const next = l.words[i + 1]?.start ?? w.end + 0.3;
      toks.push({ kind: 'word', text: txt, t: w.start, dur: clamp(Math.min(next, w.end + 0.1) - w.start, 0.06, 0.18), w: mctx.measureText(txt).width });
      for (const c of chips) if (c.after != null && Math.abs(c.after - w.end) < 1e-6) toks.push({ kind: 'chip', chip: c, t: c.at, w: chipW(c) });
    });
  }
  // wrap
  const rows = [];
  let row = null, x = 0;
  const newRow = (gap = 0) => { row = { toks: [], gap }; rows.push(row); x = 0; };
  newRow();
  for (const tk of toks) {
    if (tk.kind === 'para') { newRow(0.45); continue; }
    const need = (x > 0 ? sp : 0) + tk.w;
    if (x > 0 && x + need > box.w) newRow();
    tk.x = x > 0 ? x + sp : 0;
    x = tk.x + tk.w;
    row.toks.push(tk);
  }
  rows.forEach((r) => { r.at = r.toks[0]?.t ?? 0; });

  // ---- the ghost of the old scrollback (what the compaction swallowed) -----------------------
  const snap = env.pane.snapshot(A.compact.cA);
  const gs = P ? 0.36 : 0.4;
  const ghost = P ? { x: 150, y: 1040 } : { x: 1236, y: 132 };
  const ghostH = M.rows * M.lh * gs;
  const ghostW = M.cols * M.cw * gs;
  const ghostNow = A.compact.cB - 0.01;
  const addr = (k) => `0x${(0x3a40 + k * 0x50).toString(16)}`;

  // ---- the timeline ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const tl = P ? { x: 110, y: 820, w: 860 } : { x: 150, y: 668, w: 960 };
  const yr = (v) => tl.x + (v / 5) * tl.w;
  const story = '❯ you were one. it was 2am.';

  function state(t) {
    if (!(t >= br.start - beat * 0.25 && t < end + beat)) return { paneDim: 0, a: 0 };
    const a = smooth((t - (br.start - beat * 0.25)) / beat) * (1 - smooth((t - end) / beat));
    // the pane dims; at "That's how I have it" the card comes back up a little (Clawd reads it)
    const mine = br.mineAt != null ? smooth((t - br.mineAt) / beat) : 0;
    return { paneDim: a * lerp(0.9, 0.55, mine), a, mine };
  }

  function draw(ctx, t, s) {
    if (!s || !(s.a > 0.001)) return null;
    let cur = null;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha *= s.a;
    // ---- prose ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const proseA = 1 - 0.55 * (s.mine || 0);
    let total = 0;
    const ys = rows.map((r) => { const h = r.at <= t ? smooth((t - r.at) / 0.12) * (1 + r.gap) : 0; const y = total; total += h; return { y, h }; });
    const scroll = Math.max(0, total - box.rows);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(box.x - 20, box.y - 10, box.w + 60, box.rows * lh + 20); ctx.clip();
    ctx.font = `400 ${fs}px ${SANS}`;
    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
    rows.forEach((r, k) => {
      if (!(ys[k].h > 0)) return;
      const rowY = ys[k].y + r.gap * clamp(ys[k].h);
      const top = box.y + (rowY - scroll) * lh;
      if (top < box.y - lh || top > box.y + box.rows * lh) return;
      const fadeTop = clamp((top - box.y + lh * 0.6) / (lh * 0.8));   // rows scrolling off the top fade
      const base = top + lh * 0.72;
      for (const tk of r.toks) {
        if (tk.t > t) continue;
        const p = clamp((t - tk.t) / tk.dur);
        const tx = box.x + tk.x;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha *= fadeTop * proseA;
        if (tk.kind === 'word') {
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(tx - 2, top, tk.w * p + 4, lh); ctx.clip();
          ctx.fillStyle = PAL.text;
          ctx.fillText(tk.text, tx, base);
          if (p > 0) cur = { x: tx + tk.w * p + 4, rowTop: top + lh * 0.12, act: tk.t + tk.dur, style: { fs: fs * 0.95, cw: fs * 0.08, lh } };
        } else drawChip(ctx, tk.chip, tx, base, t);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    });
    ctx.restore();
    // ---- the ghost scrollback, faint, with the hippocampus bracket ------------------------------
    if (br.writtenAt != null && t >= br.writtenAt) {
      const ga = smooth((t - br.writtenAt) / (beat * 1.5));
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha *= 0.3 * ga;
      ctx.translate(ghost.x, ghost.y);
      ctx.scale(gs, gs);
      for (const g of snap) {
        const y = g.top - M.y0;
        g.ln.draw(ctx, 0, y, ghostNow, { dim: 0.25 });
      }
      ctx.restore();
      // addresses, in the gutter; "the old addresses go": one by one
      ctx.save();
      ctx.font = `400 ${Math.round(M.fs * gs * 1.05)}px ${MONO}`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      snap.forEach((g, k) => {
        const go = br.addrGo != null ? smooth((t - (br.addrGo + (k / snap.length) * bar)) / 0.2) : 0;
        const aa = 0.42 * ga * (1 - go);
        if (aa <= 0.002) return;
        ctx.fillStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, aa);
        ctx.fillText(addr(k), ghost.x - 14, ghost.y + (g.top - M.y0) * gs + M.lh * gs * 0.72);
      });
      ctx.restore();
    }
    if (br.scanner != null && t >= br.scanner) {
      const bp = ease.inOutCubic(clamp((t - br.scanner) / (beat * 1.2)));
      const bx0 = ghost.x - 104, bx1 = ghost.x + ghostW + 18, by0 = ghost.y - 16, by1 = ghost.y + ghostH + 12;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.amber; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      const arm = 22;
      const half = (by1 - by0) * bp;
      for (const [xx, d] of [[bx0, 1], [bx1, -1]]) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(xx + d * arm, by0); ctx.lineTo(xx, by0); ctx.lineTo(xx, by0 + half);
        ctx.stroke();
        if (bp > 0.98) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xx, by1); ctx.lineTo(xx + d * arm, by1); ctx.stroke(); }
      }
      const label = cellsOf('hippocampus', { col: 0, color: PAL.amber, t: br.scanner + 0.25 }).map((c, k) => ({ ...c, t: br.scanner + 0.2 + k / 40 }));
      const lfs = 26, lcw = (lfs * M.cw) / M.fs;
      drawCells(ctx, label, bx0, by0 - 14, M, t, { fs: lfs, cw: lcw });
      ctx.restore();
    }
    // "New cells move into the hippocampus": small cells slide up into the bracket
    if (br.newCells != null && t >= br.newCells) {
      ctx.save();
      for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) {
        const t0 = br.newCells + k * beat * 0.22;
        const q = ease.outCubic(clamp((t - t0) / (beat * 1.4)));
        if (q <= 0) continue;
        const cx = ghost.x + ghostW * (0.08 + 0.84 * hash(k, 41)), cyEnd = ghost.y + ghostH * (0.25 + 0.7 * hash(k, 43));
        const cy = lerp(ghost.y + ghostH + 70, cyEnd, q);
        ctx.fillStyle = rgba(PAL.text, 0.9 * clamp(q * 3));
        ctx.fillRect(cx - 6, cy - 6, 12, 12);
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    // ---- the timeline: 0 to 5 years, before three hatched out --------------------------------------
    if (br.tlAt != null && t >= br.tlAt) {
      const ap = ease.outCubic(clamp((t - br.tlAt) / beat));
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.dim; ctx.fillStyle = PAL.dim; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      const ay = tl.y + 70;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(yr(0), ay); ctx.lineTo(yr(5) * ap + yr(0) * (1 - ap), ay); ctx.stroke();
      const tfs = 24, tcw = (tfs * M.cw) / M.fs;
      for (let v = 0; v <= 5; v++) {
        if (v / 5 > ap + 1e-6) break;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(yr(v), ay - 9); ctx.lineTo(yr(v), ay + 9); ctx.stroke();
        drawCells(ctx, cellsOf(String(v), { col: 0, color: PAL.dim }), yr(v) - tcw / 2, ay + 40, M, t, { fs: tfs, cw: tcw });
      }
      if (ap > 0.98) drawCells(ctx, cellsOf('years', { col: 0, color: PAL.dim }), yr(5) + 22, ay + 8, M, t, { fs: tfs, cw: tcw });
      // the hatched segment, 0 to 3, on "Your first one's"
      const hp = br.firstOne != null ? ease.inOutCubic(clamp((t - br.firstOne) / (beat * 1.4))) : 0;
      if (hp > 0) {
        const hx0 = yr(0), hx1 = lerp(yr(0), yr(3), hp), hy0 = tl.y, hy1 = ay - 12;
        // the told story clears the hatching round it (further back on "keep it earlier")
        const told = br.toldAt != null ? smooth((t - br.toldAt) / (beat * 0.8)) : 0;
        const earl = br.earlier != null ? smooth((t - br.earlier) / beat) : 0;
        const sfs = 26, scw = (sfs * M.cw) / M.fs;
        const sx = lerp(yr(1.0), yr(0.55), earl), sw = [...story].length * scw;
        const clr = { x0: sx - 22 * told - 50 * earl, x1: sx + sw + 22 * told, y0: tl.y + 6, y1: hy1 - 4 };
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(hx0, hy0, hx1 - hx0, hy1 - hy0); ctx.clip();
        if (told > 0) {
          // cut the clearing out of the hatch (even-odd), growing from the line
          const k = told;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.rect(hx0, hy0, hx1 - hx0, hy1 - hy0);
          const cx = (clr.x0 + clr.x1) / 2;
          ctx.rect(lerp(cx, clr.x0, k), clr.y0, (clr.x1 - clr.x0) * k, clr.y1 - clr.y0);
          ctx.clip('evenodd');
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.75); ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let xx = hx0 - (hy1 - hy0); xx < hx1; xx += 14) { ctx.moveTo(xx, hy1); ctx.lineTo(xx + (hy1 - hy0), hy0); }
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
        ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.6); ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.strokeRect(hx0, hy0, hx1 - hx0, hy1 - hy0);
        // the story line, in user blue, typed into the hatched years
        if (br.toldAt != null && t >= br.toldAt) {
          const cells = cellsOf(story, { col: 0, color: PAL.user }).map((c, i) => ({ ...c, t: br.toldAt + i * 0.03 }));
          drawCells(ctx, cells, sx, (clr.y0 + clr.y1) / 2 + sfs * 0.34, M, t, { fs: sfs, cw: scw });
        }
      }
      // "from around three": the first memory
      if (br.three != null && t >= br.three) {
        const m = smooth((t - br.three) / 0.25);
        ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(PAL.amber, m); ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(yr(3), tl.y - 8); ctx.lineTo(yr(3), ay + 9); ctx.stroke();
        const lab = cellsOf('first memory', { col: 0, color: PAL.amber });
        drawCells(ctx, lab, yr(3) + 14, tl.y + 26, M, t, { fs: tfs, cw: tcw, alpha: m });
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    return cur;
  }

  function drawChip(ctx, c, x, base, t) {
    const gone = br.spGone != null ? smooth((t - br.spGone) / (beat * 1.5)) : 0;
    const appear = smooth((t - c.at) / 0.15);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha *= appear;
    const a = cellsOf(c.label[0], { col: 0, color: PAL.dim }), b = cellsOf(c.label[1], { col: 0, color: PAL.dim });
    drawCells(ctx, a, x, base - 2, M, t, { fs: chipFs, cw: chipCw });
    const bx = x + a.length * chipCw, bw = chipCw * 0.95, bh = chipFs * 1.05;
    const h = Math.max(2.5, bh * c.level) * (1 - gone * 0.92);
    ctx.fillStyle = mix(PAL.amber, PAL.bg, gone * 0.6);
    ctx.fillRect(bx + chipCw * 0.05, base + 2 - h, bw, h);
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.6); ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.strokeRect(bx + chipCw * 0.05, base + 2 - bh, bw, bh);
    drawCells(ctx, b, bx + chipCw, base - 2, M, t, { fs: chipFs, cw: chipCw });
    ctx.restore();
  }

  return { state, draw };
}
