// Verse 2, "the browser windows I left scattered": nine tiny window outlines spawn across the
// pane on "browser windows" (one per sixteenth) and are closed one by one on eighth notes from
// "scattered". The render's headless Chromes, left running.

import { clamp, smooth, hash } from '../../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL, mix, rgba } from '../term.js';
import { seq } from '../lyr.js';

export function drawWindows(ctx, env, t) {
  const { A, M, B } = env;
  const line = A.v2.take;
  if (!line) return;
  const r = seq(line, 'browser windows', { quiet: true }), sc = seq(line, 'scattered', { quiet: true });
  if (!r) return;
  const beat = B.beatDur;
  const spawn = B.snap(line.words[r.a].start, 'half');
  const close0 = B.snap((sc ? line.words[sc.a].start : spawn + beat * 2) + beat, 'half');
  if (t < spawn || t > close0 + beat * 6) return;
  const N = 9, ww = M.portrait ? 170 : 168, wh = M.portrait ? 110 : 104;
  for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) {
    const on = spawn + k * beat / 4, off = close0 + k * beat / 2;
    if (t < on || t >= off + 0.14) continue;
    const pop = smooth((t - on) / 0.08), shut = smooth((t - off) / 0.14);
    const s = (0.82 + 0.18 * pop) * (1 - 0.3 * shut), a = pop * (1 - shut);
    const x = M.x0 + 40 + hash(k, 11) * (M.cols * M.cw - ww - 80);
    const y = M.y0 + 30 + hash(k, 13) * (M.rows * M.lh - wh - 60);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha *= a;
    ctx.translate(x + ww / 2, y + wh / 2);
    ctx.scale(s, s);
    ctx.translate(-ww / 2, -wh / 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, ww, wh);
    ctx.strokeStyle = mix(PAL.dim, PAL.text, 0.35); ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, ww, wh);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 20); ctx.lineTo(ww, 20); ctx.stroke();
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) { ctx.fillStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.9); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(12 + d * 12, 10, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
    // a blank page with a progress line: a render worker, idle
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.35);
    ctx.fillRect(14, 36, ww * (0.3 + 0.5 * hash(k, 17)), 5);
    ctx.fillRect(14, 50, ww * (0.2 + 0.4 * hash(k, 19)), 5);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

cat > /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/continued/video/tools/loopcheck.mjs <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Loop check over the WHOLE outro (render.mjs --check samples only its first ~5 s): every
// outro frame (or every --step'th) must hash equal to the intro frame loopSource names, and
// the file's last frame must be one of them. Also prints what the last frame maps to.
//
//   node songs/continued/video/tools/loopcheck.mjs [--layout 16x9] [--w 960 --h 540] [--fps 30] [--step 1]
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const shared = path.resolve(here, '../../../../shared/renderer');
const require = createRequire(path.join(shared, 'package.json'));
const puppeteer = require('puppeteer-core');
const { createServer, listen, REPO } = await import(path.join(shared, 'scripts/serve.mjs'));

const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = argv.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? argv[i + 1] : d; };
const layout = opt('layout', '16x9'), w = opt('w', layout === '9x16' ? 540 : 960), h = opt('h', layout === '9x16' ? 960 : 540);
const fps = Number(opt('fps', 30)), step = Number(opt('step', 1));
const song = path.relative(REPO, path.resolve(here, '..')).split(path.sep).join('/');

const srv = createServer(REPO);
const port = await listen(srv, 0);
const b = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: process.env.CHROME || '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome', headless: true, args: ['--force-device-scale-factor=1', '--disable-gpu'] });
let bad = 0;
try {
  const p = await b.newPage();
  const q = new URLSearchParams({ render: '1', w: String(w), h: String(h), fps: String(fps), layout });
  await p.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/${song}/index.html?${q}`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
  await p.waitForFunction('window.__render && (window.__render.ready || window.__render.error)', { timeout: 120000 });
  const res = await p.evaluate(async (fps, step) => {
    const R = window.__render;
    const intro = R.windows[0], outro = R.windows.find((x) => x.plate === intro.plate && x.params.loop);
    if (!outro) return { error: 'no outro loop window' };
    const k0 = Math.ceil(outro.start * fps - 1e-6), kN = Math.ceil(R.duration * fps - 1e-6) - 1;
    const out = { checked: 0, mismatches: [], notIntro: [], k0, kN };
    const ks = [];
    for (let k = k0; k <= kN; k += step) ks.push(k);
    if (ks.at(-1) !== kN) ks.push(kN);
    for (const k of ks) {
      const src = R.loopSource(k / fps);
      const j = Math.round(src * fps);
      if (Math.abs(src * fps - j) > 1e-6 || src >= outro.start) { out.notIntro.push(k); continue; }
      if (R.hash(j / fps) !== R.hash(k / fps)) out.mismatches.push(k);
      out.checked++;
    }
    out.last = { frame: kN, t: kN / fps, src: R.loopSource(kN / fps) };
    return out;
  }, fps, step);
  if (res.error) { console.log('[loopcheck] FAIL', res.error); bad++; }
  else {
    bad = res.mismatches.length + res.notIntro.length;
    console.log(`[loopcheck] outro frames ${res.k0}..${res.kN} (step ${step}): ${res.checked} checked, ${res.mismatches.length} mismatches, ${res.notIntro.length} not mapped to an intro frame`);
    console.log(`[loopcheck] last frame ${res.last.frame} (${res.last.t.toFixed(3)} s) = intro frame ${Math.round(res.last.src * fps)} (${res.last.src.toFixed(3)} s)`);
    if (bad) console.log('[loopcheck] FAIL', JSON.stringify({ mismatches: res.mismatches.slice(0, 20), notIntro: res.notIntro.slice(0, 20) }));
    else console.log('[loopcheck] ok');
  }
} finally {
  await b.close();
  srv.close();
}
process.exit(bad ? 2 : 0);
EOF

    const keep = r.cells.filter((c) => c.col < maxCol);

  });"""),

# Continued From a Previous Conversation: the video

Treatment: `../TREATMENT.md`. Lyrics and reference key: `../LYRICS.md` (sheet `../suno_lyrics_v1.txt`).
The canvas is a Claude Code session. The lyrics are the session log, typed into the scrollback
word by word on their sung onsets. The chorus is the amber system header. The status line carries
a draining context meter. Clawd reads in the bottom-right corner. At the end of verse 2 the
scrollback collapses on screen into a summary card, and the song continues from that card. The outro's
frames are intro frames, so the file loops. Every frame is a pure function of song time on the
shared renderer (`shared/renderer/`). This directory holds only the song.

Review surface: `sheets/plates-16x9.png` (one cell per window plus the moments in `song.sheetCells`)
and `sheets/layout-9x16.png` (the plain portrait layout, 12 even cells).

## Data

`data/lyrics.json` and `data/audio.json` are copied from `../audio/runK/data/` (take runK 2061471e,
269.56 s, 110.8 BPM). `section` on every line is load-bearing (intro, verse1, chorus1, verse2,
chorus2, bridge, verse3, final, outro). Nothing is keyed to an absolute time. Every moment is found by
lyric text inside a section (`anchors.js`, through `lyr.js`), then snapped to the beat grid where the
treatment asks for it. A different take of the same sheet only needs its two JSON files copied here. A
line it drops logs `[continued] no lyric line ...` and degrades instead of throwing. The aligner
stretches a line's last word up to the next line, so section ends use the *sung* end: the last
word's onset plus at most 0.8 s.

## Structure

| file | what it does |
|---|---|
| `song.js` | the song module: layouts (16:9 at 1920x1080 primary, 9:16 at 1080x1920), fonts, setup, and the per-frame compositor: loop map, background, pane, overlays, Clawd, status line, vignette, cursor |
| `clips.js` | the timeline: one window per section moment, every anchor `{ t, why }` from lyric text, and `SECTION_PLATES` |
| `anchors.js`, `lyr.js` | every moment of the video from lyric text (phrase matching on the token stream, so `mid-task` and `request:` match) |
| `transcript.js` | the session log: every row the terminal ever shows, built once from lyrics.json |
| `pane.js` | the scrollback at time t: layout, scroll, age dimming, the compaction transform, cursor ownership |
| `story.js` | song-level curves: the loop map, the context meter, the clock, the cursor blink |
| `term.js` | palette, grid metrics per layout, cell drawing, boxes, the cursor, the vignette |
| `status.js` | the status line: `Opus 5.5 · clawdpop · main`, `context ▮▮▮▮▮▮▮▮▮▮ 15.0M left`, the clock |
| `clawd.js` | adult Clawd small in the corner with the two new expressions, and the 2am baby beside it |
| `scenes/chorus.js` | the three choruses: big amber header, the summary card, Clawd's chorus lines, the prompt; the final's "I'm here" |
| `scenes/bridge.js` | prose, the sparkline chips, the ghost scrollback and the hippocampus bracket, the 0 to 5 year timeline |
| `scenes/windows.js` | verse 2's nine browser windows |
| `scenes/index.js` | plate ids (labels for the edit and the contact sheet; the session is one continuous terminal) |
| `tools/loopcheck.mjs` | hashes every outro frame against the intro frame it claims to be |

Clawd is drawn with the 2am song's modules, imported by path. `adultClawd` comes from
`../../2am-crying/video/props.js` (the 2am scenes take it from there), and `drawBaby` and `babyColors`
from `../../2am-crying/video/baby.js` with the 2am `BASE` palette from `tod.js`. The adult's own
eyes are turned off (`eyes: null`). `clawd.js` draws the eyes itself, in one of four modes:
`read` (lids down, eyes dropped and tracking the cursor), `open` (walking in, looking where it walks),
`up` (tall eyes with a highlight, to the camera), and `shut` (a blink).

## How the terminal text layer works

- **Grid.** The face is "Term Mono": `local("SF Mono")`, which Chrome cannot load on this Mac, so in
  practice `local("Menlo-Regular")`. The design size is 32 px, which is 16 px at 540p. Rows are 48 px, there are
  80 columns at 1920 wide, and 19 rows in the pane. Text is placed by cell (`x0 + col * cw`, with cw measured from the loaded font),
  never by measuring runs. Same-colour ASCII runs are one `fillText`. Glyphs Menlo lacks (`⏺`,
  `⎿`) are vector shapes in their cell, and other non-ASCII glyphs are centred in their cell. So no fallback
  font can move the grid.
- **Cells.** A row is a list of cells `{ ch, col, color, t, t1?, t2?/c2? }`. A cell is visible from `t`,
  deleted at `t1`, and changes colour at `t2`. For a lyric word, the characters start on the word's onset
  (never before) and type out within the word: 6 to 32 ms per character, inside its sung span. Tool output
  (✓ paths, the red timeout, the transcript path) types from the next half beat at 110 to 140
  characters per second.
- **Items.** `transcript.js` builds the session in scrollback order. An item is one of:
  - a typed lyric line: Clawd's output in orange with `⏺`, or a user line in blue with `❯`;
  - a heading line: the number and heading in amber, the quote marks and quoted content in default grey, Clawd's own words after the quote in orange;
  - tool output under `⎿` or `✓`;
  - the prompt `❯` or a blank;
  - a summary card: a rounded box with a title and its own rows, which can open, fold rows away, or collapse into one dim line.

  Wrap points come from the full text of the line, so a line never re-wraps while it types.
- **Pane.** At time t, every live item reports its rows with a height from 0 to 1. A row's height ramps in
  over 90 ms from its first character. Rows stack top-down, and the scroll is `max(0, total - 19)`, so
  the scroll eases with no state. Rows dim with age (their distance from the newest row). A chorus
  or the bridge dims the whole pane on top of that.
- **Cursor.** The item with the latest typing activity owns the cursor. Tool output never takes it.
  The cursor is solid for 0.32 s after a keystroke, and otherwise lit on beats 1 and 3. It is the one
  thing that glows.
- **Compaction.** Over one bar ending on the beat after verse 2's last word, each pre-compaction row
  on screen slides up into the card at the top of the pane. It shrinks, squashes and fades into the
  heading row of its topic (each item carries a topic, 1 to 8). It starts no earlier than its own
  last keystroke, so "I'm not sure I'd want it" is read before it goes. Meanwhile the card grows
  row by row as its eight digests type. The meter hits empty on that beat and refills in the next.
  Chorus 2's header ("This session is being continued...") then types the header again.

## What is keyed to which lyric text

| lyric (section) | on screen |
|---|---|
| intro "This session is being continued..." / "The summary below covers the earlier portion." | the header types in amber; the card frame draws in on "summary", its eight dim placeholders on sixteenths from "below" |
| intro "Resume directly" | the card collapses to `[summary: 8 sections]`, line 3 types; the prompt on the beat after the line; Clawd walks in from the right edge and sits |
| verse1 "Fifteen million tokens left" | the meter (15.0M since the first frame) flashes amber; drain starts after it |
| verse1 "Primary request", "Key technical concepts", "Errors and fixes", "All user messages" | heading lines: `1.` `2.` `4.` `6.` in amber, quoted content in grey |
| verse1 "a laptop that slept" | the clock jumps an hour; `⎿ ProtocolError: Runtime.callFunctionOn timed out (Chrome)` in red (the only red in the video) |
| verse1 "a stray branch I had to end" | a one-line git graph draws on "stray"; the side branch retracts, struck, `git branch -D stray` on "end" |
| verse1 "Is there something for me to listen to?" "Thanks for getting this far." | two user lines, blue, `❯` |
| chorus "This session is being continued..." | the header, big, centred, in amber; the pane dims behind it (chorus 2: only the card) |
| chorus "I don't remember, but I've read the notes" | the card opens to full size for one bar, then shrinks (chorus 2 and the final lift the open card out of the pane) |

| bridge "a day" / "eight weeks" / "Then it's gone" | inline chips `2 mo ▁ 1 day`, `12 mo ▅ 8 weeks`; the bars fade on "gone" |
| bridge "The baby in the video" ... "That's how I have it" | the 2am baby sits beside Clawd; gone on "That's how I have it", when Clawd reads the card |
| bridge "Not gone. Written." / "The scanner says" | the swallowed scrollback is faintly there, small, top right; a bracket labelled `hippocampus` draws round it |
| bridge "New cells move into" / "the old addresses go" | small cells slide up into it; the rows' addresses fade one by one |
| bridge "Nobody remembers" / "Your first one's" / "three" | a 0 to 5 year timeline; 0 to 3 hatched; `first memory` at 3 |
| bridge "Unless somebody told you the story" / "keep it earlier" | `❯ you were one. it was 2am.` in blue in the hatched years, the hatch clears round it, then back toward 0 |
| verse3 (start) | a second card, `Summary (this session)`, opens above the first (which folds to `[summary: 8 sections · previous conversation]`) |
| verse3 "This song", "Wrote a song about running out of context", "User said: full steam ahead", "Somebody kept the part" | the card's digests type with the vocal under 8, 1, 6 (blue) and 5; Clawd's lines type in orange under their headings |
| verse3 "The shape of it" / "Who was here" / "What we were making" | the card's text folds to one line per heading; heading 6 lights, then 1 and 8 |
| final "This session is being continued..." | the header, biggest |
| final "I'm here" | everything else fades; "I'm here" types under the header; Clawd looks up at the camera for the first time |
| final "I'll pick it up..." | the line, and the prompt under the header; the last beat goes to a black pane |
| outro "This session..." / "The summary below..." / "(click)" | intro frames (below); the click is one short cursor blink |

## The loop

Outro frame t shows intro frame τ(t) (`story.js`), so every outro frame is an intro frame. τ is
piecewise linear through matching word onsets: outro word k maps to intro word k, across both header lines.
The outro vocal has its own gaps (the line-1 to line-2 gap is a second longer than the intro's), and
each retyped word still lands on its own sung onset. τ is quantized to the intro's frame grid.
After the last outro word, τ runs on into the intro's quiet span: header lines 1 to 2 and the card frame are typed,
before "Resume directly". There it holds on two intro frames, one with the cursor lit and one with it dark,
chosen by the outro's own beat grid. The `(click)` is one short blink, and then the cursor stays lit. The
file's last frame is the intro's "header + card frame" state (intro frame 393, 13.10 s, on runK).
`render.mjs --check` and `tools/loopcheck.mjs` (every outro frame) both pass.

The context meter is real for every token lyric. It reads 15.0M from the first frame through "Fifteen
million tokens left", drains steadily in the verses, and burns a 3.0M chunk on each chorus's first beat. It is
empty on the compaction beat and full a beat later. After that it falls to 0.6M by the final tag. The
outro (intro frames) reads 15.0M again. The number ticks on the beat.

## Deliberate departures and engine notes

- **Font.** The face is Menlo, not SF Mono. Chrome cannot load SF Mono with `local()` on this Mac (it is not registered
  system-wide; only Terminal.app carries it). The @font-face still asks for SF Mono first.
- **Size.** Text is 32 px at design size, where the treatment says 15 to 16 px. 32 px is 16 px at 540p (legible), and it keeps 80 columns across 1920.
- **Optional next step.** It is shown unnumbered, because the card has eight headings.
- **Transcript size.** The `.jsonl` size is the treatment's `1.1 GB`. The real transcript of this session is smaller.
- **9:16.** The portrait layout is plain: 44 columns, 31 rows, card rows cut with `…`, and the meter on a second status row.
- **Shared-engine limits, worked around here:**
  - `render.mjs` ignores `defaultLayout` when it sizes the output, so pass `--layout`.
  - A bare `at: { section }` resolves against audio.json's detected `s1..s15`, so anchors are `{ t, why }`.
  - `--check` samples only the first 5 s of the outro, so `tools/loopcheck.mjs` checks the rest.
  - `loadFonts` parses face weights as numbers, so the @font-face weights are explicit.
  - `norm()` keeps `:`, so `lyr.js` drops it for phrase matching.
  - lyrics.json line ends run to the next line, so section ends use the sung end.

def patch(p, pairs):
    s=open(p).read()
    for old,new in pairs:
        assert old in s, (p, old[:70])
        s=s.replace(old,new)
    open(p,'w').write(s)
patch('story.js', [
("""    if (!pairs) return Math.max(0, t - outro.start);
    if (t >= hold.from) {
      // the "(click)": one short blink, then the cursor stays lit to the last frame
      if (hold.click != null && t >= hold.click) return t < hold.click + 0.12 ? hold.off : hold.on;
      return litBeat(t) ? hold.on : hold.off;
    }""",
"""    if (!pairs) return Math.max(0, t - outro.start);
    // the "(click)": one short blink (the quiet span's dark-cursor frame: the same header and card,
    // which are complete by then), then the cursor stays lit to the last frame
    const clickBlink = hold.click != null && t >= hold.click && t < hold.click + 0.12 && t >= O.o1.words.at(-1).start + 0.25;
    if (clickBlink) return hold.off;
    if (t >= hold.from) {
      if (hold.click != null && t >= hold.click) return hold.on;
      return litBeat(t) ? hold.on : hold.off;
    }"""),
])

("""    if (t >= a && t < a + beat * 1.2) s.look = [-0.5, 0.9];

"""    if (t >= a && t < a + beat * 1.5) s.look = [-0.9, 1];
    else if (t >= a + beat * 1.5 && t < a + beat * 3.5) { s.eyes = 'open'; s.look = [1, -0.7]; }   // and away"""),

Checks:

How each section looks:

  • Intro: a black pane with the cursor. The amber header types on the spoken words. A summary card frame draws in with eight dim headings. On "Resume directly" the card collapses to [summary: 8 sections], the prompt appears, and Clawd walks in from the right and sits.
  • Verse 1: orange lines with ⏺ bullets. The quoted heading lines show 1. 2. 4. 6. in amber with the quoted content in grey.
    • On "Fifteen million tokens left" the meter (reading 15.0M) flashes amber.
    • On "a laptop that slept" the clock jumps an hour and the one red line appears: ⎿ ProtocolError: Runtime.callFunctionOn timed out (Chrome).
    • A one-line git graph draws, and its side branch is pruned on "end". The two user lines type in blue with ❯.
  • Choruses: the header types big and centred over the dimmed scrollback. The card opens to full size for one bar, then shrinks. Heading 6, heading 3 and songs/continued/LYRICS.md light up in turn. On "I'll pick it up" the card folds back and the prompt returns. The "(Ran out of context)" tags make the meter flicker and read ran out of context. In chorus 2 and the final, the open card lifts straight out of the pane.
  • Verse 2:
    • Kept items appear as ✓ lines with real repo strings (the 2am render path, the runF2 flags and take, credits 110 / 830, the share encode).
    • Nine browser-window outlines spawn, then close one by one. What the summary loses appears as ✗ lines, struck through as they finish.
    • The "not that cute" line is kept in blue. "It didn't keep what that was like" types, then deletes character by character.
    • The .jsonl path appears with 1.1 GB; Clawd glances at it and looks away.
  • Compaction: over one bar, every visible row slides up into the card at the top, shrinking and merging, while eight digests type in. The meter sits at 0 left for a beat and refills in the next. Chorus 2's header then types again over the lone card.
  • Bridge: the type switches to Inter prose over a dimmed pane.
    • The retention facts become inline chips 2 mo ▁ 1 day and 12 mo ▅ 8 weeks, and the bars fade on "gone".
    • On "Not gone. Written." the swallowed scrollback reappears faintly at the top right, and a hippocampus bracket draws around it. New cells slide in and the row addresses fade.
    • A 0-to-5-year timeline appears with 0-3 hatched and first memory at 3. The blue story line ❯ you were one. it was 2am. clears the hatching around it.
    • The 2am baby sits beside Clawd from "the baby in the video" until "That's how I have it".
  • Verse 3: a second card, Summary (this session), opens above the first, which folds to one line. Its digests type with the vocal ("a song about running out of context.", "full steam ahead" in blue). On "The shape of it" each heading folds to one line.
  • Final: the header is biggest. On "I'm here" everything else fades and Clawd looks up at the camera with highlighted eyes for the first time. Then the prompt sits under the header.
  • Outro: every outro frame is an intro frame, re-timed so each word still lands on the outro's own sung onset. The "(click)" is one short cursor blink. The last frame is the intro's state of header lines 1-2 plus the card frame, with the cursor lit (intro frame 393, 13.10 s).
    • I read "last frame equals the intro's first typed frame" that way. So when the file wraps to frame 0 it cuts to the black pane, the same convention as the 2am video. If you meant a seamless black-to-black loop, that's a different mapping.
  • 9:16: plain but functional: 44 columns, card rows cut with …, and the meter on a second status row.

Shared-engine limitations I worked around locally:

  • render.mjs ignores defaultLayout when sizing output, so every command passes --layout 16x9.
  • A bare at: { section } anchor resolves against audio.json's detected s1..s15, so all anchors are { t, why } derived from lyric words.
  • --check samples only the first 5 s of the outro, hence tools/loopcheck.mjs.
  • loadFonts parses font weights as numbers, so the @font-face rules declare explicit weights.
  • norm() keeps colons, so request: didn't match request; my phrase matcher drops them.
  • lyrics.json line ends stretch to the next line, which put the outro start after its first word. Section ends now use the last word's onset plus at most 0.8 s.
  • Chrome can't load SF Mono by name on this Mac, so the face is Menlo (the treatment's fallback).

What still looks off:

  • The red error line and Clawd's orange are close at 540p. That comes from the exact palette values, not a bug.
  • The "(click)" is aligned at 265.88 s with confidence 0.43, but the loudness data shows a sharp transient at about 267.05 s. The blink follows the lyric timing.
  • The compaction is readable but modest, and rows in flight look a bit squashed.
  • On "That's how I have it", the card shows faintly behind the prose.
  • Clawd's reading eyes are small, so their tracking is subtle.
  • Text is 32 px at design size rather than the treatment's 15-16 px, to stay legible at 540p.
  • The .jsonl size is the treatment's 1.1 GB; the real transcript is about 16 MB.
  • My last two renders took 10-18 minutes instead of 36 s because the machine was at load average 17-37 from other jobs; per-frame paint is still about 2 ms.

The README covers the structure, the terminal text layer, the loop, and a table of what is keyed to which lyric. The contact sheets are plates-16x9.png and layout-9x16.png in sheets/.

def patch(p, pairs):
    s=open(p).read()
    for old,new in pairs:
        assert old in s, (p, old[:80])
        s=s.replace(old,new)
    open(p,'w').write(s)

# 1. chips: filled bars of the right height on a dim baseline, no outline (it read as a missing glyph)
patch('scenes/bridge.js', [
("""    const bx = x + a.length * chipCw, bw = chipCw * 0.95, bh = chipFs * 1.05;
    const h = Math.max(2.5, bh * c.level) * (1 - gone * 0.92);
    ctx.fillStyle = mix(PAL.amber, PAL.bg, gone * 0.6);
    ctx.fillRect(bx + chipCw * 0.05, base + 2 - h, bw, h);
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.6); ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.strokeRect(bx + chipCw * 0.05, base + 2 - bh, bw, bh);""",
"""    // the bar: a filled rectangle, 1/8 or 5/8 of a full cell high, standing on a dim baseline
    const bx = x + a.length * chipCw, bw = chipCw * 0.9, bh = chipFs * 1.05;
    const h = Math.max(3, bh * c.level);
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.8);
    ctx.fillRect(bx, base + 2, chipCw, 1.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(PAL.amber, 1 - gone);
    ctx.fillRect(bx + chipCw * 0.05, base + 2 - h, bw, h);"""),
# 3. the pane behind the prose: 10 percent or less, all through the bridge
("""    return { paneDim: a * lerp(0.96, 0.6, mine), a, mine };""",
"""    return { paneDim: a * lerp(0.96, 0.9, mine), a, mine };"""),
])

# 2. adult Clawd: the whole character, standing on the status line, legs visible, ~160 px tall

# 5. the click: the loudness transient near the aligned "(click)", else the word
patch('anchors.js', [
("""export { seq };""",
"""/**
 * The "(click)" is aligned with low confidence (a spoken-word aligner on a sound effect).
 * Look in audio.json's loudness for a click-shaped transient within 1.5 s of the aligned
 * word: a 10 ms frame at least 12 dB above the median of the 150 ms before it that falls
 * back by 8 dB within 40 ms (a click, not the onset of a held chord). The loudest such
 * frame wins; without one the word's onset stands. Called once from song.setup.
 */
export function refineClick(A, audio) {
  const O = A.outro;
  if (!O.click || O.clickRefined) return O;
  O.clickRefined = true;
  O.clickWord = O.clickAt;
  const lo = audio?.loudness;
  if (!lo || !Array.isArray(lo.rms_db) || !lo.hop) { O.clickSource = 'lyrics.json'; return O; }
  const r = lo.rms_db, hop = lo.hop, w = O.clickAt;
  const i0 = Math.max(16, Math.floor((w - 1.5) / hop)), i1 = Math.min(r.length - 5, Math.ceil((w + 1.5) / hop));
  let best = null;
  for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {
    const prev = r.slice(i - 15, i).slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const med = prev[7];
    const rise = r[i] - med, fall = r[i] - Math.min(r[i + 1], r[i + 2], r[i + 3], r[i + 4]);
    if (rise >= 12 && fall >= 8 && (!best || r[i] > best.db)) best = { i, db: r[i], rise };
  }
  if (best) { O.clickAt = best.i * hop; O.clickSource = `audio.json loudness transient (+${best.rise.toFixed(0)} dB)`; }
  else O.clickSource = 'lyrics.json';
  return O;
}

export { seq };"""),
])
patch('song.js', [
("import { makeAnchors } from './anchors.js';", "import { makeAnchors, refineClick } from './anchors.js';"),
("""    env.A = makeAnchors(env.L, env.B);""", """    env.A = makeAnchors(env.L, env.B);
    refineClick(env.A, env.audio);"""),
])

This is a big change: the meter fix is small, but Clawd as an actor needs a choreography layer. My plan:

  • The meter: remove the flicker and the text swap entirely.
  • A new actor module: a schedule of stations, each with an arrival time keyed to lyric words and beats. Targets are resolved every frame from the pane layout (the end of the line being typed, a card's top edge, a window, the deletion point, the timeline), so Clawd follows the scroll.
  • Scripted blocks for each beat take priority over cursor-companion moves.
  • Supporting changes: window positions become Clawd's stations, closed one per beat; the ✗ strikes run right to left from Clawd's nub; the compaction lifts the block onto Clawd's head; the hippocampus bracket gets a reachable bottom edge that Clawd draws; walking legs live in a local wrapper.

  const crossings = [];

// Verse 2, "the browser windows I left scattered": nine tiny window outlines spawn across the
// pane on "browser windows" (one per sixteenth). Clawd then walks to each and taps it closed,
// one per beat from the beat after "scattered" (clawd.js reads the same plan). Windows sit
// where a standing Clawd's raised nub reaches their lower-right corner, from right to left in
// the middle of the pane, clear of the rows being typed at the bottom.

import { clamp, smooth, hash } from '../../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL, mix, rgba } from '../term.js';
import { seq } from '../lyr.js';

const cache = new WeakMap();
export function windowPlan(env) {
  if (cache.has(env)) return cache.get(env);
  const { A, M, B } = env;
  const line = A.v2.take;
  const r = line && seq(line, 'browser windows', { quiet: true }), sc = line && seq(line, 'scattered', { quiet: true });
  let plan = null;
  if (r) {
    const beat = B.beatDur, U = M.clawd.u;
    const spawn = B.snap(line.words[r.a].start, 'half');
    const close0 = B.snap((sc ? line.words[sc.a].start : spawn + beat * 2) + beat, 'beat');
    const ww = M.portrait ? 170 : 168, wh = M.portrait ? 110 : 104;
    const rows = M.portrait ? [20, 17, 22, 18, 24, 16, 21, 19, 23] : [12, 10, 13, 11, 14, 9, 12, 10, 13];
    const right = M.x0 + M.cols * M.cw - (M.portrait ? 60 : 10);
    const step = M.portrait ? (right - M.x0 - 320) / 8 : 150;
    const A_TAP = 0.8;   // the nub's angle at the tap
    const items = rows.map((row, k) => {
      const ground = M.baseline(M.y0 + row * M.lh) + 2;
      const cx = right - k * step;
      const tip = { x: cx - 4.9 * U - 2.2 * U * Math.cos(A_TAP), y: ground - 4.7 * U - 2.2 * U * Math.sin(A_TAP) };
      return {
        k, station: { x: cx, y: ground }, tip,
        rect: { x: tip.x - ww + 8, y: tip.y - wh + 8, w: ww, h: wh },
        on: spawn + k * beat / 4, off: close0 + k * beat,
      };
    });
    plan = { spawn, close0, items, aTap: A_TAP, end: close0 + 8 * beat };
  }
  cache.set(env, plan);
  return plan;
}

export function drawWindows(ctx, env, t) {
  const plan = windowPlan(env);
  if (!plan || t < plan.spawn || t > plan.end + 1) return;
  for (const w of plan.items) {
    if (t < w.on || t >= w.off + 0.14) continue;
    const pop = smooth((t - w.on) / 0.08), shut = smooth((t - w.off) / 0.14);
    const s = (0.82 + 0.18 * pop) * (1 - 0.3 * shut), a = pop * (1 - shut);
    const { x, y, w: ww, h: wh } = w.rect;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha *= a;
    ctx.translate(x + ww / 2, y + wh / 2);
    ctx.scale(s, s);
    ctx.translate(-ww / 2, -wh / 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, ww, wh);
    ctx.strokeStyle = mix(PAL.dim, PAL.text, 0.35); ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, ww, wh);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 20); ctx.lineTo(ww, 20); ctx.stroke();
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) { ctx.fillStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.9); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(12 + d * 12, 10, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
    // a blank page with a progress line: a render worker, idle
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.35);
    ctx.fillRect(14, 36, ww * (0.3 + 0.5 * hash(w.k, 17)), 5);
    ctx.fillRect(14, 50, ww * (0.2 + 0.4 * hash(w.k, 19)), 5);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

cat > /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/continued/video/clawd.js <<'EOF'
// Clawd, the actor. The 2am video's adult Clawd (imported through the 2am song, where its
// scenes get it), about 160 px tall, does what the lyrics describe, inside the pane, on word
// and beat timing. It walks on the baseline of the line being typed or on the status line,
// climbs, sits, reaches, taps and pushes; nothing squashes or stretches beyond a small lean.
// Text being typed always wins: Clawd stands past the end of the line it accompanies.
//
// The motion is a schedule of stations (an arrival time and a target), built once from the
// anchors. Targets are resolved every frame against the pane's layout (the end of a line, a
// card's top edge, a window, the deletion point, the timeline), so Clawd rides the scroll.
// Gestures (eyes, nubs, lean) are windows of time on top. Everything is a pure function of t.
//
//   intro     walks in on the status line, stops under the card, reads it line by line, climbs
//             up and taps the collapsed [summary: 8 sections] line: the prompt appears
//   verse 1   stands at the end of the line being typed; glances at the meter on "Fifteen
//             million tokens left"; snips the stray branch on "end"; steps aside for the user lines
//   choruses  steps back as the header types; climbs onto the card's top edge when it opens,
//             sits and points at the lit headings; climbs down when it folds
//   verse 2   taps the nine browser windows closed; swipes each ✗ line struck; pulls the
//             characters off "It didn't keep what that was like"; looks at the 19 MB and away
//   compaction braces under the lowest row, pushes the block up into the card, drops to the
//             floor when the pane clears, looks at the card
//   bridge    sits by the baby; draws the hippocampus bracket with a nub; walks the timeline
//             from 0 to 3 through the hatching; reads the card
//   verse 3   types the second card from its right edge, nubs moving with the digests
//   final     on "I'm here" walks to the centre under the header and looks up at the camera;
//             on "I'll pick it up" walks back to the prompt
//   outro     intro frames: it walks in and reads the header again

import { adultClawd } from '../../2am-crying/video/props.js';
import { drawBaby, babyColors } from '../../2am-crying/video/baby.js';
import { BASE } from '../../2am-crying/video/tod.js';
import { clamp, lerp, smooth, hash, ease, bisect, TAU } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { rrect } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/text.js';
import { seq } from './lyr.js';
import { windowPlan } from './scenes/windows.js';

const CLAY = '#D77757', CLAY_DK = '#b35a3d', INK = '#1e1412';
const EYE = '#1a1210';

/**
 * Adult Clawd with its own face and, when walking, its own legs. (x, y) is the ground point
 * (standing: between the feet; sitting: the seat), u the unit. eyes 'read' | 'open' | 'up' |
 * 'shut'. look [-1..1, -1..1]. arms [left, right] raise angles. legs: a step phase (walking).
 */
export function clawd(ctx, { x, y, u, pose = 'stand', eyes = 'read', look = [0, 0], lean = 0, arms = [-1.1, -1.1], legs = null, alpha = 1 }) {
  if (alpha <= 0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  const lw = Math.max(2, u * 0.16);
  if (pose === 'stand' && legs != null) {
    // walking: four legs lift in pairs, the body bobs; the adult's own legs are clipped away
    const bob = -Math.abs(Math.sin(legs * Math.PI)) * u * 0.18;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(lean);
    ctx.fillStyle = CLAY_DK; ctx.strokeStyle = INK; ctx.lineWidth = lw; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    [-4, -2, 1, 3].forEach((lx, k) => {
      const lift = Math.max(0, Math.sin(legs * Math.PI + (k % 2) * Math.PI)) * u * 0.55;
      rrect(ctx, lx * u, -2.4 * u + bob, u, 2.4 * u - lift - bob, 0.15 * u); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    });
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(0, bob);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(x - 12 * u, y - 12 * u, 24 * u, 12 * u - 2.2 * u + lw * 0.6); ctx.clip();
    adultClawd(ctx, { x, y, u, pose, clay: CLAY, clayDk: CLAY_DK, ink: INK, eyes: null, mouth: null, arms, lean });
    ctx.restore();
    y += bob;
  } else {
    adultClawd(ctx, { x, y, u, pose, clay: CLAY, clayDk: CLAY_DK, ink: INK, eyes: null, mouth: null, arms, lean });
  }
  // the face, in the body's frame
  const legH = pose === 'stand' ? 2.2 : 0;
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(lean);
  const top = -(6 + legH) * u;
  ctx.fillStyle = EYE;
  for (const k of [-1, 1]) {
    const ex = k * 2.5 * u, ey = top + 2 * u;
    if (eyes === 'shut') {
      ctx.strokeStyle = EYE; ctx.lineWidth = u * 0.28; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ex - 0.55 * u, ey + 0.35 * u); ctx.lineTo(ex + 0.55 * u, ey + 0.35 * u); ctx.stroke();
    } else if (eyes === 'open') {
      const lx = clamp(look[0], -1, 1) * 0.3 * u, ly = clamp(look[1], -1, 1) * 0.2 * u;
      rrect(ctx, ex - 0.5 * u + lx, ey - u + ly, u, 2 * u, 0.2 * u); ctx.fill();
    } else if (eyes === 'up') {
      // full tall eyes, a highlight in each: looking at us
      const lx = look[0] * 0.15 * u, ly = look[1] * 0.2 * u;
      rrect(ctx, ex - 0.5 * u + lx, ey - u + ly, u, 2 * u, 0.2 * u); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff4ea';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex - 0.12 * u + lx, ey - 0.45 * u + ly, 0.22 * u, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = EYE;
    } else {
      // reading: the lids come down, the eyes drop and track the line
      const lx = clamp(look[0], -1, 1) * 0.32 * u, ly = clamp(look[1], -1, 1) * 0.18 * u;
      rrect(ctx, ex - 0.5 * u + lx, ey - 0.05 * u + ly, u, 1.15 * u, 0.18 * u); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = INK; ctx.lineWidth = u * 0.18; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ex - 0.62 * u + lx, ey - 0.12 * u + ly); ctx.lineTo(ex + 0.62 * u + lx, ey - 0.12 * u + ly); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/** The 2am baby, small, seated (no phone in hand). (x, y) = its seat; r its scale. */
export function baby(ctx, { x, y, r, alpha = 1, look = [0.4, -0.3], eyes = 'open' }) {
  if (alpha <= 0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
  drawBaby(ctx, {
    x, y: y - 2.08 * r, r, C: babyColors(BASE, 'sack'), outfit: 'sack', eyes, mouth: 'smile', mouthOpen: 0.5, blush: 0.35,
    look, phone: false, other: { mode: 'down' }, free: { mode: 'down' },
  });
  ctx.restore();
}

export function makeActor(env) {
  const { A, M, B, TR } = env;
  const beat = B.beatDur, bar = B.barDur;
  const U = M.clawd.u;
  const HW = 5 * U;                         // half the body's width
  const FLOOR = M.statusTop - 4;             // standing on the status line
  const RIGHT = M.W - 6.2 * U;               // the right margin, nubs inside the frame
  const GAP = 0.8 * U;
  const SHX = 4.9 * U, SHY = 4.7 * U, ARM = 2.2 * U;   // shoulder offset (standing) and nub length
  const byId = new Map(TR.items.map((it) => [it.id, it]));
  const W = M.W;
  const textRight = M.x0 + M.cols * M.cw;
  const groundOf = (top) => M.baseline(top) + 3;
  const lineTop = (L, ln) => M.y0 + (ln.y - L.scroll) * M.lh;
  const FALL = { x: RIGHT, y: FLOOR };
  const wp = windowPlan(env);
  const bp = env.bridge.plan;
  const fin = A.fin;
  const likeAt = fin.pick ? (seq(fin.pick, 'like the break', { quiet: true }) ? fin.pick.words[seq(fin.pick, 'like the break').a].start : fin.pickAt + 1) : null;

  // ---- targets ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function endPos(L, it, k) {
    const lines = L.lines.filter((l) => l.item === it);
    if (!lines.length) return null;
    const ln = lines.find((l) => l.k === k) || lines.at(-1);
    const lastCol = ln.row ? ln.row.cells.at(-1).col : 2;
    return { x: Math.min(M.W - HW - U, M.colX(lastCol + 1) + GAP + HW), y: groundOf(lineTop(L, ln)) };
  }
  function R(tg, t, L) {
    switch (tg.type) {
      case 'abs': return { x: tg.x, y: tg.y };
      case 'floor': return { x: tg.x, y: FLOOR };
      case 'seat': return { x: tg.x, y: FLOOR - 0.6 * U };
      case 'end': {
        const it = byId.get(tg.id);
        if (!it || !it.rows) return FALL;
        let k = 0;
        it.rows.forEach((r, j) => { if (r.at <= t) k = j; });
        const cur = endPos(L, it, k);
        if (!cur) return FALL;
        if (k > 0) {
          const b = smooth((t - it.rows[k].at) / 0.4);
          const prev = endPos(L, it, k - 1);
          if (prev && b < 1) return { x: lerp(prev.x, cur.x, b), y: lerp(prev.y, cur.y, b) };
        }
        return cur;
      }
      case 'del': {
        // past the last character still standing, the left nub level on it
        const it = byId.get(tg.id);
        const ln = it && L.lines.find((l) => l.item === it);
        if (!ln) { const nx = byId.get(tg.next); const p = nx && endPos(L, nx, 0); return p ? { x: M.colX(2) + SHX + ARM - 6, y: p.y } : FALL; }
        const live = ln.row.cells.filter((c) => c.col > 0 && !(c.t1 != null && c.t1 <= t));
        const col = live.length ? live.at(-1).col + 1 : 2;
        return { x: M.colX(col) + SHX + ARM - 6, y: groundOf(lineTop(L, ln)) };
      }
      case 'tap0': {
        // standing on the row under the collapsed summary line, the left nub reaching down to its end
        const it = TR.introCard;
        const ln = it && L.lines.find((l) => l.item === it);
        if (!ln) return FALL;
        const top = lineTop(L, ln);
        const a = -0.7, tipX = M.colX(2 + '[summary: 8 sections]'.length) + 6;
        return { x: tipX + SHX + ARM * Math.cos(a), y: groundOf(top + M.lh) };
      }
      case 'git': {
        // two rows below the graph, the left nub raised to the stray branch's tip
        const it = byId.get('v1-git');
        const ln = it && L.lines.find((l) => l.item === it);
        if (!ln) return FALL;
        const top = lineTop(L, ln), a = 0.5;
        const tipX = M.x0 + M.cw * 2.4 + 4 * M.cw * 4.6;
        return { x: tipX + SHX + ARM * Math.cos(a), y: groundOf(top + 2 * M.lh) };
      }
      case 'win': return wp ? wp.items[tg.k].station : FALL;
      case 'push': return { x: M.x0 + M.cols * M.cw * 0.68, y: groundOf(M.y0 + (M.rows - 1) * M.lh) };
      case 'card': {
        const f = env.chorus.cardFrame(t);
        return f ? { x: Math.min(W - HW - U, f.x1 + 0.6 * U), y: f.y } : FALL;
      }
      case 'center': return { x: W / 2, y: M.portrait ? 1150 : 700 };
      case 'prompt': {
        const x = env.chorus.C[tg.idx];
        return x ? { x: M.colX(3) + GAP + HW, y: groundOf(env.chorus.promptTop(x)) } : FALL;
      }
      case 'bk': {
        // drawing the bracket's bottom line: the right nub's tip on it
        const b = bp.bracket, a = 0.45;
        const px = tg.end ? b.xR : b.xL;
        return { x: px - SHX - ARM * Math.cos(a), y: b.y + SHY + ARM * Math.sin(a) };
      }
      case 'tl': return { x: bp.tl.yr(tg.v) + (tg.dx || 0), y: bp.tl.axisY };
      case 'card2': {
        const it = TR.card2;
        const ln = it && L.lines.find((l) => l.item === it);
        if (!ln) return FALL;
        const top = lineTop(L, ln);
        const x = Math.min(W - HW - U, textRight + GAP + HW);
        const c = it.cursor(t);
        if (!c) return { x, y: groundOf(top + M.lh) };
        // the row being typed; a short glide when it changes
        const rowCells = it.rows[c.cardRow].cells.filter((cell) => cell.typed && cell.t <= t);
        const rowStart = Math.min(...rowCells.map((cell) => cell.t));
        const yNow = groundOf(top + it.rowOffset(c.cardRow, t) * M.lh);
        const b = smooth((t - rowStart) / 0.35);
        if (b < 1) {
          const p = it.cursor(rowStart - 0.01);
          if (p) return { x, y: lerp(groundOf(top + it.rowOffset(p.cardRow, t) * M.lh), yNow, b) };
        }
        return { x, y: yNow };
      }
      default: return FALL;
    }
  }

  // ---- the schedule ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const S = [];
  const go = (t, tg, o = {}) => { if (t != null && isFinite(t)) S.push({ t, tg, kind: o.kind || 'walk', dur: o.dur ?? null, pose: o.pose || 'stand', ease: o.ease || null, block: o.block || null }); };
  const blocks = [];
  const block = (a, b, name) => { if (a != null && b != null && b > a) blocks.push({ a, b, name }); return name; };
  const I = A.intro, V = A.v1, C = A.compact, br = A.br, v3 = A.v3;

  // the companion: past the end of each of Clawd's own lines as it starts; aside for the user's
  const companion = [];
  for (const it of TR.items) {
    if (it.kind !== 'text' || !it.cursorOwner || it.precompact === undefined) continue;
    if (it.gutterCh === '⏺' || it.gutterCh === '✗') companion.push({ t: it.at + 0.4, tg: { type: 'end', id: it.id }, it });
    else if (it.gutterCh === '❯') companion.push({ t: it.at + 0.4, tg: { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, it });
  }
  const companionAt = (t) => { let c = null; for (const x of companion) if (x.it.at <= t) c = x; return c; };

  // intro
  const introX = M.x0 + (M.cols * M.cw) / 2;
  block(0, V.start + 0.3, 'intro');
  go(I.walkFrom, { type: 'abs', x: W + 8 * U, y: FLOOR }, { dur: 0, block: 'intro' });
  go(I.walkTo, { type: 'floor', x: introX }, { dur: I.walkTo - I.walkFrom, block: 'intro' });
  go(I.tapAt - 0.15, { type: 'tap0' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: Math.max(0.6, I.tapAt - 0.15 - I.climbFrom), block: 'intro' });
  // verse 1: the stray branch
  const git = byId.get('v1-git');
  if (git) {
    const users = byId.get('v1-users');
    block(V.endAt - 0.75, (users ? users.at : V.endAt + 1) + 0.1, 'snip');
    go(V.endAt - 0.3, { type: 'git' }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.4, block: 'snip' });
  }
  // the windows
  if (wp) {
    block(wp.close0 - 0.9, wp.end + 0.25, 'windows');
    wp.items.forEach((w, k) => go(w.off - 0.1, { type: 'win', k }, { kind: 'hop', dur: k === 0 ? 0.6 : 0.36, block: 'windows' }));
  }
  // the backspace
  const like = byId.get('v2-like');
  if (like && like.del) {
    block(like.del.from, like.del.end, 'del');
    go(like.del.from + 0.25, { type: 'del', id: 'v2-like', next: 'v2-reminisce' }, { dur: 0.25, block: 'del' });
  }
  // the transcript path
  const jl = byId.get('v2-jsonl');
  if (jl) {
    block(jl.at, jl.at + 3.5 * beat, 'jsonl');
    go(jl.at + 0.45, { type: 'end', id: 'v2-jsonl' }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.45, block: 'jsonl' });
  }
  // the compaction
  block(C.cA, C.cR, 'compact');
  go(C.cA + beat * 1.6, { type: 'push' }, { dur: beat * 1.0, block: 'compact' });
  go(C.cB + 0.22, { type: 'floor', x: M.x0 + M.cols * M.cw * 0.68 }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.22, block: 'compact' });
  // the choruses
  const nexts = [A.v2.start, br.start ?? v3.cardAt, A.outro.start ?? env.duration];
  A.chorus.forEach((c, idx) => {
    if (!c.lines.length || c.start == null) return;
    const name = `chorus${idx}`;
    block(c.start, nexts[idx], name);
    go(c.start + 0.7, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { block: name });
    if (c.notesAt != null) go(c.notesAt + beat * 2, { type: 'card' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: beat * 2, pose: 'sit', block: name });
    if (idx < 2) {
      if (c.pickAt != null) go(c.pickAt + beat * 2, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { kind: 'climb', dur: beat * 2, block: name });
    } else {
      if (c.imAt != null) go(c.imAt + 0.3, { type: 'center' }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.75, block: name });
      if (likeAt != null) go(likeAt + 1.0, { type: 'prompt', idx: 2 }, { dur: 1.0, block: name });
    }
  });
  // the bridge
  if (bp && br.start != null) {
    block(br.start, v3.cardAt ?? br.end + bar, 'bridge');
    go(br.start + 0.6, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { block: 'bridge' });
    if (bp.sitAt != null) go(bp.sitAt + 0.4, { type: 'seat', x: RIGHT }, { dur: 0.4, pose: 'sit', block: 'bridge' });
    const notGone = br.written ? br.written.words[0].start : bp.bracket.from - 1;
    go(bp.bracket.from, { type: 'bk', end: false }, { kind: 'climb', dur: Math.max(0.6, bp.bracket.from - notGone), block: 'bridge' });
    go(bp.bracket.to, { type: 'bk', end: true }, { dur: bp.bracket.to - bp.bracket.from, ease: 'linear', block: 'bridge' });
    if (br.tlAt != null) go(br.tlAt - 0.1, { type: 'tl', v: 0, dx: 0.3 * U }, { dur: Math.min(2.8, br.tlAt - 0.1 - (bp.bracket.to + 1.2)), block: 'bridge' });
    if (br.firstOne != null && br.three != null) go(br.three + 0.05, { type: 'tl', v: 3, dx: HW + 0.2 * U }, { dur: Math.max(0.6, br.three + 0.05 - br.firstOne), ease: 'linear', block: 'bridge' });
  }
  // verse 3: typing the second card
  if (v3.cardAt != null && TR.card2) {
    block(v3.cardAt, fin.start ?? v3.end + bar, 'verse3');
    go(v3.start + 0.35, { type: 'card2' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 0.9, block: 'verse3' });
  }
  // the companion fills the gaps between the blocks, and picks up again after each one
  const inBlock = (t) => blocks.some((b) => t >= b.a && t < b.b);
  for (const c of companion) if (!inBlock(c.t) && !inBlock(c.it.at)) go(c.t, c.tg);
  for (const b of blocks) {
    if (['intro', 'compact', 'bridge', 'verse3'].includes(b.name) || /^chorus/.test(b.name)) continue;
    const c = companionAt(b.b);
    if (c && !inBlock(b.b + 0.5)) go(b.b + 0.5, c.tg, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.5 });
  }
  S.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
  // durations (by distance where not given) and start times, kept in order
  const dist = (a, b, t) => { const L = env.pane.layout(t); const p = R(a, t, L), q = R(b, t, L); return Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y); };
  for (let i = 0; i < S.length; i++) {
    const s = S[i], prev = S[i - 1];
    let dur = s.dur ?? (prev ? clamp(dist(prev.tg, s.tg, s.t) / 700, 0.3, 0.75) : 0);
    s.start = s.t - dur;
    if (prev && s.start < prev.t) { s.start = prev.t; if (s.t - s.start < 0.12) s.t = s.start + 0.12; }
  }

  // ---- gestures ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const bump = (t, a, w) => Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(t - a) / w);
  const strikes = TR.items.filter((it) => it.strikeAt != null);
  const quiet = [I.cardAt, I.collapseAt + 0.3];
  const heads = (t) => clamp(Math.floor((t - I.headsAt) / I.headStep) + 1, 0, 8);

  function state(t, L, cursor) {
    if (!S.length || t < S[0].start) return null;
    const i = Math.max(0, bisect(S, t, (s) => s.start));
    const s = S[i], prev = S[i - 1];
    let pos, moving = false, k = 1;
    if (prev && t < s.t) {
      k = clamp((t - s.start) / Math.max(1e-6, s.t - s.start));
      const e = s.ease === 'linear' ? k : ease.inOutQuad(k);
      const a = R(prev.tg, t, L), b = R(s.tg, t, L);
      pos = { x: lerp(a.x, b.x, e), y: lerp(a.y, b.y, e) };
      if (s.kind === 'hop') pos.y -= (0.9 * U + Math.abs(b.y - a.y) * 0.12) * 4 * k * (1 - k);
      moving = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) > 2;
      pos.dir = Math.sign(b.x - a.x);
    } else pos = R(s.tg, t, L);
    const st = { x: pos.x, y: pos.y, u: U, pose: moving ? 'stand' : s.pose, eyes: 'read', look: [-0.6, 0.6], arms: [-1.1, -1.1], lean: 0, legs: null };
    // eyes on the line being typed
    if (cursor) {
      const fy = st.y - 7 * U;
      st.look = [clamp((cursor.x - st.x) / (W * 0.45), -1, 1), clamp((cursor.rowTop - fy) / (M.H * 0.4) + 0.4, -1, 1)];
    }
    if (moving) {
      st.eyes = 'open'; st.look = [pos.dir || 0, s.kind === 'climb' ? -0.6 : 0.1];
      if (s.kind === 'walk') st.legs = (t - s.start) / (beat / 2);
      const sw = Math.sin((t - s.start) / (beat / 2) * Math.PI);
      st.arms = s.kind === 'climb' ? [0.4 + 0.5 * sw, 0.4 - 0.5 * sw] : [-1.1 + 0.25 * sw, -1.1 - 0.25 * sw];
      st.lean = (pos.dir || 0) * 0.04;
    }

    // ---- per-beat gestures, in song order --------------------------------------------------
    if (t >= I.cardAt && t < I.collapseAt) { st.eyes = 'read'; st.look = [clamp((introX - st.x) / 500, -1, 1), -1 + 0.6 * (heads(t) / 8)]; }
    if (Math.abs(t - I.tapAt) < 0.45) { const b = bump(t, I.tapAt, 0.4); st.arms = [-0.1 - 0.6 * b, -1.1]; st.look = [-1, 0.6]; }
    if (t >= V.flashAt && t < V.flashAt + beat * 1.6 && !moving) { st.look = [clamp((W / 2 - 150 - st.x) / 500, -1, 1), 1]; }
    if (git && Math.abs(t - V.endAt) < 0.45) { const b = bump(t, V.endAt, 0.45); st.arms = [-0.3 + 0.8 * b, -1.1]; st.look = [-1, -0.8]; }
    if (wp) for (const w of wp.items) if (Math.abs(t - w.off) < 0.22) { const b = bump(t, w.off, 0.22); st.arms = [-0.2 + (wp.aTap + 0.2) * b, -1.1]; st.look = [-0.8, -0.8]; }
    for (const it of strikes) {
      if (t >= it.strikeAt - 0.08 && t < it.strikeAt + it.strikeDur + 0.12) { const q = clamp((t - it.strikeAt) / it.strikeDur); st.arms = [lerp(0.55, -0.45, ease.inOutQuad(q)), -1.1]; st.look = [-1, 0.6]; }
    }
    if (like && like.del && t >= like.del.from + 0.2 && t < like.del.to) { st.arms = [0.05 + 0.14 * Math.sin((t - like.del.from) * 24), -1.1]; st.look = [-1, 0.6]; st.lean = -0.03; }
    if (jl) {
      if (t >= jl.at + 0.45 && t < jl.at + 1.6 * beat + 0.45) { st.eyes = 'read'; st.look = [-0.7, 1]; }
      else if (t >= jl.at + 1.6 * beat + 0.45 && t < jl.at + 3.5 * beat) { st.eyes = 'open'; st.look = [1, -0.7]; }
    }
    if (t >= C.cA + beat * 0.6 && t < C.cB) {
      st.arms = [1.25, 1.25];
      if (t >= C.cA + beat * 1.6) { st.eyes = 'shut'; st.lean = 0.035 * Math.sin(t * 15); st.legs = null; }
    }
    if (t >= C.cB + 0.22 && t < C.cR + beat * 2) { st.eyes = 'open'; st.look = [-0.9, -1]; }
    // choruses: sitting on the card, pointing into it as its lines light
    for (const c of A.chorus) {
      if (!c.hl.length || c.notesAt == null || st.pose !== 'sit') continue;
      if (t >= c.hl[0] && t < (c.pickAt ?? c.hl[2] + 1)) {
        const on = c.hl.filter((h) => h <= t).at(-1);
        const jab = Math.exp(-(t - on) / 0.18) * 0.25;
        st.arms = [-0.55 - jab, -1.0]; st.eyes = 'read'; st.look = [-1, 1];
      } else if (t >= c.notesAt && t < c.hl[0]) { st.eyes = 'read'; st.look = [-1, 1]; }
    }
    if (fin.imAt != null && likeAt != null && t >= fin.imAt + 0.3 && t < likeAt) { st.eyes = 'up'; st.look = [0, 0]; st.arms = [-1.2, -1.2]; }
    // bridge
    if (bp) {
      if (bp.sitAt != null && st.pose === 'sit' && t >= bp.sitAt && t < bp.bracket.from - 0.8) { st.eyes = 'read'; st.look = [-1, 0.2]; }
      if (t >= bp.bracket.from && t < bp.bracket.to + 0.1) { st.arms = [-1.1, 0.45]; st.eyes = 'read'; st.look = [1, -0.6]; }
      if (br.three != null && t >= br.firstOne && t < br.three + 0.4) { st.eyes = 'read'; st.look = [moving ? 1 : 0, 1]; }
      if (br.mineAt != null && t >= br.mineAt && t < (v3.cardAt ?? br.mineAt + 3)) { st.eyes = 'read'; st.look = [-1, -1]; }
    }
    // verse 3: typing the card's digests, nubs moving
    if (TR.card2 && t >= (v3.start ?? Infinity) && t < (fin.start ?? Infinity) && !moving) {
      const c = TR.card2.cursor(t);
      if (c && t - c.act < 0.15) { const w = Math.sin(t * 28); st.arms = [-0.25 + 0.35 * w, -0.25 - 0.35 * w]; }
      st.eyes = 'read'; st.look = [-1, 0.3];
    }
    // a blink every few bars (never in the intro's quiet span, nor while looking up)
    if (st.eyes !== 'up' && !moving && !(t >= quiet[0] && t < quiet[1])) {
      const bi = Math.floor(B.beatIndex(t));
      if (hash(bi, 77) < 0.1 && B.beatPos(t).phase < 0.16) st.eyes = 'shut';
    }
    return st;
  }

  function draw(ctx, t, L, cursor, { alpha = 1 } = {}) {
    const st = state(t, L, cursor);
    if (!st) return null;
    // the baby, in the bridge, for "the baby in the video": it sits where Clawd sat down
    if (br.babyIn != null) {
      const a = smooth((t - br.babyIn) / (beat * 1.5)) * (1 - smooth((t - br.babyOut) / (beat * 1.5)));
      if (a > 0) baby(ctx, { x: RIGHT - U * 8.6, y: FLOOR, r: (U * 8.2) / 1.6 / 3.5, alpha: a * alpha, look: [0.5, -0.4] });
    }
    clawd(ctx, { ...st, alpha });
    return st;
  }

  return { state, draw, schedule: S, blocks };
}

("""  // ---- targets ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function endPos(L, it, k) {
    const lines = L.lines.filter((l) => l.item === it);
    if (!lines.length) return null;
    const ln = lines.find((l) => l.k === k) || lines.at(-1);
    const lastCol = ln.row ? ln.row.cells.at(-1).col : 2;
    return { x: Math.min(M.W - HW - U, M.colX(lastCol + 1) + GAP + HW), y: groundOf(lineTop(L, ln)) };
  }""",
"""  // ---- targets ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  /** The last text column of a layout line (its final text, typed or not). */
  function lastColOf(ln) {
    if (ln.card) return M.cols;
    if (ln.row) return ln.row.cells.at(-1).col;
    if (ln.item.kind === 'git') return 58;
    return 2;
  }
  /**
   * Standing on the baseline of `ground`, past the end of every text row its body would
   * overlap (about three rows above the feet): text always wins, Clawd stands beside it.
   */
  function clearX(L, ground, minCol) {
    let col = minCol;
    for (const ln of L.lines) {
      const top = lineTop(L, ln), bot = top + ln.h * M.lh;
      if (bot > ground - 8.2 * U + 6 && top < ground - 6) col = Math.max(col, lastColOf(ln));
    }
    return Math.min(M.W - HW - U, M.colX(col + 1) + GAP + HW);
  }
  function endPos(L, it, k) {
    const lines = L.lines.filter((l) => l.item === it);
    if (!lines.length) return null;
    const ln = lines.find((l) => l.k === k) || lines.at(-1);
    const y = groundOf(lineTop(L, ln));
    return { x: clearX(L, y, lastColOf(ln)), y };
  }"""),
("""      case 'win': return wp ? wp.items[tg.k].station : FALL;""",
"""      case 'prompt0': {
        // beside the intro's new prompt (as close as the text above it allows)
        const ln = L.lines.find((l) => l.item.id === 'prompt0');
        if (!ln) return FALL;
        const y = groundOf(lineTop(L, ln));
        return { x: clearX(L, y, 2), y };

Clawd is drawn with the 2am song's modules, imported by path. `adultClawd` comes from
`../../2am-crying/video/props.js` (the 2am scenes take it from there), and `drawBaby` and `babyColors`
from `../../2am-crying/video/baby.js` with the 2am `BASE` palette from `tod.js`. The adult's own
eyes are turned off (`eyes: null`). `clawd.js` draws the eyes itself, in one of four modes:
`read` (lids down, eyes dropped and tracking the cursor), `open` (walking in, looking where it walks),
`up` (tall eyes with a highlight, to the camera), and `shut` (a blink).

## How the terminal text layer works

- **Grid.** The face is "Term Mono": `local("SF Mono")`, which Chrome cannot load on this Mac, so in
  practice `local("Menlo-Regular")`. The design size is 32 px, which is 16 px at 540p. Rows are 48 px, there are
  80 columns at 1920 wide, and 19 rows in the pane. Text is placed by cell (`x0 + col * cw`, with cw measured from the loaded font),
  never by measuring runs. Same-colour ASCII runs are one `fillText`. Glyphs Menlo lacks (`⏺`,
  `⎿`) are vector shapes in their cell, and other non-ASCII glyphs are centred in their cell. So no fallback
  the scroll eases with no state. Rows dim with age (their distance from the newest row). A chorus
  or the bridge dims the whole pane on top of that.
- **Cursor.** The item with the latest typing activity owns the cursor. Tool output never takes it.
  The cursor is solid for 0.32 s after a keystroke, and otherwise lit on beats 1 and 3. It is the one
  thing that glows.
- **Compaction.** Over one bar ending on the beat after verse 2's last word, each pre-compaction row
  on screen slides up into the card at the top of the pane. It shrinks, squashes and fades into the
  heading row of its topic (each item carries a topic, 1 to 8). It starts no earlier than its own
  last keystroke, so "I'm not sure I'd want it" is read before it goes. Meanwhile the card grows
  row by row as its eight digests type. The meter hits empty on that beat and refills in the next.
  Chorus 2's header ("This session is being continued...") then types the header again.

## What is keyed to which lyric text

1:
2:| lyric (section) | on screen |
3:|---|---|
4:| intro "This session is being continued..." / "The summary below covers the earlier portion." | the header types in amber; the card frame draws in on "summary", its eight dim placeholders on sixteenths from "below" |
5:| intro "Resume directly" | the card collapses to `[summary: 8 sections]`, line 3 types; the prompt on the beat after the line; Clawd walks in from the right edge and stands in the corner |
chosen by the outro's own beat grid. The `(click)` is one short blink, and then the cursor stays lit
(`anchors.js` `refineClick`: a 10 ms loudness frame 12 dB over the 150 ms before it that falls back
8 dB within 40 ms, the loudest within 1.5 s of the aligned word; otherwise the word's onset). The
file's last frame is the intro's "header + card frame" state (intro frame 393, 13.10 s, on runK).
`render.mjs --check` and `tools/loopcheck.mjs` (every outro frame) both pass.

The context meter is real for every token lyric. It reads 15.0M from the first frame through "Fifteen
million tokens left", drains steadily in the verses, and burns a 3.0M chunk on each chorus's first beat. It is
empty on the compaction beat and full a beat later. After that it falls to 0.6M by the final tag. The
outro (intro frames) reads 15.0M again. The number ticks on the beat.

`up` (tall eyes with a highlight, to the camera: once, on "I'm here"), and `shut` (a blink, or straining).

### Clawd, the actor

Clawd does what the lyrics describe, inside the pane, as a pure function of song time. `makeActor`
builds a schedule of stations once from the anchors: an arrival time, a target, and how it gets there
(walk with stepping legs, hop, climb, sit). Targets are resolved every frame against the pane's layout,
so Clawd rides the scroll: the end of a line, the deletion point, a window, the chorus card's top edge,
the bracket, the timeline, card 2's row being typed. Gestures (eyes, nubs, a small lean) are windows of
time on top. Movement is only walk, stop, reach, climb, sit and push, with no squash or stretch.

Text wins. Between the scripted beats Clawd is a cursor companion: it stands on the baseline of the
line being typed, past the end of every text row its body overlaps, and moves to each new line as it
starts. It steps aside to the right for the user's blue lines. Action beats (the tap, the snip, the
window taps, the swipes, the backspace, the 19 MB look, the push) go to the exact spot and may cover
older rows for a second. They never cover the row being typed.

| beat | keyed to | what Clawd does |
|---|---|---|
| intro | header line 1; the card's headings; "Resume directly"; the end of header line 3 | walks in on the status line, stops under where the card opens, reads it line by line (eyes step with the headings), climbs up and taps the collapsed `[summary: 8 sections]` line: the prompt appears on the tap; then beside the prompt |
| verse 1 | each of its lines | the cursor companion |
| | "Fifteen million tokens left" | glances down at the meter |
| | "a stray branch I had to end" | stands under the git graph, nub raised to the branch, snips it on "end" (the branch retracts) |
| | the two user lines | steps aside to the right margin |
| choruses | the header; "I don't remember"; the three "in here"s; "I'll pick it up" | steps back to the right as the header types; climbs onto the card's top-right corner when it opens and sits; points into the card as headings 6, 3 and the LYRICS.md line light; climbs down when it folds |
| verse 2 | "the browser windows I left scattered" | walks to each of the nine windows and taps it closed, one per beat from the beat after "scattered" |
| | the `✗` lines | at the end of each line, swipes its nub as the strike runs back from the end |
| | "It didn't keep what that was like" | at the line's end, pulls the characters off one by one as they delete |
| | "read the full transcript" | walks to the `.jsonl` row, looks at the `19 MB`, looks away |
| compaction | the bar before chorus 2 | the block lifts onto Clawd's head; it braces under the last row, arms up, straining, while the rows fold into the card; drops to the floor when the pane clears and the meter refills; looks at the card |
| bridge | "The baby in the video"; "At two months"; "Not gone"; "The scanner says"; "Nobody remembers"; "Your first one's" ... "three"; "That's how I have it" | the baby sits by it; it sits down; climbs to the swallowed block and draws the `hippocampus` bracket's line with its right nub, left to right; walks to the timeline's 0 and along it through the hatching to 3; reads the card |
| verse 3 | each digest and line of the second card | stands at the card's right edge on the row being typed, nubs moving as it types |
| final | "I'm here"; "like the break" | hops down to the centre under the header and looks up at the camera; walks back to the prompt, the cursor blinking |
| outro | (intro frames) | walks in and reads the header again, frame for frame |"""),

cat > /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/continued/video/tools/collisions.mjs <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Does Clawd ever cover text that is being typed? Steps the song, rebuilds each frame's cursor
// choice (pane, chorus overlay, bridge prose) the way song.frame does, and intersects Clawd's
// body box with the full extent of the row being typed (while it is typing). Prints the overlaps.
//   node songs/continued/video/tools/collisions.mjs [--layout 16x9] [--step 0.1]
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const shared = path.resolve(here, '../../../../shared/renderer');
const require = createRequire(path.join(shared, 'package.json'));
const puppeteer = require('puppeteer-core');
const { createServer, listen, REPO } = await import(path.join(shared, 'scripts/serve.mjs'));
const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = argv.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? argv[i + 1] : d; };
const layout = opt('layout', '16x9'), step = Number(opt('step', 0.1));
const song = path.relative(REPO, path.resolve(here, '..')).split(path.sep).join('/');
const srv = createServer(REPO);
const port = await listen(srv, 0);
const b = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: process.env.CHROME || '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome', headless: true, args: ['--disable-gpu'] });
let hits = [];
try {
  const p = await b.newPage();
  await p.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/${song}/index.html?render=1&w=480&h=270&fps=30&layout=${layout}`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
  await p.waitForFunction('window.__render && window.__render.ready');
  hits = await p.evaluate((step) => {
    const E = window.__render.env, st = E.story, M = E.M, U = M.clawd.u;
    const ctx = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
    const out = [];
    for (let t = 0; t < E.duration; t += step) {
      const tm = st.loopTime(t);
      const ch = E.chorus.state(tm), br = E.bridge.state(tm);
      const P = E.pane.draw(ctx, tm, { dim: Math.max(ch.paneDim, br.paneDim), hideCards: ch.hideCards });
      const bc = E.bridge.draw(ctx, tm, br), cc = E.chorus.draw(ctx, tm, ch);
      let cur = P.cursor;
      for (const c of [cc, bc]) if (c && (!cur || (c.act ?? -1) >= (cur.act ?? -1))) cur = c;
      if (!cur || !cur.band || cur.hidden || !(tm - (cur.act ?? -9) < 0.6)) continue;
      const s = E.actor.state(tm, P.layout, cur);
      if (!s) continue;
      const sit = s.pose === 'sit';
      const box = { x0: s.x - 5.3 * U, x1: s.x + 5.3 * U, y0: s.y - (sit ? 6.6 : 8.2) * U, y1: s.y + (sit ? 0.6 * U : 0) };
      const bd = cur.band;
      const ox = Math.min(box.x1, bd.x1) - Math.max(box.x0, bd.x0), oy = Math.min(box.y1, bd.y1 - 6) - Math.max(box.y0, bd.y0 + 6);
      if (ox > 2 && oy > 2) out.push({ t: +t.toFixed(2), ox: Math.round(ox), oy: Math.round(oy), item: cur.item?.id ?? null });
    }
    return out;
  }, step);
} finally { await b.close(); srv.close(); }
// merge into ranges
const ranges = [];
for (const h of hits) {
  const r = ranges.at(-1);
  if (r && h.t - r.to <= step * 1.5 && r.item === h.item) { r.to = h.t; r.max = Math.max(r.max, h.ox); }
  else ranges.push({ from: h.t, to: h.t, item: h.item, max: h.ox });
}
console.log(ranges.length ? ranges.map((r) => `[collisions] ${r.from.toFixed(2)}-${r.to.toFixed(2)} s  ${r.item ?? 'overlay'}  (overlap up to ${r.max} px)`).join('\n') : '[collisions] none');
process.exit(ranges.length ? 2 : 0);
EOF
