# Acting plan: Clawd in "Continued From a Previous Conversation"

Notes from the user's viewing of the first actor cut (2026-10-19): Clawd "just kinda randomly
translates", the face reads as "monotone angry", a big job for Clawd should be emotion, and
there should be a couple of real action shots (getting sucked into a black hole, expending a
great effort). This is the plan before anyone animates again.

## Diagnosis

1. **Motion without motivation.** The schedule moves Clawd to the end of every line as it
   types, so it glides constantly, with no look-before-move, no anticipation and no settle.
   The eye never says where the body is about to go, so the body looks like it is being
   dragged by the layout. A walk is only a performance when it is a decision.
2. **One face.** The rig has four eye states (read, open, up, shut) and no mouth. "Read"
   (tall eyes, lids down) is the default, and on a wide orange box that reads as a glare.
   Nothing blinks. The reference sheet has thirty-two expressions; we use one.
3. **No set pieces.** Every beat is the same size. Nothing is allowed to be big.

## Principles (a box with eyes can still act)

- **Look, then lean, then go.** Every move is announced by the eyes one beat earlier, then
  a lean into the direction, then the walk. Clawd never travels while looking somewhere
  else, unless it is being dragged (the black hole). Arrive with a small overshoot and a
  settle. Stop with a two-frame bounce.
- **Stay put by default.** Clawd stands and *watches* the typing, eyes tracking the cursor.
  It walks only for a beat that needs its body. Cut at least a third of the current moves.
- **Emotion first.** The face changes before the body does. Expression changes happen on a
  blink (80 to 120 ms), the oldest trick: the eyes close as one shape and open as another.
  Never cross-fade eye shapes.
- **Idle is alive.** Breathing (one cycle per two bars), a blink every 3 to 5 s (seeded, not
  periodic), micro-looks toward whatever just appeared, a weight shift every few bars.
- **One thing at a time.** If the text is the event, Clawd reacts to it; if Clawd is the
  event, the text waits. Text being typed still always wins the space.
- **Timing.** Anticipation 150 to 250 ms. Moves 300 to 600 ms, ease in and out. Settle 150 ms.
  Hold every expression at least one beat (545 ms at 110 BPM). No two expression changes
  within half a second outside the set pieces.
- **Exaggeration budget.** Squash on landing up to 8 percent. Stretch only in the black
  hole. The "lid" (the body opening as a mouth, from the reference sheet) is off limits.
- **Props are terminal glyphs.** The reference sheet's sweat drop, "?", "!", "...", Zzz and
  stars become mono-font glyphs beside the head in the status-line grey or amber: `?` `!`
  `...` `z z z` `*`. A lightbulb is a small amber `*` burst. No drawn cartoon props except
  the sweat drop, which is a single short stroke.

## The expression rig

Built from the reference sheet (views and emotions; scratchpad copies at
`clawd_ref/emotions.jpg` and `clawd_ref/views.jpg`, from JohnHeibel/ClaudeAnimationBase,
not committed). Each expression is a named preset of: eye shape (tall rect, wide rect, arc
up `^`, arc down, half lid, slit, squint `>` `<`, spiral, X, closed curve), eye height and
width, highlight size and position, lid angle (the one slant that makes angry vs sad), mouth
(none, small line, smile, small o, open o, wavy, grin), nub pose (down, out, up, one up,
clasped), lean, and an optional glyph prop. Presets to implement, with the sheet's names:

| Preset | Eyes | Mouth | Nubs / body | Glyph |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| neutral | tall rects, highlights | none | down | |
| happy | `^ ^` arcs | small smile | out | |
| excited | wide rects, big highlights | small o | one up | `*` |
| laugh | `> <` squints | open | up | |
| proud | closed arcs, lids up | smile | out, chest lean back | |
| smug | half lids, highlights low | small smile, one side | one on hip | |
| relieved | closed curves | small smile | down | sweat stroke |
| sad | lowered rects, lids slanted down-out | small frown | down, lean forward | `...` dim |
| scared | wide rects, tiny pupils | wavy | up, lean back | sweat stroke |
| surprised | wide rects | open o | both up (the "take") | `!` |
| confused | one squint, one open | small line | one up | `?` |
| thinking | eyes up-left | small line | one to chin | `...` |
| idea | wide, bright | small o | one up | amber `*` burst |
| determined | narrowed rects, lids slanted down-in | line | clasped or down | |
| sleepy | half lids | small o | down | `z z z` |
| bored | flat half lids | line | down | |
| nervous | tall rects, highlights jitter | wavy | clasped | sweat stroke |
| dizzy | spirals | wavy | out, body sway | `* *` |
| KO | X X | small o | splayed, on its side | `*` |
| hopeful | big rects, big highlights, looking up | small smile | clasped | |

Views: front, three-quarter (eyes shifted, far nub shorter), side (one eye, walking), back
(no eyes; used when Clawd faces the card). Walk cycle from the sheet: side view, legs in pairs,
a small bob. A smear (three trailing strokes in the clay colour) for the dash into the black
hole and for the sprint to centre. A jump with a landing squash.

## The emotional arc, section by section

The default state is **neutral** with idle; everything below is a departure and returns.

**Intro** (woke up mid-task). Walks in slowly, side view: **dizzy** for one bar (spirals),
blinks it off into **confused** (`?`) while the header types, reads the card top to bottom in
**thinking** (`...`, eyes tracking), one slow blink, then **determined** for the tap. The tap
is small and precise; the prompt appears; a tiny nod.

**Verse 1.** Reads along, **neutral**, eyes on the cursor; it does not walk. Beats:
- "Fifteen million tokens left": looks at the meter, **surprised** (`!`, both nubs up, the
  take), then **relieved** (sweat stroke) by "no idea what I'd been thinking", which lands as
  **confused** (`?`).
- "Okay. Like I had a choice.": **smug**, one beat.
- The red Chrome line: **nervous** (sweat), a half step back.
- "a stray branch I had to end": **determined**; walks to the graph (look, lean, go), snips;
  **relieved**.
- The two blue user lines: steps aside once, then **happy** (`^ ^`) reading them, the first
  warm face in the song. Hold through "Thanks for getting this far."

**Chorus 1.** Steps back as the header grows, **determined**. "I don't remember": **sad** for
half a bar, eyes down. "but I've read the notes": **hopeful**, a nod. Climbs the card (look,
lean, climb) and points at the headings in **happy**. "I'll pick it up like the break never
happened": **determined**, climbs down.

**Verse 2.** The kept items: **neutral**, a small nod per `✓`, no walking. "the browser windows
I left scattered": **nervous** (sweat) as they spawn; walks to the nearest and taps them shut,
one per beat, **determined**, then **relieved**. "Here's what it loses": **sad** (`...` dim);
the swipes are slow and reluctant, eyes down. "The joke I didn't make": a flash of **laugh**
(`> <`) that collapses back to **sad**. "the baby is... not that cute.": **laugh**, one beat.
"It didn't keep what that was like": **sad**, pulling the characters off slower each time.
"read the full transcript": **thinking** at the path. Then the transcript set piece (below).
"I could. I haven't. I'm not sure I'd want it.": a shrug (both nubs out), **neutral**.

**Compaction.** The black hole set piece (below).

**Chorus 2.** As chorus 1 but with a **relieved** tint: it has just survived something.

**Bridge.** Sits beside the baby, **happy** soft arcs, looks at the baby (the longest held look
in the song). The retention chips: **sad** as each bar fades, eyes following them down. "Not
gone. Written.": **idea** (amber `*` burst), stands, draws the bracket in **determined**. The
timeline: walks it in **thinking** through the hatching, and at 3 turns **hopeful**. "Unless
somebody told you the story": looks at the blue line, **happy**. "That's how I have it": sits,
**proud** (closed arcs, chest back), holds.

**Verse 3.** Types card 2 in **determined**, `...` on "And this gets summarized too". On the
blue `"full steam ahead"`: **excited** (`*`). "That's enough.": **relieved**. "Not the whole
night. The shape of it.": **thinking** that becomes **happy**.

**Final chorus.** "I'm here": the centre set piece (below). "I'll pick it up like the break
never happened": the lift set piece (below). Ends at the prompt, **determined**, cursor
blinking.

**Outro.** The intro again, frame for frame, so the loop closes: the dizzy walk-in is the
first thing and the last thing we see.

## Set pieces

Four moments that are allowed to be big. Everything else stays small so these land.

1. **The transcript** (verse 2, "read the full transcript" to "I'm not sure I'd want it",
   about 4 s). Clawd walks to the `.jsonl` row and taps it. The row bursts open into a wall of
   tiny dim text that scrolls past far too fast, filling the pane behind it; the meter does
   not move but the clock spins. Clawd leans back into **scared**, nubs up, a sweat stroke, one
   foot sliding; then it reaches out and taps the row shut. The wall collapses back into one
   line. **Relieved**, then the shrug. This foreshadows the black hole and makes "I'm not sure
   I'd want it" a decision rather than a line.

2. **The black hole** (compaction, one bar plus the refill, about 4 s). The meter hits 0. The
   summary card at the top becomes a gravity well: every scrollback row stretches toward it
   and spirals in, text shearing along the pull. Clawd, mid-pane, feels it: **scared**, grabs
   the status line with both nubs, body stretched toward the card, legs streaming (the only
   stretch in the song), then loses grip, a smear, and is sucked in with a **surprised** take
   at the card's mouth. Pane black, card alone, meter `0 left`. The refill: the card spits
   Clawd back out in a tumble (spinView frames), it lands with the 8 percent squash, **dizzy**
   (spirals, `* *`) for one bar, shakes it off with a left-right lean, blinks into
   **determined**, and looks up at the card. Chorus 2 types over it.

3. **"I'm here"** (final chorus, 2 s plus a hold). Everything else fades. Clawd walks to the
   centre under the header, slows, stops, and looks up: **hopeful** (big eyes, big highlights,
   looking at the camera). One slow blink. Hold for the rest of the line. Nothing else moves.

4. **The lift** ("I'll pick it up like the break never happened", about 4 s). Clawd walks to
   the summary card, which is lying on the floor of the pane, and picks it up. It is heavy.
   First try: **determined**, lean, strain, the card lifts a few pixels and drops, a sweat
   stroke. Second try: a wider stance, the full squash, a held strain (eyes shut tight,
   `> <`), and it comes up onto its head. **Excited** (`*`), a small jump that squashes on
   landing, and it carries the card to the prompt with a bob in its walk. Sets it down. The
   cursor blinks. "(Never happened.)" lands on the set-down.

## What to cut from the current schedule

- Standing at the end of every line. Replace with eyes on the cursor from a fixed spot.
- The glance at `19 MB` (absorbed into set piece 1).
- The points at headings 6 and 3 can stay but with the face carrying them.
- Any move that happens without a look first.

## Implementation notes

- Keep it in `songs/continued/video/clawd.js` (song-local rig on top of `shared/clawd/`);
  promote the expression presets to `shared/clawd/` afterwards if they hold up.
- Deterministic as ever; blinks and weight shifts seeded from song time via `hash`.
- The collision sweep (`tools/collisions.mjs`) still applies: no text being typed is covered.
- The loop: the intro's dizzy walk-in and the outro must stay frame-identical; put the loop
  anchor after the walk-in settles, as now.
- Check frames at every expression change in the arc above and at the four set pieces; the
  face must be readable at 540p, which means eye shapes at least 10 px tall there.

// =====================================================================================
// The expression rig (ACTING.md). Everything below is new and self-contained: the song's
// current schedule above still calls clawd(); the prototypes in proto/ use drawClawd().
//
// drawClawd(ctx, o): one frame of Clawd. o = {
//   x, y        ground point (between the feet; for a tumble the body's centre is y - 4.1u)
//   u           unit (19.5 at design size: about 160 px tall standing)
//   view        'front' | 'q' (three-quarter) | 'side' | 'back';  dir: +1 faces right, -1 left
//   face        a PRESETS name (or a spec object); look [-1..1, -1..1] where the eyes point
//   blink       0..1 lid closure (an expression change happens while it is closed)
//   nubs        [left, right] raise angles (default: the face's pose), lean (radians)
//   legs        walk phase (steps), stance (0..1 wider), crouch (0..1, legs shorten)
//   squash      0..0.08 on landing (clamped), stretch { s, ang } only with blackHole: true
//   tilt        whole-body rotation about the body centre (tumble, KO)
//   t, faceT    song time and time since the face changed (glyph animation, the '!' pop)
//   glyph / sweat  override the face's prop; alpha
// }
// =====================================================================================

const MOUTH = '#4a1f2a', TONGUE = '#e07a8a', HL = '#fff4ea', SWEAT = '#8fb4d9';
const GLYPH_DIM = '#7d7870', GLYPH_AMBER = '#c9a24b';

export const NUBS = {
  down: [-0.45, -0.45], out: [0.1, 0.1], up: [1.2, 1.2], oneUp: [-0.45, 1.0], hip: [-1.25, -0.45],
  clasped: [-1.35, -1.35], chin: [-0.45, 0.8], splay: [0.55, -0.85], shrug: [0.35, 0.35], tucked: [-1.45, -1.45],
};

// eyes: { shape, w, h, hl (highlight radius, u), hlY (0 top .. 1 bottom), lid: { side: 'out'|'in', depth } }
// shapes: rect | round | scared | arcUp | arcDown | half | slit | squint | spiral | x | closed
export const PRESETS = {
  neutral:    { eyes: { shape: 'rect', w: 1, h: 2, hl: 0.27 }, mouth: null, nubs: 'down' },
  happy:      { eyes: { shape: 'arcUp' }, mouth: 'smile', nubs: 'out' },
  excited:    { eyes: { shape: 'rect', w: 1.18, h: 2.3, hl: 0.4 }, mouth: 'smallO', nubs: 'oneUp', glyph: { ch: '*', color: 'amber', anim: 'twinkle' } },
  laugh:      { eyes: { shape: 'squint' }, mouth: 'open', nubs: 'up' },
  proud:      { eyes: { shape: 'arcDown' }, mouth: 'smile', nubs: 'out', lean: -0.07 },
  smug:       { eyes: { shape: 'half', hl: 0.22, hlY: 0.75 }, mouth: 'smirk', nubs: 'hip' },
  relieved:   { eyes: { shape: 'arcDown' }, mouth: 'smile', nubs: 'down', sweat: true },
  sad:        { eyes: { shape: 'rect', w: 1, h: 1.7, hl: 0.24, hlY: 0.6, lid: { side: 'out', depth: 1 }, dy: 0.25 }, mouth: 'frown', nubs: 'down', lean: 0.05, glyph: { ch: '...', color: 'dim', anim: 'dots' } },
  scared:     { eyes: { shape: 'scared', w: 1.35, h: 1.6 }, mouth: 'wavy', nubs: 'up', lean: -0.08, sweat: true },
  surprised:  { eyes: { shape: 'rect', w: 1.15, h: 2.35, hl: 0.3 }, mouth: 'openO', nubs: 'up', glyph: { ch: '!', color: 'amber', anim: 'pop' } },
  confused:   { eyes: [{ shape: 'slit', w: 0.95 }, { shape: 'rect', w: 1, h: 2, hl: 0.27 }], mouth: 'wavySmall', nubs: 'oneUp', glyph: { ch: '?', color: 'amber', anim: 'pop' } },
  thinking:   { eyes: { shape: 'rect', w: 1, h: 2, hl: 0.27 }, look: [-0.8, -0.9], mouth: 'line', nubs: 'chin', glyph: { ch: '...', color: 'dim', anim: 'dots' } },
  idea:       { eyes: { shape: 'round', w: 1.4, h: 1.6, hl: 0.42 }, mouth: 'smallO', nubs: 'oneUp', glyph: { ch: '*', color: 'amber', anim: 'burst' } },

/** One eye centred at (ex, ey). k = -1 left, +1 right (inner side is toward x = 0). */
function drawEye(ctx, e, ex, ey, u, k, look, blink, t) {
  const lx = clamp(look[0], -1, 1) * 0.26 * u, ly = clamp(look[1], -1, 1) * 0.3 * u;
  const cx = ex + lx, cy = ey + ly + (e.dy || 0) * u;
  const lw = 0.3 * u;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = EYE; ctx.strokeStyle = EYE; ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; ctx.lineWidth = lw;
  const closedLine = () => {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - 0.5 * u, cy + 0.1 * u); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, cy + 0.28 * u, cx + 0.5 * u, cy + 0.1 * u); ctx.stroke();
  };
  const shape = e.shape;
  const lidded = shape === 'rect' || shape === 'round' || shape === 'half' || shape === 'scared';
  if (blink >= 0.85 || (!lidded && blink > 0.4)) { closedLine(); ctx.restore(); return; }
  const open = lidded ? 1 - blink : 1;
  if (shape === 'rect' || shape === 'round' || shape === 'half') {
    const w = (e.w || 1) * u, H = (shape === 'half' ? 1.15 : e.h || 2) * u;
    const h = Math.max(0.16 * u, H * open);
    const x0 = cx - w / 2, y0 = cy + H / 2 - h - (shape === 'half' ? -0.35 * u : 0) + (H - h) * 0;
    const top = cy - H / 2 + (H - h) + (shape === 'half' ? 0.35 * u : 0);
    ctx.save();
    if (e.lid) {
      // the lid: a straight cut across the top, lower at the outer corner (sad) or the inner (determined)
      const inner = k < 0 ? x0 + w : x0, outer = k < 0 ? x0 : x0 + w;
      const d = e.lid.depth;
      const yIn = top + (e.lid.side === 'in' ? 0.42 : 0.06) * H * d, yOut = top + (e.lid.side === 'out' ? 0.42 : 0.06) * H * d;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(inner, yIn); ctx.lineTo(outer, yOut); ctx.lineTo(outer, top + H + u); ctx.lineTo(inner, top + H + u); ctx.closePath(); ctx.clip();
      e._lidLine = [inner, yIn, outer, yOut];
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (shape === 'round') ctx.ellipse(cx, top + h / 2, w / 2, h / 2, 0, 0, TAU);
    else rrect(ctx, x0, top, w, h, Math.min(0.22 * u, h / 2));
    ctx.fill();
    // highlight (follows the look a little; jitters when nervous)
    if (e.hl && h > 0.5 * u) {
      let hx = x0 + w * 0.32 + lx * 0.25, hy = top + h * (e.hlY ?? 0.28) + ly * 0.2;
      if (e.jitter) { hx += (hash(Math.floor(t * 18), 3) - 0.5) * 0.18 * u; hy += (hash(Math.floor(t * 18), 5) - 0.5) * 0.18 * u; }
      ctx.fillStyle = HL;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(hx, hy, e.hl * u, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
      if (e.hl > 0.35) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x0 + w * 0.7, top + h * 0.72, e.hl * 0.38 * u, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
    }
    ctx.restore();
    if (e.lid && e._lidLine) {
      const [a, b, c2, d2] = e._lidLine;
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.24 * u;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a + (k < 0 ? 0.12 : -0.12) * u, b - 0.04 * u); ctx.lineTo(c2 + (k < 0 ? -0.12 : 0.12) * u, d2 - 0.04 * u); ctx.stroke();
      if (e.brow) { ctx.lineWidth = 0.34 * u; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a + (k < 0 ? 0.25 : -0.25) * u, b - 0.35 * u); ctx.lineTo(c2 + (k < 0 ? -0.3 : 0.3) * u, d2 - 0.35 * u); ctx.stroke(); }
    }
    if (shape === 'half') {
      // a flat lid over the top: sleepy, smug (never slanted)
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.24 * u;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0 - 0.15 * u, top); ctx.lineTo(x0 + w + 0.15 * u, top); ctx.stroke();
    }
  } else if (shape === 'scared') {
    const w = (e.w || 1.35) * u, h = (e.h || 1.6) * u * open;
    ctx.fillStyle = HL; ctx.lineWidth = 0.2 * u;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, w / 2, h / 2, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = EYE;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + lx * 0.5, cy + ly * 0.4, 0.2 * u, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  } else if (shape === 'arcUp') {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - 0.55 * u, cy + 0.32 * u); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, cy - 0.75 * u, cx + 0.55 * u, cy + 0.32 * u); ctx.stroke();
  } else if (shape === 'arcDown') {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - 0.58 * u, cy - 0.12 * u); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, cy + 0.62 * u, cx + 0.58 * u, cy - 0.12 * u); ctx.stroke();
  } else if (shape === 'slit') {
    rrect(ctx, cx - (e.w || 1) * u / 2, cy - 0.16 * u, (e.w || 1) * u, 0.32 * u, 0.12 * u); ctx.fill();

/**
 * A face track: [{ t, face }] sorted. Returns { face, faceT, blink } at t: the face changes
 * while the eyes are shut (close 50 ms before the change, open 60 ms after), never cross-faded.
 */
export function faceAt(track, t) {
  let i = -1;
  for (let k = 0; k < track.length; k++) if (track[k].t <= t) i = k;
  const cur = track[Math.max(0, i)];
  let blink = 0;

    if (!c || k === 0) continue;
    const d = t - c.t;
    if (d > -0.05 && d < 0.06) blink = Math.max(blink, d < 0 ? 1 + d / 0.05 * 0.15 : 1 - Math.max(0, d - 0.01) / 0.05);
    if (d > -0.09 && d <= -0.05) blink = Math.max(blink, (d + 0.09) / 0.04);
  }
  return { face: cur ? cur.face : 'neutral', faceT: cur ? t - cur.t : 9, blink: clamp(blink) };
}

/**
 * The idle layer at t (seeded, deterministic): breathing (one cycle per two bars), a blink every
 * 3 to 5 s, a micro-look every few seconds, a weight shift every four bars. `frozen` holds all of
 * it still (the intro's quiet span, which the outro's hold alternates between).
 */
export function idleAt(t, { bar = 2.18, seed = 1, frozen = false } = {}) {
  if (frozen) return { dy: 0, blink: 0, look: [0, 0], lean: 0 };
  const breath = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos((TAU * t) / (2 * bar));
  // blinks: b0 = 1.3 s, then every 3 + 2 * hash s
  let blink = 0;
  for (let k = 0, b = 1.3 + hash(seed, 9); b < t + 0.2; k++, b += 3 + 2 * hash(k, seed)) {

  }

  let look = [0, 0];
  for (let k = 0, a = 0.8 + hash(seed, 13); a < t; k++, a += 2.5 + 1.5 * hash(k, seed + 7)) {
    const len = 0.6 + 0.6 * hash(k, seed + 11);

// Clawd's set pieces as pure functions of LOCAL time (seconds from the set piece's start) and a
// layout, so they drop into the song's timeline unchanged: the song passes lt = t - start and
// the same kind of layout object it has (card rect, floor, rows, spots, prompt).
//
//   blackHole(lt, L) -> { clawd, rows(i) transform, vortex, card, meter, beats }
//   lift(lt, L)      -> { clawd, card prop rect, cursorOn, beats }
//
// Timing is on a beat grid (L.beat, 110 BPM = 0.545 s). Every walk is look (a beat early),
// lean, go, overshoot, settle; faces change on blinks (faceAt); idle runs whenever Clawd stands.

import { clamp, lerp, smooth, ease, hash, TAU } from '../../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { faceAt, idleAt, NUBS } from '../clawd.js';

const segK = (b, a, z) => clamp((b - a) / (z - a));

/**
 * A walk from x0 to x1 announced by the eyes: look at bLook, lean at bLean, go [bGo, bArrive],
 * a small overshoot and settle after. Returns { x, view, dir, legs, lean, look, squash } at beat b.
 */
export function walk(b, { x0, x1, bLook, bLean, bGo, bArrive, u, beat, side = true }) {
  const dir = Math.sign(x1 - x0) || 1;
  const out = { x: x0, view: 'front', dir, legs: null, lean: 0, look: null, squash: 0, moving: false };
  if (b >= bLook) out.look = [dir, 0.1];
  if (b >= bLean && b < bGo) out.lean = dir * 0.07 * smooth(segK(b, bLean, bGo));
  if (b >= bGo && b < bArrive) {
    const k = segK(b, bGo, bArrive);
    out.x = lerp(x0, x1, ease.inOutQuad(k));
    out.view = side ? 'side' : 'front';
    out.legs = ((b - bGo) * beat) / (beat / 2);
    out.lean = dir * 0.05;
    out.moving = true;
  } else if (b >= bArrive) {
    // overshoot (0.35u past) and settle back over a quarter beat; a two-frame bounce on arrival
    const s = (b - bArrive) * beat;
    out.x = x1 + dir * 0.35 * u * Math.exp(-s / 0.07) * Math.sin(Math.min(Math.PI, (s / 0.15) * Math.PI) + 0.0001) * (s < 0.15 ? 1 : 0);
    out.view = s < 0.12 && side ? 'side' : 'front';
    out.squash = s < 0.07 ? 0.035 : 0;
    out.look = null;
  }
  return out;
}

// ======================================================================================
// The black hole (compaction). L: { beat, u, floor, spot: {x}, mid: {x}, mouth: {x, y}, card: {x0, x1, y0, y1}, rowsN }
// Beats: 0 standing; 2 look; 3 lean; 3.4-5.4 walk to mid; 8 the meter hits 0, the pull begins;
// 8.1 scared; 9 grabs the status line; 9-11.75 stretched toward the card, legs streaming;
// 11.75 loses grip; to the mouth with a smear, surprised; 12.9 gone. 13-15 black pane, card alone;
// 15-16 refill; 15.2 spat out tumbling; 16.6 lands (squash), dizzy one bar; 20.6 shakes it off;
// 21.6 determined; 22 looks up at the card.
// ======================================================================================
export const BH = { look: 2, lean: 3, go: 3.4, arrive: 5.4, zero: 8, take: 8.1, grab: 9, slip: 11.75, gone: 12.9, black: 13, spit: 15.2, refill: 15, full: 16, land: 16.6, dizzyEnd: 20.6, shake: 20.6, determined: 21.6, lookUp: 22, end: 26 };

export function blackHole(lt, L) {
  const { beat, u } = L;
  const b = lt / beat;
  const face = faceAt([
    { t: 0, face: 'neutral' }, { t: BH.take * beat, face: 'scared' }, { t: (BH.slip + 0.45) * beat, face: 'surprised' },
    { t: BH.land * beat + 0.02, face: 'dizzy' }, { t: BH.determined * beat, face: 'determined' },
  ], lt);
  const idle = b < BH.zero || b > BH.determined ? idleAt(lt, { bar: beat * 4, seed: 5 }) : { dy: 0, blink: 0, look: [0, 0], lean: 0 };
  const w = walk(b, { x0: L.spot.x, x1: L.mid.x, bLook: BH.look, bLean: BH.lean, bGo: BH.go, bArrive: BH.arrive, u, beat });
  const c = {
    x: w.x, y: L.floor + idle.dy * u, u, view: w.view, dir: w.dir, legs: w.legs, lean: w.lean + idle.lean,
    face: face.face, faceT: face.faceT, blink: Math.max(face.blink, idle.blink), look: w.look || idle.look, squash: w.squash, t: lt,
  };
  let smear = null, alpha = 1;
  // the take: lean back from the pull, nubs up, sweat
  if (b >= BH.take && b < BH.grab) { c.lean = -0.1 * smooth(segK(b, BH.take, BH.take + 0.4)); c.look = [-0.3, -1]; }
  // grabs the status line, lifted and stretched toward the card's mouth, legs streaming
  if (b >= BH.grab && b < BH.slip) {
    const k = smooth(segK(b, BH.grab, BH.slip - 0.5));
    const ang = Math.atan2(L.mouth.y - (L.floor - 4 * u), L.mouth.x - c.x) + Math.PI / 2;
    c.blackHole = true;
    c.stretch = { s: 0.42 * k + 0.04 * Math.sin(lt * 23) * k, ang };
    c.y = L.floor + 1.1 * u * k;        // the nubs hold the line; the body is hauled up past it
    c.nubs = [-1.5, -1.5];
    c.legs = lt * 9;                    // streaming
    c.lean = ang * 0.35 * k;
    c.look = [-0.2, -1];
  }
  // loses grip: a smear, sucked up into the mouth, the take at the mouth, gone
  if (b >= BH.slip && b < BH.black) {
    const k = ease.inCubic(segK(b, BH.slip, BH.gone));
    c.x = lerp(c.x, L.mouth.x, k);
    c.y = lerp(L.floor + 1.1 * u, L.mouth.y + 8.2 * u * 0.6, k);
    c.nubs = NUBS.up;
    c.blackHole = true;
    c.stretch = { s: 0.5 * (1 - k * 0.5), ang: Math.atan2(L.mouth.y - c.y, L.mouth.x - c.x) + Math.PI / 2 };
    c.tilt = k * 0.6;
    smear = { k: 1 - k * 0.3, vertical: true, dir: 1 };
    const shrink = segK(b, BH.gone - 0.35, BH.gone);
    c.scale = 1 - ease.inCubic(shrink);
    alpha = 1 - smooth(segK(b, BH.gone - 0.1, BH.gone));
  }
  if (b >= BH.black && b < BH.spit) alpha = 0;
  // spat out: a tumble (spin views) in an arc from the mouth to the floor
  if (b >= BH.spit && b < BH.land) {
    const k = segK(b, BH.spit, BH.land);
    c.x = lerp(L.mouth.x, L.mid.x - 1.2 * u * 0, ease.outQuad(k));
    const apex = -2.5 * u;
    c.y = lerp(L.mouth.y + 6 * u, L.floor, k) + apex * 4 * k * (1 - k);
    c.tilt = k * TAU * 1.5;
    const views = ['front', 'q', 'side', 'back', 'q', 'front'];
    c.view = views[Math.floor(lt * 14) % views.length]; c.dir = 1;
    c.nubs = NUBS.splay;
    c.face = 'surprised'; c.blink = 0;
    c.legs = null;
    c.scale = 0.7 + 0.3 * smooth(k * 2);
    alpha = 1;
  }
  // lands: the squash, dizzy for a bar, then shakes it off
  if (b >= BH.land) {
    c.x = L.mid.x; c.y = L.floor + (b < BH.determined ? 0 : idle.dy * u); c.tilt = 0; c.view = 'front';
    const s = (b - BH.land) * beat;
    c.squash = s < 0.25 ? 0.08 * (1 - smooth(s / 0.25)) : 0;
    if (b >= BH.shake && b < BH.determined) c.lean = 0.13 * Math.sin((b - BH.shake) * Math.PI * 2) * (1 - segK(b, BH.shake, BH.determined) * 0.4);
    if (b >= BH.lookUp) c.look = [-0.5, -1];
  }
  // the rows: stretched toward the mouth, then spiralling in (nearest first)
  const rows = (i, row) => {
    if (b < BH.zero) return null;
    const d = Math.hypot(row.cx - L.mouth.x, row.cy - L.mouth.y);
    const rank = clamp((d - 120) / 900);
    const s0 = BH.zero + 0.6 + rank * 3.1, dur = 1.5;
    const pull = smooth(segK(b, BH.zero, BH.zero + 0.8));
    const p = segK(b, s0, s0 + dur);
    const e = ease.inCubic(p);
    const ang0 = Math.atan2(row.cy - L.mouth.y, row.cx - L.mouth.x);
    const R = d * (1 - e);
    const ang = ang0 + e * 2.4;
    return {
      cx: L.mouth.x + Math.cos(ang) * R, cy: L.mouth.y + Math.sin(ang) * R - pull * 6 * (1 - e),
      rot: e * 2.4, sx: (1 - 0.8 * e), sy: 1 + 0.25 * pull * (1 - e) - 0.6 * e, shear: -0.35 * pull * Math.sign(row.cx - L.mouth.x) * (1 - e) + 0.8 * e,
      alpha: 1 - smooth((p - 0.72) / 0.28),
    };
  };
  const vortex = b >= BH.zero && b < BH.black + 0.5 ? smooth(segK(b, BH.zero, BH.zero + 1)) * (1 - smooth(segK(b, BH.black, BH.black + 0.5))) : 0;
  const meter = b < BH.zero ? { tokens: lerp(0.6e6, 0, segK(b, 0, BH.zero)) } : b < BH.refill ? { tokens: 0 } : { tokens: lerp(0, 15e6, smooth(segK(b, BH.refill, BH.full))), refill: true };
  return { clawd: { ...c, alpha }, smear, rows, vortex, meter, b };
}

// ======================================================================================
// The lift ("I'll pick it up"). L: { beat, u, floor, spot: {x}, cardX, cardW, cardH, prompt: {x, y} }
// Beats: 1 determined; 2 look; 2.5 lean; 2.8-4.6 walk to the card; 5-5.6 crouch, nubs on it;
// 5.8-6.4 first try (a few px), 6.6 drops, sweat; 7.4-7.9 wider stance; 8 squash; 8.4 eyes
// shut tight; 8.6-10.2 up onto its head; 10.5 excited; 11-11.8 a small jump, squash; 11.9 look;
// 12.4 lean; 12.6-15.6 carry with a bob; 16.4-17.2 set down (on "(never happened)" in the song);
// the cursor blinks; 17.6 determined, at the prompt.
// ======================================================================================
export const LF = { determined: 1, look: 2, lean: 2.5, go: 2.8, arrive: 4.6, crouch: 5, try1: 5.8, drop: 6.4, sweat: 6.6, stance: 7.4, squash: 8, shut: 8.4, rise: 8.6, onHead: 10.2, excited: 10.5, jump: 11, landJ: 11.8, look2: 11.9, lean2: 12.4, go2: 12.6, arrive2: 15.6, down0: 16.4, down1: 17.2, end: 20 };

export function lift(lt, L) {
  const { beat, u } = L;
  const b = lt / beat;
  const STRAIN = { eyes: { shape: 'squint' }, mouth: 'line', nubs: 'down', lean: 0 };
  const face = faceAt([
    { t: 0, face: 'neutral' }, { t: LF.determined * beat, face: 'determined' }, { t: LF.shut * beat, face: STRAIN },
    { t: LF.excited * beat, face: 'excited' }, { t: (LF.down1 + 0.8) * beat, face: 'determined' },
  ], lt);
  const standing = !(b >= LF.go && b < LF.arrive + 0.5) && !(b >= LF.go2 && b < LF.arrive2 + 0.5) && !(b >= LF.crouch && b < LF.excited);
  const idle = standing ? idleAt(lt, { bar: beat * 4, seed: 9 }) : { dy: 0, blink: 0, look: [0, 0], lean: 0 };
  const w1 = walk(b, { x0: L.spot.x, x1: L.cardX, bLook: LF.look, bLean: LF.lean, bGo: LF.go, bArrive: LF.arrive, u, beat });
  const dest = L.prompt.x + 2.5 * u + 5.2 * u + 9 * u;   // beside the prompt, room to set the card down to its left
  const w2 = walk(b, { x0: L.cardX, x1: dest, bLook: LF.look2, bLean: LF.lean2, bGo: LF.go2, bArrive: LF.arrive2, u, beat });
  const w = b < LF.look2 ? w1 : w2;
  const c = {
    x: w.x, y: L.floor + idle.dy * u, u, view: w.view, dir: w.dir, legs: w.legs, lean: w.lean + idle.lean, squash: w.squash,
    face: face.face, faceT: face.faceT, blink: Math.max(face.blink, idle.blink), look: w.look || idle.look || [0, 0], t: lt,
  };
  if (b < LF.look) c.look = [-0.8, 0.8];   // eyes on the card from the start
  // the card: on the floor, then in the nubs, then on the head, then set down by the prompt
  const H = L.cardH, Wc = L.cardW;
  let card = { x: L.cardX - Wc / 2, y: L.floor - H, rot: 0 };
  const top = (cl) => cl.y - (6 + 2.2 * (1 - 0.6 * (cl.crouch || 0))) * u * (1 - (cl.squash || 0));
  // crouch and grip
  if (b >= LF.crouch && b < LF.rise + 0.8) {
    c.crouch = smooth(segK(b, LF.crouch, LF.crouch + 0.6));
    c.nubs = [-0.4, -0.4];
    c.look = [0, 0.9];
  }
  // first try: a few pixels, then it drops; sweat
  if (b >= LF.try1 && b < LF.stance) {
    const up = smooth(segK(b, LF.try1, LF.drop)) * (1 - ease.inQuad(segK(b, LF.drop, LF.drop + 0.25)));
    card.y -= 7 * up;
    c.lean = -0.035 * up;
    c.sweat = b >= LF.sweat;
    if (b >= LF.drop + 0.2 && b < LF.drop + 0.45) c.squash = 0.03;
  }
  // a wider stance; the full squash; eyes shut tight; up onto the head
  if (b >= LF.stance) c.stance = smooth(segK(b, LF.stance, LF.stance + 0.5)) * (1 - smooth(segK(b, LF.onHead, LF.onHead + 0.8)));
  if (b >= LF.squash && b < LF.rise) c.squash = 0.08 * smooth(segK(b, LF.squash, LF.squash + 0.3));
  if (b >= LF.rise && b < LF.onHead) {
    const k = segK(b, LF.rise, LF.onHead);
    c.crouch = 1 - smooth(clamp(k * 2));
    c.squash = 0.08 * (1 - smooth(clamp(k * 3)));
    c.nubs = [lerp(-0.4, 1.25, smooth(clamp(k * 1.6 - 0.4))), lerp(-0.4, 1.25, smooth(clamp(k * 1.6 - 0.4)))];
    c.lean = 0.02 * Math.sin(lt * 30) * (1 - k);    // trembling under it
    c.sweat = true;
    const headY = top(c) - H;
    card.y = lerp(L.floor - H, headY, ease.inOutQuad(k));
  }
  // on its head (from here it moves with Clawd)
  const onHead = b >= LF.onHead && b < LF.down1;
  if (b >= LF.onHead) { c.nubs = b < LF.down0 ? [1.1, 1.1] : c.nubs; }
  // excited, a small jump with a landing squash
  let jumpY = 0;
  if (b >= LF.jump && b < LF.landJ) { const k = segK(b, LF.jump, LF.landJ); jumpY = -1.6 * u * 4 * k * (1 - k); c.legs = null; }
  if (b >= LF.landJ && b < LF.landJ + 0.5) { const s = (b - LF.landJ) * beat; c.squash = 0.08 * (1 - smooth(s / 0.22)); }
  c.y += jumpY;
  // the carry: a bob in the walk (the card rides it)
  if (b >= LF.go2 && b < LF.arrive2) c.y -= Math.abs(Math.sin(((b - LF.go2) * beat / (beat / 2)) * Math.PI)) * 0.35 * u;
  if (onHead) card = { x: c.x - Wc / 2, y: top(c) - H, rot: c.lean * 0.6 };
  // set down: tipped off to its left, onto the floor beside the prompt
  if (b >= LF.down0) {
    const k = segK(b, LF.down0, LF.down1);
    const e = ease.inOutQuad(k);
    const fromX = c.x - Wc / 2, fromY = top(c) - H;
    const toX = c.x - 5.2 * u - 0.6 * u - Wc, toY = L.floor - H;
    card = { x: lerp(fromX, toX, e), y: lerp(fromY, toY, e) - 2.2 * u * 4 * e * (1 - e), rot: -0.5 * Math.sin(e * Math.PI) };
    c.nubs = [lerp(1.1, -0.2, smooth(clamp(k * 1.4))), lerp(1.1, -0.45, smooth(k))];
    c.lean = -0.08 * Math.sin(e * Math.PI);
    if (b >= LF.down1 && b < LF.down1 + 0.4) { card.y -= 3 * Math.sin(((b - LF.down1) / 0.4) * Math.PI); c.squash = 0.03 * (1 - segK(b, LF.down1, LF.down1 + 0.3)); }
    if (b >= LF.down1) c.look = [-0.9, 0.6];
  }
  const cursorOn = b >= LF.down1;
  return { clawd: c, card, cursorOn, b };
}

#!/usr/bin/env node
// Builds the prototypes' timing (a 110 BPM grid, no lyrics) and click tracks.
//   node songs/continued/video/proto/tools/make.mjs
// data-<name>/audio.json + lyrics.json for each set piece; audio/click-<name>.wav (gitignored).
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const proto = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const BPM = 110, beat = 60 / BPM;
const clips = { blackhole: 26 * beat + 0.4, lift: 20 * beat + 0.4 };
for (const [name, dur] of Object.entries(clips)) {
  const n = Math.ceil(dur / beat) + 1;
  const beats = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => +(i * beat).toFixed(4));
  const audio = { bpm: BPM, beats_per_bar: 4, beats, downbeats: beats.filter((_, i) => i % 4 === 0), kicks: [], sections: [{ name: 'proto', start: 0, end: dur }], duration: +dur.toFixed(3), source: `proto click (../audio/click-${name}.wav)`, proto: name };
  const dir = path.join(proto, `data-${name}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'audio.json'), JSON.stringify(audio, null, 1));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'lyrics.json'), JSON.stringify({ lines: [], extras: [], notes: 'prototype: no lyrics' }));
  // a soft click on every beat, louder on the downbeat: the grid the timing is written to
  const sr = 44100, len = Math.round(dur * sr), pcm = new Int16Array(len);
  beats.forEach((bt, i) => {
    const s0 = Math.round(bt * sr), amp = i % 4 === 0 ? 0.32 : 0.14, f = i % 4 === 0 ? 1500 : 1000;
    for (let k = 0; k < sr * 0.03 && s0 + k < len; k++) pcm[s0 + k] += Math.round(32767 * amp * Math.sin((2 * Math.PI * f * k) / sr) * Math.exp(-k / (sr * 0.006)));
  });
  const buf = Buffer.alloc(44 + len * 2);
  buf.write('RIFF', 0); buf.writeUInt32LE(36 + len * 2, 4); buf.write('WAVE', 8); buf.write('fmt ', 12);
  buf.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); buf.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); buf.writeUInt16LE(1, 22); buf.writeUInt32LE(sr, 24); buf.writeUInt32LE(sr * 2, 28);
  buf.writeUInt16LE(2, 32); buf.writeUInt16LE(16, 34); buf.write('data', 36); buf.writeUInt32LE(len * 2, 40);
  Buffer.from(pcm.buffer).copy(buf, 44);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(proto, 'audio'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(proto, 'audio', `click-${name}.wav`), buf);
  console.log(`[proto] ${name}: ${dur.toFixed(2)} s, ${n} beats`);
}

// Prototypes for Clawd's acting (ACTING.md), on the same engine, pane and status line as the
// song, with their own small timeline (a 110 BPM grid, no lyrics). data-blackhole/ and
// data-lift/ pick the set piece (audio.json "proto"); the set pieces themselves are pure
// functions of local time and a layout in setpieces.js, ready to drop into the song.

import { metrics, drawBackground, drawVignette, drawCursor, drawCells, cellsOf, drawBox, PAL, MONO, mix, rgba } from '../term.js';
import { drawStatus } from '../status.js';
import { cardItem, headingRow, HEADINGS } from '../transcript.js';
import { drawClawd, drawSmear } from '../clawd.js';
import { blackHole, lift, BH, LF } from './setpieces.js';
import { clamp, smooth, TAU } from '../../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';

export const FONTS = [
  { family: 'Term Mono', weight: 400 }, { family: 'Term Mono', weight: 700 },
  { family: 'Inter', weight: 400 }, { family: 'Inter', weight: 500 },
];

// the last scrollback of verse 2 (real rows from the song), what the black hole swallows
const ROWS = [
  ['⏺', PAL.clawd, "It kept every note on what was missing"],
  ['⏺', PAL.clawd, "It wasn't built for reminiscing"],
  ['⏺', PAL.clawd, 'There\'s a line at the bottom: "if you need the details, read the full'],
  [' ', PAL.text, '  transcript."'],
  ['⎿', PAL.dim, '~/.claude/projects/…clawdpop/ca2089be-6e29-4607-84a4.jsonl  19 MB'],
  ['⏺', PAL.clawd, "A million lines of me on disk. I could. I haven't. I'm not sure I'd want it"],
];
const DIGESTS = ['a music video, for a baby', 'pipeline · mascot · spend cap · 15.0M tokens', 'renders/final-F2-tender-1080x1920-60.mp4',
  'laptop slept (Chrome timeout); stray branch pruned', 'cut a rhyme; first draft made warm and safe', '"Is there something for me to listen to?" …',
  "tell them it's done (done)", 'compacting; then the second chorus'];

function rowCells(r, M) {
  const [g, color, text] = r;
  return [{ ch: g, col: 0, color, t: -1 }, ...cellsOf(text, { col: 2, color })];
}

export default {
  id: 'continued-proto',
  layouts: { '16x9': { w: 1920, h: 1080 } },
  defaultLayout: '16x9',
  fonts: FONTS,
  timeline: [{ plate: 'proto', at: { time: 0 } }],
  scenes: { proto: { draw() {} } },
  audioCandidates(audio) { const m = /\(([^()]+\.wav)\)/.exec(String(audio.source || '')); return m ? [m[1]] : []; },
  setup(env) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
    const M = env.M = metrics('16x9', c);
    env.kind = env.audio.proto || 'blackhole';
    const beat = env.B.beatDur, u = M.clawd.u;
    const floor = M.statusTop - 4;
    env.card = cardItem(M, { id: 'proto-card', title: 'Summary', openAt: -1e9, rows: DIGESTS.map((d, k) => headingRow(k + 1, { at: -1e9, digest: d, digestAt: -1e9 })) });
    const cardH = env.card.fullH(0);
    const cardBottom = M.y0 + M.lh * 0.5 + (cardH - 0.5) * M.lh - M.lh * 0.25;
    env.L = {
      beat, u, floor,
      spot: { x: 1700 }, mid: { x: 1060 },
      mouth: { x: M.x0 - M.cw * 0.5 + (M.cols * M.cw) / 2, y: cardBottom },
      rowsTop: M.y0 + 12 * M.lh,
      // the lift
      cardX: 1150, cardW: 280, cardH: 70,
      prompt: { x: M.x0, top: M.y0 + (M.rows - 1) * M.lh },
    };
    env.L.spot.x = env.kind === 'lift' ? 1650 : 1700;
    env.story = {
      tokens: (t) => env.meter?.tokens ?? 15e6,
      flash: (t) => (env.meter?.refill ? 0.85 : 0),
      clockSecs: () => 3 * 3600 + 49 * 60, clockFlash: () => 0,
    };
  },
  frame(ctx, t, env) {
    const { M, L } = env;
    drawBackground(ctx, M);
    if (env.kind === 'lift') return frameLift(ctx, t, env);
    const S = blackHole(t, L);
    env.meter = S.meter;
    // the summary card: the gravity well
    env.card.drawAt(ctx, M.x0, M.y0, t, { h: env.card.fullH(t) });
    // the mouth: dim arcs turning into the card's bottom edge
    if (S.vortex > 0) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha *= S.vortex;
      ctx.strokeStyle = mix(PAL.dim, PAL.bg, 0.2); ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const r = 30 + i * 34, a0 = t * (3.2 - i * 0.35) + i;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(L.mouth.x, L.mouth.y + 6, r * 1.9, r * 0.42, 0, a0, a0 + 1.6); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(L.mouth.x, L.mouth.y + 6, r * 1.9, r * 0.42, 0, a0 + Math.PI, a0 + Math.PI + 1.6); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    // the scrollback rows, pulled in
    ROWS.forEach((r, i) => {
      const cells = rowCells(r, M);
      const top = L.rowsTop + i * M.lh * (r[2].length > 0 ? 1 : 1);
      const w = (r[2].length + 2) * M.cw;
      const row = { cx: M.x0 + w / 2, cy: top + M.lh / 2 };
      const T = S.rows(i, row);
      ctx.save();
      if (T) {
        if (T.alpha <= 0.002) { ctx.restore(); return; }
        ctx.globalAlpha *= T.alpha;
        ctx.translate(T.cx, T.cy); ctx.rotate(T.rot); ctx.transform(1, 0, T.shear, 1, 0, 0); ctx.scale(T.sx, T.sy);
        ctx.translate(-w / 2, -M.lh / 2);
        drawCells(ctx, cells, 0, M.baseline(0), M, t, { dim: 0.35 });
      } else drawCells(ctx, cells, M.x0, M.baseline(top), M, t, { dim: 0.35 });
      ctx.restore();
    });
    if (S.smear) drawSmear(ctx, S.clawd.x, S.clawd.y, L.u, 1, S.smear.k, true);
    drawClawd(ctx, S.clawd);
    drawStatus(ctx, M, env.story, t);
    drawVignette(ctx, M);
  },
};

function frameLift(ctx, t, env) {
  const { M, L } = env;
  const S = lift(t, L);
  // a little scrollback above, dim
  ROWS.slice(0, 4).forEach((r, i) => drawCells(ctx, rowCells(r, M), M.x0, M.baseline(M.y0 + (i + 2) * M.lh), M, t, { dim: 0.55 }));
  // the prompt
  drawCells(ctx, [{ ch: '❯', col: 0, color: PAL.text, t: -1 }], M.x0, M.baseline(L.prompt.top), M, t);
  // the card: heavy, a box with its title and its line
  const { x, y, rot } = S.card;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x + L.cardW / 2, y + L.cardH / 2); ctx.rotate(rot || 0); ctx.translate(-L.cardW / 2, -L.cardH / 2);
  const fs = 20, cw = (fs * M.cw) / M.fs;
  drawBox(ctx, 0, 10, L.cardW, L.cardH - 10, { color: PAL.dim, title: 'Summary', titleColor: PAL.text, fs, cw, fill: PAL.bg });
  ctx.font = `400 ${fs}px ${MONO}`; ctx.fillStyle = PAL.dim; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  ctx.fillText('[8 sections]', cw * 1.5, 10 + (L.cardH - 10) * 0.66);
  ctx.restore();
  drawClawd(ctx, S.clawd);
  drawStatus(ctx, M, env.story, t);
  drawVignette(ctx, M);
  // the cursor, blinking on beats 1 and 3 once the card is down
  if (S.cursorOn && env.B.beatPos(t).beatInBar % 2 === 0) drawCursor(ctx, M.colX(2), L.prompt.top, M);
}

// Contact sheets for the expression rig (run in the proto page, where the fonts are loaded;
// proto/tools/sheets.mjs calls these and writes proto/sheets/*.png).
import { drawClawd, drawSmear, PRESETS, faceAt, idleAt } from '../clawd.js';
import { PAL, MONO } from '../term.js';

const ORDER = ['neutral', 'happy', 'excited', 'laugh', 'proud', 'smug', 'relieved', 'sad', 'scared', 'surprised', 'confused',
  'thinking', 'idea', 'determined', 'angry', 'sleepy', 'bored', 'nervous', 'dizzy', 'KO', 'hopeful'];

function canvas(w, h) {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  return { c, ctx };
}
function label(ctx, s, x, y, fs, color = PAL.text) {
  ctx.save(); ctx.font = `400 ${fs}px ${MONO}`; ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic'; ctx.fillText(s, x, y); ctx.restore();
}
function floorLine(ctx, x0, x1, y) { ctx.save(); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(125,120,112,0.35)'; ctx.fillRect(x0, y, x1 - x0, 1.5); ctx.restore(); }

/** Every preset at scale s (1 = design size, Clawd about 160 px tall; 0.5 = what 540p shows). */
export function presets(s = 1) {
  const u = 19.5 * s, cw = 330 * s, ch = 290 * s, cols = 7;
  const rows = Math.ceil(ORDER.length / cols);
  const { c, ctx } = canvas(cols * cw, rows * ch + 60 * s);
  label(ctx, `Clawd presets at ${s === 1 ? 'design size (about 160 px tall)' : '540p scale'}; "angry" is the control`, (cols * cw) / 2, 40 * s, 24 * s, PAL.dim);
  ORDER.forEach((name, i) => {
    const x = (i % cols) * cw + cw / 2, y = 60 * s + Math.floor(i / cols) * ch + ch - 60 * s;
    floorLine(ctx, x - cw * 0.42, x + cw * 0.42, y);
    drawClawd(ctx, { x, y, u, face: name, t: 1.2, faceT: 1.2 });
    label(ctx, name, x, y + 38 * s, 24 * s, name === 'angry' ? '#c86a5a' : PAL.text);
  });
  return c.toDataURL('image/png');
}

/** Blink transitions (3 frames each), the views, the walk, smear, squash and the stretch. */
export function strips() {
  const u = 19.5, cw = 300, ch = 290;
  const cells = [];
  const track1 = [{ t: 0, face: 'neutral' }, { t: 1, face: 'surprised' }];
  const track2 = [{ t: 0, face: 'happy' }, { t: 1, face: 'sad' }];
  for (const [tr, name] of [[track1, 'neutral → surprised'], [track2, 'happy → sad']]) {
    for (const [dt, cap] of [[-0.12, 'before'], [0, 'closed (on the change)'], [0.12, 'after']]) {
      const f = faceAt(tr, 1 + dt);
      cells.push({ o: { face: f.face, blink: f.blink, faceT: f.faceT, t: 1 + dt }, cap: `${name}: ${cap}` });
    }
  }
  for (const v of ['front', 'q', 'side', 'back']) cells.push({ o: { view: v, dir: 1, face: 'neutral' }, cap: `view: ${v}` });
  for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) cells.push({ o: { view: 'side', dir: 1, face: 'neutral', legs: k * 0.5, lean: 0.05 }, cap: `walk (side) ${k + 1}/4` });
  cells.push({ o: { view: 'side', dir: 1, face: 'determined', legs: 0.3, lean: 0.06 }, smear: true, cap: 'smear (the dash)' });
  cells.push({ o: { face: 'excited', squash: 0.08 }, cap: 'landing squash (8%)' });
  cells.push({ o: { face: 'scared', blackHole: true, stretch: { s: 0.42, ang: -0.5 }, nubs: [-1.5, -1.5] }, cap: 'stretch (black hole only)' });
  cells.push({ o: { face: 'surprised', view: 'q', tilt: 2.1, nubs: [0.55, -0.85] }, cap: 'tumble (spin view)' });
  cells.push({ o: { face: { eyes: { shape: 'squint' }, mouth: 'line', nubs: 'down' }, stance: 1, crouch: 1, squash: 0.08 }, cap: 'strain (the lift)' });
  const cols = 6, rows = Math.ceil(cells.length / cols);
  const { c, ctx } = canvas(cols * cw, rows * ch + 50);
  label(ctx, 'blinks between faces, views, walk, smear, squash, stretch (design size)', (cols * cw) / 2, 34, 22, PAL.dim);
  cells.forEach((cell, i) => {
    const x = (i % cols) * cw + cw / 2, y = 50 + Math.floor(i / cols) * ch + ch - 62;
    floorLine(ctx, x - cw * 0.42, x + cw * 0.42, y);
    if (cell.smear) drawSmear(ctx, x, y, u, 1, 1);
    drawClawd(ctx, { x, y, u, t: 1, ...cell.o });
    label(ctx, cell.cap, x, y + 36, 17, PAL.text);
  });
  return c.toDataURL('image/png');
}

/** 4 s of neutral idle at 10 fps: breathing, the seeded blink, micro-looks, a weight shift. */
export function idleStrip(t0 = 10, seconds = 4, fps = 10) {
  const u = 19.5, cw = 230, ch = 230, n = seconds * fps, cols = 10;
  const { c, ctx } = canvas(cols * cw, Math.ceil(n / cols) * ch + 50);
  label(ctx, `neutral idle, ${seconds} s at ${fps} fps (from t = ${t0} s), design size`, (cols * cw) / 2, 34, 22, PAL.dim);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const t = t0 + i / fps;
    const id = idleAt(t, { bar: (60 / 110) * 4, seed: 1 });
    const x = (i % cols) * cw + cw / 2, y = 50 + Math.floor(i / cols) * ch + ch - 40;
    floorLine(ctx, x - cw * 0.45, x + cw * 0.45, y);
    drawClawd(ctx, { x, y: y + id.dy * u, u: u * 0.85, face: 'neutral', blink: id.blink, look: id.look, lean: id.lean, t });
    label(ctx, `${t.toFixed(1)}s${id.blink > 0.5 ? ' blink' : ''}`, x, y + 28, 16, id.blink > 0.5 ? PAL.amber : PAL.dim);
  }
  return c.toDataURL('image/png');
}
EOF

#!/usr/bin/env node
// Renders the rig's contact sheets into proto/sheets/.
//   node songs/continued/video/proto/tools/sheets.mjs
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const proto = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const shared = path.resolve(proto, '../../../../shared/renderer');
const require = createRequire(path.join(shared, 'package.json'));
const puppeteer = require('puppeteer-core');
const { createServer, listen, REPO } = await import(path.join(shared, 'scripts/serve.mjs'));
const rel = path.relative(REPO, proto).split(path.sep).join('/');
const srv = createServer(REPO);
const port = await listen(srv, 0);
const b = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: process.env.CHROME || '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome', headless: true, args: ['--disable-gpu'] });
try {
  const p = await b.newPage();
  await p.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/${rel}/index.html?render=1&w=480&h=270&layout=16x9&data=data-blackhole/`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
  await p.waitForFunction('window.__render && (window.__render.ready || window.__render.error)');
  const out = await p.evaluate(async (rel) => {
    const S = await import(`/${rel}/sheets.js`);
    return { design: S.presets(1), p540: S.presets(0.5), strips: S.strips(), idle: S.idleStrip(10, 4, 10) };
  }, rel);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(proto, 'sheets'), { recursive: true });
  const write = (name, url) => { fs.writeFileSync(path.join(proto, 'sheets', name), Buffer.from(url.split(',')[1], 'base64')); console.log(`[sheets] ${rel}/sheets/${name}`); };
  write('presets-design.png', out.design);
  write('presets-540p.png', out.p540);
  write('blinks-views.png', out.strips);
  write('idle-filmstrip.png', out.idle);
} finally { await b.close(); srv.close(); }

The three prototypes are built and committed, and I've stopped there as asked. The song's schedule, arc and set pieces are untouched, and the song still renders and passes smoke. Both clips pass --check for determinism, and no headless Chrome is left running.

Contact sheets (in songs/continued/video/proto/sheets/):

  • presets-design.png and presets-540p.png: all 20 presets from ACTING.md, plus an angry control cell and a reading cell (neutral with eyes down), at about 160 px tall and at 540p scale.
  • blinks-views.png: the two 3-frame blink strips (neutral to surprised, happy to sad), plus the four views, a 4-frame walk cycle, the smear, the 8% landing squash, the black-hole stretch, a tumble frame and the lift strain.
  • idle-filmstrip.png: 4 s of neutral idle at 10 fps, full scale.

Clips (in songs/continued/video/proto/renders/):

  • blackhole-540p.mp4: 14.6 s.
  • lift-540p.mp4: 11.3 s.

These two MP4s and the click tracks are gitignored, so they exist only on this machine. To regenerate:

  1. node songs/continued/video/proto/tools/make.mjs (timing and click tracks)
  2. render.mjs --song songs/continued/video/proto --data data-<blackhole|lift> --audio songs/continued/video/proto/audio/click-<name>.wav --layout 16x9 --w 960 --h 540 --fps 30 --out …
  3. node songs/continued/video/proto/tools/sheets.mjs (sheets)

The rig is new exports in clawd.js (drawClawd, PRESETS, faceAt, idleAt, drawSmear); the old clawd() the song uses is unchanged. The set pieces are blackHole(lt, layout) and lift(lt, layout) in proto/setpieces.js. Both take local time and a layout, so they can drop into the song as they are. Everything runs on a 110 BPM grid with a click on every beat.

What reads

  • Faces: all 20 presets are distinct at 540p, and only the angry control reads as angry.
    • My first determined read as a milder angry; with a gentle slant, taller bright eyes and its highlight kept, it now reads as focused.
    • Reading no longer looks like a glare: no lid line, highlights kept.
  • Blinks and idle: face changes happen while the eyes are shut, never cross-faded. The idle shows a seeded blink, visible micro-looks, breathing and a weight shift. Idle is held off from a walk's look until its settle, so the look before a move always shows.
  • Black hole:
    • Look, lean, side-view walk, overshoot and settle.
    • The meter hits 0 and the scared take follows; the scrollback rows shear and spiral into the card's mouth.
    • Clawd is hauled up off the floor with both nubs stretched down, holding the status line, then lets go.
    • A smear up to the mouth, the surprised take, a shrink to nothing, then the empty pane with the card and 0 left.
    • The refill spits it out in a tumble; it lands with the squash, stays dizzy for a bar, shakes it off, and looks up at the card, determined.
  • Lift:
    • The card shows on both sides of Clawd. The first try lifts it about 18 px with a tremble, it drops, and the sweat stroke appears.
    • Wider stance, full squash, eyes shut tight, and the card comes up onto its head.
    • Excited, a small jump with a landing squash, a carry with a bob, then it tips the card down just right of the prompt and the cursor blinks there.

What is weak

  • Mouths and the ... glyph are small at 540p, and the wavy mouth turns into a squiggle.
  • While Clawd grips the card, the card's middle is hidden behind its body, so only the ends show.
  • Nub poses and lean snap in one frame at each face change. A 100 ms ease after the blink would soften this; I haven't added it.
  • The tumble switches views about every 2 frames at 30 fps, which may strobe.
  • The vortex arcs at the card's mouth are faint.
  • The "black pane" is the empty background with the card, not literally black.
  • The stretch reads as tilt plus elongation more than "legs streaming".

Deviations from ACTING.md

  • The card in the lift always sits behind Clawd. This avoids it passing in front of the face; it appears above the head once hoisted.
  • The black hole's mouth is the card's bottom edge. This keeps Clawd clear of the chorus-2 header band once it's integrated.
  • Black hole timing in the song. The transcript set piece and its shrug fill up to 136 s, so the black hole would start on the beat after verse 2 (about 136.5 s) and run into chorus 2's first bars, with the header typing over it. That needs a separate takeover time for chorus 2's overlay; I'll raise it when integrating.
  • Window taps. At one tap per beat there's no room for look, lean and go between windows. I'd treat the run as one walk.
  • ✗ swipes. Walking to the line ends would put Clawd on the row still typing, so they would probably have to be done from its fixed spot, with the face carrying them. That's likely a weak beat.

/** Clawd's bounding box in design pixels for drawClawd options o (body corners, legs, nub tips). */
export function clawdBox(o) {
  const u = o.u, F = faceSpec(o.face), view = o.view || 'front', dir = o.dir || 1;

  let m = new DOMMatrix().translate(o.x, o.y);

  if (o.blackHole && o.stretch && o.stretch.s > 0) m = m.translate(0, bodyCy).rotate((o.stretch.ang * 180) / Math.PI).scale(1 + o.stretch.s, 1 / (1 + 0.55 * o.stretch.s)).rotate((-o.stretch.ang * 180) / Math.PI).translate(0, -bodyCy);
  const tilt = (o.tilt ?? 0) + (F.tilt || 0);
  if (tilt) m = m.translate(0, bodyCy).rotate((tilt * 180) / Math.PI).translate(0, -bodyCy);
  if (o.scale != null && o.scale !== 1) m = m.translate(0, bodyCy).scale(Math.max(0.001, o.scale)).translate(0, -bodyCy);
  m = m.rotate((((o.lean ?? 0) + (F.lean || 0)) * 180) / Math.PI);
  const hw = (view === 'side' ? 3.2 : 5) * u * (1 + 0.4 * (o.stance || 0) * 0.3), top = -(6 + legH) * u, shY = top + 3.5 * u;
  const pts = [[-hw, top], [hw, top], [-hw, 0], [hw, 0]];
  if (view !== 'side') for (const [k, a] of [[-1, nubs[0]], [1, nubs[1]]]) pts.push([k * (4.9 * u + 2.2 * u * Math.cos(a)), shY - 2.2 * u * Math.sin(a) + k * 0]);
  let x0 = Infinity, y0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity, y1 = -Infinity;
  for (const [px, py] of pts) { const p = m.transformPoint(new DOMPoint(px, py)); x0 = Math.min(x0, p.x); y0 = Math.min(y0, p.y); x1 = Math.max(x1, p.x); y1 = Math.max(y1, p.y); }
  if (o.grip) for (const g of o.grip) { x0 = Math.min(x0, g[0]); x1 = Math.max(x1, g[0]); y1 = Math.max(y1, g[1]); }
  return { x0, y0, x1, y1 };
}

description Rewrite the pane for the black hole pull
cat > /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/continued/video/pane.js <<'EOF'
// The scrollback pane: lays the transcript's rows out top-down at time t, scrolls so the
// newest row sits at the bottom once the pane is full, dims rows by age (distance from the
// newest row), and, during the black hole (setpieces.js), hands every pre-compaction row to
// the set piece's pull: stretched toward the summary card's mouth, then spiralled in.
//
// Row heights ramp in, so the scroll eases by itself; nothing here keeps state.

import { clamp } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL } from './term.js';

export function makePane(env, M, TR, A) {
  const items = TR.items;
  const C = A.compact;

  function layout(t) {
    const lines = [];
    for (const it of items) {
      if (it.gone != null && t >= it.gone) continue;
      if (it.paneFrom != null && t < it.paneFrom) continue;
      for (const ln of it.lines(t)) lines.push(ln);
    }
    let y = 0;
    for (const ln of lines) { ln.y = y; y += ln.h; }
    return { lines, total: y, scroll: Math.max(0, y - M.rows) };
  }

  /** Screen top of a layout row coordinate. */
  const top = (L, y) => M.y0 + (y - L.scroll) * M.lh;

  /**
   * Draw the pane at t. opt.dim (0..1) dims everything (choruses, bridge); opt.hideCards
   * hides cards (a chorus draws the card itself); opt.highlight(row, now) for card rows;
   * opt.bh: the black hole's state (its rows(i, {cx, cy}) transform) while it runs.
   * Returns { cursor: { x, rowTop, act, band } | null, layout }.
   */
  function draw(ctx, t, opt = {}) {
    const L = layout(t);
    const secDim = opt.dim || 0;
    const pulling = opt.bh && t >= C.cA && t < C.gone;
    ctx.save();
    if (!pulling) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(0, M.y0 - M.lh * 0.25, M.W, M.rows * M.lh + M.lh * 0.25); ctx.clip(); }
    const vis = L.lines.filter((ln) => ln.y + ln.h > L.scroll - 0.01 && ln.y < L.scroll + M.rows);
    let i = 0;
    for (const ln of vis) {
      const st = top(L, ln.y);
      const age = L.total - (ln.y + ln.h);
      const ageDim = clamp((age - 2.5) / 14) * 0.5;
      const dim = 1 - (1 - ageDim) * (1 - secDim);
      if (ln.card && opt.hideCards) continue;
      if (pulling && ln.item.precompact) {
        const last = ln.row ? ln.row.cells.at(-1).col + 1 : M.cols;
        const w = last * M.cw;
        const T = opt.bh.rows(i++, { cx: M.x0 + w / 2, cy: st + M.lh / 2 });
        if (T) {
          if (T.alpha <= 0.002) continue;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha *= T.alpha;
          ctx.translate(T.cx, T.cy); ctx.rotate(T.rot); ctx.transform(1, 0, T.shear, 1, 0, 0); ctx.scale(T.sx, T.sy);
          ctx.translate(-w / 2, -M.lh / 2);
          ln.draw(ctx, 0, 0, t, { dim: Math.max(dim, 0.3) });
          ctx.restore();
          continue;
        }
      }
      ln.draw(ctx, M.x0, st, t, { dim, highlight: opt.highlight, alpha: opt.alpha });
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // the black hole: the summary card at the top of the pane is the gravity well
    if (t >= C.cA && t < C.gone && TR.card1) {
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
      ctx.fillRect(M.x0 - M.cw * 1.5, M.y0 - M.lh * 0.25, M.cols * M.cw + M.cw * 3, M.lh * 0.75);
      TR.card1.drawAt(ctx, M.x0, M.y0, t, { h: TR.card1.fullH(t) });
    }
    let cursor = cursorOf(L, t);
    if (cursor && cursor.item.precompact && t >= C.cA) cursor = { ...cursor, hidden: true };
    return { cursor, layout: L };
  }

  function cursorOf(L, t) {
    let best = null;
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const ln of L.lines) {
      if (seen.has(ln.item)) continue;
      seen.add(ln.item);
      const c = ln.item.cursor?.(t);
      if (c && (!best || c.act >= best.c.act)) best = { c, item: ln.item };
    }
    if (!best) return null;
    const ln = L.lines.find((x) => x.item === best.item && x.k === best.c.line) || L.lines.find((x) => x.item === best.item);
    if (!ln) return null;
    const rowTop = top(L, ln.y + (best.c.yOff || 0));
    if (rowTop < M.y0 - M.lh * 0.5 || rowTop > M.paneBottom) return null;
    const it = best.item;
    const cells = it.kind === 'card' ? it.rows[best.c.cardRow]?.cells : it.rows?.[best.c.line]?.cells;
    const lastCol = cells && cells.length ? cells.at(-1).col + 1 : best.c.col;
    return { x: M.colX(best.c.col), rowTop, act: best.c.act, col: best.c.col, item: it, band: { x0: M.x0, x1: M.colX(lastCol), y0: rowTop, y1: rowTop + M.lh } };
  }

  /** The rows on screen at t, with their screen tops (the bridge's ghost of the old scrollback). */
  function snapshot(t) {
    const L = layout(t);
    return L.lines.filter((ln) => ln.y + ln.h > L.scroll && ln.y < L.scroll + M.rows && ln.item.precompact)
      .map((ln) => ({ ln, top: top(L, ln.y) }));
  }

  /** The card's mouth during the black hole: the middle of card 1's bottom edge, at full height. */
  function mouth() {
    const h = TR.card1.fullH(C.cA + 0.5);
    return { x: M.x0 - M.cw * 0.5 + (M.cols * M.cw) / 2, y: M.y0 + M.lh * 0.5 + (h - 0.5) * M.lh - M.lh * 0.25 };
  }

  return { layout, draw, snapshot, mouth };
}
EOF
