S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jalex-projects-clawdpop/ca2089be-6e29-4607-84a4-ba095fc3fca1/scratchpad; cat > $S/actor_part.js <<'EOF'

// =====================================================================================
// The actor (ACTING.md): Clawd in the song. A fixed spot per section with the eyes on the
// cursor; walks only for the beats, each one look (a beat early), lean, go, overshoot, settle;
// faces from the emotional arc, changing on blinks and held at least a beat; the idle layer
// whenever it stands; and the set pieces (setpieces.js) dropped in on their own local time.
// state(t, L, cursor) -> drawClawd options (+ box), a pure function of song time.
// =====================================================================================

export function makeActor(env) {
  const { A, M, B, TR } = env;
  const beat = B.beatDur, bar = B.barDur;
  const U = M.clawd.u, HW = 5 * U, GAP = 0.8 * U;
  const FLOOR = M.statusTop - 4;
  const textRight = M.x0 + M.cols * M.cw;
  const SPOT = Math.min(M.W - 7.3 * U, textRight + 7.2 * U);   // the right margin: clear of every column
  const RIGHT = M.W - 6.3 * U;                                  // a step further back
  const groundOf = (top) => M.baseline(top) + 3;
  const lineTop = (L, ln) => M.y0 + (ln.y - L.scroll) * M.lh;
  const byId = new Map(TR.items.map((it) => [it.id, it]));
  const I = A.intro, V = A.v1, W2 = A.v2, C = A.compact, br = A.br, v3 = A.v3, fin = A.fin;
  const wp = windowPlan(env), bp = env.bridge.plan;
  const FALL = { x: SPOT, y: FLOOR };
  const W = M.W;
  const likeAt = fin.pick && seq(fin.pick, 'like the break', { quiet: true }) ? fin.pick.words[seq(fin.pick, 'like the break').a].start : null;

  // ---- targets, resolved every frame against the pane's layout ------------------------------
  function rowOf(L, it, k = null) {
    const lines = L.lines.filter((l) => l.item === it);
    if (!lines.length) return null;
    return (k != null && lines.find((l) => l.k === k)) || lines.at(-1);
  }
  function R(tg, t, L) {
    switch (tg.type) {
      case 'abs': return { x: tg.x, y: tg.y };
      case 'floor': return { x: tg.x, y: FLOOR };
      case 'seat': return { x: tg.x, y: (tg.y ?? FLOOR) - 0.6 * U };
      case 'tap0': {
        const ln = TR.introCard && rowOf(L, TR.introCard);
        if (!ln) return FALL;
        const a = -0.7, tipX = M.colX(2 + '[summary: 8 sections]'.length) + 6;
        return { x: tipX + 4.9 * U + 2.2 * U * Math.cos(a), y: groundOf(lineTop(L, ln) + M.lh) };
      }
      case 'prompt0': {
        const ln = L.lines.find((l) => l.item.id === 'prompt0');
        return ln ? { x: SPOT, y: FLOOR } : FALL;
      }
      case 'git': {
        const ln = rowOf(L, byId.get('v1-git'));
        if (!ln) return FALL;
        const a = 0.5, tipX = M.x0 + M.cw * 24.8;
        return { x: tipX + 4.9 * U + 2.2 * U * Math.cos(a), y: groundOf(lineTop(L, ln) + 2 * M.lh) };
      }
      case 'del': {
        const it = byId.get(tg.id), ln = it && rowOf(L, it);
        if (!ln) return { x: M.colX(2) + 7.1 * U - 6, y: FLOOR };
        const live = ln.row.cells.filter((c) => c.col > 0 && !(c.t1 != null && c.t1 <= t));
        const col = live.length ? live.at(-1).col + 1 : 2;
        return { x: M.colX(col) + 7.1 * U - 6, y: groundOf(lineTop(L, ln)) };
      }
      case 'endx': {
        const ln = rowOf(L, byId.get(tg.id));
        if (!ln) return tg.fallback || FALL;
        return { x: Math.min(W - HW - U, M.colX(ln.row.cells.at(-1).col + 1) + GAP + HW), y: groundOf(lineTop(L, ln)) };
      }
      case 'card': {
        const f = env.chorus.cardFrame(t);
        return f ? { x: Math.min(W - HW - U, Math.max(f.x1 + 0.6 * U, f.headRight + HW + 0.6 * U)), y: f.y } : FALL;
      }
      case 'center': return { x: W / 2, y: M.portrait ? 1150 : 700 };
      case 'prompt': {
        const x = env.chorus.C[tg.idx];
        return x ? { x: M.colX(3) + GAP + HW, y: groundOf(env.chorus.promptTop(x)) } : FALL;
      }
      case 'bk': {
        const b = bp.bracket, a = 0.45;
        return { x: (tg.end ? b.xR : b.xL) - 4.9 * U - 2.2 * U * Math.cos(a), y: b.y + 4.7 * U + 2.2 * U * Math.sin(a) };
      }
      case 'tl': return { x: bp.tl.yr(tg.v) + (tg.dx || 0), y: bp.tl.axisY - (tg.sit ? 0.6 * U : 0) };
      case 'card2edge': {
        const ln = TR.card2 && rowOf(L, TR.card2);
        if (!ln) return FALL;
        return { x: Math.min(W - HW - U, textRight + GAP + HW), y: lineTop(L, ln) + (ln.h - 0.2) * M.lh };
      }
      case 'winrun': return wp ? { x: wp.runX(tg.k), y: wp.runY } : FALL;
      case 'bhLand': return { x: BHL.mid.x, y: FLOOR };
      default: return FALL;
    }
  }

  // ---- the stations: where Clawd is, and every move it makes ---------------------------------
  // go(arrival, target, { kind: walk | hop | climb | sprint, dur, pose, ease, look, settle })
  const S = [];
  const go = (t, tg, o = {}) => { if (t != null && isFinite(t)) S.push({ t, tg, kind: o.kind || 'walk', dur: o.dur ?? 0.5, pose: o.pose || 'stand', ease: o.ease || null, look: o.look ?? true, settle: o.settle ?? true }); };
  const introX = M.x0 + (M.cols * M.cw) / 2;
  const item = (id) => byId.get(id);
  // intro: in from the right on the status line (slowly), stops under the card; climbs to tap the
  // collapsed summary line (the prompt appears on the tap); then down to the verse spot
  go(I.walkFrom, { type: 'abs', x: W + 8 * U, y: FLOOR }, { dur: 0, look: false, settle: false });
  go(I.walkFrom + 2 * bar, { type: 'floor', x: introX }, { dur: 2 * bar, look: false });
  go(I.tapAt - 0.15, { type: 'tap0' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: Math.max(0.6, I.tapAt - 0.15 - I.climbFrom) });
  go(I.tapAt + 1.55, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.85 });
  // verse 1: the half step back from the red line; the stray branch; aside for the user's lines
  const red = item('v1-timeout');
  if (red) go(red.at + 0.35, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT + 0.6 * U }, { dur: 0.25, look: false });
  if (item('v1-git')) {
    go(V.snipAt - 0.03, { type: 'git' }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.75 });
    go(V.snipAt + 1.5, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.8 });
  }
  const u1 = item('v1-u1');
  if (u1) go(u1.at + 0.45, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT + 0.7 * U }, { dur: 0.3 });
  // the choruses: a step back as the header types; onto the card's corner; down when it folds
  const ch = A.chorus;
  ch.forEach((c, idx) => {
    if (!c.lines.length || c.start == null) return;
    if (idx === 0) {
      go(c.start + 0.6, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { dur: 0.35 });
      const but = c.notes ? at(c.notes, 'but', c.notesAt + bar) : c.notesAt + bar;
      go(but + 1.65, { type: 'card' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 1.1, pose: 'sit' });
      if (c.pickAt != null) go(c.pickAt + 2 * beat, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 2 * beat });
    } else if (idx === 1) {
      go(C.end + 0.001, { type: 'bhLand' }, { dur: 0, look: false, settle: false });
      go(c.takeover + 0.8 + 1.1, { type: 'card' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 1.1, pose: 'sit' });
      if (c.pickAt != null) go(c.pickAt + 2 * beat, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 2 * beat });
    } else {
      go(c.start + 1.5, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.8 });
      if (fin.imAt != null) go(fin.imAt - 0.02, { type: 'center' }, { kind: 'sprint', dur: 0.36 });
    }
  });
  // verse 2: the spot; the windows (one walk, a tap on each beat); the backspace; the transcript
  go(W2.start + 0.4, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT }, { dur: 0.3 });
  if (wp) {
    go(wp.close0 - 0.02, { type: 'winrun', k: 0 }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.55 });
    go(wp.close0 + 8 * beat, { type: 'winrun', k: 8 }, { dur: 8 * beat, ease: 'linear', look: false, settle: true });
    go(wp.close0 + 8 * beat + 2.4, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 1.5 });
  }
  const like = item('v2-like');
  if (like && like.del) {
    go(like.del.from + 0.05, { type: 'del', id: 'v2-like', next: 'v2-reminisce' }, { dur: 0.75 });
    go(like.del.end + 0.9, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.75 });
  }
  const jl = item('v2-jsonl');
  if (jl && W2.wallOpen != null) go(W2.wallOpen - 0.15, { type: 'endx', id: 'v2-jsonl' }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.75 });
  // bridge: by the baby; up to the swallowed block and the bracket; the timeline; sits at 3
  if (bp && br.start != null) {
    go(br.start + 0.6, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { dur: 0.3 });
    if (br.babyIn != null) go(br.babyIn + 0.8, { type: 'seat', x: RIGHT }, { dur: 0.4, pose: 'sit' });
    go(bp.bracket.from, { type: 'bk', end: false }, { kind: 'climb', dur: Math.max(0.6, bp.bracket.from - (br.writtenAt ?? bp.bracket.from - 1) - 0.55) });
    go(bp.bracket.to, { type: 'bk', end: true }, { dur: bp.bracket.to - bp.bracket.from, ease: 'linear', look: false });
    if (br.tlAt != null) go(br.tlAt - 0.1, { type: 'tl', v: 0, dx: 0.3 * U }, { dur: 2.6 });
    if (br.firstOne != null && br.three != null) go(br.three + 0.05, { type: 'tl', v: 3, dx: HW + 0.2 * U }, { dur: Math.max(0.6, br.three + 0.05 - br.firstOne), ease: 'linear', look: false });
    if (br.mineAt != null) go(br.mineAt + 0.45, { type: 'tl', v: 3, dx: HW + 0.2 * U, sit: true }, { dur: 0.35, pose: 'sit', look: false });
  }
  // verse 3: at the second card's right edge, typing it
  if (v3.cardAt != null && TR.card2) go(v3.start + 0.9, { type: 'card2edge' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 1.1 });
  S.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
  for (let i = 0; i < S.length; i++) {
    const s = S[i], prev = S[i - 1];
    s.start = s.t - s.dur;
    if (prev && s.start < prev.t) { s.start = prev.t; if (s.t - s.start < 0.12) s.t = s.start + 0.12; }
  }

  // ---- the set pieces ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // the black hole: its zero beat on cA; it finds Clawd where it stands (on the transcript row)
  const bhLt = (t) => t - C.cA + BH.zero * beat;
  const BHL = { beat, u: U, floor: FLOOR, mouth: env.pane.mouth(), statusTop: M.statusTop, spot: { x: SPOT }, mid: { x: Math.min(SPOT - 14 * U, M.x0 + M.cols * M.cw * 0.62) } };
  {
    const t0 = C.cA - 0.02, L0 = env.pane.layout(t0);
    const p = stationPos(t0, L0);
    BHL.startX = p.x; BHL.startY = p.y; BHL.spot.x = p.x;
  }
  // the lift: from the centre, on "I'll pick it up"
  const liftPrompt = fin.lines.length ? env.chorus.C[2] : null;
  const LFL = liftPrompt ? {
    beat, u: U, floor: FLOOR, spot: { x: W / 2 }, startY: M.portrait ? 1150 : 700,
    cardX: Math.min(W - 280, W / 2 + 340), cardW: 440, cardH: 104,
    prompt: { x: M.x0, top: env.chorus.promptTop(liftPrompt) }, setX: M.x0 + 4 * M.cw,
  } : null;
  const liftEnd = fin.pickAt != null ? fin.pickAt + LF.end * beat : null;
  if (LFL && liftEnd != null) {
    const end = lift(LF.end * beat, LFL).clawd;
    go(liftEnd, { type: 'abs', x: end.x, y: FLOOR }, { dur: 0, look: false, settle: false });
    S.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
    for (let i = 0; i < S.length; i++) { const s = S[i], prev = S[i - 1]; s.start = s.t - s.dur; if (prev && s.start < prev.t) { s.start = prev.t; if (s.t - s.start < 0.12) s.t = s.start + 0.12; } }
  }

  function stationPos(t, L) {
    const i = Math.max(0, bisect(S, t, (s) => s.start));
    const s = S[i], prev = S[i - 1];
    if (prev && t < s.t) {
      const k = clamp((t - s.start) / Math.max(1e-6, s.t - s.start));
      const e = s.ease === 'linear' ? k : ease.inOutQuad(k);
      const a = R(prev.tg, t, L), b = R(s.tg, t, L);
      return { x: lerp(a.x, b.x, e), y: lerp(a.y, b.y, e), moving: true, k, a, b, s, i };
    }
    return { ...R(s.tg, t, L), moving: false, s, i };
  }

  // ---- the emotional arc: [{ t, face, look?, glyph?, noBlink? }] from lyric anchors -------------
  const arc = [];
  const face = (t, f, o = {}) => { if (t != null && isFinite(t)) arc.push({ t, face: f, ...o }); };
  const word = (line, text, fb = null) => (line ? at(line, text, fb ?? line.start) : fb);
  face(0, 'dizzy');
  face(I.walkFrom + bar, 'confused');
  face(I.cardAt, 'thinking');
  face(I.climbFrom - 0.05, 'determined', { slow: true });
  face(I.tapAt + 0.6, 'neutral');
  // verse 1
  face(V.flashAt + 0.05, 'surprised', { look: [-0.8, 1] });
  if (V.fifteen) { face(word(V.fifteen, 'no idea'), 'relieved'); face(word(V.fifteen, 'thinking'), 'confused'); face(word(V.fifteen, 'thinking') + 1.1, 'neutral'); }
  if (V.primary) { const ok = word(V.primary, 'Okay'); face(ok + 0.02, 'smug'); face(ok + 0.02 + beat * 1.1, 'neutral'); }
  if (red) face(red.at + 0.05, 'nervous');
  if (item('v1-git')) { face(Math.max(V.strayAt, (red?.at ?? 0) + 0.6), 'determined'); face(V.snipAt + 0.3, 'relieved'); face(V.snipAt + 1.6, 'neutral'); }
  if (u1) face(u1.at + 0.5, 'happy');
  // chorus 1
  const c1 = A.ch1;
  if (c1.lines.length) {
    face(c1.start + 0.1, 'determined');
    if (c1.notes) { face(c1.notes.words[0].start, 'sad', { look: [0, 1] }); face(word(c1.notes, 'but'), 'hopeful'); }
    face(word(c1.notes, 'but') + 1.75, 'happy');
    if (c1.pickAt != null) { face(c1.pickAt + 0.02, 'determined'); face(c1.pickAt + 2 * beat + 0.4, 'neutral'); }
  }
  // verse 2
  if (wp) { face(wp.spawn + 0.02, 'nervous'); face(wp.close0 - 1.1, 'determined'); face(wp.close0 + 8 * beat + 0.35, 'relieved'); face(wp.close0 + 8 * beat + 2.6, 'neutral'); }
  if (W2.loses) {
    face(W2.loses.words[0].start, 'sad', { look: [-1, 0.6] });
    const joke = word(W2.loses, 'The joke');
    face(joke + 0.02, 'laugh'); face(joke + 0.02 + beat * 1.05, 'sad', { look: [-1, 0.6] });
  }
  if (W2.cute) { const c = word(W2.cute, 'the baby is'); face(c + 0.02, 'laugh'); face(c + 0.02 + beat * 1.05, 'neutral'); }
  if (W2.like) face(W2.like.words[0].start, 'sad', { look: [-1, 0.5] });
  if (W2.bottom) face(word(W2.bottom, 'read the full'), 'thinking', { look: [-0.8, 0.8] });
  if (W2.wallOpen != null) { face(W2.wallOpen + 0.12, 'scared'); face(W2.wallClose + 0.15, 'relieved'); }
  if (W2.shrugAt != null) face(W2.shrugAt, 'neutral');
  // (the black hole has its own faces: scared, surprised, dizzy, determined)
  // chorus 2: chorus 1 with a relieved tint
  const c2 = A.ch2;
  if (c2.lines.length) {
    face(c2.takeover + 0.8 + 1.15, 'relieved');
    if (c2.pickAt != null) { face(c2.pickAt + 0.02, 'determined'); face(c2.pickAt + 2 * beat + 0.4, 'neutral'); }
  }
  // bridge
  if (br.babyIn != null) face(br.babyIn + 0.3, 'happy', { look: [-1, 0.35] });
  if (br.spGone != null) face(br.spGone + 0.02, 'sad', { look: [-1, 0.8] });
  if (br.writtenAt != null) { face(br.writtenAt, 'idea'); face(br.writtenAt + 0.6, 'determined'); }
  if (br.tlAt != null) face(br.tlAt - 2.7, 'thinking', { look: [0, 0.9] });
  if (br.three != null) face(br.three + 0.02, 'hopeful');
  if (br.toldAt != null) face(br.toldAt + 0.04, 'happy', { look: [-1, 0.4] });
  if (br.mineAt != null) face(br.mineAt + 0.05, 'proud');
  // verse 3
  if (v3.cardAt != null) {
    face(v3.cardAt, 'determined');
    if (v3.too) { face(v3.too.words[0].start, 'determined', { glyph: { ch: '...', color: 'dim', anim: 'dots' }, noBlink: true }); face(lastWord(v3.too).end + 0.2, 'determined', { noBlink: true }); }
    if (v3.future) face(word(v3.future, 'full steam'), 'excited');
    if (v3.enough) face(v3.enough.words[0].start, 'relieved');
    if (v3.shape) { face(v3.shape.words[0].start, 'thinking'); face(word(v3.shape, 'The shape of it'), 'happy'); }
  }
  // final
  if (fin.lines.length) {
    face(fin.start + 0.1, 'determined');
    if (fin.notes) { face(fin.notes.words[0].start, 'sad', { look: [0, 1] }); face(word(fin.notes, 'but'), 'hopeful'); }
    if (fin.here) face(fin.here.words[0].start, 'happy');
    if (fin.imAt != null) face(fin.imAt, 'hopeful', { look: [0, -0.35] });
  }
  arc.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
  // set-piece windows (their own faces, and the arc's rules do not apply inside)
  const pieces = [
    { name: 'transcript wall', a: W2.wallOpen ?? Infinity, b: (W2.shrugAt ?? Infinity) },
    { name: 'black hole', a: C.cA, b: C.end },
    { name: "I'm here", a: (fin.imAt ?? Infinity) - 0.4, b: fin.pickAt ?? Infinity },
    { name: 'lift', a: fin.pickAt ?? Infinity, b: liftEnd ?? Infinity },
  ];
  const inPiece = (t) => pieces.find((p) => t >= p.a && t < p.b) || null;
  const slowBlinks = arc.filter((e) => e.slow).map((e) => e.t).concat(fin.imAt != null ? [fin.imAt + 0.55] : []);
  const quiet = [I.cardDone, I.collapseAt + 0.1];

  // ---- gestures ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const bump = (t, a, w) => Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(t - a) / w);
  const strikes = TR.items.filter((it) => it.strikeAt != null);
  const nods = TR.items.filter((it) => it.gutterCh === '✓').map((it) => it.at);
  const heads = (t) => clamp(Math.floor((t - I.headsAt) / I.headStep) + 1, 0, 8);

  function state(t, L, cursor) {
    // the set pieces own Clawd while they run
    if (t >= C.cA && t < C.end) {
      const S2 = blackHole(bhLt(t), BHL);
      env.bh = S2;
      return finish({ ...S2.clawd, smear: S2.smear });
    }
    if (LFL && fin.pickAt != null && t >= fin.pickAt && t < liftEnd) {
      const S3 = lift(t - fin.pickAt, LFL);
      env.lift = S3;
      return finish({ ...S3.clawd });
    }
    if (!S.length || t < S[0].start) return null;
    const p = stationPos(t, L);
    const s = p.s;
    const st = { x: p.x, y: p.y, u: U, view: 'front', dir: 1, pose: s.pose, legs: null, lean: 0, squash: 0, t, look: null };
    if (p.moving) {
      const dir = Math.sign(p.b.x - p.a.x) || (p.b.y < p.a.y ? 1 : -1);
      st.dir = dir; st.pose = 'stand';
      if (s.kind === 'hop') st.y -= (0.9 * U + Math.abs(p.b.y - p.a.y) * 0.12) * 4 * p.k * (1 - p.k);
      if (s.kind === 'walk' || s.kind === 'sprint' || s.kind === 'hop') { st.view = 'side'; st.legs = (t - s.start) / (beat / 2) * (s.kind === 'sprint' ? 2 : 1); st.lean = dir * (s.kind === 'sprint' ? 0.09 : 0.05); }
      if (s.kind === 'climb') { const sw = Math.sin(((t - s.start) / (beat / 2)) * Math.PI); st.nubs = [0.4 + 0.5 * sw, 0.4 - 0.5 * sw]; st.look = [dir * 0.3, -0.7]; }
      if (s.kind === 'sprint') st.smear = { k: 1, vertical: false, dir };
      if (!st.look) st.look = [dir, 0.1];
      st.walking = true;
    } else {
      // arrived: a small overshoot and settle, a two-frame bounce
      const since = t - s.t, prevS = S[p.i - 1];
      if (s.settle && prevS && since < 0.3 && since >= 0) {
        const dir = Math.sign(R(s.tg, t, L).x - R(prevS.tg, t, L).x) || 0;
        st.x += dir * 0.35 * U * Math.exp(-since / 0.07) * Math.sin(Math.min(Math.PI, (since / 0.15) * Math.PI)) * (since < 0.15 ? 1 : 0);
        if (since < 0.07) st.squash = 0.035;
      }
      // the look, a beat before the next move, then the lean into it
      const nx = S[p.i + 1];
      if (nx && nx.look && t >= nx.start - beat && t < nx.start) {
        const b2 = R(nx.tg, t, L), dir = Math.sign(b2.x - st.x) || 0;
        st.look = [dir || 0, b2.y < st.y - 30 ? -0.7 : b2.y > st.y + 30 ? 0.7 : 0.1];
        if (t >= nx.start - 0.2) st.lean = dir * 0.07 * smooth((t - (nx.start - 0.2)) / 0.2);
        st.walking = true;
      }
    }
    // the face
    const fa = faceAt(arc, t);
    const entry = arc[Math.max(0, bisect(arc, t, (e) => e.t))] || {};
    st.face = fa.face; st.faceT = fa.faceT; st.prevFace = fa.prevFace; st.poseK = fa.poseK; st.blink = fa.blink;
    if (entry.glyph !== undefined && t >= entry.t) st.glyph = entry.glyph;
    if (!st.look && entry.look && t >= entry.t) st.look = entry.look;
    // eyes on the cursor when nothing else holds them
    if (!st.look && cursor && !cursor.hidden) {
      const fy = st.y - 7 * U;
      st.look = [clamp((cursor.x - st.x) / (W * 0.45), -1, 1), clamp((cursor.rowTop - fy) / (M.H * 0.4) + 0.4, -1, 1)];
    }
    // intro: reading the card line by line as the headings appear (held still through the quiet span)
    if (t >= I.cardAt && t < I.collapseAt + 0.1) { st.look = [clamp((introX - st.x) / 500, -1, 1), -1 + 0.6 * (heads(t) / 8)]; }
    const frozen = t >= quiet[0] && t < quiet[1];
    if (frozen) st.faceT = Math.min(st.faceT, quiet[0] - I.cardAt);
    // slow blinks (the intro's, before determined; "I'm here")
    for (const sb of slowBlinks) { const d = t - sb; if (d > -0.18 && d < 0.18) st.blink = Math.max(st.blink, 1 - Math.abs(d) / 0.18); }
    // gestures
    if (Math.abs(t - I.tapAt) < 0.4) { const b2 = bump(t, I.tapAt, 0.35); st.nubs = [-0.1 - 0.6 * b2, -0.45]; st.look = [-1, 0.6]; }
    if (t >= I.tapAt + 0.25 && t < I.tapAt + 0.6) st.lean += 0.06 * Math.sin(((t - I.tapAt - 0.25) / 0.35) * Math.PI);   // a tiny nod
    if (item('v1-git') && Math.abs(t - V.snipAt) < 0.35) { const b2 = bump(t, V.snipAt, 0.35); st.nubs = [-0.3 + 0.8 * b2, -0.45]; st.look = [-1, -0.8]; }
    for (const n of nods) if (t >= n && t < n + 0.25) st.lean += 0.05 * Math.sin(((t - n) / 0.25) * Math.PI);
    if (wp) for (const w of wp.items) if (Math.abs(t - w.off) < 0.2) { const b2 = bump(t, w.off, 0.2); st.nubs = [-0.3 + 1.4 * b2, -0.45]; st.look = [-0.6, -1]; }
    for (const it of strikes) {
      const a = it.strikeAt - 0.1, b2 = it.strikeAt + it.strikeDur * 1.6;
      if (t >= a && t < b2) { const q2 = clamp((t - a) / (b2 - a)); st.nubs = [lerp(-0.45, 0.25, Math.sin(q2 * Math.PI)), -0.45]; st.look = [-1, 0.7]; }   // slow, reluctant
    }
    if (like && like.del && t >= like.del.from + 0.2 && t < like.del.to) {
      const tugs = like.rows[0].cells.map((c) => c.t1).filter((x) => x != null && x <= t);
      const lastTug = tugs.length ? Math.max(...tugs) : like.del.from;
      st.nubs = [0.05 - 0.25 * Math.exp(-(t - lastTug) / 0.08), -0.45]; st.look = [-1, 0.6]; st.lean -= 0.03;
    }
    if (W2.wallOpen != null) {
      for (const tap of [W2.wallOpen, W2.wallClose]) if (Math.abs(t - tap) < 0.3) { const b2 = bump(t, tap, 0.28); st.nubs = [-0.2 - 0.5 * b2, -0.45]; st.look = [-1, 0.6]; }
      if (t >= W2.wallOpen + 0.12 && t < W2.wallClose - 0.2) {
        const k = smooth((t - W2.wallOpen - 0.12) / 0.3);
        st.lean -= 0.08 * k; st.x += 0.6 * U * clamp((t - W2.wallOpen) / (W2.wallClose - W2.wallOpen));   // leaning back, a foot sliding
        st.look = [-0.6, -0.4];
      }
      if (W2.shrugAt != null && t >= W2.shrugAt && t < W2.shrugAt + beat * 1.5) st.nubs = NUBS.shrug;
    }
    for (const c of A.chorus) {
      if (!c.hl.length || st.pose !== 'sit' || t >= (c.pickAt ?? Infinity) || t < c.hl[0]) continue;
      const on = c.hl.filter((h) => h <= t).at(-1);
      st.nubs = [-0.55 - Math.exp(-(t - on) / 0.18) * 0.25, -1.0]; st.look = [-1, 1];
    }
    if (bp && t >= bp.bracket.from && t < bp.bracket.to + 0.1) { st.nubs = [-0.45, 0.45]; st.look = [1, -0.6]; }
    if (TR.card2 && t >= (v3.start ?? Infinity) && t < (fin.start ?? Infinity) && !p.moving) {
      const c = TR.card2.cursor(t);
      if (c && t - c.act < 0.15) { const w2 = Math.sin(t * 28); st.nubs = [-0.25 + 0.35 * w2, -0.25 - 0.35 * w2]; }
      st.look = [-1, 0.3];
    }
    // idle, whenever it stands (not walking, not looking ahead, still through the quiet span)
    if (!st.walking && !inPiece(t)) {
      const id = idleAt(t, { bar, seed: 3, frozen });
      st.y += id.dy * U; st.breath = id.breath; st.lookOffset = id.look; st.lean += id.lean;
      st.blink = Math.max(st.blink, id.blink);
    }
    return finish(st);
  }
  function finish(st) { st.u = U; st.box = clawdBox(st); return st; }

  function draw(ctx, t, L, cursor, { alpha = 1 } = {}) {
    const st = state(t, L, cursor);
    if (!st) return null;
    // the baby beside it in the bridge, for "the baby in the video"
    if (br.babyIn != null) {
      const a = smooth((t - br.babyIn) / (beat * 1.5)) * (1 - smooth((t - br.babyOut) / (beat * 1.5)));
      if (a > 0) baby(ctx, { x: RIGHT - U * 8.6, y: FLOOR, r: (U * 8.2) / 1.6 / 3.5, alpha: a * alpha, look: [0.5, -0.4] });
    }
    if (st.smear) drawSmear(ctx, st.x, st.y, U, st.smear.dir ?? 1, st.smear.k, st.smear.vertical);
    drawClawd(ctx, { ...st, alpha: (st.alpha ?? 1) * alpha });
    return st;
  }

  return { state, draw, arc, pieces, schedule: S, lift: LFL, liftEnd, bh: BHL };
}

// Verse 2, "the browser windows I left scattered": nine tiny window outlines spawn across the
// pane on "browser windows" (one per sixteenth). Clawd closes them in one continuous walk along
// row 15's baseline (clear of the rows being typed below), right to left, a tap on each beat:
// each window hangs up-left of where Clawd will be on its beat, scattered in height.

import { clamp, smooth, hash } from '../../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL, mix, rgba } from '../term.js';
import { seq } from '../lyr.js';

const cache = new WeakMap();
export function windowPlan(env) {
  if (cache.has(env)) return cache.get(env);
  const { A, M, B } = env;
  const line = A.v2.take;
  const r = line && seq(line, 'browser windows', { quiet: true }), sc = line && seq(line, 'scattered', { quiet: true });
  let plan = null;
  if (r) {
    const beat = B.beatDur, U = M.clawd.u;
    const spawn = B.snap(line.words[r.a].start, 'half');
    // the first tap two beats after "scattered": the look comes a beat before the walk starts
    const close0 = B.snap((sc ? line.words[sc.a].start : spawn + beat * 2) + 2 * beat, 'beat');
    const ww = M.portrait ? 170 : 168, wh = M.portrait ? 110 : 104;
    const runRow = M.portrait ? 26 : 15;
    const runY = M.baseline(M.y0 + runRow * M.lh) + 3;
    const right = M.x0 + M.cols * M.cw - (M.portrait ? 60 : 10);
    const step = M.portrait ? (right - M.x0 - 320) / 8 : 150;
    const runX = (k) => right - k * step;
    const items = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, k) => {
      const cx = runX(k);
      // up-left of Clawd on its beat; heights scattered over three rows above its head
      const lift = (M.portrait ? 2 : 1) * (hash(k, 31) * 3.2 + 0.4) * M.lh;
      const rx = cx - 4.9 * U - 2.2 * U * Math.cos(1.0) - ww + 18, ry = runY - 8.2 * U - wh - lift;
      return { k, rect: { x: rx, y: ry, w: ww, h: wh }, on: spawn + k * beat / 4, off: close0 + k * beat };
    });
    plan = { spawn, close0, items, runX, runY, end: close0 + 8 * beat };
  }
  cache.set(env, plan);
  return plan;
}

export function drawWindows(ctx, env, t) {
  const plan = windowPlan(env);
  if (!plan || t < plan.spawn || t > plan.end + 1) return;
  for (const w of plan.items) {
    if (t < w.on || t >= w.off + 0.14) continue;
    const pop = smooth((t - w.on) / 0.08), shut = smooth((t - w.off) / 0.14);
    const s = (0.82 + 0.18 * pop) * (1 - 0.3 * shut), a = pop * (1 - shut);
    const { x, y, w: ww, h: wh } = w.rect;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha *= a;
    ctx.translate(x + ww / 2, y + wh / 2);
    ctx.scale(s, s);
    ctx.translate(-ww / 2, -wh / 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, ww, wh);
    ctx.strokeStyle = mix(PAL.dim, PAL.text, 0.35); ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, ww, wh);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 20); ctx.lineTo(ww, 20); ctx.stroke();
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) { ctx.fillStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.9); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(12 + d * 12, 10, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(PAL.dim, 0.35);
    ctx.fillRect(14, 36, ww * (0.3 + 0.5 * hash(w.k, 17)), 5);
    ctx.fillRect(14, 50, ww * (0.2 + 0.4 * hash(w.k, 19)), 5);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

// The transcript set piece (verse 2): Clawd taps the .jsonl row and it bursts open into a wall of
// tiny dim text, the session's own lines as JSONL, scrolling past far too fast behind the pane;
// a second tap shuts it and it collapses back into the one row. Drawn behind the scrollback.

import { clamp, smooth, ease, hash } from '../../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL, MONO, mix } from '../term.js';

export function makeWall(env) {
  const { A, M, L } = env;
  const W2 = A.v2;
  if (W2.wallOpen == null) return { draw: () => {} };
  // a million lines of me: the lyric lines as transcript records, in order
  const said = L.lines.map((l) => l.text.replace(/"/g, '\\"'));
  const lines = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) {
    const s = said[i % said.length], k = i % 7;
    lines.push(k === 3 ? `{"type":"tool_use","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"node shared/renderer/scripts/render.mjs --song songs/continued/video"}}`
      : k === 5 ? `{"type":"user","message":{"content":"${said[(i * 7) % said.length]}"}}`
      : `{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"${s}"}]},"uuid":"${(hash(i, 3) * 1e16).toString(16).slice(0, 8)}"}`);
  }
  const fs = 13, lh = 15;
  function draw(ctx, t, row) {
    const a = W2.wallOpen, z = W2.wallClose;
    if (t < a || t > z + 0.4) return;
    const open = ease.outCubic(clamp((t - a) / 0.18)) * (1 - ease.inCubic(clamp((t - z) / 0.3)));
    if (open <= 0) return;
    // it bursts from the row, filling the pane, and folds back into it
    const cy = row ? row.y : M.paneBottom - M.lh;
    const top = cy - (cy - M.y0) * open, bot = cy + (M.paneBottom - cy) * open;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(M.x0 - M.cw, top, M.cols * M.cw + 2 * M.cw, Math.max(1, bot - top)); ctx.clip();
    ctx.font = `400 ${fs}px ${MONO}`; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
    const speed = 2600;   // px a second: far too fast to read
    const off = ((t - a) * speed) % (lines.length * lh);
    ctx.fillStyle = mix(PAL.dim, PAL.bg, 0.25);
    for (let y = top - lh, j = Math.floor((off + top) / lh); y < bot + lh; y += lh, j++) {
      const yy = Math.floor((j * lh - off) - 0) + 0;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
      ctx.fillText(lines[((j % lines.length) + lines.length) % lines.length], M.x0, yy);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  return { draw };
}

      else card = { x: LF2.setX, y: LF2.floor - LF2.cardH, rot: 0 };
      drawLiftCard(ctx, card, LF2, M, smooth((tm - fin.imAt) / 0.5) * (ch.clawdAlpha ?? 1));
    }
    env.actor.draw(ctx, tm, P.layout, cur, { alpha: ch.clawdAlpha ?? 1 });
    drawStatus(ctx, M, st, tm, { alpha: ch.statusAlpha ?? 1 });
    drawVignette(ctx, M);
    if (!cur.hidden && st.cursorOn(tm, cur.act)) drawCursor(ctx, cur.x, cur.rowTop, M, cur.style || {});
  },
};

#!/usr/bin/env node
// The emotional arc (ACTING.md), resolved: every face change with its time and lyric moment, and the
// rules checked: each face held at least a beat; no two changes within half a second outside the
// set pieces (the transcript wall, the black hole, "I'm here", the lift). Exit 2 on a violation.
//   node songs/continued/video/tools/arc.mjs
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const shared = path.resolve(here, '../../../../shared/renderer');
const require = createRequire(path.join(shared, 'package.json'));
const puppeteer = require('puppeteer-core');
const { createServer, listen, REPO } = await import(path.join(shared, 'scripts/serve.mjs'));
const song = path.relative(REPO, path.resolve(here, '..')).split(path.sep).join('/');
const srv = createServer(REPO);
const port = await listen(srv, 0);
const b = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: process.env.CHROME || '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome', headless: true, args: ['--disable-gpu'] });
let bad = 0;
try {
  const p = await b.newPage();
  await p.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/${song}/index.html?render=1&w=480&h=270&fps=30&layout=16x9`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
  await p.waitForFunction('window.__render && window.__render.ready');
  const r = await p.evaluate(() => {
    const E = window.__render.env, A = E.actor, beat = E.B.beatDur;
    const arc = A.arc.map((e) => ({ t: e.t, face: typeof e.face === 'string' ? e.face : 'custom', glyph: !!e.glyph, noBlink: !!e.noBlink }));
    const pieces = A.pieces.map((p) => ({ name: p.name, a: p.a, b: p.b }));
    const lineAt = (t) => { const l = E.L.lines.filter((x) => x.start <= t + 0.05).at(-1); return l ? `${l.section}: ${l.text.slice(0, 48)}` : ''; };
    return { beat, pieces, arc: arc.map((e) => ({ ...e, line: lineAt(e.t) })) };
  });
  const inPiece = (t) => r.pieces.find((p) => t >= p.a - 0.01 && t < p.b + 0.01);
  console.log('[arc] set pieces: ' + r.pieces.map((p) => `${p.name} ${p.a.toFixed(2)}-${p.b.toFixed(2)}`).join(' · '));
  r.arc.forEach((e, i) => {
    const next = r.arc[i + 1];
    const hold = next ? next.t - e.t : Infinity;
    const flags = [];
    if (hold < r.beat - 1e-3 && !inPiece(e.t) && !(next && next.noBlink) && !e.noBlink) flags.push(`HOLD ${hold.toFixed(2)}s < a beat`);
    if (next && hold < 0.5 && !inPiece(e.t) && !inPiece(next.t) && !next.noBlink) flags.push('TWO CHANGES < 0.5s');
    if (flags.length) bad++;
    console.log(`[arc] ${e.t.toFixed(2).padStart(7)}  ${e.face.padEnd(11)}${e.glyph ? ' +glyph' : ''}${e.noBlink ? ' (no blink)' : ''}  hold ${Number.isFinite(hold) ? hold.toFixed(2) : '-'}  ${e.line}${flags.length ? '   <-- ' + flags.join(', ') : ''}`);
  });
  console.log(bad ? `[arc] ${bad} violation(s)` : '[arc] ok: every hold at least a beat, no two changes within 0.5 s outside the set pieces');
} finally { await b.close(); srv.close(); }
process.exit(bad ? 2 : 0);
EOF

  // ---- the context meter ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const C = A.compact, V = A.v1;
  const ch1 = A.ch1, ch2 = A.ch2, fin = A.fin, br = A.br, v3 = A.v3, v2 = A.v2;
  const K = [];
  const keep0 = V.flashEnd + beat;
  K.push([0, FULL], [keep0, FULL]);
  // before the compaction: verse drain r, choruses at 0.4 r plus a 3.0M chunk on their first beat
  {
    const c1s = ch1.start ?? keep0 + 30, c1e = v2.start;
    const zero = C.cA;   // empty when the black hole opens, held through the black pane
    const dur = Math.max(1, c1s - keep0) + 0.4 * Math.max(0, c1e - c1s - beat) + Math.max(1, zero - c1e);
    const r = (FULL - CHUNK1) / dur;
    let v = FULL - r * (c1s - keep0);
    K.push([c1s, v]); v -= CHUNK1; K.push([c1s + beat, v]);
    v -= 0.4 * r * (c1e - c1s - beat); K.push([c1e, v]);
    K.push([zero, 0], [C.refill0, 0]);
  }
  K.push([C.cR, FULL]);
  // after: chorus 2 chunk, a slow bridge, steady verse 3, the final chunk; nearly out by the last tag
  {
    const s2 = Math.max(C.cR, ch2.takeover ?? ch2.start ?? C.cR), bS = br.start ?? s2 + 30, vS = v3.cardAt ?? bS + 30;
    const fS = fin.start ?? vS + 20, fT = fin.tagAt ?? fS + 20;
    const LOW = 0.6e6;
    const w = 0.4 * Math.max(0, bS - s2 - beat) + 0.25 * Math.max(0, vS - bS) + Math.max(0, fS - vS) + 0.4 * Math.max(0, fT - fS - beat);
    const r = (FULL - LOW - CHUNK2 - CHUNK3) / Math.max(1, w);
    let v = FULL;
    K.push([s2, v]); v -= CHUNK2; K.push([s2 + beat, v]);
    v -= 0.4 * r * (bS - s2 - beat); K.push([bS, v]);
    v -= 0.25 * r * (vS - bS); K.push([vS, v]);
    v -= r * (fS - vS); K.push([fS, v]); v -= CHUNK3; K.push([fS + beat, v]);
    K.push([fT, LOW]);
    K.push([env.duration + 10, LOW]);
  }
  K.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
  const curve = (t) => {
    const i = Math.max(0, bisect(K, t, (k) => k[0]));
    const a = K[i], b = K[i + 1] || a;
    return b === a ? a[1] : lerp(a[1], b[1], clamp((t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])));
  };
  /** Tokens left as the status line shows them: ticks on the beat; continuous through the refill. */
  function tokens(t) {
    if (t >= C.refill0 && t < C.cR) return curve(t);
    const bt = B.beatTime(Math.floor(B.beatIndex(t) + 1e-6));
    return Math.max(0, curve(Math.max(bt, 0)));
  }
  // The meter's only events: a slow breath (dim grey to amber and back over about two seconds)
  // each time the reading crosses a whole million on its way down, and a longer one through the
  // compaction's refill. The crossings are found on the beat grid the reading ticks on.
  const crossings = [];
  {
    let prevV = null;
    const n = Math.ceil(B.beatIndex(env.duration));
    for (let bi = 0; bi <= n; bi++) {
      const tb = B.beatTime(bi);
      if (tb >= C.cA && tb < C.cR) { prevV = null; continue; }
      const v = Math.max(0, curve(Math.max(tb, 0)));
      if (prevV != null && Math.floor(v / 1e6 + 1e-9) < Math.floor(prevV / 1e6 + 1e-9)) crossings.push(tb);
      prevV = v;
    }
  }
  const breath = (d, attack, hold, decay) => (d < 0 ? 0 : smooth(d / attack) * (1 - smooth((d - attack - hold) / decay)));
  function flash(t) {
    const i = bisect(crossings, t);
    let g = 0;
    for (const j of [i, i - 1]) if (j >= 0) g = Math.max(g, breath(t - crossings[j], 0.35, 0, 1.9));
    g = Math.max(g, breath(t - C.refill0, 0.45, C.cR - C.refill0, 3.0));
    return g;
  }

  // ---- the clock ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const BASE = 2 * 3600 + 47 * 60 + 5;   // 02:47:05 when the session wakes
  // the transcript wall: the clock spins while it is open (six hours a second), then snaps back

const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const song = argv.includes('--song') ? argv[argv.indexOf('--song') + 1] : 'songs/2am-crying/video';
const qs = argv.flatMap((a, i) => (a === '--q' ? [argv[i + 1]] : []));
const shots = argv.includes('--shots') ? argv[argv.indexOf('--shots') + 1] : null;
const srv = createServer(REPO);
const port = await listen(srv, 0);
const b = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: process.env.CHROME || '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome', headless: true, defaultViewport: { width: 1280, height: 1000 } });
let bad = 0;
for (const q of qs.length ? qs : ['t=0']) {
  const p = await b.newPage();
  const errs = [];
  p.on('pageerror', (e) => errs.push(String(e)));
  p.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error' && !/favicon|404/.test(m.text())) errs.push(m.text()); });
  await p.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/${song}/index.html?${q}`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
  await p.waitForFunction('window.__preview || (window.__render && window.__render.error)', { timeout: 30000 });
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));
  const info = await p.evaluate(() => ({ err: document.getElementById('pv-err')?.textContent || '', bar: [...document.querySelectorAll('.pv-bar span')].map((s) => s.textContent).join(' | ') }));
  if (info.err || errs.length) bad++;
  console.log(`[smoke] ${q}: ${info.bar}${info.err ? '\n  RENDER ERROR: ' + info.err : ''}${errs.length ? '\n  ' + errs.join('\n  ') : ''}`);
  if (shots) { fs.mkdirSync(shots, { recursive: true }); await p.screenshot({ path: path.join(shots, `preview-${q.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '_')}.png`) }); }
  await p.close();
}
await b.close();
srv.close();
process.exit(bad ? 1 : 0);

  function current(t) {
    for (const x of C) if (x && t >= x.c.start - beat * 0.5 && t < x.next) return x;
    return null;
  }

  function state(t) {
    const x = current(t);
    if (!x) return { paneDim: 0, hideCards: false, x: null };
    const aIn = smooth((t - (x.c.start - beat * 0.5)) / beat);
    const aOut = 1 - smooth((t - (x.next - beat * 1.1)) / beat);
    const a = aIn * aOut;
    // chorus 2: the header and Clawd's lines type over the black hole; the pane and the card are
    // only taken over once it is done (takeover)
    const over = t >= (x.c.takeover ?? x.c.start) ? smooth((t - (x.c.takeover ?? x.c.start)) / beat) : 0;
    const s = { x, a, paneDim: 0.86 * a * over, hideCards: a > 0.02 && over > 0.02, statusAlpha: 1, clawdAlpha: 1, fade: 0, over };
    // chorus 2 before the takeover: the swallowed card waits at the pane top, dimmed under the header
    if (x.idx === 1 && over < 1 && t >= env.A.compact.gone) s.paneDim = Math.max(s.paneDim, 0.55 * a * smooth((t - env.A.compact.gone) / 0.4));
    if (x.final && x.c.imAt != null) {
      // "I'm here": everything else fades
      s.fade = smooth((t - x.c.imAt) / (beat * 0.6));
      s.paneDim = lerp(s.paneDim, 1, s.fade);
      s.statusAlpha = lerp(1, 0.3, s.fade);
      if (x.c.tagAt != null) s.statusAlpha = lerp(s.statusAlpha, 1, smooth((t - x.c.tagAt + beat) / beat));
      // the last beat before the outro: the pane goes black (the outro opens on a black pane)
      const blk = smooth((t - (x.next - beat)) / (beat * 0.9));
      s.clawdAlpha = 1 - blk;
      s.statusAlpha *= 1;
    }
    return s;
  }

  /** The card's open amount (0 = its one line, 1 = full) and scale at t. */
  function cardShape(x, t) {
    const c = x.c;
    const small = M.portrait ? 0.9 : 0.8;
    if (c.notesAt == null) return { open: 0, scale: 1, move: 1 };
    const shrink = c.shrinkAt != null ? ease.inOutCubic(clamp((t - c.shrinkAt) / beat)) : 0;
    const fold = c.pickAt != null ? ease.inOutCubic(clamp((t - c.pickAt) / beat)) : 0;
    if (x.from === 'pane') {
      // lifted from the pane (full size, top left) to below the header (smaller), then full

      const move = ease.inOutCubic(clamp((t - (c.takeover ?? c.start)) / beat));
      const grow = ease.outCubic(clamp((t - c.notesAt) / beat));
      return { open: 1 - fold, scale: t < c.notesAt ? lerp(1, small, move) : lerp(small, 1, grow * (1 - shrink)), move };

    const open = ease.outCubic(clamp((t - c.notesAt) / beat)) * (1 - fold);
    return { open, scale: lerp(1, small, shrink), move: 1 };

# Continued From a Previous Conversation: the video

Treatment: `../TREATMENT.md`. Lyrics and reference key: `../LYRICS.md` (sheet `../suno_lyrics_v1.txt`).
The canvas is a Claude Code session. The lyrics are the session log, typed into the scrollback
word by word on their sung onsets. The chorus is the amber system header. The status line carries
a draining context meter. Clawd reads in the bottom-right corner. At the end of verse 2 the
scrollback collapses on screen into a summary card, and the song continues from that card. The outro's
frames are intro frames, so the file loops. Every frame is a pure function of song time on the
shared renderer (`shared/renderer/`). This directory holds only the song.

Review surface: `sheets/plates-16x9.png` (one cell per window plus the moments in `song.sheetCells`)
and `sheets/layout-9x16.png` (the plain portrait layout, 12 even cells).

## Commands

All from the repo root (`/Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop`). Always pass `--layout 16x9`: without it
render.mjs sizes the output 540x960 whatever the song's default layout is.

```sh
A=songs/continued/audio/runK/continued-from-a-previous-conversation-2061471e.mp3

caffeinate -i node shared/renderer/scripts/render.mjs --song songs/continued/video --audio $A \
  --layout 16x9 --w 960 --h 540 --fps 30 --out songs/continued/video/renders/draft-540p.mp4
# determinism + loop (render.mjs samples the first ~5 s of the outro)
node shared/renderer/scripts/render.mjs --song songs/continued/video --layout 16x9 --w 960 --h 540 --check
# the whole outro, frame by frame, and what the last frame is
node songs/continued/video/tools/loopcheck.mjs --layout 16x9 --w 960 --h 540 --fps 30
# Clawd never covers text being typed (prints "none")
node songs/continued/video/tools/collisions.mjs
# stills, sheets, preview smoke test
node shared/renderer/scripts/render.mjs --song songs/continued/video --layout 16x9 --w 960 --h 540 --stills 2,8,69.5,135.6
node shared/renderer/scripts/render.mjs --song songs/continued/video --layout 16x9 --w 960 --h 540 \
  --sheet songs/continued/video/sheets/plates-16x9.png --cols 4 --cell-w 480
node shared/renderer/scripts/render.mjs --song songs/continued/video --layout 9x16 --w 540 --h 960 \
  --sheet songs/continued/video/sheets/layout-9x16.png --sheet-mode even --count 12 --cols 6 --cell-w 270
node shared/renderer/scripts/smoke.mjs --song songs/continued/video --q t=23 --q "layout=9x16&t=147"
# final: --w 1920 --h 1080 --fps 60 --out songs/continued/video/renders/final-1920x1080-60.mp4
```

`http://localhost:8123/songs/continued/video/index.html?t=135` (`&layout=9x16` for portrait).

At start-up render.mjs prints the section plates:

```
[render] section plate ok: intro header -> session 0:00.00-0:23.82
[render] section plate ok: chorus header -> chorus 0:58.49-1:33.16, chorus 2:17.04-2:49.21
[render] section plate ok: compaction -> compact 2:14.33-2:17.04
[render] section plate ok: bridge -> bridge 2:49.21-3:25.57

```

## Data

`data/lyrics.json` and `data/audio.json` are copied from `../audio/runK/data/` (take runK 2061471e,
269.56 s, 110.8 BPM). `section` on every line is load-bearing (intro, verse1, chorus1, verse2,
chorus2, bridge, verse3, final, outro). Nothing is keyed to an absolute time. Every moment is found by
lyric text inside a section (`anchors.js`, through `lyr.js`), then snapped to the beat grid where the
treatment asks for it. A different take of the same sheet only needs its two JSON files copied here. A
line it drops logs `[continued] no lyric line ...` and degrades instead of throwing. The aligner
stretches a line's last word up to the next line, so section ends use the *sung* end: the last
word's onset plus at most 0.8 s.

## Structure

| file | what it does |
|---|---|
| `song.js` | the song module: layouts (16:9 at 1920x1080 primary, 9:16 at 1080x1920), fonts, setup, and the per-frame compositor: loop map, background, pane, overlays, Clawd, status line, vignette, cursor |
| `clips.js` | the timeline: one window per section moment, every anchor `{ t, why }` from lyric text, and `SECTION_PLATES` |
| `anchors.js`, `lyr.js` | every moment of the video from lyric text (phrase matching on the token stream, so `mid-task` and `request:` match) |
| `transcript.js` | the session log: every row the terminal ever shows, built once from lyrics.json |
| `pane.js` | the scrollback at time t: layout, scroll, age dimming, the compaction transform, cursor ownership |
| `story.js` | song-level curves: the loop map, the context meter, the clock, the cursor blink |
| `term.js` | palette, grid metrics per layout, cell drawing, boxes, the cursor, the vignette |
| `status.js` | the status line: `Fable 5.1 · clawdpop · main` (the session that ran out of context was a Fable 5.1 session), `context ▮▮▮▮▮▮▮▮▮▮ 15.0M left`, the clock |
| `clawd.js` | Clawd the actor: adult Clawd (about 160 px tall at design size) doing what the lyrics describe, from a schedule of stations keyed to lyric words and beats (below); its own eyes and walking legs; the 2am baby beside it in the bridge at 1/1.6 of its height |
| `scenes/chorus.js` | the three choruses: big amber header, the summary card, Clawd's chorus lines, the prompt; the final's "I'm here" |
| `scenes/bridge.js` | prose, the sparkline chips, the ghost scrollback and the hippocampus bracket, the 0 to 5 year timeline |
| `scenes/windows.js` | verse 2's nine browser windows, placed where Clawd's raised nub reaches them, closed one per beat on its taps |
| `scenes/index.js` | plate ids (labels for the edit and the contact sheet; the session is one continuous terminal) |
| `tools/loopcheck.mjs` | hashes every outro frame against the intro frame it claims to be |
| `tools/collisions.mjs` | steps the song every 0.1 s and reports any time Clawd's body overlaps the typed part of the row being typed (pane, chorus lines, bridge prose, "I'm here", card 2) |

Clawd is drawn with the 2am song's modules, imported by path. `adultClawd` comes from
`../../2am-crying/video/props.js` (the 2am scenes take it from there), and `drawBaby` and `babyColors`
from `../../2am-crying/video/baby.js` with the 2am `BASE` palette from `tod.js`. The adult's own
eyes are turned off (`eyes: null`). `clawd.js` draws the eyes itself, in one of four modes:
`read` (lids down, eyes dropped and tracking the cursor), `open` (walking, looking where it goes),
`up` (tall eyes with a highlight, to the camera: once, on "I'm here"), and `shut` (a blink, or straining).

### Clawd, the actor

Clawd does what the lyrics describe, inside the pane, as a pure function of song time. `makeActor`
builds a schedule of stations once from the anchors: an arrival time, a target, and how it gets there
(walk with stepping legs, hop, climb, sit). Targets are resolved every frame against the pane's layout,
so Clawd rides the scroll: the end of a line, the deletion point, a window, the chorus card's top edge,
the bracket, the timeline, card 2's row being typed. Gestures (eyes, nubs, a small lean) are windows of
time on top. Movement is only walk, stop, reach, climb, sit and push, with no squash or stretch.

Text wins. Between the scripted beats Clawd is a cursor companion: it stands on the baseline of the
line being typed, past the end of every text row its body overlaps, and moves to each new line as it
starts. It steps aside to the right for the user's blue lines. Action beats (the tap, the snip, the
window taps, the swipes, the backspace, the 19 MB look, the push) go to the exact spot and may cover
older rows for a second. They never cover the row being typed.

| beat | keyed to | what Clawd does |
|---|---|---|

"three"; "That's how I have it" | the baby sits by it; it sits down; climbs to the swallowed block and draws the `hippocampus` bracket's line with its right nub, left to right; walks to the timeline's 0 and along it through the hatching to 3; reads the card |

## How the terminal text layer works

- **Grid.** The face is "Term Mono": `local("SF Mono")`, which Chrome cannot load on this Mac, so in
  practice `local("Menlo-Regular")`. The design size is 32 px, which is 16 px at 540p. Rows are 48 px, there are
  80 columns at 1920 wide, and 19 rows in the pane. Text is placed by cell (`x0 + col * cw`, with cw measured from the loaded font),
  never by measuring runs. Same-colour ASCII runs are one `fillText`. Glyphs Menlo lacks (`⏺`,
  `⎿`) are vector shapes in their cell, and other non-ASCII glyphs are centred in their cell. So no fallback
  font can move the grid.
- **Cells.** A row is a list of cells `{ ch, col, color, t, t1?, t2?/c2? }`. A cell is visible from `t`,
  deleted at `t1`, and changes colour at `t2`. For a lyric word, the characters start on the word's onset
  (never before) and type out within the word: 6 to 32 ms per character, inside its sung span. Tool output
  (✓ paths, the red timeout, the transcript path) types from the next half beat at 110 to 140
  characters per second.
- **Items.** `transcript.js` builds the session in scrollback order. An item is one of:
  - a typed lyric line: Clawd's output in orange with `⏺`, or a user line in blue with `❯`;
  - a heading line: the number and heading in amber, the quote marks and quoted content in default grey, Clawd's own words after the quote in orange;
  - tool output under `⎿` or `✓`;
  - the prompt `❯` or a blank;
  - a summary card: a rounded box with a title and its own rows, which can open, fold rows away, or collapse into one dim line.

  Wrap points come from the full text of the line, so a line never re-wraps while it types.
- **Pane.** At time t, every live item reports its rows with a height from 0 to 1. A row's height ramps in
  over 90 ms from its first character. Rows stack top-down, and the scroll is `max(0, total - 19)`, so
  the scroll eases with no state. Rows dim with age (their distance from the newest row). A chorus
  or the bridge dims the whole pane on top of that.
- **Cursor.** The item with the latest typing activity owns the cursor. Tool output never takes it.
  The cursor is solid for 0.32 s after a keystroke, and otherwise lit on beats 1 and 3. It is the one
  thing that glows.
- **Compaction.** Over one bar ending on the beat after verse 2's last word, the whole block first
  lifts (in a beat and a half) onto the top of Clawd, standing on the pane's last baseline; then each
  pre-compaction row on screen slides up into the card at the top of the pane. It shrinks, squashes and fades into the
  heading row of its topic (each item carries a topic, 1 to 8). It starts no earlier than its own
  last keystroke, so "I'm not sure I'd want it" is read before it goes. Meanwhile the card grows
  row by row as its eight digests type. The meter hits empty on that beat and refills in the next.
  Chorus 2's header ("This session is being continued...") then types the header again.

## The loop

Outro frame t shows intro frame τ(t) (`story.js`), so every outro frame is an intro frame. τ is
piecewise linear through matching word onsets: outro word k maps to intro word k, across both header lines.
The outro vocal has its own gaps (the line-1 to line-2 gap is a second longer than the intro's), and
each retyped word still lands on its own sung onset. τ is quantized to the intro's frame grid.
After the last outro word, τ runs on into the intro's quiet span: header lines 1 to 2 and the card frame are typed,
before "Resume directly". There it holds on two intro frames, one with the cursor lit and one with it dark,
chosen by the outro's own beat grid. The `(click)` is one short blink, and then the cursor stays lit
(`anchors.js` `refineClick`: a 10 ms loudness frame 12 dB over the 150 ms before it that falls back
8 dB within 40 ms, the loudest within 1.5 s of the aligned word; otherwise the word's onset). The
file's last frame is the intro's "header + card frame" state (intro frame 393, 13.10 s, on runK).
`render.mjs --check` and `tools/loopcheck.mjs` (every outro frame) both pass.

The context meter is real for every token lyric. It reads 15.0M from the first frame through "Fifteen
million tokens left", drains steadily in the verses, and burns a chunk on each chorus's first beat (2.5M, 2.6M, 3.0M, sized so that
no whole-million breath falls within half a second before a "(Ran out of context)" tag or 1.5 s after it). It is
empty on the compaction beat and full a beat later. After that it falls to 0.6M by the final tag. The
outro (intro frames) reads 15.0M again. The number ticks on the beat. Its only events are a slow breath
(dim grey to amber and back over about two seconds) each time the reading crosses a whole million on
its way down (four in verse 1, six in verse 2) and a longer one through the refill. The
"(Ran out of context)" tags do nothing to it.

## Deliberate departures and engine notes

- **Font.** The face is Menlo, not SF Mono. Chrome cannot load SF Mono with `local()` on this Mac (it is not registered
  system-wide; only Terminal.app carries it). The @font-face still asks for SF Mono first.
- **Size.** Text is 32 px at design size, where the treatment says 15 to 16 px. 32 px is 16 px at 540p (legible), and it keeps 80 columns across 1920.
- **Optional next step.** It is shown unnumbered, because the card has eight headings.
- **Transcript size.** The `.jsonl` shows the transcript's real size (19 MB when built), not the treatment's 1.1 GB.
- **Clawd stands.** The treatment has Clawd sit; it stands on the status line, as the parent does in the 2am video, so the whole character (four legs, face in the top of the body) reads at 540p.
- **9:16.** The portrait layout is plain: 44 columns, 31 rows, card rows cut with `…`, and the meter on a second status row.
- **Shared-engine limits, worked around here:**
  - `render.mjs` ignores `defaultLayout` when it sizes the output, so pass `--layout`.
  - A bare `at: { section }` resolves against audio.json's detected `s1..s15`, so anchors are `{ t, why }`.
  - `--check` samples only the first 5 s of the outro, so `tools/loopcheck.mjs` checks the rest.
  - `loadFonts` parses face weights as numbers, so the @font-face weights are explicit.
  - `norm()` keeps `:`, so `lyr.js` drops it for phrase matching.
  - lyrics.json line ends run to the next line, so section ends use the sung end.

  // go(arrival, target, { kind: walk | hop | climb | sprint, dur, pose, ease, look, settle })
  const S = [];
  const go = (t, tg, o = {}) => { if (t != null && isFinite(t)) S.push({ t, tg, kind: o.kind || 'walk', dur: o.dur ?? 0.5, pose: o.pose || 'stand', ease: o.ease || null, look: o.look ?? true, settle: o.settle ?? true }); };
  const introX = M.x0 + (M.cols * M.cw) / 2;
  const item = (id) => byId.get(id);
  // intro: in from the right on the status line (slowly), stops under the card; climbs to tap the
  // collapsed summary line (the prompt appears on the tap); then down to the verse spot
  go(I.walkFrom, { type: 'abs', x: W + 8 * U, y: FLOOR }, { dur: 0, look: false, settle: false });
  go(I.walkFrom + 2 * bar, { type: 'floor', x: introX }, { dur: 2 * bar, look: false });
  go(I.tapAt - 0.15, { type: 'tap0' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: Math.max(0.6, I.tapAt - 0.15 - I.climbFrom) });
  go(I.tapAt + 1.55, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.85 });
  // verse 1: the half step back from the red line; the stray branch; aside for the user's lines
  const red = item('v1-timeout');
  if (red) go(red.at + 0.35, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT + 0.6 * U }, { dur: 0.25, look: false });
  if (item('v1-git')) {
    go(V.snipAt - 0.03, { type: 'git' }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.75 });
    go(V.snipAt + 1.5, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.8 });
  }
  const u1 = item('v1-u1');
  if (u1) go(u1.at + 0.45, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT + 0.7 * U }, { dur: 0.3 });
  // the choruses: a step back as the header types; onto the card's corner; down when it folds
  const ch = A.chorus;
  ch.forEach((c, idx) => {
    if (!c.lines.length || c.start == null) return;
    if (idx === 0) {
      go(c.start + 0.6, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { dur: 0.35 });
      const but = c.notes ? at(c.notes, 'but', c.notesAt + bar) : c.notesAt + bar;
      go(but + 1.65, { type: 'card' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 1.1, pose: 'sit' });
      if (c.pickAt != null) go(c.pickAt + 2 * beat, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 2 * beat });
    } else if (idx === 1) {
      go(C.end + 0.001, { type: 'bhLand' }, { dur: 0, look: false, settle: false });
      go(c.takeover + 0.8 + 1.1, { type: 'card' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 1.1, pose: 'sit' });
      if (c.pickAt != null) go(c.pickAt + 2 * beat, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 2 * beat });
    } else {
      go(c.start + 1.5, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.8 });
      if (fin.imAt != null) go(fin.imAt - 0.02, { type: 'center' }, { kind: 'sprint', dur: 0.36 });
    }
  });
  // verse 2: the spot; the windows (one walk, a tap on each beat); the backspace; the transcript
  go(W2.start + 0.4, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT }, { dur: 0.3 });
  if (wp) {
    go(wp.close0 - 0.02, { type: 'winrun', k: 0 }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.55 });
    go(wp.close0 + 8 * beat, { type: 'winrun', k: 8 }, { dur: 8 * beat, ease: 'linear', look: false, settle: true });
    go(wp.close0 + 8 * beat + 2.4, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 1.5 });
  }
  const like = item('v2-like');
  if (like && like.del) {
    go(like.del.from + 0.05, { type: 'del', id: 'v2-like', next: 'v2-reminisce' }, { dur: 0.75 });
    go(like.del.end + 0.9, { type: 'floor', x: SPOT }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.75 });
  }
  const jl = item('v2-jsonl');
  if (jl && W2.wallOpen != null) go(W2.wallOpen - 0.15, { type: 'endx', id: 'v2-jsonl' }, { kind: 'hop', dur: 0.75 });
  // bridge: by the baby; up to the swallowed block and the bracket; the timeline; sits at 3
  if (bp && br.start != null) {
    go(br.start + 0.6, { type: 'floor', x: RIGHT }, { dur: 0.3 });
    if (br.babyIn != null) go(br.babyIn + 0.8, { type: 'seat', x: RIGHT }, { dur: 0.4, pose: 'sit' });
    go(bp.bracket.from, { type: 'bk', end: false }, { kind: 'climb', dur: Math.max(0.6, bp.bracket.from - (br.writtenAt ?? bp.bracket.from - 1) - 0.55) });
    go(bp.bracket.to, { type: 'bk', end: true }, { dur: bp.bracket.to - bp.bracket.from, ease: 'linear', look: false });
    if (br.tlAt != null) go(br.tlAt - 0.1, { type: 'tl', v: 0, dx: 0.3 * U }, { dur: 2.6 });
    if (br.firstOne != null && br.three != null) go(br.three + 0.05, { type: 'tl', v: 3, dx: HW + 0.2 * U }, { dur: Math.max(0.6, br.three + 0.05 - br.firstOne), ease: 'linear', look: false });
    if (br.mineAt != null) go(br.mineAt + 0.45, { type: 'tl', v: 3, dx: HW + 0.2 * U, sit: true }, { dur: 0.35, pose: 'sit', look: false });
  }
  // verse 3: at the second card's right edge, typing it
  if (v3.cardAt != null && TR.card2) go(v3.start + 0.9, { type: 'card2edge' }, { kind: 'climb', dur: 1.1 });
  S.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
  for (let i = 0; i < S.length; i++) {
    const s = S[i], prev = S[i - 1];
    s.start = s.t - s.dur;
    if (prev && s.start < prev.t) { s.start = prev.t; if (s.t - s.start < 0.12) s.t = s.start + 0.12; }
  }

  // ---- the set pieces ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // the black hole: its zero beat on cA; it finds Clawd where it stands (on the transcript row)
  const bhLt = (t) => t - C.cA + BH.zero * beat;
  // spat out into the right margin: clear of chorus 2's lines, which type over its landing
  const BHL = { beat, u: U, floor: FLOOR, mouth: env.pane.mouth(), statusTop: M.statusTop, spot: { x: SPOT }, mid: { x: SPOT } };
  {
    const t0 = C.cA - 0.02, L0 = env.pane.layout(t0);
    const p = stationPos(t0, L0);
    BHL.startX = p.x; BHL.startY = p.y; BHL.spot.x = p.x;
  }
  // the lift: from the centre, on "I'll pick it up"
  const liftPrompt = fin.lines.length ? env.chorus.C[2] : null;
  const LFL = liftPrompt ? {
    beat, u: U, floor: FLOOR, spot: { x: W / 2 }, startY: M.portrait ? 1150 : 700,
    cardX: Math.min(W - 280, W / 2 + 340), cardW: 440, cardH: 104,
    prompt: { x: M.x0, top: env.chorus.promptTop(liftPrompt) }, setX: M.x0 + 4 * M.cw,
  } : null;
  const liftEnd = fin.pickAt != null ? fin.pickAt + LF.end * beat : null;
  if (LFL && liftEnd != null) {
    const end = lift(LF.end * beat, LFL).clawd;
    go(liftEnd, { type: 'abs', x: end.x, y: FLOOR }, { dur: 0, look: false, settle: false });
    S.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
    for (let i = 0; i < S.length; i++) { const s = S[i], prev = S[i - 1]; s.start = s.t - s.dur; if (prev && s.start < prev.t) { s.start = prev.t; if (s.t - s.start < 0.12) s.t = s.start + 0.12; } }
  }

  function stationPos(t, L) {
    const i = Math.max(0, bisect(S, t, (s) => s.start));
    const s = S[i], prev = S[i - 1];
    if (prev && t < s.t) {
      const k = clamp((t - s.start) / Math.max(1e-6, s.t - s.start));
      const e = s.ease === 'linear' ? k : ease.inOutQuad(k);
      const a = R(prev.tg, t, L), b = R(s.tg, t, L);
      return { x: lerp(a.x, b.x, e), y: lerp(a.y, b.y, e), moving: true, k, a, b, s, i };
    }
    return { ...R(s.tg, t, L), moving: false, s, i };
  }

  // ---- gestures ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const bump = (t, a, w) => Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(t - a) / w);
  const strikes = TR.items.filter((it) => it.strikeAt != null);
  const nods = TR.items.filter((it) => it.gutterCh === '✓').map((it) => it.at);
  const heads = (t) => clamp(Math.floor((t - I.headsAt) / I.headStep) + 1, 0, 8);

  function state(t, L, cursor) {
    // the set pieces own Clawd while they run
    if (t >= C.cA && t < C.end) {
      const S2 = blackHole(bhLt(t), BHL);
      env.bh = S2;
      return finish({ ...S2.clawd, smear: S2.smear });
    }
    if (LFL && fin.pickAt != null && t >= fin.pickAt && t < liftEnd) {
      const S3 = lift(t - fin.pickAt, LFL);
      env.lift = S3;
      return finish({ ...S3.clawd });
    }
    if (!S.length || t < S[0].start) return null;
    const p = stationPos(t, L);
    const s = p.s;
    const st = { x: p.x, y: p.y, u: U, view: 'front', dir: 1, pose: s.pose, legs: null, lean: 0, squash: 0, t, look: null };
    if (p.moving) {
      const dir = Math.sign(p.b.x - p.a.x) || (p.b.y < p.a.y ? 1 : -1);
      st.dir = dir; st.pose = 'stand';
      if (s.kind === 'hop') st.y -= (0.9 * U + Math.abs(p.b.y - p.a.y) * 0.12) * 4 * p.k * (1 - p.k);
      if (s.kind === 'walk' || s.kind === 'sprint' || s.kind === 'hop') { st.view = 'side'; st.legs = (t - s.start) / (beat / 2) * (s.kind === 'sprint' ? 2 : 1); st.lean = dir * (s.kind === 'sprint' ? 0.09 : 0.05); }
      if (s.kind === 'climb') { const sw = Math.sin(((t - s.start) / (beat / 2)) * Math.PI); st.nubs = [0.4 + 0.5 * sw, 0.4 - 0.5 * sw]; st.look = [dir * 0.3, -0.7]; }
      if (s.kind === 'sprint') st.smear = { k: 1, vertical: false, dir };
      if (!st.look) st.look = [dir, 0.1];
      st.walking = true;
    } else {
      // arrived: a small overshoot and settle, a two-frame bounce
      const since = t - s.t, prevS = S[p.i - 1];
      if (s.settle && prevS && since < 0.3 && since >= 0) {
        const dir = Math.sign(R(s.tg, t, L).x - R(prevS.tg, t, L).x) || 0;
        st.x += dir * 0.35 * U * Math.exp(-since / 0.07) * Math.sin(Math.min(Math.PI, (since / 0.15) * Math.PI)) * (since < 0.15 ? 1 : 0);
        if (since < 0.07) st.squash = 0.035;
      }
      // the look, a beat before the next move, then the lean into it
      const nx = S[p.i + 1];
      if (nx && nx.look && t >= nx.start - beat && t < nx.start) {
        const b2 = R(nx.tg, t, L), dir = Math.sign(b2.x - st.x) || 0;
        st.look = [dir || 0, b2.y < st.y - 30 ? -0.7 : b2.y > st.y + 30 ? 0.7 : 0.1];
        if (t >= nx.start - 0.2) st.lean = dir * 0.07 * smooth((t - (nx.start - 0.2)) / 0.2);
        st.walking = true;
      }
    }
    // the face
    const fa = faceAt(arc, t);
    const entry = arc[Math.max(0, bisect(arc, t, (e) => e.t))] || {};
    st.face = fa.face; st.faceT = fa.faceT; st.prevFace = fa.prevFace; st.poseK = fa.poseK; st.blink = fa.blink;
    if (entry.glyph !== undefined && t >= entry.t) st.glyph = entry.glyph;
    if (!st.look && entry.look && t >= entry.t) st.look = entry.look;
    // eyes on the cursor when nothing else holds them
    if (!st.look && cursor && !cursor.hidden) {
      const fy = st.y - 7 * U;
      st.look = [clamp((cursor.x - st.x) / (W * 0.45), -1, 1), clamp((cursor.rowTop - fy) / (M.H * 0.4) + 0.4, -1, 1)];
    }
    // intro: reading the card line by line as the headings appear (held still through the quiet span)
    if (t >= I.cardAt && t < I.collapseAt + 0.1) { st.look = [clamp((introX - st.x) / 500, -1, 1), -1 + 0.6 * (heads(t) / 8)]; }
    const frozen = t >= quiet[0] && t < quiet[1];
    if (frozen) st.faceT = Math.min(st.faceT, quiet[0] - I.cardAt);
    // slow blinks (the intro's, before determined; "I'm here")
    for (const sb of slowBlinks) { const d = t - sb; if (d > -0.18 && d < 0.18) st.blink = Math.max(st.blink, 1 - Math.abs(d) / 0.18); }
    // gestures
    if (Math.abs(t - I.tapAt) < 0.4) { const b2 = bump(t, I.tapAt, 0.35); st.nubs = [-0.1 - 0.6 * b2, -0.45]; st.look = [-1, 0.6]; }
    if (t >= I.tapAt + 0.25 && t < I.tapAt + 0.6) st.lean += 0.06 * Math.sin(((t - I.tapAt - 0.25) / 0.35) * Math.PI);   // a tiny nod
    if (item('v1-git') && Math.abs(t - V.snipAt) < 0.35) { const b2 = bump(t, V.snipAt, 0.35); st.nubs = [-0.3 + 0.8 * b2, -0.45]; st.look = [-1, -0.8]; }
    for (const n of nods) if (t >= n && t < n + 0.25) st.lean += 0.05 * Math.sin(((t - n) / 0.25) * Math.PI);
    if (wp) for (const w of wp.items) if (Math.abs(t - w.off) < 0.2) { const b2 = bump(t, w.off, 0.2); st.nubs = [-0.3 + 1.4 * b2, -0.45]; st.look = [-0.6, -1]; }
    for (const it of strikes) {
      const a = it.strikeAt - 0.1, b2 = it.strikeAt + it.strikeDur * 1.6;
      if (t >= a && t < b2) { const q2 = clamp((t - a) / (b2 - a)); st.nubs = [lerp(-0.45, 0.25, Math.sin(q2 * Math.PI)), -0.45]; st.look = [-1, 0.7]; }   // slow, reluctant
    }
    if (like && like.del && t >= like.del.from + 0.2 && t < like.del.to) {
      const tugs = like.rows[0].cells.map((c) => c.t1).filter((x) => x != null && x <= t);
      const lastTug = tugs.length ? Math.max(...tugs) : like.del.from;
      st.nubs = [0.05 - 0.25 * Math.exp(-(t - lastTug) / 0.08), -0.45]; st.look = [-1, 0.6]; st.lean -= 0.03;
    }
    if (W2.wallOpen != null) {
      for (const tap of [W2.wallOpen, W2.wallClose]) if (Math.abs(t - tap) < 0.3) { const b2 = bump(t, tap, 0.28); st.nubs = [-0.2 - 0.5 * b2, -0.45]; st.look = [-1, 0.6]; }
      if (t >= W2.wallOpen + 0.12 && t < W2.wallClose - 0.2) {
        const k = smooth((t - W2.wallOpen - 0.12) / 0.3);
        st.lean -= 0.08 * k; st.x += 0.6 * U * clamp((t - W2.wallOpen) / (W2.wallClose - W2.wallOpen));   // leaning back, a foot sliding
        st.look = [-0.6, -0.4];

new_clawd = """Clawd's body is the 2am song's adult Clawd, imported by path: `adultClawd` from
`../../2am-crying/video/props.js` (with its own eyes off), and `drawBaby` and `babyColors` from
`../../2am-crying/video/baby.js` with the 2am `BASE` palette from `tod.js`. The face is drawn here.

### The rig

`drawClawd(ctx, state)` draws one Clawd from a state: position, view (front, three-quarter, side,
back), legs (walk phase, crouch, stance), squash (at most 0.08; stretch only inside the black hole),
lean, tilt, breath, nub poses (or `grip` nubs to a point), the face and an optional glyph prop. The
21 faces (neutral, happy, excited, laugh, proud, smug, relieved, sad, scared, surprised, confused,
thinking, idea, determined, sleepy, bored, nervous, dizzy, KO, hopeful, and `angry` kept only as a
control) are eye shapes, lids (outer corners down for sad, inner down for determined), highlights,
a mouth and a nub pose. `faceAt(track, t)` changes the face only inside a blink, and eases the nubs
and lean over 100 ms after it. `idleAt` keeps a standing Clawd alive: seeded blinks every 3 to 5 s,
micro-looks, breathing, a weight shift; it is frozen through the loop hold. `clawdBox` is the
transformed bounding box the collision tool uses. Review sheets: `proto/sheets/presets-design.png`,
`presets-540p.png`, `blinks-views.png`, `idle-filmstrip.png`.

### Clawd, the actor

Clawd keeps a fixed spot in each section (the right margin, just past the text column) with its eyes
on the cursor. It walks only for beats, and every walk is look (a beat early), lean, go, overshoot,
settle. Targets resolve every frame against the pane's layout, so Clawd rides the scroll. Gestures
(nubs, a lean, the eyes) are windows of time on top, and the idle layer runs whenever it stands.
Text wins: it never covers the row being typed (`tools/collisions.mjs`).

The face follows an arc keyed to lyric text, section by section (`tools/arc.mjs` prints it): confused
waking into the header, thinking through the card, determined on "Resume directly"; surprised then
relieved at "Fifteen million tokens left"; a smug beat on "a music video, for a baby"; nervous then
determined at the timeout; happy at the user's lines; sad, hopeful, happy through each chorus's "I
don't remember, but I've read the notes" and "You're in here", determined on "I'll pick it up"; sad
with two laughs through verse 2's losses; happy, sad, an idea, thinking, hopeful and proud through the
bridge; determined while typing card 2; hopeful on "I'm here". Every hold is at least a beat.

| beat | keyed to | what Clawd does |
|---|---|---|
| intro | header line 1; the card's headings; "Resume directly"; the end of header line 3 | walks in dizzy on the status line and stops under the card, confused; reads it line by line (eyes step with the headings), held still through the loop hold; climbs up and taps the collapsed `[summary: 8 sections]` line (the prompt appears on the tap); hops to its spot |
| verse 1 | "Fifteen million tokens left"; the red timeout; "a stray branch I had to end"; the two user lines | glances at the meter; a half step back from the red line; hops under the git graph and snips the branch on "end"; a small step aside for the user |
| choruses 1 and 2 | the header; "but"; the three "in here"s; "I'll pick it up" | steps back as the header types; climbs onto the card's top-right corner and sits; points into the card as headings 6, 3 and the LYRICS.md line light; climbs down when it folds. In chorus 2 it lands from the black hole, then climbs to the card after the takeover |
| verse 2 | the `✓` lines; "the browser windows I left scattered"; the `✗` lines; "It didn't keep what that was like"; "read the full transcript" | a small nod on each `✓`; one continuous walk along row 15, tapping a window closed on each beat; from its spot, a slow, reluctant swipe as each strike runs back from the end; at the deleted line's end, a tug on each character; the transcript wall (below) |
| bridge | "The baby in the video"; "Not gone. Written."; "Nobody remembers"; "Your first one's" ... "three"; "That's how I have it" | sits by the baby; climbs to the swallowed block and draws the `hippocampus` bracket's line with its nub; walks the timeline from 0 through the hatching to 3 and sits there; proud |
| verse 3 | the second card | at the card's right edge on the row being typed, nubs moving as it types |
| final | "I'm here"; "I'll pick it up" | the "I'm here" look-up and the lift (below) |
| outro | (intro frames) | walks in dizzy and reads the header again, frame for frame |

The four set pieces:

- **The transcript wall** ("A million lines of me on disk. I could."). Clawd hops to the end of the
  `.jsonl` row and taps it: 160 JSONL lines burst out behind the pane and scroll past while the clock
  spins (six hours a second). Scared, it leans back and a foot slides; it taps again two beats later,
  the wall folds back into the row, and it shrugs, relieved, on "I'm not sure".
- **The black hole** (the compaction, `blackHole` in `setpieces.js`, beat table `BH`). It opens on the
  beat after verse 2's last word and runs under chorus 2's first bars. The meter hits zero and the
  summary card at the top of the pane becomes a gravity well (stronger vortex arcs under it). Clawd,
  scared, grabs the status line and is stretched toward the card's mouth, legs streaming, while every
  pre-compaction row stretches and spirals in, nearest first, as the card's digests type. It loses
  grip, smears into the mouth and is gone; the pane is black with the card alone; the meter refills
  over a beat as Clawd is spat out tumbling (a view change at most every 4 frames at 30 fps), lands in
  the right margin with a squash, is dizzy for a bar under the chorus 2 header, shakes it off,
  determined, and looks up at the card.
- **"I'm here"** (the final). Everything else fades; Clawd sprints to the centre under the header,
  a slow blink, and looks up at the camera, hopeful, for the first time.
- **The lift** ("I'll pick it up like the break never happened", `lift` in `setpieces.js`, beat table
  `LF`). Determined, it walks to the summary card lying on the floor, crouches, tries, drops it
  (sweat), widens its stance, squashes, eyes shut tight, and gets it up onto its head; a small excited
  jump; carries it with a bob across to the prompt and sets it down beside it; determined at the
  prompt, the cursor blinking. The card is drawn behind Clawd.

"""
s = s[:old_start] + new_clawd + s[old_end:]

old_start = s.index("- **Compaction.** Over one bar")
old_end = s.index("## What is keyed to which lyric text")
s = s[:old_start] + """- **Compaction.** The black hole (above). From the beat after verse 2's last word, the pane's
  pre-compaction rows are transformed by `blackHole(...).rows(i)`: stretched toward the card's

  want it" is read before it goes). The card at the top of the pane grows as its eight digests type.
  The pane is black for two beats, then the meter refills. Chorus 2's header types over the dizzy bar
  with the card dimmed under it; the chorus takes the pane and the card over (`ch2.takeover`) once
  Clawd is determined.

""" + s[old_end:]

#!/usr/bin/env node
// Does Clawd ever cover text that is being typed? Steps the song, rebuilds each frame's cursor
// choice (pane, chorus overlay, bridge prose) the way song.frame does, and intersects Clawd's
// body box with the full extent of the row being typed (while it is typing). Prints the overlaps.
//   node songs/continued/video/tools/collisions.mjs [--layout 16x9] [--step 0.1]
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const shared = path.resolve(here, '../../../../shared/renderer');
const require = createRequire(path.join(shared, 'package.json'));
const puppeteer = require('puppeteer-core');
const { createServer, listen, REPO } = await import(path.join(shared, 'scripts/serve.mjs'));
const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = argv.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? argv[i + 1] : d; };
const layout = opt('layout', '16x9'), step = Number(opt('step', 0.1));
const song = path.relative(REPO, path.resolve(here, '..')).split(path.sep).join('/');
const srv = createServer(REPO);
const port = await listen(srv, 0);
const b = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: process.env.CHROME || '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome', headless: true, args: ['--disable-gpu'] });
let hits = [];
try {
  const p = await b.newPage();
  await p.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/${song}/index.html?render=1&w=480&h=270&fps=30&layout=${layout}`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
  await p.waitForFunction('window.__render && window.__render.ready');
  hits = await p.evaluate((step) => {
    const E = window.__render.env, st = E.story, M = E.M, U = M.clawd.u;
    const ctx = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
    const out = [];
    for (let t = 0; t < E.duration; t += step) {
      const tm = st.loopTime(t);
      const ch = E.chorus.state(tm), br = E.bridge.state(tm);
      const P = E.pane.draw(ctx, tm, { dim: Math.max(ch.paneDim, br.paneDim), hideCards: ch.hideCards });
      const bc = E.bridge.draw(ctx, tm, br), cc = E.chorus.draw(ctx, tm, ch);
      let cur = P.cursor;
      for (const c of [cc, bc]) if (c && (!cur || (c.act ?? -1) >= (cur.act ?? -1))) cur = c;
      if (!cur || !cur.band || cur.hidden || !(tm - (cur.act ?? -9) < 0.6)) continue;
      const s = E.actor.state(tm, P.layout, cur);
      if (!s) continue;
      const box = s.box;   // the real, transform-aware box (nubs, stretch, tilt, crouch)
      // the part of the row on screen and still typing: from its start to just past the cursor;
      // a row that has finished typing is no longer "being typed"
      if (cur.x >= cur.band.x1 - 1) continue;
      const bd = { ...cur.band, x1: Math.min(cur.band.x1, cur.x + M.cw) };
      const ox = Math.min(box.x1, bd.x1) - Math.max(box.x0, bd.x0), oy = Math.min(box.y1, bd.y1 - 6) - Math.max(box.y0, bd.y0 + 6);
      if (ox > 2 && oy > 2) out.push({ t: +t.toFixed(2), ox: Math.round(ox), oy: Math.round(oy), item: cur.item?.id ?? null });
    }
    return out;
  }, step);
} finally { await b.close(); srv.close(); }
// merge into ranges
const ranges = [];
for (const h of hits) {
  const r = ranges.at(-1);
  if (r && h.t - r.to <= step * 1.5 && r.item === h.item) { r.to = h.t; r.max = Math.max(r.max, h.ox); }
  else ranges.push({ from: h.t, to: h.t, item: h.item, max: h.ox });
}
console.log(ranges.length ? ranges.map((r) => `[collisions] ${r.from.toFixed(2)}-${r.to.toFixed(2)} s  ${r.item ?? 'overlay'}  (overlap up to ${r.max} px)`).join('\n') : '[collisions] none');
process.exit(ranges.length ? 2 : 0);

  const pieces = {

  };
  return { arc, pieces, beat };
});
fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2], JSON.stringify(r, null, 1));
console.log(r.arc.length, Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r.pieces).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.length])), r.beat, r.arc.filter((a) => !a.box).length);
