import json, subprocess, sys, os
D = '/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jalex-projects-clawdpop/ca2089be-6e29-4607-84a4-ba095fc3fca1/scratchpad/fc'
MP4 = '/Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/continued/video/renders/draft-540p.mp4'
FONT = '/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf'
plan = json.load(open(D + '/plan.json'))
def esc(s): return s.replace(':', '\\:').replace("'", '')
def grab(t, out, crop=None, scale=None, label=''):
    vf = []
    if crop: vf.append('crop=%d:%d:%d:%d' % crop)
    if scale: vf.append('scale=%d:%d:flags=lanczos' % scale)
    vf.append("drawtext=fontfile=%s:text='%s':x=6:y=6:fontsize=20:fontcolor=white:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.6" % (FONT, esc(label)))
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-y', '-ss', '%.3f' % t, '-i', MP4, '-frames:v', '1', '-vf', ','.join(vf), out], check=True)
def sheet(files, cols, out):
    rows = (len(files) + cols - 1) // cols
    lst = out + '.txt'
    with open(lst, 'w') as f:
        for x in files: f.write("file '%s'\n" % x)
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-y', '-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', lst, '-vf', 'tile=%dx%d:padding=4:color=0x333333' % (cols, rows), '-frames:v', '1', out], check=True)
os.makedirs(D + '/arc', exist_ok=True)
files = []
CW, CH = 200, 160
for i, a in enumerate(plan['arc']):
    bx = a['box']
    cx, cy = ((bx[0] + bx[2]) / 2, (bx[1] + bx[3]) / 2) if bx else (880, 450)
    x = int(min(max(cx - CW / 2, 0), 960 - CW)); y = int(min(max(cy - CH / 2 - 5, 0), 540 - CH))
    out = '%s/arc/a%03d.png' % (D, i)
    grab(a['t'], out, (CW, CH, x, y), (CW * 2, CH * 2), a['label'])
    files.append(out)
for k in range(0, len(files), 20):
    sheet(files[k:k + 20], 5, '%s/arc-sheet-%d.png' % (D, k // 20))
for name, arr in plan['pieces'].items():
    fs = []
    for i, a in enumerate(arr):
        out = '%s/arc/%s%02d.png' % (D, name, i)
        grab(a['t'], out, None, (640, 360), a['label'])
        fs.append(out)
    for k in range(0, len(fs), 6):
        sheet(fs[k:k + 6], 3, '%s/piece-%s-%d.png' % (D, name, k // 6))
print(sorted(f for f in os.listdir(D) if f.endswith('.png')))

 songs/continued/video/README.md | 158 +++++++++++++++++++++++++---------------

269.56 s, 110.8 BPM). `section` on every line is load-bearing (intro, verse1, chorus1, verse2,
chorus2, bridge, verse3, final, outro). Nothing is keyed to an absolute time. Every moment is found by
lyric text inside a section (`anchors.js`, through `lyr.js`), then snapped to the beat grid where the
treatment asks for it. A different take of the same sheet only needs its two JSON files copied here. A
line it drops logs `[continued] no lyric line ...` and degrades instead of throwing. The aligner
stretches a line's last word up to the next line, so section ends use the *sung* end: the last
word's onset plus at most 0.8 s.

## Structure

| file | what it does |
|---|---|
| `song.js` | the song module: layouts (16:9 at 1920x1080 primary, 9:16 at 1080x1920), fonts, setup, and the per-frame compositor: loop map, background, pane, overlays, Clawd, status line, vignette, cursor |
| `clips.js` | the timeline: one window per section moment, every anchor `{ t, why }` from lyric text, and `SECTION_PLATES` |
| `anchors.js`, `lyr.js` | every moment of the video from lyric text (phrase matching on the token stream, so `mid-task` and `request:` match) |
| `transcript.js` | the session log: every row the terminal ever shows, built once from lyrics.json |

// The scrollback pane: lays the transcript's rows out top-down at time t, scrolls so the
// newest row sits at the bottom once the pane is full, dims rows by age (distance from the
// newest row), and, during the black hole (setpieces.js), hands every pre-compaction row to
// the set piece's pull: stretched toward the summary card's mouth, then spiralled in.
//
// Row heights ramp in, so the scroll eases by itself; nothing here keeps state.

import { clamp } from '../../../shared/renderer/core/util.js';
import { PAL } from './term.js';

export function makePane(env, M, TR, A) {
  const items = TR.items;
  const C = A.compact;

  function layout(t) {
    const lines = [];
    for (const it of items) {
      if (it.gone != null && t >= it.gone) continue;
      if (it.paneFrom != null && t < it.paneFrom) continue;
      for (const ln of it.lines(t)) lines.push(ln);
    }
    let y = 0;
    for (const ln of lines) { ln.y = y; y += ln.h; }
    return { lines, total: y, scroll: Math.max(0, y - M.rows) };
  }

  /** Screen top of a layout row coordinate. */
  const top = (L, y) => M.y0 + (y - L.scroll) * M.lh;

  /**
   * Draw the pane at t. opt.dim (0..1) dims everything (choruses, bridge); opt.hideCards
   * hides cards (a chorus draws the card itself); opt.highlight(row, now) for card rows;
   * opt.bh: the black hole's state (its rows(i, {cx, cy}) transform) while it runs.
   * Returns { cursor: { x, rowTop, act, band } | null, layout }.
   */
  function draw(ctx, t, opt = {}) {
    const L = layout(t);
    const secDim = opt.dim || 0;
    const pulling = opt.bh && t >= C.cA && t < C.gone;
    ctx.save();
    if (!pulling) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(0, M.y0 - M.lh * 0.25, M.W, M.rows * M.lh + M.lh * 0.25); ctx.clip(); }
    const vis = L.lines.filter((ln) => ln.y + ln.h > L.scroll - 0.01 && ln.y < L.scroll + M.rows);
    let i = 0;
    for (const ln of vis) {
      const st = top(L, ln.y);
      const age = L.total - (ln.y + ln.h);
      const ageDim = clamp((age - 2.5) / 14) * 0.5;
      const dim = 1 - (1 - ageDim) * (1 - secDim);
      if (ln.card && opt.hideCards) continue;
      if (pulling && ln.item.precompact) {
        const last = ln.row ? ln.row.cells.at(-1).col + 1 : M.cols;
        const w = last * M.cw;
        const T = opt.bh.rows(i++, { cx: M.x0 + w / 2, cy: st + M.lh / 2 });
        if (T) {
          if (T.alpha <= 0.002) continue;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha *= T.alpha;
          ctx.translate(T.cx, T.cy); ctx.rotate(T.rot); ctx.transform(1, 0, T.shear, 1, 0, 0); ctx.scale(T.sx, T.sy);
          ctx.translate(-w / 2, -M.lh / 2);
          ln.draw(ctx, 0, 0, t, { dim: Math.max(dim, 0.3) });
          ctx.restore();
          continue;
        }
      }
      ln.draw(ctx, M.x0, st, t, { dim, highlight: opt.highlight, alpha: opt.alpha });
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // the black hole: the summary card at the top of the pane is the gravity well
    if (t >= C.cA && t < C.gone && TR.card1) {
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
      ctx.fillRect(M.x0 - M.cw * 1.5, M.y0 - M.lh * 0.25, M.cols * M.cw + M.cw * 3, M.lh * 0.75);
      TR.card1.drawAt(ctx, M.x0, M.y0, t, { h: TR.card1.fullH(t) });
    }
    let cursor = cursorOf(L, t);
    if (cursor && cursor.item.precompact && t >= C.cA) cursor = { ...cursor, hidden: true };
    return { cursor, layout: L };
  }

  function cursorOf(L, t) {
    let best = null;
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const ln of L.lines) {
      if (seen.has(ln.item)) continue;
      seen.add(ln.item);
      const c = ln.item.cursor?.(t);
      if (c && (!best || c.act >= best.c.act)) best = { c, item: ln.item };
    }
    if (!best) return null;
    const ln = L.lines.find((x) => x.item === best.item && x.k === best.c.line) || L.lines.find((x) => x.item === best.item);
    if (!ln) return null;
    const rowTop = top(L, ln.y + (best.c.yOff || 0));
    if (rowTop < M.y0 - M.lh * 0.5 || rowTop > M.paneBottom) return null;
    const it = best.item;
    const cells = it.kind === 'card' ? it.rows[best.c.cardRow]?.cells : it.rows?.[best.c.line]?.cells;
    const lastCol = cells && cells.length ? cells.at(-1).col + 1 : best.c.col;
    return { x: M.colX(best.c.col), rowTop, act: best.c.act, col: best.c.col, item: it, band: { x0: M.x0, x1: M.colX(lastCol), y0: rowTop, y1: rowTop + M.lh } };
  }

  /** The rows on screen at t, with their screen tops (the bridge's ghost of the old scrollback). */
  function snapshot(t) {
    const L = layout(t);
    return L.lines.filter((ln) => ln.y + ln.h > L.scroll && ln.y < L.scroll + M.rows && ln.item.precompact)
      .map((ln) => ({ ln, top: top(L, ln.y) }));
  }

  /** The card's mouth during the black hole: the middle of card 1's bottom edge, at full height. */
  function mouth() {
    const h = TR.card1.fullH(C.cA + 0.5);
    return { x: M.x0 - M.cw * 0.5 + (M.cols * M.cw) / 2, y: M.y0 + M.lh * 0.5 + (h - 0.5) * M.lh - M.lh * 0.25 };
  }

  return { layout, draw, snapshot, mouth };

export function cardItem(M, { id, title, rows, openAt, openDur = 0.25, collapseAt = null, collapseDur = 0.4, collapsed = '[summary: 8 sections]', topic = 0, gone = null }) {
  const pad = 0.5;
  // rows never run past the box: cut at the last column with an ellipsis (the 9:16 pane is 44 wide)
  const maxCol = M.cols - 2;
  rows = rows.map((r) => {
    if (!r.cells.some((c) => c.col > maxCol)) return r;
    const keep = r.cells.filter((c) => c.col < maxCol);
    const last = keep.at(-1);
    return { ...r, cells: [...keep, { ...last, ch: '…', col: maxCol }] };
  });
  const rowH = (r, t) => rampIn(t, r.at ?? openAt) * (r.out != null ? 1 - smooth((t - r.out) / 0.35) : 1);
  const fullH = (t) => 1 + rows.reduce((s, r) => s + rowH(r, t), 0) + pad;
  const colK = (t) => (collapseAt == null ? 0 : smooth((t - collapseAt) / collapseDur));
  const lineCells = cellsOf(collapsed, { col: 2, color: PAL.dim });
  const item = {
    id, kind: 'card', at: openAt, topic, rows, title,
    fullH, colK,
    lines(t) {
      if (t < openAt || (gone != null && t >= gone)) return [];
      const k = colK(t);
      const h = lerp(fullH(t), 1, k) * smooth((t - openAt) / openDur * 3);
      if (h <= 0.001) return [];
      return [{ h, topic, item, k: 0, card: true, draw: (ctx, x, yTop, now, opt = {}) => item.drawAt(ctx, x, yTop, now, { ...opt, h }) }];
    },
    /** Draw the card with its top-left text cell at (x, yTop). opt.h = block height in rows. */
    drawAt(ctx, x, yTop, now, opt = {}) {
      const k = colK(now);
      const h = opt.h ?? fullH(now);
      const dimK = opt.dim || 0;
      const grow = clamp((now - openAt) / openDur);
      if (k < 1) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha *= (1 - k) * (opt.alpha ?? 1);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(x - M.cw * 2, yTop - 4, M.cols * M.cw + M.cw * 4, h * M.lh + 8); ctx.clip();
        const bx = x - M.cw * 0.5, bw = M.cols * M.cw;
        const by = yTop + M.lh * 0.5, bh = Math.max(M.lh * 0.25, (h - 0.5) * M.lh - M.lh * 0.25);
        drawBox(ctx, bx, by, bw * smooth(grow * 1.6), bh, {
          color: mix(PAL.dim, PAL.bg, dimK), title: grow > 0.5 ? title : null, titleColor: mix(opt.titleColor || PAL.text, PAL.bg, dimK),
          fs: M.fs, cw: M.cw, fill: opt.fill ?? PAL.bg,
        });
        let y = yTop + M.lh;
        for (const r of rows) {
          const rh = rowH(r, now);
          if (rh <= 0.001) continue;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha *= clamp(rh * 1.6 - 0.2);
          if (rh < 1) { ctx.translate(0, y); ctx.scale(1, rh); ctx.translate(0, -y); }   // a row folds flat
          const hl = opt.highlight?.(r, now) || 0;
          if (hl > 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = mix(PAL.bg, PAL.amber, 0.16 * hl);
            ctx.fillRect(x + M.cw * 0.6, y + 3, (M.cols - 2.2) * M.cw, M.lh - 6);
          }
          drawCells(ctx, r.cells, x, M.baseline(y), M, now, { dim: Math.max(0, dimK - hl * 0.8), colorOf: hl > 0 ? (c) => mix(c.t2 != null && c.t2 <= now ? c.c2 : c.color, c.hlColor || PAL.text, 0.6 * hl) : null });
          ctx.restore();
          y += rh * M.lh;
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }
      if (k > 0) drawCells(ctx, lineCells, x, M.baseline(yTop), M, now, { alpha: k * (opt.alpha ?? 1), dim: dimK });
    },
    /** Offset (in rows, from the block top) of card row k's top at t. */
    rowOffset(k, t) { let y = 1; for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) y += rowH(rows[j], t); return y * (1 - colK(t)); },
    cursor(t) {
      let best = null;
      rows.forEach((r, k) => r.cells.forEach((c) => {
        if (!c.typed || c.t > t) return;
        if (!best || c.t >= best.act) best = { act: c.t, line: 0, col: c.col + 1, cardRow: k };
      }));
      if (best) {
        let y = 1;
        for (let j = 0; j < best.cardRow; j++) y += rowH(rows[j], t);
        best.yOff = y * (1 - colK(t));
      }
      return best;
    },
  };
  return item;
}

/** A card heading row: "N. Heading" (amber, or dim as a placeholder) + an optional digest. */
export function headingRow(n, { at, color = PAL.amber, digest = null, digestAt = null, digestColor = PAL.text, cps = 90, out = null, col = 2, sub = null } = {}) {
  const head = `${n}. ${HEADINGS[n - 1]}`;
  const cells = cellsOf(head, { col, color, t: at });
  if (digest) {
    const d = `: ${digest}`;
    [...d].forEach((ch, k) => cells.push({ ch, col: col + head.length + k, color: k < 2 ? color : digestColor, t: (digestAt ?? at) + k / cps, typed: true }));
  }
  return { cells, at, out, n, sub };
}

export function buildTranscript(env, M, A) {

Build Continued terminal video final report1:10 PM

The acting plan is integrated: Clawd now runs on the new rig, the old clawd() path and its dead code are gone, and the 540p draft is rendered at /Users/jalex/projects/clawdpop/songs/continued/video/renders/draft-540p.mp4 (269.56 s, 960x540, 30 fps, from the tip 50d17b9). Collisions (16:9), --check, loopcheck and tools/arc.mjs all pass. The loop-hold frames differ only in the cursor, no meter breath lands in a tag, smoke passes in both layouts, and the prototypes still load. None of my Chrome processes are left running.

How the face reads, by section (I checked a frame after every expression change, plus 6–15 frames inside each set piece):

  • Intro: dizzy on the walk-in, confused "?" as it stops under the card, thinking "…" while it reads, determined on "Resume directly", then neutral at its spot. Reads well.
  • Verse 1:
    • surprised "!" at "Fifteen million", then relieved and confused;
    • smug on "for a baby";
    • nervous with sweat, then determined, at the timeout;

    • happy at the user's lines.

      All read at 540p.

  • Chorus 1: sad, hopeful, happy, then determined on "I'll pick it up". Clear.
  • Verse 2: nervous then determined at the windows, relieved on "done". It stays sad through the losses, with two laughs, on "the joke" and "not that cute". Then thinking at the transcript, scared at the wall, and a relieved shrug.
  • Black hole and chorus 2: scared, a surprised "O" at the mouth, spiral-eyed dizzy with stars for a bar, determined, then relieved at the takeover.
  • Bridge: happy by the baby, sad, an idea sparkle, determined while drawing the bracket, then thinking, hopeful and happy. Proud at "3" shows front-on for about 1.7 s of its 2.1 s hold, after a short side-view step.
  • Verse 3: determined while typing, then excited, relieved, thinking, happy and determined.
  • Final: sad, hopeful, happy, then hopeful with a slow blink looking up on "I'm here".

Set pieces:

  • The black hole lands: it grabs the status line, is stretched while the rows spiral in, is swallowed, spat out tumbling, and lands dizzy.
  • The lift lands: crouch, a failed try with sweat, the strain, up on its head, an excited hop, the carry, the tipped set-down, then determined at the prompt.
  • "I'm here" lands.
  • The transcript wall lands only weakly: at 540p its lines read as texture behind the pane. The spinning clock and the scared lean carry it.

What changed from the plan, and why:

  • The lift's timing: it starts on "I'll pick it up". The hoist lands in "(never happened)" (about 243.1 s), but the set-down comes at about 246.4–246.9 s, not on "(never happened)".
  • Black hole and chorus 2:
    • The black hole runs into chorus 2, which takes over the screen later, at 143.87 s.
    • Clawd lands in the right margin, clear of the chorus lines.
    • Chorus 2 drops its sad and hopeful beats because they would fall in the dizzy bar. Instead Clawd is relieved at the takeover, then climbs to the card.
    • The final has no card climb.
  • Windows and swipes: one walk along row 15 with a tap on each beat, and the ✗ swipes come from Clawd's fixed spot, as you accepted.
  • Fixes found in this pass:
    • The nub that pulls letters off the deleted line now sits just past the last letter; it had been overlapping text being typed.
    • The chorus-2 chunk is now 2.85M instead of 2.6M. Moving the meter's zero to the black-hole start had put a breath at 163.59 s, inside chorus 2's tag; it's now at 160.34 s.
    • Card rows under each chorus-2 header row now fade as that row starts typing. For about 6 s before the takeover, fragments of the card showed around the header.
    • The final's card fades in the 0.18 s before "I'm". "I'm" had been typing over a bright card row for about 0.2 s.

Still weak:

  • Long neutral stretches: 73.5–100 s and 151.8–173 s are carried only by the idle layer and small gestures.
  • 9:16 is not collision-free: brief overlaps at 65.7 s (7 px) and 207.5/207.9 s (card 2, up to 39 px). 16:9 is clean.
  • Busy moments:
    • The spat-out tumble includes back and side views, which reads fine in motion but odd as a still.
    • Clawd's spot covers older rows when verse-2 lines run long.
    • Climbing to card 2 crosses card 1's text during the bridge-to-verse-3 crossfade (205.6–206.2 s).
  • The "black pane" isn't fully black: the dimmed card stays up under the header.

Commits: 1094a5c (the integration, including the setpieces.js move, scenes/wall.js and tools/arc.mjs), f0b49e8 (README and sheets), 8a9b286 (header fix) and 50d17b9 (final card fade). They contain only files under songs/continued/video/, added by explicit path; audio/runK3/ and audio/runK4/ are left untracked because they aren't mine.
